tgt: Kabinete e lemogile gore Aforika Borwa e dirile segopotso sa Letsatsi la Boditšhabatšhaba la Ditšhabakopano le le kgatlhanong le Tiriso e e botlhaswa ya Diritibatsi le go Gweba ka Batho go go Seng mo Molaong ka la bo 26 Seetebosigo 2013, kwa Kimberley.

src: The Day was used to emphasise the importance of dealing with challenges facing the world, including crime, HIV and AIDS, moral degeneration, domestic violence and teenage pregnancy.
tgt: Letsatsi leo le diriseditswe go gatelela botlhokwa jwa go samagana le dikgwetlho tse di lebaneng lefatshe, tse di akaretsang bosenyi, HIV le AIDS, go nyelela ga maitsholo, tirisodikgoka mo malapeng le boimana jwa basetsanyana.

src: Cabinet welcomes the hosting of the Science, Technology and Innovation Summit which takes place from 20 to 21 July.
tgt: Kabinete e amogela go amogelwa ga Samiti ya Saense, Thekenoloji le Boitlhamedi, e e diragalang go tloga ka la bo 20 go ya go la bo 21 Phukwi.

src: The summit will address a recommendation of the Ministerial Review Committee report, improved coordination and integration within the National System of Innovation and strengthened dialogue between government, industry and academia.
tgt: Samiti e tla lebelela katlenegiso ya pegelo ya Komiti ya Tshekatsheko ya Ditona, tomagano le kgokaganyo e e tokafetseng mo Thulaganyong ya Bosetšhaba ya Boitlhamedi le dipuisano tse di maatlafetseng magareng ga puso, madirelo le barutegi.

src: Cabinet welcomes the report on progress made in Muyexe village in Giyani, Limpopo province in the implementation of commitments made by government to improve the lives of the people.
tgt: Kabinete e amogela pegelo e e ka ga tswelelopele e e dirilweng kwa motseng wa Muyexe kwa Giyani, kwa Porofenseng ya Limpopo mo go tsenngweng tirisong ga maitlamo a a dirilweng ke puso go tokafatsa matshelo a batho.

src: Cabinet further echoed the President’s concern that all levels of government should speed up delivery as per the agreed plans.
tgt: Gape kabinete e boeleditse matshwenyego a Moporesitente a gore magato otlhe a puso a tshwanetse go akofisa tlamelo ya ditirelo go ya ka maano a go dumelanweng ka ona.

src: Cabinet welcomes the launch on Saturday, 29 June 2013 of SIP-18 which relates to the issues of infrastructure for the purpose of delivering on water and sanitation.
tgt: Kabinete e amogela go tlhomiwa ga Porojeke ya Mafaratlhatlha a Togamaano ya bo 18 ka Lamatlhatso, la bo 29 Seetebosigo 2013, e e amanang le dintlha tsa mafaratlhatlha le maitlhomo a go tlamela ka metsi le kgelelo ya leswe.

src: The project will ensure the provision of sustainable supply of water to meet social needs and support economic growth.
tgt: Porojeke e tla netefatsa tlamelo e e nnelang ruri ya metsi go fitlhelela ditlhokego tsa loago le go tshegetsa kgolo ya ikonomi.

src: Cabinet welcomed a briefing it received on cartel activities in the construction sector.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse pegelo eo e e amogetseng malebana le ditiro tsa digongwana mo lephateng la dikonteraka.

src: Cabinet welcomes the outcome of the investigation that yielded evidence of pervasive price fixing, collusion and corruption in the private construction industry.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse dipoelo tsa dipatlisiso tse di tlhagisitseng bopaki jwa go okediwa ga ditlhotlhwa go go seng mo molaong, ditumelano tsa bogodu le bobodu mo intasetering ya dikonteraka tsa poraefete.

src: The scale of the collusion warrants firm action by the competition authorities.
tgt: Seelo sa ditumelano tseno tsa bogodu se tlhoka dikgato tse di gagametseng tsa bothati jwa kgaisano.

src: Cabinet awaits the outcome of the Competition Tribunal process but notes that the evidence shows substantial damage to the public interest with inflated prices that the state paid as a result of the collusion."
tgt: Kabinete e emetse ditshweetso tsa tsamaiso ya Kgotla ya Dikgaisano fela e lemoga bopaki jo bo supang tshenyo e e boitshegang mo dikgatlhegong tsa setšhaba moo mmuso o duetseng ditlhotlhwa tse di kwa godimo thata ka ntlha ya ditumelano tseno tsa bogodu.

src: Key Cabinet discussions and decisions Cabinet approved the National Drug Master Plan (2013-2017) and its implementation over the next five years.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse Leanolegolo la Bosetšhaba la Diritibatsi (2013-2017) le go tsenngwa tirisong ga lona mo dingwageng tse tlhano tse di latelang.

src: The Plan serves as the country’s blueprint for preventing and reducing alcohol and substance abuse and its associated social and economic consequences on South African society.
tgt: Leano le dira jaaka mosupatsela wa naga malebana le go thibela le go fokotsa tiriso e e botlhaswa ya nnotagi le diritibatsi mmogo le ditlamorago tse di amanang nayo tsa loago le ikonomi mo baaging ba Aforika Borwa.

src: Cabinet approved the Hosting of the National Broad-Based Black Economic Empowerment Summit in October 2013.
tgt: Kabinete e rebotse go Amogelwa ga Samiti ya Bosetšhaba ya Maatlafatso e e Atolositsweng ya Ikonomi ya Bantsho ka Diphalane 2013.

src: The National Summit will showcase success stories and articulate government’s interventions in support of effective and sustainable economic participation and access for black people in the mainstream of the economy, in a way that will contribute to inclusive growth.
tgt: Samiti ya Bosetšhaba e tla bontsha dikgang tsa katlego le go tlhalosa ditsereganyo tsa puso go tshegetsa seabe se se mosola le se se nnelang ruri sa bantsho mo ikonoming le go fitlhelela tsa ikonomi ka tsela e e tshwaelang mo kgolong e e akaretsang botlhe.

src: Cabinet approved for South Africa to co-host the “Leading Change in the City” Conference with the United Nations Human Settlements programme (UN-HABITAT) on 5 and 6 September 2013.
tgt: Kabinete e rebotse gore Aforika Borwa e amogele Khonferense ya "Go etelelapele Diphetogo mo Toropokgolong" mmogo le lenaane la Ditšhabakopano la Bonno jwa Batho (UN-HABITAT) ka la bo 5 le la bo 6 Lwetse 2013.

src: The emphasis of the conference is on women’s participation in urban life in Africa.
tgt: Maitlhomomagolo a khonferense eno ke go lebelela seabe sa basadi mo botshelong jwa metsesetoropo mo Aforika.

src: The conference will provide a platform for Africa to adequately address the challenges of urbanisation and harness urbanisation for human development.
tgt: Khonferense e tla tlamela Aforika ka tšhono ya go samagana le dikgwetlho tsa bonno jwa kwa metsesetoropong le go dirisa kgolo ya bonno jwa kwa metsesetoropo go tlhabolola batho.

src: Cabinet approved the Draft White Paper on Families and the Implementation Plan.
tgt: Kabinete e rebotse Lekwalotlhomo le le ka ga Malapa le Leano la Go tsenngwa tirisong.

src: Draft White Paper on Families will enable Government and other stakeholders to use family as the springboard for the realisation of societal well-being.
tgt: Lekwalotlhomo le le ka ga Malapa le tla kgontsha Puso le batsayakarolo ba bangwe go dirisa malapa jaaka motheo wa go fitlhelela itekanelo ya loago.

src: The White Paper proposes three key strategic priorities, Promotion of healthy family life, Family strengthening and Family preservation.
tgt: Lekwalotlhomo le tshitshinya ditlapele tsa togamaano di le tharo, Tsweletso ya botshelo jwa lelapa jo bo itekanetseng, maatlafatso ya Lelapa mmogo le tshomarelo ya Lelapa.

src: Cabinet approved the finalisation and gazetting of the second National Water Resource Strategy.
tgt: Kabinete e rebotse go konosediwa le go tsenngwa mo kaseteng ga Togamaano ya bobedi ya Ditlamelo tsa Bosetšhaba tsa Metsi.

src: This strategy builds on the 2004 National Water Resource Strategy.
tgt: Togamaano eno e agelela mo Togamaanong ya Bosetšhaba ya Ditlamelo tsa Metsi ya 2004.

src: The National Water Resource Strategy 2 provides an analysis on the role of water in the economy and identifies the specific challenges, development opportunities and actions which inform an agreed framework for the priority areas of the country.
tgt: Togamaano ya Bosetšhaba ya bo 2 ya Ditlamelo tsa Metsi e tlamela ka tshekatsheko ya seabe sa metsi mo ikonoming mmogo le go supa dikgwetlho tse di rileng, ditšhono tsa tlhabololo le dikgato tse di thusang letlhomeso le go dumelanweng ka lona malebana le dintlha tsa ditlapele tsa naga.

src: The Strategy 2 also seeks to ensure sustainable, equitable and secure water for a better life and environment for all and that water is efficiently and effectively managed for equitable and sustainable growth and development.
tgt: Togamaano ya bo 2 e ikaelela go netefatsa metsi a a nnelang leruri, ka tekatekano mme a babalesegile gore rotlhe re nne le botshelo jo bo botoka le tikologo le gore metsi a tsamaisiwe ka tshwanelo le bokgoni gore go nne le kgolo le tlhabololo e e nnelang ruri.

src: Cabinet approved the report on the Outcomes of the 16th meeting of the Conference of Parties to the Convention on International Trade in Endangered Species of Wild Fauna and Flora (CITES CoP 16), held in Bangkok, Thailand from 3 – 14 March 2013.
tgt: Kabinete e rebotse pegelo e e ka ga Dipoelo tsa kopano ya bo 16 ya Khonferense ya Maloko a Tumelano mo Kgwebisano ya Boditšhabatšhaba ya Ditshedi tse di mo Matshosetsing tsa Diphologolo le tsa Dimela tsa Naga (CITES CoP) 16, e e neng e tshwaretswe kwa Bangkok, Thailand go tloga ka la bo 3 go fitlha ka la bo 14 Mopitlwe 2013.

src: Cabinet further approved that South Africa prepares and submits a trade proposal for consideration at CITES CoP 17 in 2016 in South Africa.
tgt: Gape Kabinete e rebotse gore Aforika Borwa e rulaganye le go tlhagisa tshitshinyo ya kgwebo gore e lebelelwe kwa CITES Cop 17 ka 2016 mo Aforika Borwa.

src: Cabinet accepted the invitation from the African Development Bank for South Africa to become a member of the Infrastructure Consortium for Africa (ICA) which was launched at the G8 Gleneagles Summit in 2005.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse taletso go tswa kwa Bankeng ya Tlhabololo ya Aforika tebang le Aforika Borwa go nna tokololo ya Mokgatlhokgwebisano ya Mafaratlhatlha a Aforika (ICA) e e tlhomilweng kwa Samiting ya G8 ya Gleneagles ka 2005.

src: South Africa’s large investment in infrastructure over the medium term will be enhanced through its membership to the ICA especially in the generation of data and knowledge products and the coordination of development policies between the G20 and African countries.
tgt: Peeletso e kgolo ya Aforika Borwa mo mafaratlhatlheng mo pakeng e e magareng e tla tokafadiwa ka botokokololo jwa yona jwa ICA, bogolo segolo mo go tlhagisiweng ga dikumo tsa tshedimosetso le kitso le kgokgaganyo ya dipholisi tsa tlhabololo magareng ga dinaga tsa G20 le tsa Aforika.

src: Cabinet approved the submission of the Southern African Development Community (SADC) Protocol on Trade in Services to Parliament for ratification, in accordance with section 231 of the Constitution.
tgt: Kabinete e rebotse go tlhagisiwa ga Tsamaiso ya Dinaga tsa Mokgatlho wa Tlhabololo ya Borwa jwa Aforika (SADC) ya Kgwebisano ka Ditirelo kwa Palamenteng gore e amogelwe, go ya ka karolo ya 231 ya Molaotheo.

src: The objectives of the Protocol are to liberalise intra-regional trade in services on the basis of equity, balance and mutual benefit.
tgt: Maitlhomo a Tsamaiso eno ke go golola kgwebisano ya ditirelo ya mo gare ga kgaolo go lebeletswe tekatekano le dipoelo tse di mosola go botlhe.

src: This Protocol also sets out a framework for the liberalisation of trade in services between SADC member states and serves as a basis for negotiations.
tgt: Gape Tsamaiso eno e tlhagisa letlhomeso la go gololwa ga kgwebisano ya ditirelo magareng ga mebuso e e leng ditokololo tsa SADC mme e dira jaaka motheo wa ditherisano.

src: Cabinet noted the launch of the Bachelor of Human Settlements Development Degree (BHSD) in partnership between the Department of Higher Education and Training and the Nelson Mandela Metro University.
tgt: Kabinete e lemogile go tlhomiwa ga borutegi jwa Bachelor of Human Settlements Development Degree (BHSD) ka tirisanommogo magareng ga Lefapha la Thuto le Katiso e Kgolwane le Yunibesithi ya Nelson Mandela Metro.

src: The Bachelor Degree (BHSD) is aimed at developing effective Human Settlements managers and practitioners who will possess the relevant knowledge and skills necessary to create, upgrade and speed up sustainable human settlements development in South Africa.
tgt: Maikaelelo a Dikirii ya BHSD ke go tlhabolola batsamaisi le badiri ba Bonno jwa Batho ba ba tla nnang le kitso le bokgoni jo bo maleba go tlhama, tokafatsa le go akofisa tlhabololo ya bonno jwa batho mo Aforika Borwa.

src: Cabinet calls on all government departments, municipalities and parastatals operating in Gauteng to register all state vehicles for e-tags.
tgt: Kabinete e ikuela mo mafapheng otlhe a puso, makgotlatoropo le ditheo tsa puso tse di kwa Gauteng go kwadisetsa dijanaga tsotlhe tsa puso e-tag.

src: Cabinet approved the implementation steps proposed for the establishment of a Border Management Agency (BMA).
tgt: Kabinete e rebotse dikgato tsa go tsenya tirisong tse di tshitshintsweng malebana le go tlhamiwa ga Setheo sa Tsamaiso ya Melelwane (BMA).

src: The BMA would manage migration, customs and land border line control services and efficiently coordinate the service of all departments in ports of entry.
tgt: BMA e tla tsamaisa ditirelo tsa khudugo, lekgetho le taolo ya mola wa molelwane le go gokaganya sentle ditirelo tsa mafapha otlhe kwa dintlheng tsa matseno a naga.

src: The Department of Home Affairs will be the lead Department in establishing the BMCabinet approved the following Bills for submission to Parliament.
tgt: Lefapha la Merero ya Selegae le tla etelela pele Lefapha go tlhama BMKabinete e rebotse Melaotlhomo e e latelang gore e ka tlhagisiwa kwa Palamenteng:.

src: Customs Control Bill (CCB), the Customs Duty Bill, 2013 (CDB) and the Customs and Excise Amendment Act, 2013 (CEAA) - The Bills provides a foundation for the facilitation of international trade and protection of the economy and society, thereby creating a balance between customs control and trade facilitation Water Research Amendment Bill - The Amendment aims to bring it in line with major changes in institutions, policy, water science and legal environment and also to increase the Water Research Commission’s contribution to the water research needs of South Africa and to ensure that the country is strategically placed to respond to the needs and challenges of an arid country like South Africa.
tgt: Molaotlhomo wa Taolo ya Lekgetho, Molaotlhomo wa Lekgetho la Thomelontle wa 2013 le Molao o o Baakantsweng wa Lekgetho le le Kgethegileng wa 2013 – Molaotlhomo o dira tlamelo ya motheo wa kgokaganyo ya kgwebisano ya boditšhabatšhaba le tshireletso ya ikonomi le baagi, mme ka go rialo o dira gore go nne le tekatekano magareng ga taolo ya lekgetho le kgokaganyo ya kgwebisano.

src: National Environmental Management Laws Amendment Bill, 2013 - The bill proposes amendments to certain provisions under the National Environmental Management Act, 1998 (Act No.
tgt: Molaotlhomo o o Baakantsweng wa Patlisiso ya Metsi – Maikaelelo a Paakanyo ke go o lepalepanya le diphetogo tse dikgolo mo ditheong, pholising, saenseng ya metsi le seemo sa molao le mo go oketseng seabe sa Khomišene ya Patlisiso ya Metsi mo ditlhokegong tsa patlisiso ya metsi a Aforika Borwa, mmogo le go netefatsa gore naga e beilwe sentle go ka tsibogela ditlhokego le dikgwetlho tsa naga e e omeletseng e tshwana le Aforika Borwa.

src: 107 of 1998) and further ensure that the country’s natural resources are protected for current and future generation as contemplated by the National Development Plan (NDP).
tgt: Molaotlhomo o o Baakantsweng wa Melao ya Bosetšhaba ya Tsamaiso ya Tikologo wa 2013 – Molaotlhomo o tshitshinya dipaakanyo tsa ditlamelo dingwe ka fa tlase ga Molao wa Bosetšhaba wa Tsamaiso ya Tikologo, 1998 (Molao wa bo 107 wa 1998) mme gape o netefatsa gore ditlamelo tsa tlholego tsa naga di a sirelediwa gore di dirisiwe ke baagi ba ga jaanong le ba isago jaaka go rulagantswe mo Leanong la Tlhabololo la Bosetšhaba.

src: Draft National Environmental Management: Air Quality Amendment Bill, 2013 - This Bill amends certain provisions under the National Environmental Management: Air Quality Act, 2004 which regulates air quality in the country to protect the environment by providing reasonable measures for the prevention of pollution and ecological degradation while promoting justifiable economic and social development.
tgt: Tsamaisotlhomo ya Bosetšhaba ya Tikologo: Molaotlhomo o o Baakantsweng wa Boleng jwa Mowa wa 2013 – Molaotlhomo ono o baakanya ditlamelo tse di rileng ka fa tlase ga Tsamaiso ya Bosetšhaba ya Tikologo: Molao wa Boleng jwa Mowa, 2004 o o laolang boleng jwa mowa mo nageng go sireletsa tikologo ka go tlamela ka dikgato tse di amogelesegang tsa thibelo ya kgotlhelego le go senyega ga tlhago fa go ntse go tswelediwa tlhabololo e e tlhokegang ya ikonomi le loago.

src: National Environmental Management: Waste Amendment Bill, 2013 - The Bill amends the National Environmental Management: Waste Act, 2008 (Act No.
tgt: Tsamaiso ya Bosetšhaba ya Tikologo: Molaotlhomo o o Baakantsweng wa Matlakala wa 2013 – Molaotlhomo o baakanya Molao wa Bosetšhaba wa Tsamaiso ya Tikologo: Molao wa Matlakala, 2008 (Molao wa bo 59 wa 2008) yo o laolang tsamaiso ya matlakala go sireletsa boitekanelo le tikologo.

src: 59 of 2008) which regulates waste management in order to protect health and the environment.
tgt: Tsamaiso ya Bosetšhaba ya Tikologo: Molaotlhomo o o Baakantsweng wa Mafelo a a Sireleditsweng wa 2013 – Molaotlhomo o baakanya Molao wa Bosetšhaba wa Tsamaiso ya Tikologo: Molao wa Mafelo a a Sireleditsweng, 2003 (Molao wa bo 57 wa 2003).

src: National Environmental Management: Protected Areas Amendment Bill, 2013 - The Bill amends the National Environmental Management: Protected Areas Act, 2003 (Act No.57 of 2003).
tgt: Dipaakanyo di akaretsa tsamaiso ya Mafelo a a Sireleditsweng a Lewatle mo thulaganyong ya tsamaiso ya Mafelo a mangwe a a Sireleditsweng mmogo le go diragatsa Dikgoeletso tsa Moporesitente tse di farologanyang maikarabelo magareng ga tsamaiso ya botshwaratlhapi le tikologo.

src: Amendments incorporate the management of Marine Protected Areas in the system of management of other Protected Areas as well as giving effect to the Presidential Proclamations separating the functions between fisheries and environmental management.
tgt: Molaotlhomo o o Baakantsweng wa Kgwebo ya Bankaposo ya Aforika Borwa – Maitlhomomagolo a Molao wa Kgwebo ya Bankaposo ya Aforika Borwa, 2010 (Molao wa bo 9 wa 2010) ke go tlhama setheo sa ditšhelete go rotloetsa bontsi go boloka le go beeletsa le go tlhama banka ya boitlhophelo jwa ntlha ya setlhopha se se amogelang lotseno lo lo kwa tlase.

src: Cabinet approved the unemployment Insurance Amendment Bill 2012 for public comments and for consultation with NEDLAC Social Partners.
tgt: Kabinete e rebotse Molaotlhomo o o Baakantsweng wa Inšorense ya Botlhokatiro wa 2012 gore baagi ba tshwaele mo go ona le gore go batlwe maikutlo a Balekane ba Loago ba Lekgotla la Bosetšhaba la Tlhabololo ya Ikonomi le ya Ditiro.

src: This Bill amends the Unemployment Insurance Act, No.
tgt: Molaotlhomo ono o baakanya Molao wa Inšorense ya Botlhokatiro, wa bo 63 wa 2001.

src: This amendment addresses the issue of workers who are presently excluded in the Act and improve payment of benefits to contributors, extend the period of payment of benefits to the contributor from eight to twelve months and provides for the nomination of beneficiaries in case of death benefits.
tgt: Paakanyo eno e samagana le dintlha tsa badiri ba ga jaanong ba ba sa akarediweng mo Molaong le go tokafatsa tuelo ya ditshiamelo tsa babeeletsi ba yona, go atolosa paka ya tuelo ya ditshiamelo tsa babeeletsi ba yona go tloga mo dikgweding di le robedi go ya go dikgweding di le 12 mme e dira tlamelo ya go tlhophiwa ga bajalefa laditshiamelo malebana le ditshiamelo tsa loso.

src: Cabinet approved the submission of the Electoral Amendment Bill, 2013 to Parliament.
tgt: Kabinete e rebotse go isiwa ga Molaotlhomo o o Baakantsweng wa Ditlhopho wa 2013 kwa Palamenteng.

src: The Amendment Bill seeks to provide for special votes in elections for the National Assembly, as well as to provide for the registration of voters who are ordinarily resident outside the Republic to enable them to cast a special vote.
tgt: Molaotlhomo o o Baakantsweng o ikaelela go dira tlamelo ya ditlhopho tse di kgethegileng mo ditlhophong tsa Kokoanotheomolao ya Bosetšhaba, mmogo le go dira tlamelo ya go kwadisiwa ga batlhophi ba e leng gore ba nna kwa ntle ga Rephaboliki go ba kgontsha go nna le seabe mo ditlhophong tse di kgethegileng.

src: Appointments Cabinet concurs with the appointment Mr. Romeo Adams to the position of Deputy Director-General: Corporate Services in the Department of Justice and Constitutional Development.
tgt: Kabinete e dumelana le go thapiwa ga Rre Romeo Adams mo maemong a Motlatsamokaedikakaretso: Ditirelo tsa Ditheo mo Lefapheng la Bosiamisi le Tlhabololo ya Molaotheo.

src: Cabinet concurs with the appointment Ms Irene Rofhiwa Singo to the position of Chief Financial Officer in the Department of Mineral Resources.
tgt: Kabinete e dumelana le go thapiwa ga Mme Irene Rofhiwa Singo mo maemong a Motlhankedimogolo wa Ditšhelete mo Lefapheng la Metswedi ya Dimenerale.

src: Cabinet concurs with the appointment Ms Kalayvani Pillay to the position of Deputy Director-General: Legislative Development in the Department of Justice and Constitutional Development.
tgt: Kabinete e dumelana le go thapiwa ga Mme Kalayvani Pillay mo maemong a Motlatsamokaedikakaretso: Tlhabololo ya Molao mo Lefapheng la Bosiamisi le Tlhabololo ya Molaotheo.

src: Cabinet concurs with the appointment Dr Bismark Tyobeka to the position of Chief Executive Officer of the National Nuclear Regulator of South Africa.
tgt: Kabinete e dumelana le go thapiwa ga Ngaka Bismark Tyobeka mo maemong a Motlhankedimogolo wa Molaodi wa Bosetšhaba wa Nutlilia mo Aforika Borwa.

src: Cabinet concurs with the re-appointment of Mr Tsietsi Mokhele as Chief Executive Officer of the South African Maritime Safety Authority (SAMSA) for a period of five years with effect from 1 April 2013.
tgt: Kabinete e dumelana le go thapiwa gape ga Rre Tsietsi Mokhele jaaka Motlhankedimogolo wa Bothati jwa Aforika Borwa jwa Pabalesego ya Lewatle sebaka sa dingwga di le tlhano go tloga ka 1 Moranang 2013.

src: Cabinet concurs the re-appointment of the following Non-Executive members to the board of the South African National Accreditation System (SANAS), whose current term of office will expire on 30 November 2013, to serve a second term from 1 December 2013 to 30 November 2018.Vernon Roderick SeymourPhakamisa Zonke.
tgt: Kabinete e dumelana le go thapiwa gape ga ditokololo tse di latelang tse e seng tsa Khuduthamaga mo botong ya Bosetšhaba ya Tlhomamiso ya Aforika Borwa, tse paka ya tsona ya ga jaana mo kantorong e tla khutlang ka la bo 30 Ngwanaitseele 2013, go dira paka ya bobedi go tloga ka la bo 1 Sedimonthole 2013 go fitlha ka la bo 30 Ngwanaitsele 2018.• Rre Vernon Roderick Seymour• Rre Phakamisa Zonke.

src: Cabinet noted the re-appointment of thirteen members to the South African Council for Space Affairs (SACSA) with effect from 24 June 2013 to 24 June 2015.
tgt: Kabinete e lemogile go thapiwa gape ga ditokololo di le sometharo mo Lekgotleng la Aforika Borwa la Merero ya Sebaka go tloga ka la bo 24 Seetebosigo 2013 go fitlha ka la bo 24 Seetebosigo 2015.

src: Cabinet also noted the appointment of representatives from the Department of Defence, Council of Scientific and Industrial Research and the Department of International Relations and Cooperation with effect from 24 June 2013 to 24 June 2015.Dr Peter MartinezMs Nomfuneko MajajaMr Kim Victor GorringeDr Sandile Bethuel MalingaMs Pontsho MarupingMs Andiswa MlisaDr Valanathan MunsamiMr Tenza ThembaMr Ron OlivierMr Linden PetzerMr Hendrik RheederAdv Phetole Patrick SekhuleDr Jo-Ansie Karina van WykNomination from the Department of DefenceNomination from the Council for Scientific and Industrial Research (CSIR)Nomination from the Department of International Relations and Cooperation.
tgt: Gape Kabinete e lemogile go thapiwa ga dikemedi go tswa kwa Lefapheng la Tshireletso, Lekgotla la Dipatlisiso tsa Saense le Indaseteri (CSIR) le Lefapha la Dikamano le Tirisaommogo ya Boditšhabatšhaba go tloga ka la bo 24 Seetebosigo 2013 go fitlha ka la bo 24 Seetebosigo 2015.a.

src: Cabinet’s position on prominent issues in the current environment.
tgt: Seemo sa Kabinete mo mererong e e kwa setlhoeng mo maemong a ga jaanong.

src: Cabinet congratulated the people of Zimbabwe and political parties on holding successful harmonised parliamentary and local elections.
tgt: Kabinete e akgola batho ba Zimbabwe le makoko a sepolotiki mo go tshwareng ditlhopo tsa palamente le tsa selegae tse di edileng ka katlego.

src: Cabinet commended the efforts of President Jacob Zuma as the Southern African Development Community (SADC) Facilitator on the Zimbabwe Dialogue in ensuring that all political parties were committed to peaceful elections.
tgt: Kabinete e akgola matsapa a a dirilweng ke Moporesitente Jacob Zuma jaaka Mogokaganyi wa Dinaga tsa Mokgatlho wa Tlhabololo ya Borwa jwa Aforika mo Dipuisanong tsa Zimbabwe go netefatsa fa makoko otlhe a ikgolaganya le ditlhopo tsa kagiso.

src: Cabinet condemned the bomb attack on a building housing the Turkish Embassy staff in Mogadishu, Somalia, and expressed condolences to the Governments and people of Somalia and Turkey.
tgt: Kabinete e kgadile tlhaselo ka bomo ya kago e e dulang badiredi ba Ntlokemedi ya Turkey kwa Mogadishu, Somalia, mmogo le go atolosa matshediso kwa mebusong le mo bathong ba Somalia le Turkey.

src: On the eve of our 20 Years of Freedom, Cabinet joins the nation in celebrating Women’s Month under the theme “A Centenary of Working Together towards Sustainable Women Empowerment and Gender Equality”.
tgt: Letsatsi pele ga dingwaga di le 20 tsa Kgololosego, Kabinete e ikamanya le setšhaba go keteka Kgwedi ya Bomme ka fa tlase ga moono wa “Dingwaga di le Lekgolo tsa Tirisanommogo ya Ntshetsopele ya Matlafatso ya Bomme le Tekano ya Bong.”Keteko ya dingwaga di le lekgolo e tlotlomatsa dikgaratlho tse di dirilweng ke bomme, fa esale ka nako ya mogale Charlotte Maxeke, yo a neng a eteletsepele setlhopha sa bomme ka mogwanto o o neng o tshwaretswe kwa Bloemfontein yo o neng o eme kgatlhanong le melawana ya dipasa ka 1913.Karolo e e tshamikilweng ke bomme mo go lwantsheng melao ya dipasa le mo maphateng a mangwe a kgaratlhelo ya kgololosego ke tshusumetso enngwe e e botlhokwa ya letsholo la ga jaanong la Karata ya Boitshupo e e sa tswang go tlhongwa.

src: The centenary honours the struggles waged by women since the distinguished activist, Charlotte Maxeke, led a group of women on a march in Bloemfontein against pass laws in 1913.
tgt: Jaaka setšhaba se tlotlomatsa bomme, Kabinete e dira boikuelo go maAforika Borwa otlhe go ema kgatlhanong le tlhokafatso ngwe le ngwe ya bomme le bana le go tlotla ditshwanelo tsa bomme jaaka di sireletsegile mo Molaotheong wa rona.

src: The contribution made by women in fighting pass laws and in other facets of the liberation struggle is an important part of the inspiration behind the recently launched Smart ID WEBTOKEN the nation celebrates women, Cabinet also calls on all South Africans to take a stand against any abuse of women and children and to respect the rights of women as enshrined in our Constitution.
tgt: Kabinete e boeleditse tebogo ya mo malobeng ya ga Moporesitente Jacob Zuma mo setšhabeng le mo baaging ba boditšhabatšhaba mo go direng Letsatsi la Boditšhabatšhaba la Nelson Mandela letsatsi le legolo go gaisa la keteko ya letsatsi la matsalo a ga Madiba go fitlha ga jaanong.

src: Cabinet reiterated President Jacob Zuma’s earlier thank you to the nation and the international community for making Nelson Mandela International Day the biggest Madiba birthday celebration to date.
tgt: Ka la bo 18 Phukwi, diketekete tsa batho go ralala Aforika Borwa le lefatshe ba ile ba ipha nako go tshwara phage ka mangana le go thusa batho ba ba dikobo dikhutshwane.

src: On July 18, thousands of people around South Africa and the world took time to roll up their sleeves and help less fortunate people.
tgt: Kabinete e dira boikuelo go maAforika Borwa go ema nokeng Letsatsi la Pulo ya Metshameko le Setso la Nelson Mandela kwa FNB Stadium, Johannesburg, ka la bo 17 Phatwe.

src: Cabinet called on South Africans to support the inaugural Nelson Mandela Sport and Culture Day at FNB Stadium, Johannesburg, on 17 August.
tgt: Di-springboks di tla tshameka le Argentina, Bafana Bafana e tla nkgisana magwafi le Burkina Faso, mme Setlhopha sa Matsopa a Kgwele ya Dinao a Aforika Borwa se tla tshameka le Italy, mme go latelwe ka konsarata ya maemo a kwa godimo bosigo.

src: All proceeds will go to the Nelson Mandela children’s hospital project.
tgt: Matlole otlhe a tla abelwa porojeke ya Sepetlela sa Bana sa Nelson Mandela.

src: Cabinet reiterated the call to South Africans to “Take Action Inspire Change (and) Make Every Day a Mandela Day”.Cabinet continues to call on all South Africans to continue keeping former President Nelson Mandela in their thoughts and prayers as he responds to medical treatment.
tgt: Kabinete e boetse gape ya dira boikuelo go maAforika Borwa go “Tsaya Kgato Tlhotlheletsa Phetogo (le) Go dira Letsatsi lengwe le lengwe go nna Letsatsi la Mandela.”Kabinete e tswelela go dira boikuelo mo maAforika Borweng go tswelela go baya Moporesitente wa mo malobeng Nelson Mandela mo megopolong le mo dithapelong tsa bone jaaka a tsibogela kalafo sentle.

src: Cabinet is saddened by the passing of former Chief Justice Pius Langa who was laid to rest on 3 August 2013 during a Special Official Funeral.
tgt: Kabinete e utlwile botlhoko ka go tlhokofala ga Moatlhodi Mogolo wa Maloba Pius Langa yo o bolokilweng ka la bo 3 Phatwe 2013 ka Phitlho e e Kgethegileng ya Semmuso.

src: Cabinet offers condolences to his family, friends and colleagues.
tgt: Kabinete e romela matshediso kwa lelapeng, ditsaleng le kwa badirimmogong ba gagwe.

src: Former Chief Justice Pius Langa will be remembered for his contribution to the liberation Struggle, his defence of our constitutional democracy and, more recently, his work in the Press Freedom Commission.6 Cabinet recognises the positive developments in the education sector, in particular the strengthening of the Curriculum Assessment Policy Statements (CAPS) and the continued support from teachers in its implementation.
tgt: Moatlhodi Mogolo wa Maloba Pius Langa o tla gopolwa ka seabe sa gagwe sa go kgaratlhela kgololosego, tshireletso ya gagwe ya molaotheo wa rona wa temokrasi mmogo le tiro ya gagwe ya mo malobeng jaana mo Khomišeneng ya Kgololosego ya Bobegakgang.

src: Cabinet welcomed the establishment of the Task Team assigned to manage the implementation of the South African Sign Language (SASL) curriculum in 2014 from Grades R to 12, in line with the President’s call to have the sign language declared as official.
tgt: Kabinete e akgola ditlhabololo tse di namatshang tsa lephata la thuto, segolo setonna matlafatso ya Pegelo ya Pholisi ya Kharikhulamo le Tlhatlhobo (CAPS) le kemo nokeng ya barutabana mo go e tsenyeng tirisong.

src: The new curriculum will provide greater access to education opportunities for all.7 Cabinet calls on the 2013 matriculants to register now at tertiary institutions for 2014 in line with the Department of Higher Education and Training’s Apply Now!
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse go tlhamiwa ga Setlhopa sa Tiro se se tla tsamaisang tsenngotirisong ya kharikhulamo ya Puo ya Diatla ya Aforika Borwa (SASL) ka 2014, e e tla simololang mo Mophatong wa R go fitlha ko wa 12, go tsamaelana le kgoeletso ya Moporesitente ya go amogela puo ya diatla jaaka puo ya semmuso.

src: Learners are encouraged to carefully consider their career choices and assess their financial requirements.
tgt: .Baithuti ba rotloediwa go sekaseka ka botlalo boikgethelo jwa bona jwa dirutwa le go sekaseka ditlhokego tsa bona tsa matlole.

src: Learners are reminded about government’s National Student Financial Aid Scheme (NSFAS) which provides financial aid to academically deserving and financially needy students.8 Cabinet congratulates the launch of the 24-hour television news channel by the South African Broadcasting Corporation which responds to the ever-increasing demand for up-to-date news broadcasts on events of national and international importance and gives a voice and platform to all South Africans.9 Cabinet congratulates swimmers Cameron van der Burgh, Chad le Clos and Giulio Zorzi who made the country proud by winning medals at the 15th International Swimming Federation (FINA) World Championships in Barcelona.10 Cabinet extended its well wishes to the Muslims of South Africa as they celebrate Eid.
tgt: Baithuti ba gakololwa gape le ka Sekema sa Thuso ya Matlole a Baithuti sa Bosetšhaba seo se tlamelang baithuti ba ba falolang sentle mmogo le le baithuti ba ba tlhokang ka thuso ya matlole.

src: Cabinet also wishes the South African Jewish Community a happy month of Elul.2 Key Cabinet discussions and decisions.1 Cabinet approved the commencement of the consultation process for the National Water Policy Positions by the Department of Water Affairs.
tgt: Kabinete e akgola go tlhonngwa ga kanala ya dikgang ya diura di le 24 ya Lekgotla la Kgaso la Aforika Borwa, eo e tsibogelang dikgatlhegelo tse di oketsegang tsa kgaso ya dikgang tse di leng mo dinakong ka ga ditiragalo tsa bosetšhaba le tsa boditšhabatšhaba le ka go abela maAforika Borwa otlhe lentswe le serala.

src: The Principles provide a guide to how the powers of an Executive Authority are delegated to an Accounting Officer and further to lower structures as prescribed in the Public Service Act (PSA) and the Public Financial Management Act (PFMA).The Principles make the process of delegating powers easier, which will promote more efficient and effective service delivery.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse phatlalatso ya Pholisi ya Dithoto le Dithata ya Bosetšhaba ka maikaelelo a go tlamela baagi ka tšhono ya go tshwaela mo nakong ya matsatsi a le 30.Maikaelelo a pholisi eno ke go lepanya le go tobana le merero e e farologaneng e e amang dithoto le dithata, eo e amanang le dikarolo tse di farologaneng, go akaretsa: kgwebo, saense, temothuo le boitekanelo.

src: The Minister of Public Service and Administration will further unpack the Principles and its implications at a later stage.5 Cabinet has approved the following treaties to be assented to Parliament in terms of Section 231 of the Constitution of the Republic of South Africa: Firstly, South Africa’s accession to the Agreement for the establishment of the Indian Ocean Tuna Commission (IOTC), Secondly the Convention for the Conservation of Southern Bluefin Tuna (CCSBT) and Thirdly the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) Port State Measures Agreement to Prevent, Deter and Eliminate Illegal, Unreported and Unregulated (IUU) Fishing.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse letlhomeso la pholisis malebana le tekolo ya baagi la setlhogo sa, “Letlhomeso la go Matlafatsa tirisanommogo ya Setšhaba le Puso mo go lekoleng Thebolo ya Ditirelo tsa Motheo.”Mafapha a puso a a rweleng maikarabelo a thebolo ya ditirelo tsa baagi, a tshwanetse go lepanya le go sekaseka matlhomeso a bona go akaretsa mekgwatiriso ya go tsenyeletsa ditshwaelo le maitemogelo a baagi ka thebolo ya ditirelo.

src: The Convention provides a legal framework for regional cooperation amongst States concerned to undertake collaborative actions towards solving interlinked problems of the coastal and marine environment that they share.
tgt: Meono eno, ke mosupatsela wa ka moo dithata tsa Molaodi Khuduthamaga di abelwang Motlhankedi wa Morwalamaikarabelo ka gone, mmogo le go fetisetswa kwa magatong a kwa tlase jaaka go tlhalositswe mo Molaong wa Ditirelo tsa Puso le mo Molaong wa Taolo ya Matlole a Puso.

src: The highest decision-making organ of the Abidjan Convention is the Conference of Parties (COP), a biennial meeting that brings together the Ministers of Environment and technical experts from Contracting parties, as well as observer states, other United Nations agencies and non-governmental organisations.7 Cabinet was briefed on the report of the South African delegation’s participation at the 57th Session of the United Nations Commission on the Status of Women, held from 4 to 15 March 2013.The 57 session was held at the UN Headquarters in New York, and the priority theme was “Elimination of Violence against Women and Girls”.Several commitments were made and adopted as resolutions by the participants on ending violence against women and girls.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse ditumelano tse di latelang, tse di tshwanetseng go atlenegisiwa ke Palamente go ya ka Karolo ya 231 ya Molaotheo wa Rephaboliki ya Aforika Borwa: Ya ntlha, Kamogelo ya Aforika Borwa ya Tumelano ya go tlhamiwa ga Khomišene ya Tšhuna ya Indian Ocean, ya bobedi, Tumelano ya Tshomarelo ya Tšhuna ya Bluefin ya kwa Borwa mmogo le ya boraro Mokgatlho wa Dijo le Temothuo wa Dinagakopano Tumelano ya Maano ya Mabopo a Puso go Thibela, Diegisa le go Fedisa Bothwaratlhapi jo bo seng ka fa Molaong, jo bo sa Begiwang le jo bo sa Laolweng.

src: Cabinet called on all government departments to contribute towards the implementation of these commitments.8 Cabinet approved the submission of the South African Mid-term Global AIDS Review progress report to the United Nation General Assembly.
tgt: Tona ya Temothuo, Dikgwa le Bodirelatlhapi le yona e tsenetse dipuisano tseno go tlhalosa molemo yo o tla tlisiwang ke tumelano eno, mo intasetering ya bodirelatlhapi le seabe sa yona mo kgodisong ya ikonomi ya naga ya rona.

src: The report responds to the Political Declaration on 10 HIV/AIDS targets derived from a set of core indicators.
tgt: Kabinete e atlenegisitse fa Aforika Borwa e tla tshwara Khonferense ya bo 11 ya Makoko (COP) ya Kokoanyo ya Abidjan kwa Motse Kapa go simolola ka la bo 24-28 Mopitlwe 2014.Kokoanyo ya Abidjan ke e ngwe ya Dikhonfensene tsa Dikgaolo di le 18 tsa Mawatle moo maanotiro a neng a tlhamiwa ke Lenaane la Tikologo ya Dinagakopano jaaka karolo ya tiragatso ya Lenaneo la Stockholm la 1972.Kokoanyo eno e tlamela ka letlhomeso la molao mabapi le tirisanommogo ya dikgaolo gare ga Dipuso tse di amegang tse di batlang go tsaya dikgato ka tlhakanelo mabapi le tharabololo ya mathata a a golaganeng le tikologo ya mawatle le ya mabopo eo e dirisiwang ka tlhakanelo.

src: Cabinet commended the department of Health for a report that shows South Africa is on track to achieve the majority of the core indicators by the set 2015 deadline.9 Cabinet was briefed on the implementation of Section 100 (1)
tgt: Lephata la maemo a kwa godimo le le dirang ditshwetso la Kokoanyo ya Abidjan ke COP, kopano ya morago ga dingwaga di le pedi e e kopanyang Ditona tsa Tikologo le baitseanape ba setegeniki ba Makoko a Tumelano, le dinaga tsa balebeledi, ditheo tse dingwe tsa Dinagakopano le mekgatlho e eseng ya puso.

src: They were further apprised on the outstanding matters that still require WEBTOKEN of 31 July 2013 the credit balance was R.3bn compared to an overdraft of R1, 7b when it went under administration in December 2011.Having appreciated the corrective measures put in place in the five departments that are under administration, Cabinet approved that the Ministerial Committee can commence the six month transitional process of handing over the administration of Limpopo to the Premier and his new Executive.
tgt: Kabinete e ile ya begelwa ka pegelo ya botsayakarolo jwa kemedi ya Aforika Borwa ya Puisano ya bo 57 ya Khomišene ya Dinagakopano ka ga Maemo a Bomme e e neng e tshwere go tloga ka la bo 4 go fitlhela la bo 15 Mopitlwe 2013.Puisano eno ya bo 57, e ne e tshwerwe kwa Ntlokgolong ya Dinagakopano kwa New York, mme moono wa botlhokwa e ne e le, “Go fedisiwa ga Ntwa Kgatlhanong le Bomme le Basetsana.”Batsayakarolo ba ile ba itlama le go amogela dintlha dingwe jaaka maano a go fedisa ntwa kgatlhanong le bomme le basetsana.

src: A fuller briefing by the Ministerial Committee will take place at an appropriate time.3 Bills.1 Cabinet approved the introduction of the Legal Metrology Bill to Parliament.
tgt: Kabinete e akgotse Lefapha la Boitekanelo ka pegelo e e bontshang fa maAforika Borwa a dira sentle go fitlhelela bontsi jwa setlhopha sa maikaelelo ka letlha la maparego la 20.9 Kabinete e tlhaloseditswe ka boripana ka tiragatso ya Karolo 100 (1)

src: Cabinet’s position on prominent issues in the current environment.
tgt: Seemo sa Kabinete mo mererong e e kwa setlhoeng mo maemong a ga jaanong Kabinete e amogetse go bolelelwa ga baagi ka kitsiso ya borataro ya Dikaelo tsa Tlhabololo ke Tona ya Lefapha la Tekolo le Tshekatsheko ya Tiro mo Kantorong ya Boporesitente.

src: Cabinet welcomed the public launch of the sixth edition of the Development Indicators by the Minister in the Presidency for Performance Monitoring and Evaluation.
tgt: Jaaka setśhaba se ipakaanyetsa go keteka Dingwaga di le 20 tsa Kgololosego, maAforika Borwa a tshwanetse go tlala boipelo ka gonne botshelo bo tokafetse tota fa e sale ka ngwaga wa 1994.Dikaelo di bontsha tokafalo mo dintlheng tse di botlhokwa, mme mo je lengwe, di bontsha fa re tshwanetse go dira ka natla go tobana le dikgwetlho dingwe tse di tlhagelelang ganngwe le gape.

src: As the nation prepares to celebrate 20 Years of Freedom, South Africans should be proud that life has changed for the better since 1994.The indicators show improvement in key areas and simultaneously point to the hard work still required to deal with some of our more persistent challenges.
tgt: Gape, dikaelo tseno, di tlhotlhetsa dipuisano ka ga dikgwetlho dingwe tse di lebaganeng le naga ya rona, ebile di dira jaaka mosupatsela wa loeto la rona mo ntshetsopeleng ya katlatleloloago le ikonomi.

src: Cabinet commended the 41% (115) of municipalities that received unqualified financial statements on the 2011/2012 financial audits.
tgt: Kabinete e akgotse 41% (115) tsa dimmasepala tse di amogetseng pegelo ya matlole e e senang selabe boemong jwa dipegelo tsa boruni jwa matlole a ngwaga wa ditšhelete wa 2011/12.

src: It further acknowledged the improvement made by the 21 municipalities that previously received the adverse or disclaimed opinions in the previous year.
tgt: Gape e amogela tokafalo e e dirilweng ke dimmasepala di le 21 tseo maloba di amogetseng tshwaelo e sa siamang kgotsa ya ngongorego mo ngwageng o o fetileng.

src: Cabinet appreciates the work done by the Auditor General in assisting the municipalities to improve on the governance compliance requirements.
tgt: Kabinete e itumeletse tiro e e dirilweng ke Kantoro ya Morunikakaretso ka go thusa dimmasepala go tlhabolola tsamaiso ya kobamelo ya ditlhokego.

src: It also acknowledged the commitment made by the municipality leadership to continue to work on further improving the areas highlighted by the Auditor General.3 Cabinet thanked all South Africans for their support of the Nelson Mandela Sport and Cultural Day hosted in aid of the Nelson Mandela Children's Hospital project.
tgt: Gape, e amogetse maitlamo a a dirilweng ke boeteledipele jwa dimmasepala go tswelelapele ka go tlhabolola dintlha tse di neng di tlhagisitswe ke Kantoro ya Morunikakaretso.3 Kabinete e lebogile maAforika Borwa ka kakaretso ka go ema nokeng Letsatsi la Metshameko le Setso la Nelson Mandela, le le neng le ketekiwa go etleetsa ka matlole porojeke ya Sepetlela sa Bana ya Nelson Mandela.

src: South Africans are encouraged to continue working in communities and partnering with government to improve the lives of citizens and bring to life the ideals to which Madiba dedicated his life.4 Cabinet noted the upcoming visit of President Jacob Zuma to the Russian Republic.
tgt: MaAforika Borwa a rotloediwa go tswelelapele ka go direla baagi le go ipopa ngata e le nngwe le puso ka maikaelelo a go tlhabolola botshelo jwa baagi le ntshetsopele ya meono ya ga Madiba ya go ikentsha setlhabelo.4 Kabinete e amogetse loeto le le latelang la Moporesitente Jacob Zuma la go etela kwa Rephaboliking ya Russia.

src: He will be attending the Group of 20 (G20) Summit in St Petersburg on 5 and 6 September 2013 as part of promoting South Africa’s political and economic interests.
tgt: O tla be a ya go tsenela Samiti ya Ditlhopha di le 20 (G20) kwa St Petersburg ka la bo 5 le la bo 6 Lwetse 2013 jaaka karolo ya go godisa dikgatlhegelo tsa Aforika Borwa tsa sepolitiki le ikonomi.

src: South Africa continues to support the G20’s development agenda that advances global economic stability and long-term sustainable growth and job creation.5 Cabinet commended the first meeting of the Brazil, Russia, India, China and South Africa (BRICS) Business Council, which saw business leaders from these countries converge in South Africa.
tgt: Aforika Borwa e tswelelapele ka go ema nokeng leano la tlhabololo la G20 le le matlafatsang ikonomi ya lefatshe le ntshetsopele ya kgolo ya paka e telele le go tlhola ditiro.5 Kabinete e akgotse kopano ya ntlha ya Lekgotla la Kgwebo ya Brazil, Russia, India, China le Aforika Borwa (BRICS), e e dirileng gore baeteledipele ba dikgwebo go tswa mo dinageng tseo ba kopanela mo Aforika Borwa.

src: The meeting was also attended by prominent business leaders from 19 other African countries.6 Cabinet welcomed the assurance given at the 12th annual African Growth and Opportunity Act (AGOA) Forum to renew AGOA before it expires in 2015.
tgt: Gape, kopano eo e ne e tsenetswe le ke baeteledipele ba ba itsegeng ba dikgwebo go tswa kwa dinageng tse dingwe di le 19 tsa Aforika.6 Kabinete e amogetse netefaletso e e tlhalositsweng ka kopano ya bo 12 ya ngwaga le ngwaga ya Foramo ya Molao wa Kgolo le Tšhono ya Aforika (AGOA) ya go ntshwafatsiwa ga AGOA pele e felelwa ke nako ka ngwaga wa 2015.

src: AGOA has benefited both the United States and the African continent and has underpinned a growing and relatively balanced bilateral trade relationship between South Africa and the United States (US).SA believes AGOA offers an appropriate framework to build stronger, mutually beneficial bilateral trade and investment relations and strengthen cooperation between the US and the broader African continent.7 As part of the nationwide celebration of Women’s Month, Deputy President Kgalema Motlanthe will on Friday, 23 August 2013 visit Gombani Village in Mutale Municipality, Limpopo, to hand over houses to the community.
tgt: AGOA e dirile gore dikontinente ka bobedi ya Amerika le ya Aforika di une molemo ka bobedi le go mametlelela botsalano jwa kgwebo e e golang le e e nang le botsitso gare ga Aforika Borwa le Amerika.

src: Cabinet welcomes the launch of the Public Service Charter and commends public service unions and the State as the employer on the commitments made through this Charter.
tgt: Kabinete e amogela tlhomamiso ya Kgolagano ya Ditirelo tsa Baagi mme gape e tlotlomatsa mekgatlho ya badiri ba puso le Puso jaaka mothapi ka boitlamo jo bo dirilweng ka Kgolagano eno.

src: The Charter introduces service standards within the public service with public service unions pledging their commitment to support the service standards.
tgt: Kgolagano eno e tlhagisa maemo a ditirelo tsa puso a a totobetseng mo lekaleng la ditirelo tsa puso mme mekgatlho ya badiri ba puso e netefaditse boitlamo jwa tsona jwa go ema nokeng maemo a ditirelo.

src: Cabinet notes that many sectors are currently or have been engaged in wage negotiations.
tgt: Kabinete e ela tlhoko fa makala a mantsi ga jaana a tshwaragane le Dipuisano tsa Meputso.

src: Cabinet welcomes settlements that have been reached in some sectors and takes note of continuing negotiations in others.
tgt: Kabinete e amogela ditumelano tse di dirilweng mo makaleng a manngwe, e bile e ela tlhoko fa makala a mangwe a ntse a tsweletse pele ka dipuisano.

src: Cabinet recognises that in a democracy, workers have the right to strike.
tgt: Kabinete e amogela gore mo nageng ya temokerasi, badiri ba na le tshwanelo ya go tshwara megwanto.

src: Cabinet emphasises that such right must be exercised in a non-violent manner and in full compliance with the law.
tgt: Kabinete e gatelela fa tshwanelo eo e tshwanetse go diragadiwa ntle le tirisodikgoka le ka go obamela molao ka dinako tsotlhe.

src: There is a responsibility on trade union leaders, employers and the state’s security services to ensure that the law is upheld, that provocative actions are avoided and that industrial action is conducted in a peaceful manner.
tgt: Baeteledipele ba Mekgatlho ya badiri, bathapi le ditirelo tsa tshireletso ya puso ba na le maikarabelo a go netefatsa kobamelo ya molao, le go ikgatolosa maitshwaro a go rumulana le go diragatsa megwanto ya badiri ka mokgwa wa kagiso.

src: Cabinet calls on all parties to use their efforts to settle negotiations as soon as possible and to avoid protracted disputes.
tgt: Kabinete e dira boikuelo go mekgatlho yotlhe go dira ka bo jotlhe go wetsa dipuisano tsa meputso ka bonako jo bo kgonagalang le go tiila dipuisano tse di tsayang nako e teleele.

src: Such expeditious settlements will help to reduce the costs to the economy and promote the achievement of the county’s jobs and growth goals.
tgt: Ditumelano tsa ka bonako di tla thusa go fokotsa ditshenyegelo tsa khampani le go godisa maikaelelo a naga a ditiro le kgolo.

src: Cabinet acknowledged the second Annual Mining Lekgotla that was held last week.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse Kopano ya bobedi ya Ngwaga ya Meepo eo e neng e tshwerwe mo bekeng e e fetileng.

src: The Lekgotla presented another opportunity for the key role players in the mining industry to continue engaging in finding lasting solutions to the challenges that afflict this sector.
tgt: Kopano eo e tlhagisitse gape tšhono e ngwe go batsayakarolo ba botlhokwa mo indasetering ya meepo go tswelelapele ka dipuisano go bona ditharabololo tsa nako e teleele mo dikgwetlhong tse di lebaganeng le lephata leo.

src: Under the leadership of the Deputy President Kgalema Motlanthe government also continues to support the framework agreement and its implementation for a sustainable and stable mining sector.
tgt: Ka fa tlase ga boeteledipele jwa Motlatsamoporesitente Kgalema Motlanthe, puso e tswelelapele ka go ema nokeng lenaanetsamaiso la tumelano le tiragatso ya lona go ntshetsapele kgolo le botsitso mo lephateng la meepo.

src: In the build-up to the 20 Years of Freedom on the 27 April 2014, Cabinet calls on all South Africans to commemorate our history and celebrate our diverse cultures during Heritage Month.
tgt: Mo go ipaakanyetseng segopotso sa Dingwaga di le 20 tsa Kgolosego ka la bo 27 Moranang 2014, Kabinete e dira boikuelo go maAforika Borwa otlhe go keteka histori ya rona le go itumelela meetlo ya rona e e farologaneng ka Kgwedi ya Ngwaobošwa.

src: This year’s celebrations will be marked under the theme: “Reclaiming, Restoring and Celebrating Our Living Heritage”.The Heritage Day celebrations will take place at Sisa Dukashe Stadium in Mdantsane, Buffalo City Metro Municipality, Eastern Cape province on 24 September WEBTOKEN part of the 20 Years of Freedom campaign, the national communication partnership will see the launch of ‘Freedom Friday’ on 20 September 2013, which will provide a platform for South Africans to cherish our hard-fought freedom to ensure that future generations are able to benefit from our developmental democracy.
tgt: Keteko ya monongwaga e tla diriwa ka fa tlase ga moono wa: “Pusetso, Poloko le Keteko ya Ngwaobošwa ya Rona e e Tswelelangpele”.Letsatsi la ngwaobošwa le tla ketekiwa kwa Lebaleng la Metshameko la Sisa Dukashe mo Mdantsane, Mmasepala wa Buffalo City, wa Porofense ya Kapa Botlhaba ka la bo 24 Lwetse 2013.Jaaka karolo ya letšholo la Dingwaga di le 20 tsa Kgololosego, kgolagano ya bosetšhaba ya tlhaeletsano e tla tlhomamisa ‘Labotlhano wa Kgololesego’ ka la bo 20 Lwetse 2013, go ka tlamela maAforika Borwa ka serala sa go tlotlomatsa kgololosego ya rona e e kgaratlhetsweng boima go netefatsa losika la isago le tla kgona go una molemo mo temokerasing ya rona e e tlhabologang.

src: During September, in support of our domestic tourism efforts, Cabinet encourages South Africans to visit heritage sites to remind us of our journey to freedom.
tgt: Ka Lwetse, ka maikaelelo a go ema nokeng maano a Bojanala mo nageng, Kabinete e rotloetsa maAforika Borwa go etela mafelo a ngwaobošwa gore gakolola ka loeto lwa rona lwa go fitlhelela kgololosego.

src: Also, to support our natural heritage by visiting national parks free of charge from 9 to 13 September 2013 as part of the 8th annual South African National Parks (SANParks) Week.
tgt: Gape, go e ma nokeng bošwa jwa rona jwa tlholego ka go etela diphaka tsa bosetšhaba ntle le tuelo go simolola ka la bo 9 go fitlha ka la bo 13 Lwetse 2013 jaaka karolo ya beke ya Borobedi ya Ngwaga le Ngwaga ya Diphaka tsa Bosetšhaba tsa Aforika Borwa (SANParks).

src: Cabinet encourages all parents and guardians to support their children in the preparation for the upcoming Annual National Assessments (ANA) in literacy and numeracy that takes place between 10 and 13 September 2013.Parents and guardians must ensure that they engage with the 2013 ANA results as this serves as an important diagnostic tool of learners’ strengths and WEBTOKEN preparation for the upcoming ANA parents, guardians and learners are urged to use the tools provided by the Department of Basic Education.
tgt: Kabinete e rotloetsa batsadi botlhe le baemedi ba bana go thusa bana ba bona fa ba ipakaanyetsa Ditlhatlhobo tsa Bosetšhaba tsa Ngwaga (ANA) tsa go buisa le go bala tse di tla diragalang ka la bo 10 go fitlha Lwetse 2013.Batsadi le baemedi ba bana ba tshwanetse go netefatsa fa ba itepanya le dipholo tsa ANA tsa 2013 ka gonne e le sedirisiwa se se botlhokwa go ka tlhomamisa bokgoni le bokoa jwa baithuti.

src: These can be accessed on the Department's website.
tgt: Se, se ka fitlhelwa mo webosaeteng ya Lefapha mo (WEBTOKEN).

src: Cabinet extends a message of support to the South Africa National Defence Force soldiers deployed in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo for the period 13 June 2013 to 31 March 2014.
tgt: Kabinete e romela molaetsa wa thotloetso go masole a Tshireletso ya Bosetšhaba ya Aforika Borwa ao a rometsweng kwa botlhabatsatsi jwa Rephaboliki ya Temokerasi ya Congo paka ya go tloga ka la bo 13 Seetebosigo 2013 go fitlha ka la bo 31 Mopitlwe 2014.

src: South Africans are called upon to support and give recognition to these soldiers who are instrumental is realising South Africa’s commitment to peace, stability and the strengthening of democracy in the African continent.
tgt: Go diriwa boipiletso go maAforika Borwa go thusa le go tlotlomatsa masole ano, ba ba leng botlhokwa go diragatsa boitlamo jwa Aforika Borwa jwa kagiso, botsitso le matlafatso ya temokerasi mo kontinenteng ya Aforika.

src: Cabinet congratulates the presidential appointments of Mr Mxolisi Sandile Oliver Nxasana as the National Director of Public Prosecutions and Vasantrai Soni (SC) as the Head of Special Investigative Unit .
tgt: Kabinete e akgola go thapiwa ke boporesitente jwa ga Rre Mxolisi Sandile Oliver Nxasana jaaka Mokaedi wa Bosetšhaba wa Batšhutšhisi le Vasantrai Soni (SC) jaaka Molaodi wa Lekala le le Kgethegileng la Dipatlisiso.

src: Cabinet wishes the Jewish community of South Africa a very happy Rosh Hashanah (5 to 6 September 2013).
tgt: Kabinete e eletsa masego morafe wa maJuta wa Aforika Borwa Rosh Hashanah ya boitumelo (5-6 Lwetse 2013).

src: Rosh Hashanah has profound significance for the Jewish Community in that it marks the beginning of a process of self-examination and reflection culminating in Yom Kippur, the Day of Atonement.
tgt: Rosh Hashanah e botlhokwa go morafe wa maJuta ka gonne e bontsha tshimologo ya moono wa go ipatlisisa ka namana le go itebelela go tsamaelana le Yom Kippur, e leng Letsatsi la Poelano.

src: Cabinet expresses its condolences to Minister Mthethwa and his family on the passing away of his mother Ms Nurse Gumbi on 3 September 2013.
tgt: Kabinete e romela Matshidiso go Tona Mthetwa le losika la gagwe ka go tlhokafala ga mme wa gagwe Mohumagadi Nurse Gumbi ka la bo 03 Lwetse Dipuisano le ditshweetso tsa Kabinete tse di botlhokwa.

src: Cabinet received a report on the results of the Management Performance Assessments Tool (MPAT) of national and provincial departments for the 2012/13 financial year.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse dipholo tsa pegelo ya Ditshekatsheko tsa Tiragatso ya Didirisiwa tsa Bolaodi (MPAT) jwa mafapha a bosetšhaba le a porofense boemong jwa ngwaga wa ditšhelete wa 2012/13.

src: The report is another tool that seeks to improve the quality of services provided by the departments.
tgt: Maikaelelo a pegelo ke go dirisiwa jaaka sedirisiwa sa tlhabolola ya boleng jwa ditirelo tse di tlamelwang ke mafapha.

src: It assesses the four broad management areas namely supply chain management human resource management strategic planning and service delivery improvement.
tgt: Se sekaseka tlhabololo ya dintlhakgolo di le nne tse di anameng tsa bolaodi ebong taolo ya kabo ya ditirelo, taolo ya didirisiwa tsa botho, thulaganyo ya togamaano le thebolo ya ditirelo.

src: The assessment is done on three levels, self-assessment then a moderated process by the internal audit and finally moderated by a team of independent moderators.
tgt: Tshekatsheko e diriwa ka magato a le mararo, tshekatsheko ya sebele morago ga moo go latela tsamaiso ya thulaganyo ya boruni jwa mogare le thulaganyo ya setlhopa sa basekaseki ba ba ikemetseng.

src: The report will be further unpacked by the Department of Performance Monitoring and Evaluation during a scheduled launch of the MPAT next week in Cape Town.
tgt: Pegelo e tla tlhalosiwang ka botlalo ke Lefapha la Tekolo le Tshekatsheko ya Tiro ka leltha la tlhomamiso ya MPAT ka beke e e latelang kwa Motse Kapa.

src: Cabinet received and approved the first quarter reports for 2013/14 on the implementation of Delivery Agreements for the Outcomes.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse le go atlenegisa dipegelo tsa kotara ya ntlha tsa ngwaga wa ditšhelete wa 2013/14 ka tiragatso ya Ditumelano tsa Ditirelo boemong jwa Dikaelo.

src: These reports will be unpacked during a planned series of media briefings for each of the 12 Outcomes.
tgt: Dipegelo tseno di tla tlhalosiwa ka botlalo ka nako ya ditshwaelo tse di rulaganyeditsweng bobegakgang mabapi le ngwe le ngwe ya Dikaelo tse di Kabinete e amogetse pegelo ka ga Porojeke ya go Tlosiwa ga Tshedimosetso e e sa Siamang ya Sekoloto mme e atlenegisitse ditshitshinyo tsa Komiti ya Ditiro tsa lekala la Dikgolagano tsa Kgwebisano le tsa Boditšhabatšhaba.

src: This seeks to address the issue of access to credit to those South Africans that can afford credit.
tgt: Seno se ikaeletse go lebagana le ntlha ya gore maAforika Borwa a kgone go fitlhelela sekoloto fa ba kgona sekoloto.

src: These are consumers who may have paid their debts in full and are in a position to afford credit but whose access is currently impeded by negative credit information on their record.
tgt: Ba, ke badirisi ba ba ka neng ba duetse sekoloto sa bona ka botlalo e bile ba kgona sekoloto mme fela ba thibelwa ke tshedimosetso e e fosagetseng ya dintlha tsa bona ka sekoloto.

src: This is primarily about ensuring that the National Credit Act (Act 34 of 2005) works as intended in terms of ensuring that consumers who can afford credit can be able to access it.
tgt: Maikaelelo ke go netefatsa fa Molao wa Bosetšhaba wa Sekoloto (Molao 34 wa bo 2005) o dira go ya ka maikaelelo a ona a go netefatsa fa badirisi ba ba kgonang sekoloto ba kgona go se fitlhelela.

src: Inaccessible or expensive credit hinders growth.
tgt: Tlhokego ya phitlhelelo kgotsa sekoloto se se kwa godimo se kgoreletsa kgolo.

src: Access to sustainable credit market is essential to all developmental goals.
tgt: Phitlhelelo ya sekoloto se se kgonagalang e botlhokwa mo go matlafatseng maikaelelo a tlhabololo.

src: Cabinet approved the White Paper on Remand Detention and its introduction to Parliament.
tgt: Kabinete e atlenegisitse Molaotshitshinyo ka Pusetsomorago ya Dikgetse tsa Batshwarwa ba ba mo kgolegelong le go tlhagisiwa ga ona fa pele ga Palamente.

src: The draft White Paper seeks to improve the management of awaiting trial detention system in South African prisons.
tgt: Maikaelelo a Molaotshitshinyo ke go tlhabolola taolo ya lenaneo la batshwarwa ba ba letileng tsheko mo dikgolegelong tsa Aforika Borwa.

src: The paper outlines the principles that will drive the detention management of remand detention.
tgt: Tokomane eno, e totobatsa moono yo o tla tlhotlheletsang taolo ya pusetsomorago ya dikgetse tsa batshwarwa ba ba mo kgolegelong.

src: The report will be released through the Parliamentary process.
tgt: E bile, pegelo eno e tla tlhagisiwa go ya ka tsamaiso ya Palamente.

src: Cabinet approved that the Convention of Cluster Munitions be sent to Parliament for ratification.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse gore pegelo ya Tumelano ya Setlhopa sa Dibetsa e romelwa kwa Palamenteng go amogelwa.

src: Cabinet supports the destruction of cluster munitions stocks in compliance with this WEBTOKEN November 2006 a United Nations (UN) conference could not reach agreement on how the adverse humanitarian impact of these weapons should be addressed.
tgt: Ka Ngwanaitseele 2006 khonferense ya Dinagakopano ga ya ka ya kgona go fitlhelela tumelano ka mokgwa o go ka rarabololwang ditlamorago tse di sa itumediseng tsa dibetsa tseno mo bathong.

src: This led to a group of 46 countries, including South Africa, embarking on a process outside the UN, the so-called Oslo Process, to ban cluster munitions.
tgt: Se se ile sa tlhotlheletsa gore setlhopa sa dinaga di le 46, go akarediwa le Aforika Bowa se tshwarwe dipuisano ntle le UN, mme ka ntlha ya seo gwa rebolwa tumelano e e bidiwang Tsamaiso ya Oslo ya kiletso ya setlhopa sa dibetsa.

src: South Africa together with 93 other States signed the Convention in December 2008.
tgt: Aforika Borwa mmogo le Dinaga tse dingwe di le 93, e saenile Tumelano eno ka Sedimonthole 2008.

src: On 1 August 2010 the Convention entered into force.
tgt: Tumelano e ile ya tsena tirisong ka la bo 1 Phatwe 2010.

src: The Convention bans the use, production, stockpiling and transfer of certain category of cluster munitions.
tgt: Tumelano e iletsa tiriso, tlhagiso, go bolokwa ga mokowa, le tsamaiso ya magato a a rileng a setlhopa sa dibetsa.

src: The ratification of the Convention is in line with South Africa’s commitments to upholding human rights and humanitarian law when engaging in war fare.
tgt: Tetelelelo ya Tumelano e tsamaelana le boitlamo jwa Aforika Borwa jwa mametlelelo ya ditshwanelo tsa botho le molao wa botho fa e ikamana le ntwa ya dibetsa.

src: Cabinet approved the submission of the report on the Audit of Registered State Land and a desktop analysis of Private Land Ownership in South Africa, by the Chief Surveyor-General to WEBTOKEN information is critical to the success of all land developments in the country.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse pegelo e e tlhagisitsweng kwa Palamenteng ke Mokanokimogolokakaretso ka ga Boruni jwa Lefatshe la Puso le le Kwadisitsweng le tshekatsheko ya tshedimosetso ka ga Beng ba Lefatshe la Poraefete mo Aforika Borwa.

src: The purpose of the audit of registered state land is to determine how much land is owned by the state, what it is used for and who the occupants/users are.
tgt: Maikaelelo a tshekatsheko ya lefatshe la Puso le le kwadisitsweng ke go tlhomamisa gore puso e na le lefatshe le le kae, le dirisetswa eng le gore badudi kgotsa badirisi ba lona ke bo WEBTOKEN, se tla dirisediwa go matlafatsa bonnete jwa lenaneo la lefatshe, le le tla dirang jaaka motheo wa thulaganyo wa lefatshe le le matlafaditsweng le taolo, go akarediwa ditiro tse di lebaganeng le taolo ya merero ya thoto le thebolo ya ditirelo tse di tlhabolotsweng.

src: This will be used to enhance the integrity of the land register, which would serve as the basis for enhanced land planning and administration, including other functions relating to property portfolio management and improved delivery of services.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse Sebopego sa Khampani ya Dikhoine ya Aforika Borwa mabapi le R2 ya 2013 (1/4 oz) segopotso sa tsweletso ya khoine ya digarata di le 24 tsa gauta le R1 ya 2013 (1/10 oz) segopotso sa tsweletso ya khoine ya digarata di le 24.Tlhagiso ya khoine ya R2 ya 2013 e tla kwalwa ka puo ya se-San mme sebopego sa khoine ya gauta sa R1 ya 2013 e tla nna pollinatara ya boraro ya Mamanthane o o jang Maungo.

src: The coin designs together with their Proclamations will be printed in the Government Gazette.
tgt: Dibopego tsa dikhoine mmogo le Dikgoeletso tsa tsone di tla phatlalatswa mo Lokwalodikgang lwa Melawana ya Puso.

src: Thereafter they will be manufactured and sold through the normal channels.
tgt: Morago ga moo di tla tlhagisiwang le go rekisiwa ka tsela e e tlwaelegileng.

src: Cabinet approved the submission to the United Nation Committee on the Rights of the Child and African Union Expert Committee the 3 reports relating to the progress made in securing the rights and wellbeing of children.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse ditshwaelo tse di dirilweng ke Komiti ya Dinaga tse Dikopaneng ka ga Ditshwanelo tsa Bana le Komiti ya Boitsanape ya Dinaga Kopano dipegelo di le 3 tse di amang tswelelopele e e dirilweng mabapi le tshireletso le boitekanelo jwa bana.

src: The reports provide a transparent and critical opportunity for South Africa to assess the progress it has made in these areas:a) Country Report on the Optional Protocol on the Sale of Children, Child Prostitution and Child Pornographyb) the combined second, third and fourth report on the United Nations Convention on the Rights of the Childc) the African Charter on the Rights and Welfare of the Child: First Country report to the African Union Expert Committee on the Rights and Welfare of the Child.
tgt: Dipegelo tseno di tlamela ka tšhono e e totobetseng le e e botlhokwa go sekaseka tswelelopele e e dirilweng ke Aforika Borwa ka ga dintlha tsenoa) Pegelo ya Naga ya Protokholo ya Boikgetholo ka ga Thekiso ya Bana, go gweba ka mmele ga bana le Dipontsho tse di maponopono tsa Banab) Pegelo ya tlhakanelo ya bobedi, boraro le ya bone ya Tumelano ya Dinaga Kopano ka ga Ditshwanelo tsa Banac) Tšhata ya Aforika ka ga Ditshwanelo le Boitekanelo jwa Bana: Pegelo ya Ntlha ya Naga go Komiti ya Boitseanape ya Dinaga Kopano tsa Aforika ka ga ditshwanelo le Boitekanelo jwa Bana.

src: Cabinet thanks the range of committed civil society organisations and international partners who partnered with government in realising the commitments made to children in our Constitution.
tgt: Kabinete e leboga mekgatlho e e farologaneng ya baagi le bomphato ba dinaga tsa boditšhabatšhaba bao ba ileng ba ipopa ngata e le nngwe le puso go ntshetsapele boitlamo jo bo dirilweng boemong jwa bana mo Molaotheong wa rona.

src: Cabinet approved the submission of the Restitution of Land Rights Amendment Bill to Parliament.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse tshwaelo ka ga go tlhagisiwa kwa Palamenteng ga Molaotlhomo wa Pusetso ya Ditshwanelo tsa Lefatshe.

src: The Bill amends the Restitution Act to extend the date for the lodging of claims for restitution to 31 December 2018 the criminalisation of the lodgement of a fraudulent claim the simplification of the procedure for the appointment of Judges to the Land Claims Court and the amendment of certain provisions aimed at promoting the effective implementation of the Act.
tgt: Maikaelelo a Molaotlhomo ke go tlhabolola Molao wa Pusetso go atolosa letlha la dipegelo tsa ditopo tsa pusetso go fitlhela ka la bo 31 Sedimonthole 2018 go akaretsa bosenyi jwa topo ya bofora jaaka tatofatso, nolofatso ya tsamaiso ya go thapiwa ga Baatlhaodi boemong jwa Kgotlatshekelo ya Ditopo tsa Lefatshe le tlhabololo ya ditaelo tse di rileng tse di tobileng go godisa tiragatso e manontlhotlho ya Molao.

src: The re-opening of lodgment of claims is guided by the vision of the National Development Plan as well as the Comprehensive Rural Development Programme and other growth strategies intended to promote national reconciliation and social cohesion.
tgt: Go bulwa sešwa ga ditopo go tlhotlheleditswe ke ponelopele ya Leano la Bosetšhaba la Tlhabololo le Porograma e e Golagantsweng ya Tlhabololo ya Metsemagae le maano manngwe a kgolo ao a lebaganeng le go godisa poelano le kitlano ya setšhaba.

src: Cabinet approved the introduction of the Science and Technology Laws, Amendment Bill, 2013 to Parliament.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse go tlhagisiwa kwa Palamenteng ga Molaotlhomo Tlhabololo wa Melao ya Saense le Thekhenoloji wa 2013.Molaotlhomo Tlhabololo o tobile diphetogo tsa Melao e mentsi, e e laolang ditiro tsa ditheo (dikhansele tsa saense) tseo di neng di tlhamilwe go ya ka Molao ono.

src: The Amendment Bill deals with amendments to a battery of Acts which govern the operations of entities (science councils) that were established in terms of the said Acts.
tgt: Maikaelelo a Molaotlhomo ke go golaganya tsamaiso ya go tlhopiwa le go thapiwa ga maloko le go tlatsa diphatlatiro tsa Diboto kgotsa Dikhansele tsa ditheo tseo.

src: The Bill seeks to streamline the process for the nomination and appointment of members as well as the filling of vacancies to the Boards or Councils of such entities.
tgt: Molaotlhaomo o godisa bokgeleke jwa tiro le tolamo mo ditsamaisong le taolo ya ditheo tsa baagi tse di leng ka fa tlase ga taolo ya Tona ya Saense le WEBTOKEN ntlheng ya matlafatso ya maikarabelo a tekolo ke Palamente, maikaelelo a Molaotlhomo ke go golola Palamente mo maikarabelong a a rileng a taolo mabapi le go thapiwa ga maloko le go tlatsa diphatlatiro tsa Diboto le Dikhansele tseo.

src: This accords with the constitutional principle of separation of powers.
tgt: Se, se tsamaelana le moono wa kgaogano ya maatla.

src: Cabinet approved for the publication of the Traditional Affairs Bill in the Government Gazette for public comments.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse gore Molaotlhomo wa Merero ya Setso o phasalatswe mo Lokwalodikgang lwa Melawana ya Puso go abela baagi tšhono ya go tshwaela.

src: The Bill makes statutory provisions for the recognition of the Khoi-San and also addresses limitations of existing legislation relating to traditional leadership and governance.
tgt: Molaotlhomo o tlamela ka ditaelo tsa semolao boemong jwa kamogelo ya maKhoi-San le go lepanya ditlhokego tsa molao wa ga jaana le boeteledipele jwa setso le taolo.

src: Since 1994 government has paid particular attention to the challenges relating to the Khoi-San and specifically, the recognition of Khoi-San communities and leaders.
tgt: Fa e sale go tloga ka 1994 puso e etse tlhoko dikgwetlho tse di amang morafe wa maKhoi-San le boeteledipele.

src: The Bill will contribute to the National Development Plan’s key target relating to the broadening of social cohesion and unity while addressing the inequities of the past.
tgt: Molaotlhomo o tla tlhotlheletsa dintlhakgolo tsa Leano la Bosetšhaba la Tlhabololo mabapi le matlafatso ya kutlwano ya setšhaba le kitlano mo go je lenngwe o lebaganye le ditshiamololo tsa puso ya maloba.

src: Cabinet approved the National Credit Act Policy Review Framework and the National Credit Amendment Bill for introduction to Parliament.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse go tlhagisiwa kwa Palamenteng ga Lenaanetsamaiso la Tshekatsheko ya Pholisi ya Molao wa Bosetšhaba wa Sekoloto le ka nakMolaotlhomo Tlhabololo wa Bosetšhaba wa Sekoloto.

src: The National Credit Act, 2005 (Act 34 of 2005) came into full effect on 1 June 2007 introducing a new era of credit regulations into the South African legal system.
tgt: Molao wa Bosetšhaba wa Sekoloto wa 2005 (Molao bo 34 wa 2005) o tsentswe tirisong ka botlalo ka la bo 1 Seetebosigo 2007 ka nako ya go tlhagisiwa ga melawana ya sekoloto mo Lenaneong la Molao wa Aforika Borwa.

src: The Bill aims to strengthen the capacity of the National Credit Regulator (NCR) to address certain challenges especially around court processes and to strengthen enforcement and implementation of the provisions of the National Credit Act 34 of 2005.The Department of Trade and Industry (the dti) also concluded that the policy framework on Consumer Credit, on which the National Credit Act 34 of 2005 is founded, is sound and relevant.
tgt: Maikaelelo a Molaotlhomo ke go matlafatsa bokgoni jwa Molaodi wa Bosetšhaba wa Sekoloto (NCR) go tobana le dikgwetlho tse di rileng, segolo jaang mabapi le ditsamaiso tsa kgotlatshekelo le godisa kobamelo le tiragatso ya ditaelo tsa Molao wa Bosetšhaba wa Sekoloto wa bo 34 wa 2005.Lefapha la Kgwebo le Indaseteri (dti) le lona le dumetse fa pholisi ya Lenaanetsamaiso la Sekoloto sa Badirisi seo e leng motheo wa Molao wa Bosetšhaba wa Sekoloto wa bo 34 wa 2005, o siame e bile o le botlhokwa.

src: This follows a comprehensive review, in 2012 by the dti.
tgt: Seno, se builwe morago ga tshekotsheko e e golagantsweng e e dirilweng ke dti ka 2012.

src: Cabinet approved the submission of the Determination of Remuneration of Members of Constitutional Institutions Matters Amendment Bill, 2013.The Bill aims to create uniformity in respect of the determination of remuneration, allowances and other terms and conditions of employment of members from the Chapter 9 Institutions, thereby enhancing efficiency and consistency in the operations and governance of these key institutions.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse tshwaelo ka ga Molaotlhomo Tlhabololo wa Tlhomamiso ya Meputso ya Maloko ka ga Merero ya Ditheo tsa Molaotheo wa 2013.Maikaelelo a Molaotlhomo ke go tlhola mokgwa o o tshwanang mabapi le tlhomamiso ya meputso, diallawanse le dipeelo le mabaka a mangwe boemong jwa go thapiwa ga maloko a Ditheo tsa Chapter 9, ka maikaelelo a go godisa bokgeleke jwa tiro le tolamo mo tiragatsong ya ditiro le taolo ya ditheo tse di botlhokwa tseno.

src: Cabinet approved the appointment of Mr Mokutule Joseph Kgobokoe to the post of Deputy Director-General: Food Security and Agrarian Reform at the Department of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse go thapiwa ga Rre Mokutule Joseph Kgobokoe jaaka Motlatsamokaedikakaretso wa: Tshireletso ya Dijo le Tlhabololo ya Temothuo wa Lefapha la Temothuo, Dikgwa le Botšhwasi jwa Ditlhapi.

src: Cabinet approved with the appointment of Ms Zandile Yvonne Mathe to the post of Deputy Director-General: National Water Resource Infrastructure at the Department of Water Affairs.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse go thapiwa ga Mohumagadi Zandile Yvonne Mathe jaaka Motlatsamokaedikakaretso wa: Lekala la Bosetšhaba la Mafaratlhatlha ya Metswedi ya Metsi wa Lefapha Merero ya Metsi.

src: Cabinet approved the appointment of the following people as board members to the Cooperative Banks Development Agency:a) Sethe Patricia Makhesha (Chairperson)b) Peter Koch (re appointment to Deputy Chairperson)c) Venete Jarlene Kleind) Lufuno Nevondwee) Thabo Vaughan Shenxanef) Samuel Senalor Akrongg) David Ginsburgh) Renganayagee Kisten.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse go thapiwa ga batho ba ba latelang jaaka maloko a boto ya Ajensi Tlhabololo ya Tlhakanelo ya Dipolokelo:a) Sethe Patricia Makhesha (Modulasetilo)b) Peter Koch (Motlatsamodulasetilo o thapiwa lekgetlho la bobedi)c) Venete Jarlene Kleind) Lufuno Nevondwee) Thabo Vaughan Shenxanef) Samuel Senalor Akrongg) David Ginsburgh) Renganayagee Kisten.

src: Cabinet approved the appointment of the following members to the Agricultural Research Council in terms of section 9(1) of the Agricultural Research Act, 1990 Act No.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse go thapiwa ga maloko a a latelang a Khansele ya Dipatlisiso tsa Temothuo go tsamaelana le karolo 9(1) ya Molao wa Dipatlisiso tsa Temothuo wa 1990 Molao wa bo 86 wa 1990 paka e e sa feteng dingwaga di le tharo.

src: a) Mr Jonathan Winston Alexander Godden (reappointment)b) Prof Michael Jeffrey Kahn (reappointment)c) Prof Sibusiso Vil-Nkomo (reappointment)d) Dr Joyce Chitja (reappointment)e) Ms Wilna Jansen Van Rijssen (reappointment)f) Ms Dudu Msomi (reappointment)g) Mr Mzolisi Dyasi (reappointment)h) Prof Frans J.
tgt: a) Rre Jonathan Winston Alexander Godden (o thapiwa lekgetlho la bobedi)b) MoporofesaraMichael Jeffrey Kahn (o thapiwa lekgetlho la bobedi)c) MoporofesaraSibusiso Vil-Nkomo (o thapiwa lekgetlho la bobedi)d) Ngaka Joyce Chitja (o thapiwa lekgetlho la bobedi)e) Mohumagadi Wilna Jansen Van Rijssen (o thapiwa lekgetlho la bobedi)f) Ms Dudu Msomi (o thapiwa lekgetlho la bobedi)g) Rre Mzolisi Dyasi (o thapiwa lekgetlho la bobedi)h) MoporofesaraFrans J.

src: Cabinet concurred with the appointment of the following persons to the Council Of The Private Security Industry Regulatory Authority, for a period not exceeding three years:a) Mr Daniel Claude Mojalefa Rathebe (Vice-Chairperson)b) Brigadier Cynthia Lindiwe Philison (councillor)c) Mr Benjamin Somangamane Ntuli (councillor)d) Ms. Nontokoza Mthembu (councillor).
tgt: Kabinete e dumelane le go thapiwa ga batho ba ba latelang ba Khansele ya Bolaodi Taolo jwa Tshireletso ya Diindaseteri tsa Poraefete, paka e e sa feteng dingwaga di le tharo:a) Rre Daniel Claude Mojalefa Rathebe (Motlatsamodulasetilo)b) Mobrigadiri Cynthia Lindiwe Philison (Molekgotla)c) Rre Benjamin Somangamane Ntuli (Molekgotla)d) MohumagadiNontokoza Mthembu (Molekgotla).

src: Cabinet approved the extension of the employment contract of Dr Vuyelwa Nhlapo as the Chief Executive Officer of ` the National Development Agency, for a 2 year term with effect 1 September 2013 to 31 August 2015.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse katoloso ya kgolagano ya tiro ya ga Ngaka Vuyelwa Nhlapo jaaka Motlhankedimogolomolaodi wa Ajensi Tlhabololo ya Bosetšhaba paka ya dingwaga di le 2 go simolola ka Lwetse 2013 go fitlha 31 Phatwe 2015.

src: Cabinet approved the appointment of Mr Mokadi Max Mathye as the Chief Executive Officer for the Food and Beverage Sector Education and Training Authority.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse go thapiwa ga Rre Mokadi Max Mathye jaaka Motlhankedi Molaodimogolo wa Bolaodi Katiso jwa Lekala la Thuto ya Dijo le Dino.

src: Cabinet approved the reappointment of those members who confirmed their availability to continue serving on the Human Resource Development Council of South Africa from September 2013 to August 2018.This multi-sectoral advisory council is chaired by Deputy President Kgalema Motlanthe and comprises of 13 Ministers who sit permanently and represent government.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse go thapiwa lekgetlho la bobedi ga maloko a ileng a netefatsa fa ba kgona gape go direla Khansele ya Tlhabololo ya Botho ya Aforika Borwa go simolola ka Lwetse 2013 go fitlha ka Phatwe 2018.Modulasetilo wa Khansele ya kgakololo ya makala a mantsi ano ke Motlatsa Moporesitente Kgalema Motlanthe e bile e na le Ditona di le 13 bao e leng maloko a leruri a a emetseng puso.

src: It is further constituted by representatives from organised business and labour, academics, civil society and generally coopted members.
tgt: Gape, e tlhamilwe ka baemedi go tswa go mekgatlho ya kgwebo le ya badiri, barutegi, baagi le maloko a a tlhophilweng.

src: Cabinet’s position on prominent issues in the current environment.1 Under President Jacob Zuma’s leadership, government is rolling out the country’s multitrillion-rand public infrastructure programme aimed at unlocking job opportunities and bringing services to all South Africans.
