tgt: Puso e tswelela go dira setlapele le go tsweletsa go tsewa ga Dipalo le Disaense jaaka karolo ya go tlhabolola bokgoni jwa botlhokwa jo bo tlhokwang ke ikonomi ya rona e e tlhabologang.6 Kabinete e amogela pego e e dirilweng ke Setlhopha sa Tikwatikwe ya Lenaane la Dipatlisiso tsa AIDS mo Aforika Borwa malebana le go bonwa ga dilwantshamegare tse dintšhwa tse di maatla tsa HIPatlisiso e ikaegile ka mokgwa yoo mmele wa ga mosadi wa kwa KwaZulu-Natal o tsibogetseng tshwaetso ya gagwe ya HIV ka tenga ka go bopa dilwantshamegare tse di maatla.

src: The research centres on how a KwaZulu-Natal woman’s body responded to her HIV infection by making potent antibodies.
tgt: Thutopatlisiso eno e e phasaladitsweng mo jenaleng ya maemo a a kwa godimo ya saense, Nature, e tlhalosa ka moo setlhopha sa babatlisisi se boneng le go supa dilwantshamegare tseno mo mading a mosadi yoo mme ba itsadisetsa tsa bone kwa laboratoring.

src: The study, published in the prestigious scientific journal, Nature, describes how the research team found and identified these antibodies in the woman’s blood and then cloned the antibodies in the laboratory.
tgt: Dilwantshamegare tse di dirilweng di ne tsa dirisiwa mo metseletseleng ya diteko kwa laboratori go senola tsela e e latetsweng ke masole a mmele a mosadi go dira dilwantshamegare tseno tse di maatla.

src: The cloned antibodies were then used in a series of experiments in the laboratory to elucidate the pathway followed by the woman’s immune system to make these potent antibodies.
tgt: Kitso e ntšhwa e e bonweng go tswa mo mosading ono wa kwa KwaZulu-Natal malebana le tsibogelo ya masole a mmele a gagwe kgatlhanong le HIV e lere tsholofelo ya togamaano ya isago ya thibelo le kalafi ya HIThibololo eno ga se kalafi ya HIV/AIDS mme puso e ikuela go maAforika Borwa go tswelela go dira diteko tsa HIV gongwe go tswelela ka kalafi ya dianthiritrobaerale e e newang batho ba ba fitlhelwang ba na le HIV.7 Moporesitente Jacob Zuma o tla rebola puo ya meletlo ya monongwaga ya Letsatsi la Ditshwanelo tsa Botho ka la bo 21 Mopitlwe 2014 ka fa tlase ga moono wa "Re keteka Dingwaga di le 20 tsa go fetola matshelo ka ditshwanelo tsa botho!"

src: Cabinet calls on South Africans to celebrate living in a country that guarantees that never again will our humanity be taken from any South African, irrespective of their race, gender, creed or sexual orientation.
tgt: Kabinete e ikuela go maAforika Borwa otlhe go keteka go nna mo nageng e e netefaletsang gore ga go kitla go tlhola go diragala gore botho jwa rona bo tsewe go tswa mo moAforika Borweng ope, go sa kgathalasege lotso, bong, tumelo gongwe boitlhophelo jwa gore o ratana le batho ba bong bofe.

src: We all have a responsibility to ensure that our human rights record and history are preserved and strengthened for future generations.8 National Water Week will be launched at Bushbuckridge on 14 March and will continue with a number of events up until 23 March 2014.
tgt: Rotlhe re na le maikarabelo a go netefatsa gore rekoto le hisetori ya rona ya ditshwanelo tsa botho di somarelwa le go maatlafaletswa bana ba rona.8 Beke ya Bosetšhaba ya Metsi e tla tlhomiwa kwa Bushbuckridge ka la bo 14 Mopitlwe mme e tla tswelela ka ditiragalo di le mmalwa go fitlha ka la bo 23 Mopitlwe 2014.

src: The launch event will take place around the lowering of pumps at the South Vertical Shaft of the old ERPM mine to deal with the issue of Acid Mine Drainage in the Central Witwatersrand Basin.
tgt: Tiragalo ya go tlhoma e tla diragala go lebilwe go isiwa tlase ga dipompo kwa Šafoteng e e Tsepameng ya kwa Borwa ya moepo wa bogologolo wa ERPM go samagana le morero wa Tshologelo ya Esiti ya Meepo mo karolong ya Bogareng ya Mokgatshe wa Witwatersrand.

src: The remainder of the week will also see the handover of waste water treatment works and bulk water supply projects in a number of provinces.
tgt: Mo bekeng e e setseng go tla rebolwa diporojeke tsa phepafatso ya metsi a a leswe le tlamelo ya metsi mo diporofenseng di le mmalwa.

src: This year’s theme is “Water is Life - 20 Years of Water Delivery for Social and Economic Development”.
tgt: Moono wa monongwaga ke "Metsi ke Botshelo - Dingwaga di le 20 tsa Tlamelo ya Metsi go Tlhabolola Loago le Ikonomi."

src: Cabinet calls on South Africans to conserve water and reiterates the need for sustainable management of this scarce resource, in order to widen access to even more South Africans.9 Cabinet was apprised of the successful inaugural Presidential Youth Indaba that was held in Ekurhuleni from 28 February to 03 March 2014.
tgt: Kabinete e ikuela mo maAforika Borweng go somarela metsi mme e boeletsa botlhokwa jwa tsamaiso e e netefaletsang go nna teng leruri ga tlamelo eno e e tlhaelang, gore go atolosediwe phitlhelelo go maAforika Borwa a le mantsi.9 Kabinete e tlhaloseditswe ka Presidential Youth Indaba ya ntlha e e atlegileng e e neng e tshwaretswe kwa Ekurhuleni go tloga ka la bo 28 Tlhakole go ya go la bo 03 Mopitlwe 2014.

src: The Indaba was hosted by the Presidency, the Economic Development Department (EDD) and the National Youth Development Agency (NYDA).
tgt: Indaba e ne e tsamaisiwa ke kantoro ya Moporesitente, Lefapha la Tlhabololo ya Ikonomi (EDD) le Setheo sa Bosetšhaba sa Tlhabololo ya Bašwa (NYDA).

src: The Indaba gave effect to the Youth Employment Accord that was signed in April 2013 by government, business and labour.
tgt: Indaba e diragaditse Tumelano ya go Thapiwa ga Bašwa e e saenilweng ke puso, kgwebo le badiri ka Moranang 2013.

src: President Jacob Zuma delivered the keynote address at the Indaba, which was attended by at least 500 young people from all provinces.
tgt: Moporesitente Jacob Zuma o tlhagisitse puo ya dintlha tse di botlhokwa kwa Indaba, e e neng e tsenetswe ke bonnye jwa bašwa ba le 500 go tswa kwa diporofenseng tsotlhe.

src: Various Ministers participated in panel discussions to brief young people on government programmes for youth employment.
tgt: Ditona tse di farologaneng di nnile le seabe mo dipuisanong tsa ditlhopha go tlhalosetsa bašwa ka manaane a puso a go thapiwa ga bašwa.

src: In addition, concrete strategies were adopted which will see the President and various Ministers constantly collaborating with the youth to make job creation a reality.
tgt: Go tlaleletsa foo, go amogetswe ditogamaano tse di tsepameng tse di tla dirang gore Moporesitente le Ditona tse di farologaneng di buisane le bašwa gangwe le gape go dira gore go tlhamiwa ga ditiro e nne kgang yA nnete.10 Kabinete e lemogile Khonferense ya Bosetšhaba ya Patlomaikutlo e e ka ga Lekwalopuso la Matlhagolatsela la Pholisi ya Bosetšhaba e e KopanEtsweng ya Thekenoloji ya Ditlhaeletsano tsa Tshedimosetso (ICT) e e neng e tsenetswe ke bontsi e bile e atlegile, e e neng e tshwerwe ka la bo 3 Mopitlwe 2014.

src: 1.10 Cabinet noted the well-attended and successful National Consultative Conference on the National Integrated ICT Policy Green Paper, which was held on 3 March 2014.
tgt: Kabinete e rotloetsa baagi go nna le seabe mo ditheetsong tsa porofense tsa Lekwalopuso la Matlhagolatsela tse di simologang kwa Rustenburg ka la bo 7 Mopitlwe.

src: Cabinet encourages the public to participate in the Green Paper provincial hearings that begin in Rustenburg on 7 March.
tgt: Lekwalopuso la Matlhagolatsela le tla lebisa kwa go konosediweng ga Lekwalopuso la Mabudusatsela mo bogareng jwa ngwaga, mme seo se tla tlamela ka letlhomeso la go fetola molao ka ditsela tse di tla lebelelang diphetogo tse di gaketseng tsa ICT mo dingwageng tse di fa gautshwane.11 Kabinete e itumeletse go itse gore fa e sale go amogelwa "SA Connect", e leng Pholisi le Togamaano ya Broadband, ka la bo 4 Sedimonthole 2013, dikolo di le 782 di golagane ka dikhomphiutara le dilaboratori tse di nang le inthanete go tlhomilwe Setheo sa Inkamva e-Skills, mme go tlhamilwe Lekgotla la Bosetšhaba la Bogakolodi la Broadband.12 Lefapha la Merero ya Tikologo le tla tsamaisa Khonferense ya bo11 ya Maphata (COP11) go tloga ka di17 go ya go di21 Mopitlwe 2014, kwa Cape Town International Convention Centre, ka fa tlase ga moono wa: "Go Tsweletsa Kgolo mo Dikgwebong tsa kwa Mawatleng mo Aforika: Go Lebilwe Tsamaiso e e nnelang Leruri ya Ditlamelo tsa Lewatle."

src: The Green Paper will lead to the finalisation of the White Paper by mid-year, which will provide the framework to change legislation in ways that would take into account the sweeping changes in ICT in recent years.
tgt: COP11 e e tshwarwang morago ga dingwaga tse dingwe le tse dingwe di le pedi e kopanya ditona tsa tikologo go tswa kwa dinageng di le 22 tse di ka fa tlase ga Tumelano ya Tirisanommogo mo Tshireletsong, Tsamaisong le Tlhabololo ya Tikologo ya Mawatle le Mabopo a Lebopo la Atlantic a Kgaolo ya Bophirima, Bogare le Borwa jwa Aforika.

src: 1.11 Cabinet is pleased to note that since the adoption of “SA Connect”, the Broadband Policy and Strategy, on 4 December 2013, 782 schools have been connected with computers and cyberlabs the Ikamva e-Skills Institute was launched, and the National Broadband Advisory Council established.12 The Department of Environmental Affairs will host the 11th Conference of Parties (COP11) from 17 to 21 March 2014, at the Cape Town International Convention Centre, under the theme: “Promoting Blue Growth in Africa: Towards Sustainable Management of Marine Resources”.
tgt: Khonferense ya 2014 e tla sekaseka ditiro le ditshwetso tse di diragaditsweng mo pakeng ya 2012/13 tekanyetsokabo ya 2014/15, mme e swetse ka dikgato tse di tlhokegang go tsenya tirisong Tumelano le Maano a yona a Tiragatso.

src: The biennial COP11 brings together ministers of environment from 22 nations which are covered by the Convention for Cooperation in the Protection, Management and Development of the Marine and Coastal Environment of the Atlantic Coast of the West, Central and Southern Africa Region.
tgt: Gape e tla tlhalosa ka moo maphata a ka amogelang mogopolo wa "Kgolo mo Dikgwebong tsa kwa Mawatleng " jaaka tsela ya go tsamaisa ditlamelo tsa lewatle le mabopo ka tsela e e nnelang leruri.13 Kabinete e akgotse setlhopha sa Bosetšhaba sa Aforika Borwa sa Khirikhete sa ba dingwaga tse di ka fa tlase ga di le 19 ka phitlhelelo ya sona e e gaisang ka go gapa Sejana sa bona sa ntlha sa Lefatshe sa ba Dingwaga tse di ka fa tlase ga di le 19 sa Lekgotla la Boditšhabatšhaba la Khirikhete (ICC) kwa Dubai.

src: The 2014 conference will review activities and decisions executed during the 2012/2013 period the budget for 2014/2015, and rule on action needed to implement the Convention and its Action Plan.
tgt: Tiragatso e e susumetsang ya setlhopha e tshwanetse go rotloetsa batshameki botlhe ba bašwa go eletsa go fitlhelela seemo se se kwa godimo.14 Kabinete e amogetse Letsatsi le le tlang la Boditšhabatšhaba la Basadi - 8 Mopitlwe 2014.

src: It will also determine how parties can embrace the “Blue Growth” concept as a way of sustainably managing marine and coastal resources.13 Cabinet extended congratulations to the South African National Under-19 cricket team on their outstanding achievement in winning their maiden International Cricket Council (ICC) Under-19 World Cup in Dubai.
tgt: Letsatsi le tlamela maAforika Borwa ka tšhono ya go gopola diphitlhelelo le go intsha setlhabelo ga basadi ba maAforika Borwa mo baaging ba rona.

src: South Africans need to reflect on the progress made by communities, society and the country at large in advancing the rights of women.
tgt: MaAforika Borwa a tlhoka go lebelela tswelelopele ya baagi, setšhaba le naga ka bophara mo go tsweletseng ditshwanelo tsa basadi.

src: While the Constitution provides the bedrock of values and principles, it is the responsibility of all of us to safeguard and protect women and ensure that they are empowered to participate as equal citizens in the development of our economy and country.2 Cabinet deliberation and approvals.1 Cabinet approved the initiation of a broader consultative process with the aim of producing more professional graduates.
tgt: Le fa Molaotheo o tlamela ka dintlhatheo, ke maikarabelo a rona rotlhe go tlhokomela le go sireletsa basadi le go netefatsa gore ba a maatlafadiwa go nna le seabe jaaka baagi ba ba lekalekanang le ba bangwe mo tlhabololong ya ikonomi le naga.2 Ditsereganyo le dikatlenegiso tsa Kabinete Kabinete e aamogetse go simololwa ga thulaganyo e e anameng ya patlomaikutlo ka maikaelelo a go tlhagisa dialogane tse dintsi tsa porofešenale.

src: This will introduce a framework for enhanced interaction, coordination and collaboration between professional bodies, quality councils, industry, higher education institutions and government.
tgt: Seno se tla itsise letlhomeso la tshusumetsano e e tokafetseng, kgokaganyo le tirisanommogo magareng ga ditheo tsa porofešenale, makgotla a boleng, madirelo, ditheo tsa thuto e kgolwane mmogo le puso.

src: This will contribute towards the development of a skilled and capable workforce to support an inclusive growth path.2 Cabinet approved the Unemployment Insurance Amendment Bill 2014 for submission to Parliament.
tgt: Seno se tla tshwaela mo tlhabololong ya badiri ba ba nang le bokgoni go tshegetsa tsela e e akaretsang ya kgolo.2 Kabinete e amogetse Molaotlhomo o o Baakantsweng wa Inšorense ya Botlhokatiro wa 2014 gore o tlhagisiwe kwa Palamenteng.

src: This is the second amendment to the Unemployment Insurance Act, No.
tgt: Seno ke paakanyo ya bobedi ya Molao wa Inšorense ya Botlhokatiro, wa bo 63 wa 2001.Dipaakanyo di tswelela go fokotsa ditlamorago tse di masisi tsa botlhokatiro mo ikonoming le loago ka go obamela dipeelo tsa Mekgatlho ya Boditšhabatšhaba ya Badiri, go akarediwa le barutwana ba ba mo boithutelatirong le badiredisetšhaba ba ga jaanong ba ba sa sirelediwang go ya ka Molao.

src: Implementation of the Amendment Bill, 2014 will amongst other things extend the period of payment of benefits to the contributor, from 8 months to 12 months, thus enabling them to look for alternative employment and earn benefits over a longer period.
tgt: Go tsenngwa tirisong ga Molaotlhomo o o Baakantsweng, 2014, ga reng ga tse dingwe, o tla atolosa paka ya tuelo ya ditshiamelo tsa moabi, go tloga go dikgwedi di le 8 go ya go di le 12, mme ka go rialo o ba kgontsha go batla tiro e nngwe mme ba ntse ba amogela ditshiamelo mo pakeng e e telejana.

src: A contributor will also have an extended period in which to lodge a claim, from 6 months to 12 months.
tgt: Gape moabi o tla nna le paka e e atolositsweng ya go ka tsenya topotuelo, go tloga mo dikgweding di le 6 go ya go di le Gape e tla dira gore go nne le go tlhophiwa ga baamogelatshiamelo mo mabakeng a ditshiamelo tsa loso.3 Go thapiwaKabinete e amogetse go thapiwa ga ba ba latelang:.

src: It will also allow for the nomination of beneficiaries in case of death benefits.3 AppointmentsCabinet approved the following appointments:3.1 Mr Daan du Toit as Deputy Director-General: International Cooperation and Resources at the Department of Science and Technology.2 Mr Garth Strachan as Deputy Director-General: Industrial Development Policy Development at the Department of Trade and Industry.3 Ms Malebo Mabitje-Thompson Deputy Director-General: Industrial Development Incentive Administration at the Department of Trade and Industry.4 Board of the South African Special Risk Insurance Association (SASRIA) State- Owned Corporation (SOC) Limiteda) Re-appointment of Mr Cedrick Mnwabisi Masondo as Managing Director and as Executive Director to the Board.
tgt: Rre Daan du Toit jaaka Motlatsamokaedikakaretso: Tirisanommogo ya Boditšhabatšhaba le Ditlamelo kwa Lefapheng la Saense le Thekenoloji.

src: b) Re-appointment of Ms Karen Pepler as Executive Director to the Board.
tgt: Rre Garth Strachan jaaka Motlatsamokaedikakaretso: Tlhabololo ya Madirelo le Tlhabololo ya Pholesi kwa Lefapheng la Kgwebisano le Intaseteri.

src: Cabinet’s decisions on current issues and upcoming events.
tgt: Ditshwetso tsa Kabinete mo mererong ya ga jaanong le mo ditiragalong tse di tlang.

src: Cabinet welcomed the release of the Twenty Year Review South Africa Report 1994–2014, by President Jacob Zuma, which is testimony to the progress government has made to ensure a better life for WEBTOKEN the spirit of the Review being dedicated to former President Nelson Mandela, the Executive calls on all sectors of society to engage with the report, join in the 20 Years of Freedom celebrations and help shape the national discussion on our achievements and challenges.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse kgololo ya Pegelo ya Ditlhotlhomiso mo Aforika Borwa mo Dingwageng di le Masomamabedi go tloga ka 1994-2014, ka Moporesitente Jacob Zuma, e leng bosupi jwa tswelelopele e e dirilweng ke puso go netefatsa gore go nna le botshelo jo bo botoka go WEBTOKEN moweng wa gore Ditlhotlhomiso tseno di akgolele Moporesitente wa maloba Nelson Mandela, Khuduthamaga e ikuela mo maphateng otlhe a loago go sekaseka pegelo eno, go ikamanya le meletlo ya Dingwaga di le 20 tsa Kgololesego le go thusa go bopa dipuisano tsa bosetšhaba ka ga diphitlhelelo mmogo le dikgwetlho tsa rona.

src: The Review confirms the progress we have made in building a non-racial, non-sexist, thriving and vibrant constitutional democracy, making South Africa a better country to live in.
tgt: Ditlhotlhomio di tlhomamisa tswelelopele e re e boneng mo go ageng temokerasi e e sa tlhaoleng ka semorafe, e e sa tlhaoleng ka bong, e e matlhagatlhaga e bile e susumetsa molaotheo wa temokerasi, go dira Aforika Borwa naga e go leng botoka go nna mo go yona.

src: Cabinet reminds all sectors of society that 2014 has been dedicated to the 20 Years of Freedom campaign.
tgt: Kabinete e gakolola maphata otlhe a loago gore 2014 e beetswe thoko go nna ya letsholo la Dingwaga di le 20 tsa Kgololesego.

src: April marks Freedom Month.
tgt: Moranang ke Kgwedi ya Kgololesego.

src: All South Africans and international partners and stakeholders are invited to join the Freedom Month celebrations by relating their stories on how, through working together, we have changed the lives of South Africans for the WEBTOKEN we make our way to polling stations on 7 May 2014, let us once again demonstrate that we are a vibrant, enthusiastic and peaceful democracy.
tgt: Go lalediwa maAforika Borwa otlhe le balekane ba boditšhabatšhaba mmogo le baamegi go tsenela meletlo ya Kgwedi ya Kgololesego ka go anega dikgang tse di ikaegileng ka kgang ya gore, ka go dira mmogo, re kgonne go fetola matshelo a maAforika Borwa go nna botoka.

src: Cabinet calls on all South Africans to be active participants in electioneering but to do so peacefully and with tolerance for the right of all voters to express their opinions publicly and make their choice privately in the voting WEBTOKEN enforcement agencies will be active to protect this right, to ensure that all areas of the country participate in the democratic process, which is a product of our Struggle for freedom.
tgt: Fa re leba kwa diteišeneng tsa go tlhopha ka la bo 7 Motsheganong 2014, a re supeng gape gore re temokerasi e e mafolofolo, e e tlhaga le ya kagiso.

src: As part of the national infrastructure roll-out plan of the Presidential Infrastructure Coordinating Commission, Cabinet draws the nation’s attention to the following positive developments:1.
tgt: Kabinete e ikuela mo maAforika Borweng go nna le seabe se se tlhaga sa go ingokela batlhophi fela ba dire jalo ka kagiso le itshokelano go lebeletswe ditshwanelo tsa batlhophi botlhe tsa go tlhagisa maikutlo a bona mo phatlhalatseng le go dira boitlhophelo mo sephiring mo ntlwanatlhophelong.

src: De Hoop Dam in Limpopo will be commissioned towards the end of March 2014.
tgt: Letamo la De Hoop kwa Limpopo le tla rebolwa go fa go lebilwe kwa bokhutlong jwa Mopitlwe 2014.

src: This is the fourth biggest dam built since our post democratic dispensation.
tgt: Seno ke letamo la bone le legolo go gaisa le le agilweng morago ga puso ya rona ya temokerasi.

src: The Dam will help drive economic activity, create jobs and aid service delivery in the province and beyond.
tgt: Letamo leno le tla thusa go tsamaisa ikonomi, go tlhama ditiro mmogo le go thusa tlamelo ya ditirelo mo porofenseng le kwa mafelong a mangwe.

src: More than 800 000 people in the Sekhukhune area will benefit from secure and improved domestic water supply while new mining and agricultural activities will also benefit from the supply of water.
tgt: Batho ba feta 800 000 mo kgaolong ya Sekhukhune ba tla ungwelwa ka tlamelo e e sireletsegileng le e e tokafetseng ya metsi a legae fa ditiro tsa meepo le temothuo le tsona di tla ungwelwa ka ntlha ya tlamelo ya metsi.

src: Municipalities in the area, supported by national and provincial government, have invested an additional R3 billion in infrastructure to treat and distribute water to rural domestic and urban users.
tgt: Makgotlatoropo mo karolong eo, a tshegeditswe ke dipuso tsa bosetšhaba le tsa porofense, a beeleditse bokana ka R3 bilione ya tlaleletso mo mafaratlhatlheng go tlhatswa le go tlamela metsi kwa badirising ba metseselegae le metsesetoropo.

src: Cabinet expressed satisfaction at the planned launch of the Lesotho Highlands Project Phase II on 27 March 2014.
tgt: Kabinete e kgotsofaditwe ke go tlhomiwa go go rulagantsweng ga Legato la II la Porojeke ya Metsi a Lesotho Highlands ka la bo 27 Mopitlwe 2014.

src: The Project is a prime example of what can be achieved when neighbouring countries cooperate and work towards a common goal.
tgt: Porojeke eno ke sekai sa botlhokwa sa gore go ka fitlhelelwa eng fa dinaga tsa boagisanyi di dirisana mmogo mme di dira go fitlhelela phitlhelelo e e tshwanang.

src: The development of mutual water resources is significantly contributing to the peace and prosperity of the Southern African region and the welfare of its people.
tgt: Go tlhabololwa ga ditlamelo tse di tlhakanetsweng tsa metsi go tshwaela e le ruri mo kagisong le khumo ya kgaolo ya Borwa jwa Aforika mmogo le katlaatlelo ya baagi ba teng.

src: Cabinet is pleased with the move to revitalise South Africa’s rail system, with the awarding of a R50 billion contract by Transnet for the building of 1 064 modern and technologically advanced locomotives.
tgt: Kabinete e itumelela kgato ya go tsosolosa tsamaiso ya diporo tsa Aforika Borwa, jaaka Transnet e abile konteraka ya R50 bilione gore go agiwe diterena di le 1 064 tsa sešweng le tse di dirisang thekenoloji e e tsweletseng pele.

src: Transnet Engineering’s role in the agreement is to ensure that the division is transformed into a global original equipment manufacturer over time.
tgt: Seabe sa tiro ya Boenjenere jwa Transnet mo tumelanong eno ke go netefatsa gore karolo e fetolwa go nna motlhagisi wa didirisiwa tsa tshimologo wa lefatshe mo tsamaong ya nako.

src: This transaction is intended to transform the South African rail industry by growing existing small businesses and creating new ones.
tgt: Maitlhomo a konteraka eno ke go tlhabolola indaseteri ya diporo ya Aforika Borwa ka go godisa dikgwebopotlana tse di leng teng le go tlhama tse dintšhwa.

src: Cabinet welcomes the launch of the first MeerKAT antenna by the Department of Science and Technology at the Square Kilometre Array (SKA) core site near Carnarvon, in the Northern Cape on 27 March 2014.The MeerKAT, which is predominantly a locally designed and built instrument, again demonstrates that South Africa can compete with the best when it comes to research, engineering, science and technology.
tgt: Kabinete e amogela go tlhomiwa ga antena ya ntlha ya MeerKAT ke Lefapha la Saense le Thekenoloji kwa setsheng sa botlhokwa sa Square Kilometre Array (SKA) gaufi le Carnarvon, kwa Kapa Bokone ka la bo 17 Mopitlwe 2014.MeerKAT, e leng sediriswa seo dikarolontsi jwa sona bo thadisitsweng le go agiwa mo gae, ke sesupo gape sa gore Aforika Borwa e ka gaisana le dinaga tse di gaisang fa go tla mo mererong ya dipatlisiso, boenjenere, saense le thekenoloji.

src: It will constitute 25 per cent of the SKA Phase .5 Cabinet expresses condolences to the families and friends of those who lost their lives as a result of the recent heavy rains.
tgt: E tla tsaya fela 25% ya Legato I la SKA.5 Kabinete e fetisetsa matshediso kwa malapeng le ditsala tsa ba ba latlhegetsweng ke matshelo ka ntlha ya dipula tse di maatla tsa fa gautshwane.

src: Cabinet reassures South Africans that the National Disaster Management Centre – through the National Joint Operational and Intelligence (NATJOINT) structure - will continue with search and rescue efforts and humanitarian relief.
tgt: Kabinete e netefaletsa maAforika Borwa gore Tikwatikwe ya Bosetšhaba ya Tsamaiso ya Matlhotlhapelo - ka popegotheo ya Bosetšhaba e e Kopanetsweng ya Tiro le Matlhale - e tla tswelela ka maiteko a go batla le go falodisa mmogo le namolo ya bopelonomi.

src: Cabinet commends the intervention by security forces to aid rescue efforts.
tgt: Kabinete e akgola tsereganyo ya maphata a tshireletso mo go thuseng maiteko a phaloso.

src: All South Africans, especially communities living in flood prone areas, are urged to take extra precautions during periods of extreme weather conditions.
tgt: Go kopiwa maAforika Borwa otlhe, bogolo segolo baagi ba ba nnang mo mafelong a a ratwang ke merwalela, go nna kelotlhoko thata mo dipakeng tsa maemo a bosa a a masisi.

src: Parents and guardians must take precautionary measures to ensure the safety of children.
tgt: Batsadi le batlhokomedi ba tshwanetse go tsaya dikgato tse di maleba go netefatsa gore bana ba nna ba babalesegile.

src: Additionally, motorists and pedestrians need to remain vigilant when using roads in wet conditions.6 Cabinet expresses its gratitude to the public for the part they played in relieving the pressure on the national power grid over the last month.
tgt: Go tlaleletsa foo, bakgweetsi le batsamayakadinao ba tshwanetse go nna ba ntshitse matlho dinameng fa ba dirisa ditsela mo maemong a a bongola.6 Kabinete e rata go leboga setšhaba ka seabe sa sona mo go namoleng kgatelelo mo tlamelong ya bosetšhaba ya motlakase mo kgweding e e fetileng.

src: Individual consumers and corporates are encouraged to continue using electricity wisely and conserve power whenever possible, especially during the current weather conditions.7 South Africa will be attending the Fourth European Union (EU)-Africa Summit taking place in Brussels, Belgium on 2 and 3 April 2014.
tgt: Go rotloediwa badirisi ba ba ikemetseng mmogo le ditheo go tswelela go dirisa motlakase ka tlhokomelo le go somarela motlakase fa go kgonegang gona, bogolo segolo mo seemong sa ga jaana sa bosa.7 Aforika Borwa o tla tsenela Samiti ya Bone ya Makokokopano a Yuropa (EU)- le a Aforika e e diragalang kwa Brussels, Belgium ka la bo 2 le la bo 3 Moranang 2014.

src: The theme of the summit is "Investing in People, Prosperity and Peace".The summit will focus on education and training, women and youth, as well as legal and illegal migrant flows between the two continents.8 On the 24 March 2014, it will be the annual commemoration of the World TB Day.
tgt: Moono wa Samiti ke "Re beeletsa mo Bathong, Lehumo le Kagiso.

src: Cabinet wishes to encourage South Africans to work together with Government to combat this scourge.
tgt: Kabinete e rata go rotloetsa maAforika Borwa go dira mmogo le Puso go lwantsha leroborobo leno.

src: The scourge of TB was worsened not only for South Africa but for the whole of Sub-Saharan Region.
tgt: Leroborobo la TB ga le a etegela fela mo Aforika Borwa, fela le mo Kgaolong yotlhe ya Sub-Sahara.

src: Government’s actions in implementing the biggest HIV and AIDS treatment and prevention programme in the World have stemmed the tide of TB.
tgt: Dikgato tsa puso tsa go tsenya tirisong lenaneo le legolo la kalafi le thibelo ya HIV le AIDs mo lefatsheng le nopotse lekhubu la TB.

src: Government programmes to combat TB also included active case finding and contact tracing, the use of GeneXpert technology to expedite TB diagnosis.
tgt: Mananeo a puso a go lwantsha TB a akareditse gape go batla dikgetse le go sala morago ba ba amaneng le tshwaetso, tiriso ya thekenoloji ya GeneXpert go akofisa go phekolwa ga TRe ipela ka gore Aforika Borwa ke moeteledipele wa Lefatshe ka go anamisa thekenoloji ya GeneXpert kwa ditlamelong tsa boitekanelo.

src: We pride ourselves on the fact that South Africa is the World leader in the coverage of health facilities with GeneXpert technology.
tgt: Kabinete e amogela Simposiamo se se tlang sa Ditona se se ka ga Tepatepanyo ya Ditsibogo tsa Kgaolo malebana le TB mo Lephateng la Meepo mo Borwa jwa Aforika.

src: The Symposium which will be held at the Sandton Convention Centre on 25 March 2014 will bring together role players in governments of the Region, the Mining Sector in South Africa, organised Labour, Development Partners and Civil Society.9 Cabinet congratulated all finalists and recipients of the Second Annual South African Premier Business Awards.
tgt: Simposiamo se se tla tshwarelwang kwa Sandton Convention Centre ka la bo 25 Mopitlwe 2014, mme se tla kopanya bannileseabe mo dipusong tsa kgaolo, Lephata la Meepo la Aforika Borwa, Bodiri jo bo rulaganeng, Balekane ba Tlhabololo mmogo le Baagi.9 Kabinete e akgotse botlhe ba ba fitlheletseng makgaolakgang le ba ba amogetseng Dikgele tsa Bobedi tsa Ngwaga le Ngwaga tsa Dikgwebo tse di Gaisang tsa Aforika Borwa.

src: The Awards recognise performance by businesses in various categories and were bestowed at an event attended by President Jacob Zuma.
tgt: Dikgele di tsibogela tiragatso ya dikgwebo mo dikarolong tse di farologaneng mme di abilwe kwa tiragalong e e neng e tsenetswe ke Moporesitente Jacob Zuma.

src: Among the recipients congratulated by Cabinet is Mr Sam Motsuenyane who deservedly received a Lifetime Achievement Award.10 Cabinet noted the forensic report that was commissioned by National Treasury on the Independent Electorate Commission (IEC).
tgt: Gareng ga baamogedi ba ba akgotsweng ke Kabinete ke Rre Sam Motsuenyane yo o amogetseng Sekgele se se maleba sa Phitlhelelo ya Botshelo Jotlhe.10 Kabinete e lemogile pegelo ya forensiki e e neng e rebotswe ke Matlole a Bosetšhaba ka ga Khomišene e e Ikemetseng ya Ditlhopho (IEC).

src: This follows the recommendation made in the Public Protector’s report.
tgt: Seno se latetse katlenegiso e e dirilweng mo pegelong ya Mosireletsi wa Setšhaba.

src: It has tasked the Minister of Home Affairs to follow up on the matter and advise Cabinet.11 Cabinet condemns the persistent gangsterism in the Western Cape, which is characterised by vicious and brutal attacks on communities and especially children.
tgt: E laetse Tona ya Merero ya Selegae go latedisisa morero oo le go begela Kabinete.11 Kabinete e kgalema ka mantswe a a bogale bosenyi jwa digongwana jo bo tswelelang pele kwa Kapa Bophirima, jo gantsi bo tletseng ditlhaselo tse di maswe le setlhogo mo baaging le, bogolo segolo mo baneng.

src: This cannot be tolerated as it threatens the gains we have made in our democracy.
tgt: Re ka se itshokele seno gonne se tshosetsa diphitlhelelo tse re di fitlhetletseng mo temokerasing ya rona.

src: Cabinet acknowledges the work by the South African Police Service in combating gangsterism and calls on the affected communities to work with police to safeguard our society from this scourge.12 Cabinet conveys its sympathies and condolences to the family and friends of Mrs Martha Mahlangu who was the mother of former MK cadre Solomon Mahlangu.
tgt: Kabinete e lemoga tiro ya Tirelo ya Sepodisi sa Aforika Borwa mo go lwantsheng bosenyi jwa digongwana mme e ikuela mo baaging ba ba amegang go dirasana le mapodisi go sireletsa baagi ba rona kgatlhanong le bosula jono.12 Kabinete e fetisa boutlwelobotlhoko le matshediso go balelapa le ditsala tsa ga Mme Martha Mahlangu yo e neng e le mmaagwe Mokaulengwe wa maloba wa MK, Solomon Mahlangu.

src: Mrs Mahlangu will be buried on Saturday 22 March 2014.
tgt: Mme Mahlangu o tla bolokwa ka Lamatlhatso, 22 Mopitlwe 2014.

src: The City of Tshwane is affording Ms Mahlangu a civic funeral and flags will be flown at halfmast to pay homage to her.
tgt: Motsesetoropo wa Tshwane o direla Mme Mahlangu phitlho ya setšhaba mme difolaga di tla folosiwa go fitlha kwa bogareng go mo tlotla.

src: Key Cabinet discussions and decisions.
tgt: Dipuisano le ditshweetso tse di botlhokwa tsa Kabinete.

src: Cabinet received a report on the Presidential Hotline for the four years it has been functional.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse pegelo ya Mogala wa Boikuelo go Moporesitente wa dingwaga di le nne tse o ntseng o dira mo go tsona.

src: Case resolution, performance improved year on year as follows 64.03% year one 77.79% in year 2 87.46% in year 3 and is now at 94.7%.
tgt: Tharabololo ya dikgetse le tiragatso e tokafetse ngwaga mongwe le mongwe jaana 64.03% ngwaga wa ntlha 77.79% ngwaga wa bobedi 87.46% ka ngwga wa boraro mme ga jaanong e eme fa go 94.7%.

src: Over the four years, the cumulative number of complaints and queries logged increased from 75 873 in the first year to 183 445 in the fourth year.
tgt: Mo dingwageng di le nne, palogotlhe ya dingongorego le dipotsiso tse di tsentsweng e oketsegile go tloga go 75 873 mo ngwageng wa ntlha go ya go 183 445 mo ngwageng wa bone.

src: Cabinet calls on departments and provinces to continue to improve on the quality and speed of the investigation of complaints as the satisfaction of citizens is critical for the reputation of the Presidential Hotline.
tgt: Kabinete e ikuela mo mafapheng otlhe le diporefense go tswelela go tokafatsa boleng le lebelo la dipatlisiso tsa dingogorego gonne go kgotsofala ga baagi go le botlhokwa mo seriting sa Mogala wa Boikuelo go Moporesitente.

src: Cabinet approved the 6th Annual Iterative Industrial Policy Action Plan (IPAP) 2014/15 - 2016/17 for implementation.
tgt: Kabinete e rebotse go tsenngwa tirisong ga Leano la Tiragatso la Pholisi ya Madirelo (IPAP) le le Ipoeletsang Ngwaga le Ngwaga la bo 6 la 2014/15-2016/17.Maikemisetso a magolo a IPAP ke go thibela kwelotlase ya madirelo le go tshegetsa kgolo le go farologanngwa ga ditirelo tsa lephata la tlhagiso la Aforika Borwa.

src: The Minister of Trade and Industry will address the media when IPAP is launched next month.
tgt: Tona ya Dikgwebo le Madirelo o tla bua le babegakgang fa IPAP e tlhomiwa mo kgweding e e tlang.

src: Cabinet approved the approach on the expiry of permits issued under the Special Dispensation for Zimbabweans project (DZP).
tgt: Kabinete e rebotse thulaganyo tebang le go felelwa ke nako ga ditetla tse di reboletsweng batswantle ba maZibambwe ka fa tlase ga porojeke ya Puso e e Kgethegileng (DZP).

src: The permit holders will be expected to re-apply for their permits in their country of origin.
tgt: Batsholaditetla ba tla tshwanelwa ke go dira dikopo tsa ditetla tsa bona sešwa kwa dinageng tse ba tswang kwa go tsona.

src: The Minister of Home Affairs will in due course provide more clarity on the process to be followed and the date of commencement.
tgt: E tla re mo tsamaong ya nako, Tona ya Merero ya Selegae a sedifatse thulaganyo e e tla latelwang le letlha la tshimologo ya seo.

src: Cabinet approved that Section 100 (1)
tgt: Kabinete e rebotse gore ditsereganyo tsa Karolo ya 100 (1)

src: interventions in Limpopo be maintained, in order to allow for a review in June 2014 after the new administration is in place.
tgt: kwa Limpopo di tswelele pele, go letla gore go nne le ditlhotlhomiso ka Seetebosigo 2014 morago ga puso e ntšhwa e sena go tsena mo tirong.

src: This will ensure continuity of interventions to address outstanding challenges.
tgt: Seno se tla netefatsa gore ditsereganyo di tswelela pele sentle go samagana le dikgwetlho tse di saletseng morago.

src: This will ensure that improvements in the provinces financial position and service delivery in social services and other sectors are maintained.
tgt: Seno se tla netefatsa gore ditokafatso mo seemong sa ditšhelete sa porofense le tlamelo ya ditirelo mo ditirelong tsa loago le mo maphateng a mangwe di tswelela pele.

src: Cabinet approved the South African Defence Review 2014, and directed that it be tabled in Parliament.
tgt: Kabinete e rebotse Ditlhotlhomiso tsa Phemelo ya Aforika Borwa ya 2014, mme ya laela gore e tlhagisiwe mo Palamenteng.

src: The Review provides a long term defense policy and Defense strategic trajectory to be pursued by the country over the next four Medium Term Strategic Framework periods.
tgt: Ditlhotlhomiso di tlamela ka pholisi ya phemelo ya pakatelele mmogo le tsela ya togamaano ya Phemelo e e tla latelwang ke naga mo dipakeng tse di latelang di le nne tsa Letlhomeso la Togamaano la Pakagare.

src: The document will be shared with the public, as they participated in the public consultations that were held across the country in the past year.6 Cabinet approved that the Report of the Ministerial Committee on Articulation Policy be published in the Government Gazette for public comment.
tgt: Lekwalo leno le tla abelanwa le setšhaba gonne se nnile le seabe mo dipatlomaikutlong tsa botlhe tse di neng di tshwerwe go ralala naga mo ngwageng o o fetileng.6 Kabinete e rebotse gore Pegelo ya Komiti ya Tona e e ka ga Pholisi ya Dipuo e phasaladiwe mo Kaseteng ya Puso gore setšhaba se tshwaele.

src: The report analyses the post-school education and training system in its socio-economic context.
tgt: Pegelo e sekaseka tsamaiso ya thuto le katiso ya morago ga sekolo go lebeletswe bokao jwa ikonomi ya loago.

src: It provides recommendations to the Minister of Higher Education and Training on how to remove unnecessary obstacles and bottlenecks that prevent or inhibit students’ progression.
tgt: E tlamela Tona ya Thuto le Katiso e Kgolwane ka dikatlenegiso tsa gore go ka tloswa jang dikgoreletsi tse di sa tlhokegeng tse di thibelang tswelelopele ya baithuti.

src: The articulation policy refers to the systematic coordination of educational institutions, programmes and qualifications so that students are able to pursue their chosen learning pathways in an efficient manner.
tgt: Pholisi ya Dipuo e kaya kgokaganyo e e rulaganeng ya ditheo tsa thuto, mananeo le borutegi gore baithuti ba kgone go tswelela mo ditseleng tse ba di itlhophetseng tsa thuto ka tsela e e bokgoni.

src: Cabinet approved the Report from the Ministerial Task Team on Mathematics and Science Foundation Programmes, be published in the Government Gazette for public comment.
tgt: Kabinete e rebotse gore Pegelo go tswa kwa Setlhopheng sa Tiro sa Tona se se ka ga Mananeo a Motheo a Dipalo le Saense, e phasaladiwe mo Kaseteng ya Puso gore setšhaba se tshwaele.

src: The Ministerial Task Team was mandated to develop a Technical Vocational Education and Training College-based Mathematics and Science Foundation Programme.
tgt: Setlhopha sa Tiro sa Tona se romilwe go tlhama Lenaane la Motheo la Dipalo le Saense la Thuto le Katiso ya Tiro ya Setegeniki kwa Kholetšheng.

src: This will help to increase the number of university Science and Mathematics entrants and enhance the innovative capacity as highlighted in the National Development Plan.
tgt: Seno se tla thusa go oketsa palo ya baithuti ba ba tsenang kwa yunibesithi ba Saense le Dipalo le go tokafatsa bokgoni jwa boitlhamedi jaaka go tlhagisitswe mo Leanong la Bosetšhaba la Tlhabololo.

src: The programme targets those who aspire to enter the Technical Vocational Education and Training sub-sector, those already in technical vocational education and training colleges aspiring to progress and enroll in universities, as well as Grade 12 learners who wish to enroll in universities but do not meet the Mathematics and Physical Science requirements.
tgt: Lenaane le totile ba ba eletsang go tsena mo lephataneng la Thuto le Katiso ya Tiro ya Setegeniki, ba ba setseng ba le kwa dikholetšeng tsa thuto le katiso ya tiro ya setegeniki mme ba eletsa go tswelela pele le go ikwadisa kwa diyunibesithi, mmogo le barutwana ba Mophato wa 12 ba ba eletsang go ikwadisa kwa diyunibesithi fela ba sa kgotsofatse ditlhokego tsa Dipalo le Saense.

src: Cabinet approved the findings of the 2012/13 survey on public funding for scientific and technological activities are published.
tgt: Kabinete e rebotse gore diphitlhelelo tsa patlisiso ya 2012/13 ya kabo ya matlole a setšhaba malebana le ditiro tsa saense le thekenoloji di phasaladiwe.

src: National Departments invested an estimated R29, 4 billion in scientific and technological activities in 2012/13, which represents 3% of the total national government budget appropriation.
tgt: Mafapha a Bosetšhaba a beeleditse madi a a fopholediwang go R.5 bilione mo ditirong tsa saense le thekenoloji ka 2012/13, mme seo se emetse 3% ya kabelo ya tekanyetsokabo yotlhe ya puso ya bosetšhaba.

src: This is an improvement from the four year average of 2.9% between 2008/09 to 2011/12.It is also evident that government funds most of the scientific research that takes place in South Africa, and that the bulk of the implementation is located outside national departments, i. e. in science councils and higher education institutions.
tgt: Seno ke tokafalo go tswa kwa palogareng ya dingwaga tse nne ya 2.9% magareng ga 2008/09 go ya go 2011/12.Gape go totobetse gore puso e tlamela ka matlole bontsi jwa dipatlisiso tsa saense tse di diragalang mo Aforika Borwa, le gore bogolo jwa go tsenngwa tirisong ga tsona bo kwa ntle ga mafapha a bosetšhaba, go tewa kwa makgotleng a saense le kwa ditheong tsa thuto e kgolwane.

src: Cabinet was apprised on the evaluation by the Department of Performance Monitoring and Evaluation of ‘The Impact of the Introduction of Grade R on Learning Outcomes’.Early investment in the growth and development of young children is likely to reduce inequality and raise productivity, especially in disadvantaged young children.
tgt: Kabinete e tlhaloseditswe ka tekanyetso e e dirilweng ke Lefapha la Tekolo le Tshekatsheko ya Tiro ka ga 'Ditlamorago tsa go Itsesewe ga Mophato wa R mo Dipoelothutong'.Dipeeletso tsa go sale gale mo kgolong le tlhabololo ya bana ba bannye di ka fokotsa go tlhoka tekatekano le go godisa tlhagiso, bogolo segolo mo baneng ba bannye.

src: Cabinet welcomes the significant achievement in the massive expansion of Grade R which needs to maximise its potential in order to have a more substantial impact on subsequent educational performance.
tgt: Kabinete e amogela diphitlhelelo tse di bonalang mo katolosong e e boitshegang ya Mophato wa R o go tlhokegang gore o godise bokgoni jwa ona gore o nne le dipoelo tse di botoka mo tiragatsong ya thuto.

src: Cabinet was briefed on the findings from the Frontline Service Delivery Monitoring Programme for 2013.Cabinet commends and is encouraged by the improvement from responsible national departments, of their strategic management and oversight of facility-level performance.
tgt: Kabinete e itsesitswe ka diphitlhelelo tsa Lenaane la Tekolo ya Tlamelo ya Ditirelo tse di kwa Mantlheng mo ngwageng wa 2013.Kabinete e akgola e bile e rotloediwa ke tokafalo go tswa mo mafapheng a bosetšhaba a a maikarabelo, ka botsamaisi jwa togamaano le bookamedi jwa tiragatso ya kwa ditlamelong.

src: Findings for the 186 facilities (monitored for the first time) across all provinces during 2013 revealed that the average ratings for dignified treatment, location and accessibility and opening and closing times were positively rated by citizens and monitors.
tgt: Diphitlhelelo tsa ditlamelo di le 186 (tse dilekolwang lwa ntlha) go ralala diporofense tsotlhe ka 2013 di supile gore palogare ya tekanyetso ya tlhokomelo e e seriti, lefelo le phitlhelelo mmogo le dinako tsa go bula le go tswala di lekanyeditswe bontle ke baagi le baelatlhoko.

src: Performance areas which require intervention are complaints management, visibility and signage, queue management and waiting times and safety.
tgt: Dikarolo tsa tiragatso tse di tlhokang tsereganyo ke tsamaiso ya dingongorego, ponagalo le matshwao, tsamaiso ya mela mmogo le nako ya go leta le pabalesego.

src: Findings from the 77 facilities which were re-monitored to assess improvements also signaled improved average ratings, signaling positive signs towards managing facility-level performance as a strategic priority.
tgt: Diphitlhelelo go tswa kwa ditlamelong di le 77 tse di etsweng tlhoko gape go lekanyetsa ditokafalo le tsona di bontshitse ditekanyetso tse di tokafetseng mme seo se bontsha matshwao a a siameng go lebeletswe go tsamaisa tiragatso ya kwa ditlamelong jaaka setlapele sa togamaano.

src: Cabinet approved the hosting of the Southern African Development Community (SADC) Extraordinary Meeting of Ministers responsible for ICT, Communications and Postal Services from 23 to 25 March 2014, in Johannesburg.
tgt: Kabinete e rebotse go amogelwa ga Kopano e e Kgethegileng ya Mokgatlho wa Tlhabololo ya Borwa jwa Aforika (SADC) ya Ditona tse di ikarabelang mo go tsa ICT, Tlhaeletsano le Ditirelo tsa Poso go tloga ka la bo 23 go fitlha ka la bo 25 Mopitlwe 2014, kwa Johannesburg.

src: AppointmentsCabinet approved the following appointments:.
tgt: Go thapiwaKabinete e rebotse go thapiwa ga ba ba latelang:.

src: Ms Elaine Alexander to the post of Deputy Director-General: Economic Development, Trade and Marketing at the Department of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries.
tgt: Mme Elaine Alexander mo phatlhatirong ya Motlatsamokaedikakaretso: Tlhabololo ya Ikonomi, Kgwebisano le Papatso kwa Lefapheng la Temothuo, Jalo ya Dikgwa le Bodirelatlhapi.

src: Ms Nkidi Dinah Mohoboko to the post of Deputy Director-General: Learning Academy at the Department of Home Affairs.
tgt: Mme Nkidi Dinah Mohoboko mo phatlhatirong ya Motlatsamokaedikakaretso: Akatemi ya go Ithuta kwa Lefapheng la Merero ya Selegae.

src: Mr Sam Themba Mtshisa to the post of Deputy Director-General: Corporate Services at the Department of Public Works.
tgt: Rre Sam Themba Mtshisa mo phatlhatirong ya Motlatsamokaedikakaretso: Ditirelo tsa Setheo kwa Lefapheng la Ditiro tsa Puso.

src: Ms Malijeng Theresa Ngqaleni to the post of Deputy Director-General: Intergovernmental Relations at the National Treasury.
tgt: Mme Malijeng Theresa Ngqaleni mo phatlhatirong ya Motlatsamokaedikakaretso: Dikamano tsa mo gare ga Mafapha kwa Lefapheng la Matlole a Bosetšhaba.

src: Mr. Michael Sass to the post Accountant-General at the National Treasury.
tgt: Rre Michael Sass mo phatlhatirong ya Ramatlotlokakaretso kwa Lefapheng la Matlole a Bosetšhaba.

src: Mr Mlungisi Justice Mathonsi as Chief Operating Officer of the South African Post Office.
tgt: Rre Mlungisi Justice Mathonsi jaaka Motlhankedimogolo wa Ditiro kwa Kantorong ya Poso ya Aforika Borwa.

src: Cabinet’s position on current issues.
tgt: Seemo sa Kabinete mo mererong ya ga jaanong.

src: Cabinet appreciated the seventh State of the Nation Address (SoNA) which was delivered by President Jacob Zuma on Tuesday, 17 June 2014.
tgt: Kabinete e itumeletse Puo ya Maemo a Setšhaba ya bosupa e e tlhagisitsweng ke Moporesitente Jacob Zuma ka Labobedi wa Seetebosigo 2014.

src: The programmes which were highlighted by President and are guided by the National Development Plan will be unpacked in the coming weeks by the various Ministerial clusters.
tgt: Manaane a a tlhagisitsweng ke Moporesitente mme a kaelwa ke Leano la Tlhabololo la Bosetšhaba (NDP) a tla tlhalosiwa ka botlalo ke ditlhopha tse di farologaneng tsa Ditona mo dibekeng tse di tlang.

src: In the spirit of Together We Move South Africa Forward, Cabinet calls on all sectors of society to partner with Government in implementing the new Programme of Action, which builds on the achievements made over the past 20 Years of Freedom.
tgt: Ka mowa wa Mmogo tla re tsweletseng pele Aforika Borwa, Kabinete e ikuela mo makaleng otlhe a setšhaba go dirisana le puso mo go tsenyeng tirisong Lenaane la Tiro le lentšhwa, le le agelelang mo godimo ga dikatlego tse di fitlheletsweng mo Dingwageng di le 20 tsa Kgololesego.2 Kabinete e itumeletse go khutlisiwa ga ditshupetso tse di neng di tsweletse mo dikgweding di le tlhano mo Ditlamong tsa Polatinamo.

src: The prolonged strike had dire negative effects on workers, employers and our economy as a whole.
tgt: Ditshupetso tsa nako e telele tseno di nnile le ditiragalo tse di sa itumediseng mo badiring, mo bathaping mmogo le mo ikonoming ya rona yotlhe.

src: While the right to strike is protected in our Constitution and labour laws, Cabinet appeals to both employers and the labour movement to resolve negotiations speedily and to avoid such prolonged strikes.
tgt: Le fa tshwanelo ya go dira ditshupetso e sireleditswe ke Molaotheo wa rona le mo melaong ya ditiro, Kabinete e ikuela mo bathaping le mo mekgatlhong ya ditiro ka bobedi go rarabolola dipuisano ka potlako le go efoga ditshupetso tsa mothale oo tsa nako e telele.

src: The success of our development programmes depends on a stable and thriving economy.
tgt: Katlego ya manaane a rona a tlhabololo e ikaegile mo ikonoming e e tsepameng le go dira bontle.

src: As South Africans, we all have a responsibility to grow the country’s economy.3 Cabinet noted the downgrading of South Africa by the rating agencies, Standard and Poor’s, and Fitch in the past week.
tgt: Jaaka maAforika Borwa, rotlhe re na le maikarabelo a go godisa ikonomi ya naga.3 Kabinete e etse tlhoko go pagololwa ga Aforika Borwa ke ditheo tsa tekanyetso e leng sa Standard and Poor’s, le sa Fitch mo bekeng e e fetileng.

src: Cabinet reiterates that government is alive to the growth challenges South Africa faces.
tgt: Kabinete a santse e buseletsa gore puso e itukiseditse dikgwetlho tsa kgolo tseo Aforika Borwa e tobaneng le tsone.

src: Government has prioritized the accelerated implementation of the National Development Plan, with reforms that are aimed at unlocking South Africa’s growth potential.
tgt: Puso e potlakisitse tsenngotirisong e e potlakisitsweng ya NDP ka dipaakanyo tse di ikaeletseng go tlhagisa bokgoni jwa kgolo jwa Aforika Borwa.

src: Government is committed to improving the regulatory environment, reducing skills shortages and accelerating its infrastructure investment programme as part of removing obstacles that are constraining growth.4 Cabinet welcomes the findings of the 2013 General Household Survey which was recently released by Statistics South Africa.
tgt: Puso e ikemiseditse go tokafatsa tikologo ya melawanataolo, ka go fokotsa tlhokego ya bokgonile go potlakisa lenaane la yone la peeletso mo mafaratlhatlheng jaaka karolo ya go tlosa dikgwetlho tse di kgoreletsang kgolo.4 Kabinete e amogetse diphitlhelelo tsa Dipatlisisokakaretso tsa Malapa tse di tlhagisitsweng ke Lefapha la Mananepalo la Aforika Borwa mo malobeng.

src: These findings confirm the good story that government’s solid policies and programmes are changing the lives of South Africans for the better.
tgt: Diphitlhelelo tseno di netefaletsa naane e ntle ya gore manaane le dipholisi tsa puso tse di nonofileng di fetola matshelo a maAforika Borwa gore a nne botoka.

src: The survey confirms that access to services such as water, refuse collection, housing and free education have recorded steady growth over time.
tgt: Dipatlisiso tseno di netefaletsa gore phitlhelelo ya ditirelo e e jaaka ya metsi, go rwalwa ga ditlakala, dintlo le thuto e e sa duelelweng di itshupile di gola ka nanabelo mo tsamaong ya nako.

src: South Africans with piped water increased to 89,9 per cent while the number of households connected to electricity stood at 85 per cent in 2013.Government’s social grant programme continues to provide a safety net for families and communities who would otherwise be devastated by the scourge of poverty and unemployment.
tgt: MaAforika a a nang le metsi a dipompo a oketsegile go fitlha mo 89,9% fa malapa a a tsentsheditsweng motlakase a e eme mo 85% ka2013.Lenaane la puso la dithebolelo tsa loago le tswelapele go abelana ka madi a tshireletsego mo malapeng le mo baaging bao ntle le thuso ya mothale o ba tla sotlegang le go feta ka leuba la bohuma le go tlhoka ditiro.

src: The number of people accessing social grants increased from 13,7 per cent in 2003 to 45,5 per cent in 2013.
tgt: Palo ya batho ba ba bonang dithebolelo tsa loago e oketsegile go tloga mo 13,7% ka 2003 go fitlha mo 45,5% ka 2013.

src: The percentage of households where people go hungry dropped from 29,3 per cent in 2002 to 13,4 per cent in 2013.
tgt: Diphesente tsa malapa a a robalang ka tlala e wetse kwa tlase go tloga mo 29,3% ka 2002 go fitlha mo 13,4% ka 20.5 Kabinete e tsibogetse boeteledipele jo bo kwa setlhoeng jo bo etilweng pele ke Moporesitente Jacob Zuma jo bo emetseng Aforika Borwa ka go tsenela Samiti ya Mokgatlho wa Aforika ya bo 23 ka moono yo o reng “Temothuo le Tlhagiso e e sa Tlhaeleng ya Dijo mo Aforika.” Samiti e simolola ka la bo 20 go fitlha ka la bo 27 Seetebosigo 2014 kwa Malabo e e kwa Rephaboliking ya Equatorial Guinea.

src: Cabinet noted the high-level South African delegation led by President Jacob Zuma that is attending the 23rd African Union Summit under the theme: “Agriculture and Food Security in Africa”.
tgt: Jaaka karolo ya kontinente, Aforika Borwa e tla bo e nna le seabe mo dipuisanong tsa maitlhomo ka ga tlhabololo ya Aforika mme se tla thusa samiti go matlafatsa manaane a tlhabololo mo nageng.6 Kabinete e lebogisitse Lefapha la Botsweretshi le Setso le mmogo le Setheo sa Tlhabololo ya Bašwa sa Bosetšhaba ka go etelapele ditiragalo tsa Kgwedi ya Bašwa ka moono wa “Bašwa ba tsweletsa pele Aforika Borwa.”Jaaka re tswelapele go keteka Kgwedi ya Bašwa, Kabinete a santse e buseletsa lenaane la puso la go dirisana le bašwa go fetola matshelo a bone le go tlhabolola WEBTOKEN dingwageng di le tlhano fela, R2,7 bilione e beetswe kwa thoko go tshegetsa ka matlole boitlhamedikgwebo jwa bašwa, dibasari tsa baithuti di menagane gabedi mme manaane a go simolola sekolo go sa le gale a thusitse kgato ya motheo mo baneng.

src: The Summit takes place from 20 to 27 June 2014 in Malabo in the Republic of Equatorial WEBTOKEN part of the continent, South Africa will be making a contribution to discussions of the development agenda for Africa and will leverage the Summit to enhance the development programmes for the country.6 Cabinet commends the Department of Arts and Culture and the National Youth Development Agency for leading Youth Month activities under the theme “Youth Moving South Africa Forward”.As we continue to celebrate the Youth Month, Cabinet reiterates government’s programme of working with young people to change their lives and transform the country.
tgt: Ditsereganyo tsa mothale o di tla tswelapele go nna tsepamisomogopolo ya puso, jaaka re laletsa bašwa go dirisana mmogo le rona mo go tsweletseng pele Aforika Borwa.

src: Such interventions will remain a focus for government, as we invite young people to become our partners in moving South African forward.
tgt: Pegelo e tlharolola tiro eo Aforika Borwa e e dirileng mo bolaoding jo bo utlwalang mo ditiragalong tsa phetogong ya loapi, mme e dira dikatlenegiso tsa tseokarolo ya Aforika Borwa mo maitekong a lefatshe ka bophara a go fokotsa kitlano ya GHG e e kwa lefaufaung.

src: The report analyses South Africa’s performance in effective management of the climate change impacts, and makes recommendations for South Africa’s contribution to the global effort to reduce Greenhouse Gas (GHG) concentrations in the atmosphere.
tgt: Seno se tsamaisana le tumelano ya Letlhomeso la Dinagakopano ka ga Phetogo ya Loapi leo Aforika Borwa e le saenileng semmuso ka 1997.Go ya ka tumelano eno dinaga di tshwanetse go neelana ka dipegelo tsa tsona tsa kgatelopele mo ntlheng eno mo morago ga dingwaga tse dingwe le tse dingwe di le pedi.

src: Cabinet welcomes the approval of a new buffer zone for the Mapungubwe World Heritage Site by the World Heritage Committee of UNESCO which held its 38th Session in Doha, Qatar, from 15 to 25 June 2014.
tgt: Aforika Borwa e tla bo e thusa go tsamaisa Kopano ya Foramo ya Tirisanommogo mo Tirisanommogong ya Boitekanelo jwa Bomme ba bana, Masea a a sa Tswang go Belegwa le jwa Bana kwa Tikwatikweng ya Kopanelo ya Sandton kwa Gauteng go simolola ka la bo 30 Seetebosigo go fitlha ka la bo 1 Phukwi 2014.

src: The new buffer zone is the result of a long consultation process involving land owners, community representatives, non-governmental organisations, mining companies and various government stakeholders.
tgt: Go thusa go tsamaisa foramo eno go neela tšhono ya go tsepamisa mogopolo mo botlhokweng jwa go natlafatsa didirisiwa, boitekanelo jwa masea a a sa tswang go belegwa le jwa bana mo Aforika Borwa mmogo le go tshwaraganya makala otlhe a setšhaba go tsayakarolo mo matsapeng ano.

src: The approval of this new buffer zone is a welcome development for South Africa’s efforts to improve the management and protection of its world heritage sites while allowing for responsible and sustainable development.
tgt: Phasalatso ya dipalo tsa ka fao lefatshe le dirang ka gone mo go fitlheleleng Maitlhomo a Tlhabololo a Ngwagakete a bo 4 le a bo 5 le one a tla letlelela batsayakarolo go tswa kwa makaleng a boitekanelo le a e seng a boitekanelo go itemogela kgatelopele le go ithuta.

src: Cabinet reminds all South Africans to honour and remember our beloved former President Nelson Mandela during this Mandela Month by actively participating in the “Clean South Africa” Campaign.
tgt: Kabinete e gakolola maAforika Borwa otlhe go tlotla le go gopola Moporesitente wa rona yo o rategang wa maloba, moswi Nelson Mandela mo Kgweding eno ya Mandela ka go nna le seabe se se tlhaga mo Letsholong la "Phepafatsa Aforika Borwa."

src: During Nelson Mandela Day on 18 July and more broadly during this month South Africans should dedicate at least 67 minutes to clean South Africa as per the call by President Jacob Zuma during the State of the Nation Address.
tgt: Ka Letsatsi la Nelson Mandela ka la bo 18 Phukwi le go ralala kgwedi eno ka bophara, maAforika Borwa a tshwanetse go aba bonnye metsotso e le 67 go phepafatsa Aforika Borwa go ya ka kgoeletso ya Moporesitente Jacob Zuma ka nako ya Puo ya Maemo a Setšhaba.

src: Former President Nelson Mandela taught us that any individual can have a positive impact on their community.
tgt: Moporesitente wa maloba moswi Nelson Mandela o re rutile gore motho mongwe le mongwe a ka ama baagi ba gaabo ka tsela e e molemo.

src: We all have a responsibility to honour his life by cleaning, improving and beautifying our communities.
tgt: Rotlhe re na le maikarabelo a go tlotla botshelo jwa gagwe ka go phepafatsa, go tokafatsa le go ntlafatsa ditšhaba tsa borona la rona.

src: Cabinet welcomes the Passenger Rail Agency of South Africa (PRASA) massive rail revitalisation programme.
tgt: Kabinete e amogela lenaane le le kgolo la tsosoloso ya diporo la Setheo sa Diporo le Banamedi sa Aforika Borwa (PRASA).

src: As part of this programme, the Minister of Transport unveiled the final design of PRASA’s brand-new, modern and safe commuter train which boasts the latest technology the rail industry has to offer throughout the world.
tgt: Jaaka karolo ya lenaane leno, Tona ya Dipalangwa e sirolotse sethalo sa bofelo sa terena e ntšhwa, ya sešweng mme e babalesegile ya PRASA e e ipelang ka thekenoloji ya sešweng mo intasetering ya diterena go ralala lefatshe.

src: This is another special milestone in government’s commitment to build infrastructure that will stimulate the economy and support local procurement.
tgt: Seno ke phitlhelelo e nngwe e e kgethegileng mo maitlamong a puso a go aga mafaratlhatlha a a tla susumetsang ikonomi le go tshegetsa theko ya selegae.

src: The first PRASA train is expected to hit the track in 2015.The modernisation of the train system will overhaul metro rail services - ‘a major catalyst for the transformation of public transport in South Africa.
tgt: Go solofetswe gore terena ya ntlha ya PRASA e tla bo e le mo seporong ka 2015.

src: PRASA will spend R51 billion over the next 10 years to procure 600 top class trains for the people of South Africa.
tgt: Go ntšhwafadiwa ga tsamaiso ya diterena go tla tokafatsa ditirelo tsa diterena tsa metro - 'sesusumetsi se segolo sa phetogo ya dipalangwa tsa botlhe mo Aforika Borwa.

src: A total of 580 of these trains will be manufactured in South Africa at a new factory to be established in Dunnotar outside Nigel in Ekurhuleni at a cost of R1 billion.
tgt: PRASA e tla dirisa bokana ka R51 bilione mo dingwageng di le 10 tse di latelang go rekela batho ba Aforika Borwa diterena tsa maemo a a kwa godimo di le 600.

src: The 600 000 m2 manufacturing facility is designed to house the manufacturing plant, a training facility and fully fledged industrial park.
tgt: Palogotlhe ya diterena tseno di le 580 di tla agiwa mo Aforika Borwa kwa faboriking e ntšhwa e e tla dirwang kwa Dunnotar kwa ntle ga Nigel e e kwa Ekurhuleni ka ditshenyegelo tsa R1 bilione.

src: The project will create 8 088 direct jobs, part of over 33 000 direct and indirect jobs over the 10-year period, achieving a local content level of over 65%.
tgt: Setheo sa bogolo jwa 600 000 m2 se diretswe go kgona go tsenya polante ya bodirelo, tlamelo ya katiso mmogo le phaka e e feletseng ya bodirelo.

src: PRASA will train a total of 19 527 individuals (engineers, artisans, technicians, train drivers and, among others, technologists) during the life of the project.
tgt: Porojeke e tla tlhama ditiro tsa tlhamalalo di le 8 088, e leng karolo ya ditiro di le 33 000 tsa tlhamalalo le tse e seng tsa tlhamalalo mo pakeng ya dingwaga di le 10, go fitlhelela tiragatso ya selegae ya go feta 65%.

src: The Rolling Stock Fleet Renewal Programme is much more than the procurement of trains, it is about three pillars which will bring this industry to its former glory, revive our rail engineering sector and contribute to economic development and localisation.3 Cabinet welcomes the launch today by President Jacob Zuma of the First Automotive Works (FAW) South Africa assembly plant and operations in the COEGA Industrial Development Zone (IDZ) in the Nelson Mandela Bay Metro in Port Elizabeth, in the Eastern Cape.
tgt: Palogotlhe ya batho ba le 19 527 (baenjiniri, badiri ka diatla, bategeniki, bakgweetsi ba diterena le, gareng ga ba bangwe, bathekenoloji) mo nakong ya porojeke.

src: The R600 million truck assembly plant, located in Zone 2 of the COEGA IDZ is funded jointly by China FAW Group Corporation and the China-Africa Development Fund.
tgt: Lenaane la Ntšhwafatso ya Dipalangwa la Kgwebo ya Diterene ga le fela ka ga go rekwa ga diterena, le ka ga dipilara di le tharo tse di tla busetsang intaseteri eno kwa serodumong sa yona sa maloba, tsa tsosolosa lephata la rona la boenjiniri jwa diterena mmogo le go tshwaela mo tlhabololong ya ikonomi ya selegae.

src: Benefits to The Nelson Mandela Bay and the greater Eastern Cape region include generation of foreign direct investment that will in turn create sustainable jobs and provide opportunities for skills development and training.4 Cabinet again condemns the theft of cables from rail, electrical and municipal public infrastructures.
tgt: Kabinete gompieno e amogela go tlhongwa ke Moporesitente Jacob Zuma ga polante ya go lomaganya le go dira ya Ditirelo tsa Dikoloi tsa Ntlha (FAW) ya Aforika Borwa ya Kgaolo ya Tlhabololo ya Diintaseteri (IDZ) kwa COEGA kwa Motsemogolong wa Nelson Mandela Bay kwa Port Elizabeth, e e kwa Kapa Botlhaba.

src: Cabinet further re-iterates its commitment to clamp down on scrap metal companies that feed off and fuel this crime.
tgt: Gape Kabinete e nyatsa bogodu jwa dikheibole go tswa mo mafaratlhatlheng a diterena, motlakase le makgotlatoropo.

src: It also provides the country with a basis to start producing scientists who will contribute to achieving Vision 2030 of the National Development Plan (NDP).This discovery is the beginning of many more that will be made possible with the Square Kilometre Array.
tgt: Kabinete e amogela go saenwa ga Molao o o Baakantsweng wa Pusetso ya Ditshwanelo tsa Mafatshe ke Moporesitente Jacob Zuma, e leng molao o o bontshang go bulwa gape ga go tsenngwa ga dikopo tsa mafatshe ke batho ba ba tlotsweng ke letlha la bofelo le le fetileng mme o tlamela badiradikopo ka dingwaga tse dingwe di le tlhano go dira dikopo tsa mafatshe.

src: Our successful bid has also opened many opportunities in the country, in particular thousands of jobs in construction, operations and maintenance in the Northern Cape where the core of the SKA is being built.8 Cabinet calls on young people to apply now for tertiary institutions in line with the Department of Higher Education and Training’s Apply Now!
tgt: Le fa go setse go tsentswe dikopo tsa pusetso ya mafatshe di fopholediwa go nna 80 000 pele ga letlha la bofelo la 1998, go fopholediwa gore go na le dikgetse tsa boammaaruri tsa palo e e ka fetang eo gatlhano tse di ka tsenngwang ke batswasetlhabelo ba diphudugo tsa pateletso tsa paka ya tlhaolele.

src: Of note are the Summits decisions on key issues pertaining to development, peace and security, climate change and the mobilisation of resources as well as the finalisation of the Agenda 2063 Continental Framework, as part of the vision of Africa in the next 50 years and the Common African Position on the Post-2015 Development Agenda.10 Cabinet sends condolences to the family and friends of African National Congress Women's League Deputy President and former ANC Chief Whip in the National Council of Provinces, Ms Nosipho Dorothy Ntwanambi.
tgt: Gape e tlamela naga ya rona ka motheo wa go simolola go tlhagisa borasaense ba ba tla tshwaelang mo phitlhelelong ya Ponelopele ya 2030 ya NDThibololo eno ke tshimologo ya tse dingwe tse dintsi tse di tla kgontshiwang ke SKKatlego ya kgaisano ya rona gape e butse ditšhono tse dintsi mo nageng, bogolo segolo diketekete tsa ditiro mo dikagong, ditirong le mo tlhokomelong mo Kapa Bokone ko mooko wa SKA o agwang gona.

src: She has left a deep void in the ongoing struggle for a just and equitable society where all its citizens enjoy equal freedoms, rights and opportunities.2 Key Cabinet decisions.
tgt: Kabinete e ikuela mo bašweng go dira dikopo tsa ditheo tsa thuto e kgolwane gone jaanong go lepalepana le letsholo la Lefapha la Thuto e Kgolwane le Katiso la Dira Kopo Jaanong!

src: The conference further agreed on the relocation of the Global Mechanism from the International Fund for Agriculture Development in Rome to Bonn to be co-located with the UNCCD secretariat.
tgt: Kabinete e romela matshediso go balelapa le ditsala tsa Motlatsa Moporesitente wa Mokgatlho wa Basadi wa African National Congress yo e neng e le Semesegolo sa maloba sa Lekgotla la Bosetšhaba la Diporofense, Mme Nosipho Ntwanambi.

src: Cabinet approved that South Africa ratify the Ban Amendment under the Basel Convention on the Control of Transboundary Movement of Hazardous Wastes and their Disposal.
tgt: Kopano e totile go samagana le dintlha tsa lefatshe tsa bosekaka, go batla go nna sekaka le go batla go omelela go go batlang go nna bongola mo tikologong.

src: The Basel Convention is an international treaty that regulates the Trans boundary movement of hazardous wastes.
tgt: Gareng ga ditshweetso tsa botlhokwa, Khonferense e dumelane ka tokafatso ya bokgoni, tiragatso le tirisego ya ditsamaiso tsa kgokaganyo tsa Kgaolo le gore Diyuniti tsa kgokaganyo tsa Kgaolo di dira ditiro tsa tsona ka tshwanelo.

src: While the Basel Convention Ban Amendment was adopted to protect developing countries from receiving imports of hazardous waste from developed countries.
tgt: Gape Khonferense e dumelane ka go fudusediwa ga Tsamaiso ya Lefatshe go tswa kwa Letloleng la Boditšhabatšhaba la Tlhabololo ya Temothuo kwa Roma go ya Bonn gore e busediwe kwa bokwaleding jwa UNCCDitshweetso di tla tshegetsa go maatlafadiwa ga bokgoni jwa go samagana le dikgwetlho tsa go kakafala mo kontinenteng.

src: Ratification of the Ban would ensure that human health and the environment are protected for future generations, and that socio-economic development is promoted sustainably.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse gore Aforika Borwa e amogela Paakanyo ya Thibelo ka fa tlase ga Tumelano ya Basel e e ka ga Taolo ya Motsamao wa go Kgabaganya melelwane ga Maswe a a Kotsi mmogo le go Latlhwa ga ona.

src: This would make a significant contribution to reducing Africa’s problems with dumped hazardous wastes.
tgt: Tumelano ya Basel ke tumelano ya boditšhabatšhaba e e laolang motsamao wa go Kgabaganya melelwane wa maswe a a kotsi.

src: The South African Government has fully implemented the eThekwini Action Plan, adopted at the last BRICS Summit hosted in Durban, South Africa, and will present a hand-over report on sectoral cooperation during its tenure as BRICS Chair, highlighting progress made by South Africa during its tenure as Chair of BRICS in relation to the decisions contained in the eThekwini Declaration and Action Plan.
tgt: Le fa Paakanyo ya Thibelo ya Tumelano ya Basel e amogetswe go sireletsa dinaga tse di tlhabologang go tlogela go amogela diromelwateng tsa maswe a a kotsi go tswa kwa dinageng tse di tlhabologileng, go amogelwa ga Thibelo go tla netefatsa gore boitekanelo jwa batho le tikologo bo sireletsa ditshika tsa isago, le gore tlhabololo ya ikonomi-loago e tswelediwa ka tsela e e nnelang leruri.

src: On Sunday 13 July 2014 the Department of Transport will be providing feedback to the Ekangala and Dr JS Moroko communities on the Moloto Road and Rail Development Initiative.
tgt: Moporesitente Jacob Zuma, o tla etelela pele kemedi ya Aforika Borwa go ya kwa Samiting ya bo6 ya Brazil, Russia, India, China, Aforika Borwa (BRICS), e e tla amogelwang ke Rephaboliki ya Feterale ya Brazil ka la bo 15-16 Phukwi 2014, ka fa tlase ga moono wa: “BRICS: Kgolo e e Akaretsang, Ditharabololo tse di nnelang Leruri."

src: The Moloto Rail Development Corridor will be an integrated public transport system which will have rail as a backbone and other modes of transport – buses and taxis in particular – providing feeder services.
tgt: Ka paka e Aforika Borwa e neng e le Modulasetilo wa BRICS, go nnile le tswelelopele e e bonalang ya go tsepamisa ditsamaiso tsa BRICS tse di tlhomilweng kwa Samiting ya Botlhano ya BRICS, e leng Lekgotlakgwebo la BRICS mmogo le Lekgotla la Maano la BRICS, mme Baeteledipele ba BRICS ba tla newa dipegelo tse di ka ga tiro e e dirilweng ke dipopegotheo tseno.

src: The leadership of Mpumalanga, Gauteng and Limpopo as well as district and municipal mayors will join the Minister during the visit.
tgt: Puso ya Aforika Borwa e diragaditse ka botlalo Leano la Tiragatso la eThekwini, le le amogetsweng kwa Samiting ya bofelo ya BRICS e e neng e tshwaretswe kwa Durban, Aforika Borwa, mme e tla tlhagisa pegelo ya go fetisa marapo malebana le tirisanommogo ya maphata mo pakeng ya yona jaaka Modulasetilo wa BRICS, e sedifatsa tswelelopele e e dirilweng ke Aforika Borwa ka paka ya yona jaaka Modulasetilo wa BRICS malebana le ditshwetso tse di fitlhelwang mo Tumelanong ya eThekwini le Leano la Tiragatso.

src: PRASA, a public entity under the Department of Transport, will lead this project from now going forward.
tgt: Ka Latshipi wa la bo 13 Phukwi 2014, Lefapha la Dipalangwa le tla bo le araba baagi ba Mebasepala wa Nkangala le wa Dr JS Moroka ka ntlha e e mabapi le Letsholo la Tlhabololo ya Seporo le Mmila wa Moloto.

src: Cabinet’s position on current issues.1 Cabinet welcomes the launch by President Jacob Zuma of Operation Phakisa, which fast-tracks delivery through detailed implementation plans, problem-solving and practical actions to drive growth.
tgt: Seemo sa Kabinete mo mererong ya ga jaanong.1 Kabinete e amogela go tlhongwa ga Operation Phakisa ke Moporesitente Jacob Zuma, e e akofisang tlamelo ya ditirelo ka maano ka botlalo a tiragatso, tharabololo ya mathata le dikgato tse di diregang go tsweletsa kgolo.

src: The Department of Environmental Affairs will be the first department to lead collaboration with the industry, labour, civil society and academia to work together to unlock the economic potential of our WEBTOKEN 2010, the ocean economy – or blue economy, as it is also known - contributed about R54 billion to South Africa’s Gross Domestic Product (GDP), and accounted for approximately 316 000 jobs.
tgt: Lefapha la Merero ya Tikologo e tla nna lefapha la ntlha go etelela pele tirisanommogo le intaseteri, bodiri, baagi le barutegi gore ba dire mmogo go bulela bokgoni jwa ikonomi jwa mawatle a rona.

src: Evidence shows that South Africa’s oceans could contribute up to R177 billion to GDP by 2033.
tgt: Ka 2010, ikonomi ya lewatle, jaaka e itsege - e tsentse bokana ka R54 bilione mo go Seelosotlhe sa Ditlhagisiwa tsa Naga mo Ngwageng (GDP) ya Aforika Borwa, mme ya tlhola ditiro di fopholediwa go 316 000.

src: The ocean also has a potential to create between 800 000 and one million direct jobs.
tgt: Bosupi bo bontsha gore mawatle a Aforika Borwa a ka tsenya go fitlha go R177 bilione mo GDP ka 2033.

src: These growth levers reflect at least 4 percent annual growth in both Gross Domestic Product contribution and job creation.
tgt: Seelo seno sa kgolo se bontsha bonnye diperesente di le nne tsa kgolo ya ngwaga le ngwaga mo go tsenyeng seatla mo GDP le mo go tlhamiweng ga ditiro.

src: Marine aquaculture, marine transport, offshore oil and gas exploration and marine protection have all been identified as focus areas of the blue economy.
tgt: Boruatlhapi jwa lewatle, dipalangwa tsa lewatle, oli ya kwa moseja le tlhotlhomiso ya digase mmogo le tshireletso ya mawatle di supilwe jaaka dintlha tse di tshwanetseng go totiwa tsa ikonomi e e tala.

src: A delivery lab has been established under each area to help resolve critical challenges.2 Cabinet thanks all South Africans and the world for participating in this year’s Nelson Mandela International Day.
tgt: Go tlhomilwe laboratori ya tlhagiso mo lefelong lengwe le lengwe go thusa go rarabolola dikgwetlho tse di masisi.2 Kabinete e leboga maAforika Borwa otlhe le lefatshe ka ntlha ya go nna le seabe ka Letsatsi la Boditšhabatšhaba la Nelson Mandela monogwaga.

src: South Africans from every part of our country answered the call to dedicate their time and energy towards making a difference.
tgt: MaAforika Borwa go tswa kwa dintlheng tsotlhe tsa naga ya rona ba tsibogetse pitso ya gore ba abe nako le maikatlapelo a bona go dira pharologano.

src: The clean-up operation beautifies our surroundings and ensures the preservation of our environment.
tgt: Letsholo la go phepafatsa le ntlafatsa tikologo ya rona mme le netefatsa tshomarelo ya tikologo ya rona.

src: As part of this campaign, the Department of Cooperative Government and Traditional Affairs (Cogta) dispatched about 150 Municipal Technical officials across municipalities to take part in this clean-up campaign, but also to support municipalities throughout the year.
tgt: Jaaka karolo ya letsholo leno, Lefapha la Pusotshwaraganelo le Merero ya Magosi le rometse batlhankedi ba Setegeniki ba Makgotlatorop ba ka nna 150 go ralala makgotlatoropo go nna karolo ya letsholo leno la go phepafatsa, mme gape le go tshegetsa makgotlatoropo ngwaga otlhe.

src: Campaigns such as the “War on Leaks” will continue and be intensified where unemployed youth and other community members will be encouraged to join government in fixing water leaks.
tgt: Matsholo a tshwana le "War on Leaks” a a lebaneng le go thiba metsi a a dutlang" a tla tswelela mme a maatlafadiwe moo bašwa ba ba sa direng le baagi ba tla rotloediwang go tshwaragana le puso go baakanya go dutla ga metsi.

src: Cabinet calls on communities to keep rivers and streams clean and clear, as this contributes to healthy, safe and decent living conditions.
tgt: Kabinete e ikuela mo baaging go tshola dinoka le melapo e le phepa gonne seno se tshwaela mo seemong sa botshelo se se itekanetseng, se babalesegile e bile se na le seriti.

src: Polluted rivers and streams threaten the livelihoods of downstream communities.3 Cabinet welcomes the agreement to launch the New Development Bank (NDB) at the Sixth BRICS Summit in Brazil and to establish the bank's regional office in Johannesburg.
tgt: Dinoka le melapo e e kgotlhelegileng di matshosetsi mo matshelong a baagi ba ba nnang gaufi natso.3 Kabinete e amogela tumelano ya go tlhoma Bankatlhabololo e Ntšhwa (NDB) kwa Samiting ya Borataro ya dinaga tsa Brazil, Russia, India, China le Aforika Borwa (BRICS) kwa Brazil le gore kantoro ya kgaolo ya banka e tlhongwe kwa Johannesburg.

src: The NDB will strengthen the cooperation among BRICS member countries and will supplement the efforts of other multilateral and regional financial institutions, thus contributing to the collective commitments of BRICS member countries for achieving the goal of strong, sustainable and balanced growth.
tgt: NDB e tla maatlafatsa tirisanommogo magareng ga dinaga tse e leng ditokololo tsa BRICS mme e tla tshegetsa maiteko a ditheo tse dingwe tsa maphatamantsi le tsa kgaolo tsa ditšhelete, mme ka go rialo e tshwaela mo maitlamong a a kopanetsweng a dinaga tse e leng ditokololo tsa BRICS a go fitlhelela phitlhelelo ya kgolo e e maatla, e e nnelang leruri e bile e na le tekatekano.

src: The regional office will play an important role in funding infrastructure and sustainable development projects in Africa.
tgt: Kantoro ya kgaolo e tla nna le seabe se se botlhokwa sa go tlamela matlole a diporojeke tsa mafaratlhatlha le tlhabololo e e nnelang leruri mo Aforika.

src: Built into the operating model of the NDB is a project preparation facility which will enable the realisation of a number of potential infrastructure projects on the continent.
tgt: Go ageletswe tlamelo ya paakanyetso ya diporojeke mo sekaong sa tiragatso sa NDB e e tla kgontshang go fitlhelelwa ga diporojeke di le mmalwa tse di ka nnang gona tsa mafaratlhatlha mo kontinenteng.

src: These have hitherto not been implemented because of the lack of funding for project preparation, a key step in making project ideas ready for funding and implementation.4 Cabinet expressed great concern over the escalation in violence between Israel and the Palestinian territories.
tgt: Tsona ga di e se di diragadiwe ka ntlha ya go tlhokega ga matlole a paakanyetso ya porojeke, e leng kgato ya botlhokwa mo go baakanyetseng dikakanyo tsa porojeke matlole le go diragadiwa.4 Kabinete e tlhagisitse matshwenyego a magolo ka ntlha ya go etegela ga tirisodikgoka magareng ga Iseraele le Palesitina.

src: Cabinet reiterates President Zuma’s call on the Israeli government to stop its ground and air offensive, which continues to cause loss of life and a devastating humanitarian crisis.
tgt: Kabinete e boeletsa boikuelo jwa Moporesitente Zuma kwa pusong ya Iseraele gore e emise ditlhaselo tsa yona tsa mo lefatsheng le mo lefaufaung, tse di tswelelang go baka tatlhegelo ya matshelo mmogo le mathata a a utlwisang botlhoko a thuso.

src: Furthermore, it calls for an end to the firing of rockets on Israeli citizens by Hamas.
tgt: Godimo ga moo, e ikuela gore Hamas e khutlise go thuntsetsa dirokete mo baaging ba Iseraele.

src: Cabinet is opposed to the veiled attempts by the Israeli Government to use its onslaught on Gaza to undermine the Unity Government in Palestine.
tgt: Kabinete ga e dumelane le maiteko a a fitlhwang a Puso ya Iseraele a go dirisa tlhaselo ya yona kwa Gaza go nyatsa Pusotshwaraganelo ya kwa Palesitina.

src: There will never be a military solution to the Israeli-Palestinian conflict.
tgt: Kgotlhang ya Iseraele le Palesitina e ka se ke ya nna le tharabololo ya sesole.

src: The only solution lies in serious and genuine negotiations involving all parties.
tgt: Tharabololo e le nngwe fela e ikaegile mo dipuisanong tse di tsepameng mme di le boammaaruri tse di akaretsang maphata otlhe.
