src: Mr Livhuwani Tommy Makhode as the Deputy DG: Institutional Planning and Support in the Department of Science and Technology.
tgt: Rre Livhuwani Tommy Makhode Motlatsa Mokaedikakaretso (DDG): Maano a Setheo le Tshegetso mo Lefapheng la Saense le Thekenoloji.

src: Mr Rory Gallocher as the Chief Executive Officer of the Social Housing Regulatory Authority.
tgt: Rre Rory Gallocher jaaka Motlhankedikhuduthamagamogolo (CEO) wa Bothati jwa Taolo ya Dintlo tsa Loago.

src: Dr Pradish Rampersadh as the new Executive Director for the South African Council for Natural Scientific Profssions.
tgt: Ngaka Pradish Rampersadh jaaka Mokaedikhuduthamaga yo montšhwa wa Lekgotla la Diporofešene tsa Saense ya Tlhago la Aforika Borwa.

src: Mr Mark Barnes as the Group Chief Executive Officer of the South African Post Office.
tgt: Rre Mark Barnes jaaka CEO wa Setlhopha sa Kantoroposo ya Aforika Borwa.

src: Board of the Development Bank of Southern Africa:i. Mr Jabulani Philip Moleketi – (re-appointment and Chairperson)ii.
tgt: Boto ya Bankatlhabololo ya Borwa jwa Aforika:i. Rre Jabulani Philip Moleketi – (o thapiwa gape mme ke Modulasetilo)ii.

src: Mr Msokoli Frans Baleni – (re-appointment and Deputy Chairperson)iii.
tgt: Rre Msokoli Frans Baleni – (o thapiwa gape mme ke Motlatsamodulasetilo)iii.

src: Implementation of key government programmes.
tgt: Go Tsenngwa Tirisong ga Manaane a Puso a a Botlhokwa.

src: Cabinet welcomed the signing of 26 agreements to the value of R94 billion during the recent State Visit by Chinese President Xi Jinping.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse go saeniwa ga ditumelano di le 26 tsa boleng jo bo kanaka R94 bilione go tswa mo Ketelong ya Puso ya Moporesitente wa China Xi Jinping ya mo malobeng.

src: The signed agreements included R12 billion to build a car-manufacturing plant in South Africa, a US$500 million loan facility to Eskom for infrastructure development and a US$2.5 billion funding guarantee for Transnet from the China Development Bank.
tgt: Ditumelano tse di saenilweng di akaretsa R12 bilione ya go aga bodutelo jwa dikoloi mo Aforika Borwa, ya madikadimo a a kanaka US$500 milione go tsamaisa ditlhabololo tsa mafaratlhatlha a Eskom le ya tlamelo e e netefaleditsweng e e kanaka US$2.5 bilione go thusa Transnet go tswa kwa Bankeng ya Ditlhabololo ya China.

src: As part of the 2nd Forum on China-Africa Cooperation (FOCAC), President Xi Jinping pledged US$60 billion for development in Africa.
tgt: Jaaka Foramo ya Bobedi ya Tirisanommogo ya China-Aforika (FOCAC),Moporesitente Jinping o ikanne go beeletsa US$60 bilione tebang le tlhabololo mo Aforika.

src: The adoption of a new Declaration and Plan of Action (2016-2018) at FOCAC consolidates the growing mutual partnership between Africa and China, which will unlock new trade and investment opportunities to help stimulate economic growth.
tgt: Kamogelotiragatso ya Tlhomamiso e ntšhwa mmogo le Leanotiro la (2016-2018) kwa FOCAC le sobokanya kgolo ya tirisanommogo magareng ga Aforika le China, e leng se se tla bulelang ditšhono tse ditšhwa tsa kgwebisano le dipeeletso go thusa go tlhatlosa kgolo ya ikonomi.

src: The economy further received an economic boost with South Africa’s BMW Group announcing an investment of R6 billion at its plant in Rosslyn, Pretoria, which bears testament to the important partnership that exists between business and government, and the role that business is playing in the development of the economy.
tgt: Ikonomi e amogetse gape le tshegetso ya ikonomi go tswa kwa Setlhopheng sa BMW sa Aforika Borwa ka go tlhagisa dipeeletso tsa bokanaka R6 bilione kwa bodutelong jwa yone jwa Rosslyn, Pretoria, e leng se se pakang tirisano mmogo e e botlhokwa e e leng teng magareng ga kgwebo le puso, mmogo le tiro eo kgwebo e e jarileng mo go tlhabololeng ikonomi.

src: On Tuesday, 8 December, President Zuma bestowed National Orders to South African citizens and eminent foreign nationals who have contributed to the upliftment of humanity.
tgt: Ka labobedi, 8 Sedimonthole, Moporesitente Zuma o apesitse baagi ba Aforika Borwa mmogo le batswantle ba ba tlotlegang bao ba nnileng le seabe mo go rotloetseng ditirelo tsa botho Matshwao a Tlotlo a Bosetšhaba.

src: The National Orders are a moment of great reflection, celebration and pride for our people.
tgt: Matshwao a Tlotlo a Bosetšhaba ke motsotswana wa go lebelela kwa morago, go keteka le go ikgantsha ka batho ba borona.

src: They celebrate human achievement, human sacrifice and human endeavours that make our country a better place.
tgt: A keteka diphitlhelelo tsa botho, go ikentsha setlhabelo ga batho le kgaratlho ya batho eo e dirang gore naga ya rona e nne lefelo le le botoka.

src: We salute the recipients of the 2015 National Orders.
tgt: Re bontsha tlotlo go baamogedi ba Matshwao a Tlotlo a Bosetšhaba ba 2015.

src: Cabinet appeals to all South Africans to use water sparingly.
tgt: Kabinete e ikuela mo go maAforika Borwa otlhe go somarela metsi.

src: This is in support of a number of measures taken to alleviate the water shortages, which have been exacerbated by the heatwave the country has experienced in the past weeks.
tgt: Seno ke go tshegetsa dikgato di le dintsinyana tse di tserweng go ka fokotsa tlhaelo ya metsi, e leng seo se gagamaditsweng ke mogote oo naga e itemogetseng one mo dibekeng tse di fetileng.

src: Whilst the recent rainfalls in some parts of the country provided some relief, the country’s water shortage remains a real challenge and requires all of us to use water sparingly and responsibly.
tgt: Le fa e le gore pula ya mo malobeng kwa dikarolong tse dingwe tsa naga e fokoditse kimologo, tlhaelo ya metsi ya naga e tswelela go nna kgwetlho e kgolo mme go tlhokega gore rona rotlhe re somarele metsi le go a dirisa ka maikarabelo.

src: Cabinet expressed its appreciation to all South Africans for participating in this year’s 16 Days of Activism for No Violence against Women and Children campaign, which ended yesterday.
tgt: Kabinete e tlhagisitse ditebogo tsa yone mo maAforika Borweng otlhe ka go tsaya karolo mo Letsholong la monongwaga la Matsatsi a le 16 a Bolweladitshwanelo Kgatlhanong le Tiririsodikgoka mo Basading le mo Baneng, le le konoseditsweng ka la bo 10 Sedimonthole 2015.

src: Recent research indicates high numbers of new HIV infections, particularly among young women and girls in Africa between 15 and 24 years of age.
tgt: Dipatlisiso tsa sešweng di bontsha gore palo e e kwa godimo ya ditshwaetso tse dintšhwa, bogolosegolo mo makgarebeng le mo basetsanyaneng mo Aforika, e mo bao ba leng magareng ga dingwaga di le 15 le 24.MaAforika Borwa a rotloediwa go gatelapele ka ditiro tsa manaane a bolweladitshwanelo a letsatsi le letsatsi jaaka karolo ya go nna Kgatlhanong le Tirisodikgoka mo Basading le mo Baneng ya #365 Days Campaign le ya letsholo la #CountMeIn e leng tse di diragadiwang ngwaga otlhe.

src: South Africans are encouraged to take forward their activism into everyday action as part of the #365 Days Campaign of No Violence Against Women and Children and the #CountMeIn campaign that unfolds throughout the year ahead.
tgt: Ka go dirisa #365 Days Campaign le #CountMeIn, naga e tlhoka go tswelela go golaganya ditokololo tsa baagi, bogolosegolo banna, go golagana le puso mo go samaganeng le leuba WEBTOKEN maikarabelo a naga, ka bongwe jwa rona kgotsa ka go golagana ga rona, go fedisa go ata ga kokwanatlhoko ka go tlhokomela boitekanelo jwa rona le jwa batho ba bangwe.

src: Cabinet has appreciated the progress that has been made by the Council for Scientific and Industrial Research in developing a bio-manufacturing process for HIV antibodies.
tgt: Kabinete e itumedisitswe ke kgatelopele e e dirilweng ke Lekgotla la Dipatlisiso tsa Saense le Intaseteri ka go tlhagisa thulaganyo ya tlhagiso ya melemo ya HIV.

src: This brings the health industry a step closer to an economically viable preventative treatment.
tgt: Seno se atumetsa intaseteri ya boitekanelo gaufi le kalafi ya thibelobolwetse e e sa jeng madi a mantsi.

src: Whilst the country still struggles to find the cure for HIV and AIDS, South Africans are still expected to practice safe sex and observe the ABC (Abstain, Be faithful and Condomise) principles of preventing new infections.
tgt: Fa naga e ssantse e tsweletse go kgarakgadiwa ke go batlana le kalafi ya go fedisa HIV le AIDS, maAforika Borwa a tswelela go rotloediwa go tsenela thobalano e e babalesegileng le go obamela metheo ya ABC (Ikilele mo thobalanong, Ikanyege mme o Dirise Mosomelwana).6 Kabinete e akgotse barutwana botlhe, baithuti, barutabana, bafatlhosi, dikolo le ditheo tsa thuto e kgolwane ka go konosetsa ngwaga wa dithuto o o atlegileng, le fa go nnile le dikgwetlho tse go itemogetsweng tsone mo gare ga ngwaga.

src: Cabinet commends all learners, students, teachers, lecturers, schools and institutions of higher learning on concluding a successful academic year, despite the challenges experienced during the year.
tgt: Kabinete gape e lakaletsa masego bao ba dumetseng go sutisa letlha la ditlhatlhobo go tshwarwa ka 2016.

src: Cabinet also wishes those who agreed to postpone examinations rescheduled for 2016 well in their coming examinations.
tgt: Lefapha la Tlhabololo ya Loago, ka tirisanommogo le Lefapha la Phemelo mmogo le Setheo sa Naga sa Tlhabololo ya Bašwa, ba tla tshwara Kopano ya bone ya Bašwa ya Bosetšhaba ya bo Leno ke lenaale la tlhabololo ya boeteledipele leo maitlhomo a lone e leng go fetola maitshwaro le go natlafatsa bašwa ka ditšhono tse di leng fa pele ga matlho a bone.

src: The camp also assists with mentoring and teaching young boys to grow into men who value and respect women.
tgt: Kopano eno gape e thusa ka go ruta basimanyana go ka nna banna ba ba tlotlang basadi.

src: A joint agreement signed between the Minister of Higher Education and Training Minister, Dr Blade Nzimande, and BRICS partners – Brazil, Russia, India and China – is aimed at developing a framework for future cooperation in education.
tgt: Tumelano e e kopanetsweng e e saenilweng ke Tona ya Lefapha la Thuto le Katiso tse di Kgolwan, Ngaka Blade Nzimande, mmogo le balekane ba BRICS e leng – Brazil, Russia, India le China – e ikemiseditse go ka tlhagisa letlhomeso la tirisanommogo mo thutong mo nakong e e tlang.

src: The agreement covers general education, educational policy strategy, Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET) colleges and higher education.
tgt: Tumelano e akaretsa thutokakaretso, togamaano ya dipholisis tsa thuto, dikholeje le dithuto tse dikgolwane tsa Katiso le Thuto ya Diatla le ya Setegenik (TVET) Dikholeje tsa TVET di na le bokgoni jwa go bulela ditšhono tsa ikonomi mo bašweng ba borona, fa ka fa letlhakoreng le lengwe di baakanya dikgwetlho tsa botlhokatiro, tlhokotekatekano le lehuma.

src: TVET colleges hold the potential to unlock economic opportunities for our young people, while addressing the challenges of unemployment, inequality and poverty affecting communities.
tgt: Tumelano, e e tla tokafatsang boleng jwa go ithuta le jwa thuto ya barutabana, gape e dira gore diyunibesiti tsa BRICS di ipofe go tshegetsa diporojeke tsa dipatlisiso tse di kopanetsweng, go rotloetsa manaane a tirisanommogo mo maemong a thuto ya morago ga go konosetsa dithuto tsa ntlha tse digolwane, a bongaka le a a kwa godimo ga a bongaka mmogo le go phasaladiwa sebedi ga dipoelo tsa saense.

src: The agreement, which will improve the quality of teaching and teachers’ education, also commits BRICS universities to support joint research projects, encourage collaborative programmes at postgraduate, doctoral and postdoctoral levels and the co-publishing of scientific results.
tgt: Lefapha la Saense le Thekenoloji le ne le tshwere Foramo ya Saense ya Aforika Borwa ka fa tlase ga moono “Re tlhotlheletsa dipuisano ka ga saense”.

src: Over 45 countries participated in debates on the interface between science, technology and innovation and society, specifically in the context of development.
tgt: Palo e e fetang dikete di le 45 e tsenetse dikganetsano ka ga kipano le saense, thekenoloji le boitlhamedi mmogo le baagi, bogolosegolo go totilwe tlhabololo.

src: The forum also served to strengthen South Africa’s strategic international science, technology and innovation partnerships.
tgt: Gape foramo e nnile le karolo ya go matlafatsa ditirisanommogo tsa boitlhamedi tsa thekenoloji, saense ya boditšhabatšhaba tsa togamaano ya Aforika Borwa.

src: South Africa will be represented in the Council of International Maritime Organisation.
tgt: Aforika Borwa e tla emelwa mo Lekgotleng la Mokgatlho wa Boditšhabatšhaba wa tsa kwa Lewatleng.

src: This is a major step towards realising the country and the continent’s potential in the maritime sector.
tgt: Eno ke kgato e kgolo go ka fitlhelela bokgoni jwa naga le jwa kontinente mo lekaleng la tsa kwa Lewatleng.

src: The organisation is responsible for adopting decisions on global maritime affairs, ranging from the Oceans Economy, rescue initiatives and safety and security matters at sea.
tgt: Mokgatlho o rwele maikarabelo a go tsenyatirisong ditshwetso mo mererong ya tsa kwa lewatleng ya lefatshe, go simolola ka Ikonomi ya kwa Mawatleng, dikgato tsa thuso mmogo le dintlha tsa pabalesego le tshireletsego kwa lewatleng.

src: The participation in this body will support government’s programme of unlocking the country’s maritime potential through the Blue Oceans Economy Strategy and Operation Phakisa, which aims to create over one million jobs by 2033.
tgt: Go tseeng karolo mo mokgatlhong ono go tla tshegetsa lenaane la puso la go bulela bokgoni jwa mawatleng jwa naga ka go dirisa Buka ya Togamaano ya Ikonomi ya kwa Mawatleng mmogo le Operation Phakisa, e eleng tseo di ikaeletseng go ka tlhola ditiro tse di ka fetang milione wa ditiro ka 2033.‎.

src: The South African National Defence Force commenced in the past week a process to upgrade Salisbury Island Naval Station in Durban into a fully functional naval base.
tgt: Sesole sa Tshireletso ya Naga ya Aforika Borwa (SANDF) se simolotse mo bekeng e e fetileng thulaganyo ya tlhabolola Seteišene sa Sesole sa kwa Metsing sa Setlhake sa Salisbury kwa Durban go ka nna kampa e e dirang ka botlalo ya sesole sa kwa metsing.

src: The upgrading of facilities will improve defence capabilities and also contribute towards the ocean economy.
tgt: Ntšhwafatso ya mafelotiriso e tla tokafatsa bokgoni jwa tsa tshireletsego mmogo le go nna le seabe mo ikonoming ya kwa mawatleng.

src: The Department of Health, in partnership with Soul City and Times Media, launched a dedicated health and lifestyle channel The Good Life Network on DStv channel 199.
tgt: Lefapha la Boitekanelo ka tirisanommogo le Soul City le Times Media, le thankgolotse kanale ya thelebišene e e samaganang le tsa boitekanelo tsa mokgwa wa go itlhokomela ya The Good Life Network mo kanaleng ya 199 ya DStv.

src: The channel offers diverse, entertaining and original home-grown content on nutrition, health and fitness, human rights, youth sexuality, HIV and TB, as well as consumer and gender rights.
tgt: Kanale e abelana ka diteng tsa fa gae tsa mmatota tse di dirang gore o itise tse di farologaneng ka ga dijo, go ikatisa, ditshwanelo tsa botho, dirwe tsa thobalano mo bašweng, HIV le TB, mmogo le ditshwanelo tsa bareki le tsa bong jo bo farologaneng.

src: Cabinet calls on South Africans to watch the channel.
tgt: Kabinete e ikuela mo maAforika Borweng go bogela kanale eno.

src: Cabinet approved the publication of the White Paper on the National Health Insurance (NHI) for South Africa, for public comment.
tgt: Kabinete e letleletse gore go phasaladiwe Lokwalotemoso lwa lefapha la puso ka ga Inšorense ya Bosetšhaba ya Boitekanelo, Inšorense ya Bosetšhaba ya Boitekanelo (NHI) mo Aforika Borwa gore baagi ba dire ditshwaelo.

src: The NHI is part of government’s major health sector reforms.
tgt: NHI ke karolo e kgolo ya puso ya ntšhwafatso ya lekala la boitekanelo.

src: The policy proposes government’s ability to offer medical services to all who visit its health facilities.
tgt: Pholisi e tshitshinya bokgoni jwa puso jwa go abelana ka ditirelo tsa boitekanelo mo go botlhe bao ba etelang mafelotiriso a bone a boitekanelo.

src: It will be funded through a central fund that will also be made available to private medical practitioners who want to participate in the scheme.
tgt: E tla tlamelwa ka matlole ka go dirisa motlamedi wa matlole otlhe ao a tla dirisediwang gape le go duelela badiredi ba ditlamo tsa boitekanelo tsa poraefete bao ba batlang go nna le karolo mo sekemeng seno.

src: Once finalised, the policy will be phased in over the years and focus mainly on commencing in underserviced areas.
tgt: Fa e fetswa go konosediwa, pholisi eo e tla tsenngwatirisong mo pakeng ya dingwaga di le tharo mme e tla tsepamisa mogopolo bogolosegolo mo go simololeng go thusa mafelo a a sa boneng ditirelo tse di lekaneng.

src: The Minister of Health, Dr Aaron Motsoaledi, will today brief the media on the roll-out of the NHCabinet approved the National Integrated Early Childhood Development (ECD) Policy.
tgt: Tona ya Boitekanelo, Ngaka Aaron Motsoaledi, gompieno o tla ema ka lefoko bobegakgang mabapi le go tsenngwatirisong ga NHKabinete e atlenegisitse Pholisi e e Kopanetsweng ya Bosetšhaba ya Thuto ya Bana ya go sa le Gale (ECD).Pholisi e tlhagisitswe ka go buisana le bannaleseabe ba ba farologaneng mo lekaleng leno.

src: This integrated ECD policy will ensure all young children and their caregivers are able to access comprehensive quality ECD services from conception to Grade The policy extends the service to eight-year-old children with developmental difficulties.
tgt: E ne ya isiwa kwa baaging gore ba dire ditshwaelo ka Tlhakole 2015.Pholisi eno e e kopanetsweng ya ECD e tla netefatsa gore bana botlhe le batlhokomedi ba bone ba kgona go fitlhelela ditirelo tse di boleng tse di mosola tsa ECD go tswa kwa tshimologong go fitlha kwa Mophatong wa Pholisi eno e atolosa ditirelo go fitlha mo baneng ba dingwaga di le robedi ba ba nang le dikgwetlho tsa go ithuta.

src: The policy further provides a monitoring and evaluation framework to ensure it is effectively implemented to all children irrespective of race, gender or religion.
tgt: Gape pholisi e abelana le ka letlhomeso la tekolo le tshekatsheko go netefatsa fa e tsenngwatirisong ka tshwanelo mo baneng botlhe go sa kgathalesege lotso lwa bone, bong jwa bone kgotsa tumelo ya bone.

src: Cabinet has approved the White Paper on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities and its Implementation Matrix.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse Lokwalotemoso lwa lefapha la puso tebang le Ditshwanelo tsa Batho ba ba nang le Bogole mmogo le Dikgatosenngotirisong tsa lone.

src: This is aligned to the disability-inclusive Sustainable Development Goals, adopted by the United Nations (UN) General Assembly (UNGA) in September 2015.
tgt: Seno se bapisitswe le Dipeelo tsa Tlhabololo ya Tshomarelo ya go akaretsa bagolofadi, tseo di amogetsweng ke Kopanokakaretso ya Dinagakopano (UNGA) ka Lwetse 2015.Pholisi e tla gatelela phetolothefosano le dipaakanyo mabapi le kakaretso yotlhe, go kopanngwa le tekatekano tebang le batho ba ba nang le bogole.

src: Cabinet approved the publication of the National Sanitation Policy for public comment.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse go phasaladiwa ga Pholisi ya Kgeleloleswe ya Bosetšhaba gore baagi ba dire ditshwaelo.

src: The policy places the well-being of people at the centre of development by striking a balance between allocating financial resources to support investments in higher levels of service, providing services to underserved households, while also maintaining and refurbishing existing sanitation infrastructure.
tgt: Pholisi e beela boitekanelo jwa batho kwa setlhoeng mo tlhabololong ka go dira gore go nne le tekatekano tebang le go abelana ka metswedi ya matlole go ka tshegetsa dipeeletso mo maemong a a kwa godimo a ditirelo, go abela ditirelo kwa malapeng a a tlamelwang ka ditirelo tse dinnye, ntse go tsweletswe go tlhokomela le go ntšhwafatsa mafaratlhatlha a a santseng a le teng a kgeleloleswe.

src: Cabinet approved for the submission to Parliament of South Africa’s 5th Periodic Report (2009-2014) on the Implementation of the Convention on the Elimination of all Forms of Discrimination against Women.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse go tlisiwa kwa Palamenteng ya Aforika Borwa ga Pegelo ya Dipaka di le Tlhano (2009-2014) ka ga Go Tsenngwa Tirisong ga Melao ya go Fedisa Mekgwa yotlhe ya Tlhaolele mo Basading.

src: The report provides an overview on the effectiveness of the range of laws, policies and programmes implemented and highlights the country’s achievements on women’s empowerment and gender equality.
tgt: Pegelo e tlamela ka lemorago la mesola ya melao e e farologaneng, dipholisis le manaane ao a tsentsweng tirisong mmogo le go neela dintlhakgolo tsa dikatlego tsa naga fa go tla mo matlafatsong ya basadi le tekatekano ya bong.

src: The report also recognises that there are persistent challenges and barriers to overcoming inequality and discrimination in the country.
tgt: Pegelo gape e tlhagisa gore go na le dikgwetlho tse di tsweletseng le dikgoreletso go ka fedisa tlhokotekatekano le tlhaolele mo nageng.

src: Cabinet approved the publication of the Draft National Action Plan to Combat Racism, Racial Discrimination, Xenophobia and Related Intolerance, for public comment.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse go phasaladiwa ga Leanotirotlhomo la Bosetšhaba la Twantsho ya Ditiro tsa Tlhaolele, Tlhaolele go ya ka Lotso, Tlhaolele go ya ka Semorafe mmogo le Ditiragalo tse Dingwe tsa Tlhoko Itshokelano, gore baagi ba dire ditshwaelo.

src: The plan is an integrated and systematic national strategy aimed at combating racism and building a truly non-racist and non-sexist democratic South WEBTOKEN provides a framework for sustained and coordinated measures to be undertaken by the country as a whole to deal with the legacy of racism and racial discrimination.
tgt: Leano leno ke togamaano ya bosetšhaba e e rulagantsweng e bile e kopanetswe ka maitlhomo a go lwantshana le tlhaolele go ya ka lotso mme go agiwa Aforika Borwa wa boammaruri wa temokerasi yo a senang tlhaolele go ya ka lotso le go ya ka bong.

src: This assists South Africa to meet its international, regional and national obligations, specifically the Durban Declaration and Programme of Action adopted by the UN at the World Conference against Racism in 2001.
tgt: Le neelana ka letlhomeso la dikgato tse di rulaganeng tsa leruri tse di ka tsewang ke naga ka bojotlhe go ka samagana le lefa la ditiro tsa tlhaolele le la tlhaolele go ya ka lotso.

src: Cabinet was briefed on progress made on the digital migration programme.
tgt: Kabinete e nopoletswe ka kgatelopele e e dirilweng mo lenaaneng la phetolelokgaso go ya go ya dijithale.

src: It approved the commencement of the dual-illumination period for the digital broadcasting signal in South Africa on 1 February 2016.
tgt: E amogetse gape le tshimololo ya paka ya kgasopedi mabapi le kgaso ya dijithale mo Aforika Borwa go ka simolola ka la bo 1 Tlhakole 2016.Phetogelo e no ya go tswa mo ditirelong tsa kgaso ya analoko go ya go ya dijithale e tlhagisa makhubu a a tlhokegang thata a kgaso a a nang le matshwanedi a go abelana ka ditirelo tse di latelelang tsa porotebente.

src: The migration from analogue to digital broadcasting services releases the much-needed radio frequency spectrum suitable for the provision of mobile broadband services.
tgt: Seno se tla oketsa kgaisano ya ikonomi ya Aforika Borwa ka go tsosolosa intaseteri ya kgaso, go natlafatsa intaseteri ya botlhagisi jwa ditlhagisiwa tsa ileketeroniki, go tlhola ditiro, mmogo le go tlhagisa mananeo a kgaso a a farologaneng a mantsi a fa gae.

src: This will increase the competitiveness of the South African economy by revitalising the broadcasting industry, strengthening the electronics manufacturing industry, creating jobs, and developing more local and diverse broadcast content.
tgt: Kabinete e nopoletswe ka ga diphitlhelelo tsa Pegelo ya Ditshupetso tsa Boitshimololedi le tsa Saense le Thekenoloji mo Aforika Borwa ya 2014 mmogo le setlwaedi sa tiragatso ya Thulaganyo ya Boitshimololedi ya Naga (NSI), tse di tlhagisiwang ngwaga le ngwaga ke Lekgotla la Dikeletso ka Boitshimololedi la Bosetšhaba.

src: Cabinet was briefed on the findings of the 2014 South African Science, Technology and Innovation Indicators Report and the trends in the performance of the National System of Innovation (NSI), produced annually by the National Advisory Council on Innovation.
tgt: Pegelo e dirisa ditshupetso tse di diphatsa go ka sekaseka tiragatso le seabe sa NSI mo ditlapeleng tse di botlhokwa tsa bosetšhaba tse di tlhagisitsweng ke Leano la Tlhabololo la Bosetšhaba (NDP) mmogo le ditokomane tse dingwe tsa dipholisi tse di nang le seabe mo tlhabololong ya ikonomi ya loago.

src: The report uses critical indicators to assess the performance and contribution of the NSI to key national priorities articulated in the National Development Plan (NDP) and other policy documents which contribute to socio-economic development.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse go phosololwa ga dikgotlatshekelo tsa magiseterata tebang le Limpopo le Mpumalanga, mmogo le go tlhomiwa ga Kgotlatshekelo ya Magiseterata ya Lephalale jaaka kantoro ya tikologo ya Karolo ya Limpopo, go nna monamaotshwere go fitlhelela kantoro ya tikologo ya karolo ya leruri e agiwa mo lefelong leo.

src: Cabinet approved the rationalisation of magisterial districts for Limpopo and Mpumalanga, and the designation of the Lephalale Magistrate’s Court as a local seat of the Limpopo Division of the High Court, as an interim measure until a separate permanent local seat of the Division is built in the area.
tgt: Go phosololwa ga dikgotlatshekelo tsa magiseterata mmogo le mafelo a taolo a Dikarolo tsa Kgotlatshekelo e Kgolo ka karolo ya ntšhwafatso ya pholisi maitlhomo a yone ke go baakanya lefa la thulaganyo ya bodulo e e sa siamang ya mo malobeng.

src: The rationalisation of magisterial districts and areas of jurisdiction of the Divisions of the High Court is part of the policy reform aimed at redressing the legacy of spatial injustices of the past.
tgt: Ke karolo gape ya phetolothefosano e e namileng go ka thusa go ka fitlhelela bosiamisi, e leng seo se lepalepisitsweng le Molaotheo wa Rephaboliki ya Aforika Borwa ya 1996.

src: It is also part of the broader transformation imperative to enhance access to justice, which is aligned to the Constitution of the Republic of South Africa of 1996.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse pegelo ka ga kgatelopele mabapi le go tsenngwatirisong ga ditaelo tsa Kabinete kwa Limpopo go ya ka Karolo ya bo 100 (1)

src: Cabinet approved the withdrawal of Section 100 (1)
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse go gogelwa morago ga ga Karolo ya bo 100 (1)

src: by 31 March 2016 in the following Limpopo provincial departments: Health Transport Public Works Roads and Infrastructure and Treasury.
tgt: go fitlha ka Mopitlwe 2016 mo mafapheng a a latelang a porofense ya Limpopo: Lefapha la Boitekanelo Lefapha la Dipalangwa Lefapha la Ditirelo tsa Puso Lefapha la Ditsela le Mafaratlhatlha go akaretsa le Lefapha la Matlole.

src: Cabinet also approved the conditional withdrawal of Section 100 (1)
tgt: Kabinete gape e amogetse go gogelwa morago ga nakwana ga Karolo ya bo 100 (1)

src: in Education to pave the way for the Provincial Treasury to effectively implement Section 18 of the Public Finance Management Act, 1999 (Act 1 of 1999) in the Limpopo Department of Education, with support from national government.
tgt: mo Thuto go ka ala tsela gore Lefapha la Matlole la Porofense le tsenya ka matlhagatlhaga Karolo ya bo 18 ya Molao wa Botsamaisi jwa Madi a Puso (PFMA), 1999 (Molao wa bo 1 wa 1999) kwa Lefapheng la Thuto la Limpopo, ka tshegetso go tswa kwa pusong ya bosetšhaba.

src: Cabinet approved the following directives to the Premier and the MECs for Finance and of Education:a) Capacitating the provincial departments by recruiting competent personnelb) Finalising the appointment of senior management positions andc) Dealing decisively with leadership failure and corruption.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse ditaelo tse di latelang tebang le Tonakgolo le Bakhuduthamaga (di-MEC) tsa Matlole le tsa Thuto:a) Go tlamela ka badiredi mafapha a porofense ka go thapa badiredi ba ba gaisangb) Go konosetsa go thapa botsamaisi jo bogolo lec) Go samagana ka tshwanelo le go retelelwa le bogwenegwene jwa boeteledipele.

src: Cabinet approved for South Africa to host the high level Anti-Drugs Dialogue Conference from 11 to 12 March 2016, which will be under the auspices of the African Union.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse gore Aforika Borwa e tshware Khonferense ya maemo a a kwa godimo ya Dipuisano tse di leng Kgatlhanong le Diritibatsi go simolola ka la bo 11 go fitlha ka la bo 12 Mopitlwe 2016, e leng seo se tla nnang ka fa tlase ga taolo ya Mokgatlhotshwaraganelo wa Aforika (AU).Seno se diragadiwa jaaka kopano ya go lekola ya Dipuisano tse di Kgatlhanong le Diritibatsi magareng ga Aforika le Russia, e leng seo se ikaeletseng go tlhagisa maemo a a kopanetsweng tebang le go samagana le mathata a lefatsha a a ka ga diritibatsi.

src: This serves as a follow-up session of the Russia-Africa Anti-Drugs Dialogue, which aims to present a consolidated position regarding countering the world drug problem.
tgt: Seno se tla tlhagisiwa kwa Kopanong e e Itlhophileng ya UNGA ka Moranang 2016.Ntwa kgatlhanong le diritibatsi tseo di seng mo molaong e tsamaisana le NDP e bile Dipuisano eno e tla tlhagisa serala sa go ka tsweletsa go gagamatsa Leano la Botlhokwa la Diritibatsi la Bosetšhaba (2013-2017).

src: Cabinet approved for the Department of Human Settlements to co-host the “Leading Change in the City: From Slums to Inclusive, Safe, Resilient and Sustainable Human Settlements” Conference with the UN Human Settlements Programme, in March 2016.The conference supports both the international development agenda and the domestic development agenda by strengthening support for Goal 11 of the Sustainable Development Goals: Make cities and human settlements inclusive, safe, resilient and sustainable.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse gore Lefapha la Bonno jwa Batho le tshware mmogo Khonferense le Lenaane la Bonno jwa Batho la “Ketelelopele ya Diphetogo mo Motseteropong: go tswa kwa megoafatsheng go lebisa kwa Bonnong jwa Batho jo bo akaretsang botlhe, jo bo babalesegileng, jo bo sa Tseweng ke Ditsuatsue le jwa Leruri” ka Mopitlwe 2016.Khonferense e tshegetsa maphata ka bobedi e leng lephata la tlhabololo la boditšhabatšhaba mmogo le lephata la tlhabololo la fa gae ka go gagamatsa tshegetso Peelong ya bo 11 ya Dipeelo tsa Tlhabololo ya Leruri: Go dira gore diteropokgolo le bonno jwa batho di fitlhelesege, di babalesege, di se tsewe ke ditsuatsue mme e nne tsa leruri.

src: The conference forms part of the discussion on the implementing of the post-2015 UN Development Agenda and the “New Urban Agenda” to be adopted by the UN in 2016.
tgt: Khonferense ke karolo ya dipuisano tse di ka ga go tsenngwatirisong ga Lenaneo la Tlhabololo la Dinagakopano (UN) la morago ga 2015 mmogo le “Lenaneo le Lentšhwa la Teropo” leo le tla amogelwang ke Dinagakopano (UN) ka 2016.

src: Cabinet approved for the Agricultural Research Council to host the 3rd Global Conference on Agricultural Research for Development in April 2016.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse gore Lekgotla la Dipatlisiso tsa Temothuo le tshware Khonferense ya Boraro e e ka ga Dipatlisiso tsa Temothuo tebang le Tlhabololo ka Moranang 2016.

src: The conference will identify: international research and innovation priorities as well as needs in national innovation systems so as to achieve future development goals, in particular for family farmers and poor communities.
tgt: Khonferense e tla nopola: dipatlisiso tsa boditšhabatšhaba le ditlapele tsa boitshimololedi mmogo le ditlhokego mo thulaganyong ya boitshimololedi mo nageng gore go kgonagale go ka fitlhelela dipeelo tse di tlang tsa tlhabololo, bogolosegolo mo malapeng a balemirui mmogo le baagi ba ba humanegileng.

src: Cabinet approved the publication of the Marine Spatial Planning Bill of 2015 for public comment.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse gore go phasaladiwe Molaotlhomo wa Tiromaano ya Sekgoba sa kwa Mawatleng wa 2015 gore baagi ba dire ditshwaelo.

src: The Bill provides a legal framework to unlock ocean economic potential by promoting cooperative spatial planning.
tgt: Molaotlhomo yoo o abelana ka letlhomeso la semola go ka bulela bokgoni jwa ikonomi ya kwa mawatleng ka go rotloetsa tiromaano ya sekgoba sa dikoporasi.

src: The Bill will assist the already existing Operation Phakisa institutional structures.
tgt: Molaotlhomo o tla thusa ditheo tseo di leng gone ga jaanong tsa Operation Phakisa.

src: It seeks to promote collaboration and responsible ocean governance arrangement.
tgt: o batla go rotloetsa tirisanommogo le dithulaganyo tse di nang le maikarabelo tsa bobusi jwa mawatle.

src: Upcoming events.
tgt: Ditiragalo tse di tlang.

src: President Zuma will lead the country’s Reconciliation Day celebration on 16 December in Port Elizabeth, Eastern Cape under the theme: “Bridging the divide: Building a common South African nationhood towards a national developmental state”.
tgt: Moporesitente Zuma o tla etelela pele mokete wa naga wa Letsatsi la Poelano ka la bo 16 Sedimonthole kwa Port Elizabeth, Kapa Botlhaba ka fa tlase ga moono: "Go fokotsa dikgaogano: Go aga Legae la Setšhaba sa Aforika Borwa se se lebisang kwa pusong e tlhabololang setšhaba.

src: The Minister of Telecommunications and Postal Services, Dr Siyabonga Cwele, will lead the South African delegation at the UNGA on the World Summit on the Information Society (WSIS) from 15 to 16 December 2015, where South Africa’s country position, contributing to the WSIS+10 Non-Paper will be presented.
tgt: Tona ya Lefapha la Mafaratlhatlha a Ditlhaeletsano le Ditirelo tsa Poso, Ngaka Siyabonga Cwele, o tla etelelapele baemedi ba Aforika Borwa kwa UNGA kwa Samiting ya Lefatshe ya Setlhopha sa Tshedimosetso go tloga ka la bo 15 go fitlha ka la bo 16 Sedimonthole 2015, mo maemo a naga ya Aforika Borwa, a tla nnang le seabe mo go WSIS+10 mo go ka se tlhagisiweng Pampiri-Epe.

src: Cabinet’s position on key issues in the environment South Africa successfully hosted the 7th Africities Summit of cities and local governments of Africa in Johannesburg from 29 November to 3 December 2015.
tgt: Aforika Borwa e tshwere ka aktlego Samiti ya bo supa ya Diteropokgolo tsa Aforika le dipusoselegae tsa Aforika kwa Johannesburg go tloga ka la bo 29 Ngwanaitseele go fitlha ka la bo 3 Sedimonthole 2015.

src: Under the theme: “Shaping the future of Africa with the people: the contribution of African local authorities to agenda 2063 of the African Union”, the summit, which attracted 15 000 mayors and 500 000 councilors, is one of the most concrete initiatives for building African unity.
tgt: Ka fa tlase ga moono: “Go baakanya bokamoso jwa Aforika le batho: seabe sa bothati jwa selegae jwa Aforika mo lenaaneng la 2063 la Mokgatlhotshwaraganelo wa Aforika” samiti, eo e ngoketseng dimeyara di le 15 000 le dikhanselara di le 500 000, ke enngwe ya matsholo a a matla a go aga tshwaraganelo ya Aforika.

src: The summit focused on strengthening local government across the African continent, particularly financial management and establishing a secure revenue base, towards the attainment of Agenda 2063 – the Africa we want.
tgt: Samiti e ne e tsepamisitse mogopolo mo go matlafatseng dipusoselegae go ralala le kontinente ya Aforika, bogolosegolo botsamaisi jwa matlole le go tlhola motheo wa lotseno lo lo babalesegileng, gore go fitlhelelwa Lenaneo la 2063 la – Aforika yo re mo batlang.

src: The summit supports the goals of the NDP in which cities and local government play an important role in our overall development.
tgt: Samiti eno e tshegetsa dipeelo tsa NDP mo diteropokgolo le dipusoselegae di tshamekang karolo e e botlhokwa mo tlhabololong ka botlalo.

src: Cabinet remains confident that as negotiations unfold at the 21st session of the Conference of the Parties (COP21) to the UN Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC), a fair and binding agreement will be reached.
tgt: Kabinete e tswelela go itshepa gore fa dipuisano di tswelela kwa Khoferenseng ya Makoko ya bo 21 (COP21) tebang le Letlhomeso la Tumelano ya Dinagakopano tebang le Phetogo ya Maemo a Loapi (UNFCCC), tumelano e e sa tseeng letlhakore e e tshwaraganyang maphata otlhe e tla amogelwa.

src: Climate change is a global problem requiring a global solution, which can only be effectively addressed multilaterally, under the broad-based legitimacy of the UNFCCC and with all parties making a contribution.
tgt: Phetogo ya maemo a loapi ke bothata jwa lefatshe lotlhe mme go tlhokega tharabololo ya lefatshe lotlhe, e leng seo se ka baakanngwang ka tshwanelo ke dipuso di le mmalwa, ka fa tlase ga tetlelelo ya UNFCCC le makoko otlhe a tsaya WEBTOKEN Aforika Borwa re ka bua ka boikgantsho gore re tsentsetirisong dipholisi tse di mafolofolo e bile e le tsa boitshimololedi tse di gatelang pele, mmogo le maano a a samaganang le maemo a loapi a a fetogetseng ruri.

src: In South Africa, we can proudly say that we have put in place progressive, innovative and proactive policies, and plans to deal with an ever-changing climate.
tgt: Dipholisi tseno di laolwa ke metheo e e reretsweng ruri ya tlhabololo ya leruri, e leng karolo e e botlhokwa thata ya Ponelopele ya 2030 jaaka go tlhagelela mo NDJaaka e le kopano ya bofelofelo ya Kabinete monongwaga wa 2015, kabinete e eletsa maAforika Borwa otlhe matlhatsi le matlhogonolo mo pakeng e e tlang ya khunologo.

src: These policies are guided by the overarching principle of sustainable development, which is the cornerstone of Vision 2030 as contained in the NDBeing the last Cabinet meeting for 2015, Cabinet extends its best wishes to all South Africans for the upcoming festive season.
tgt: Ka mowa wa setlha seno le ka go tsweletsa mowa wa Botho, Kabinete e ikuela mo maAforika Borweng otlhe go ka thusa batho le malapa a a tlhokang mo ditšhabeng tsa bobone.

src: In the spirit of the season and in keeping with the spirit of Ubuntu, Cabinet calls on all South Africans to assist needy individuals and families in their community.
tgt: Re setšhaba se se tlhokomelanang, se se tlhotlanang mme e bile se tlhokomela bao ba humanegileng.

src: The coming New Year offers all of us the possibility to recommit ourselves to work for a better future for all.
tgt: Ngwaga o Mošwa o o tlang o neela botlhe tšhono ya go ikana gape go direla bokamoso jo bo botoka mo go botlhe.

src: Cabinet extends its condolences and sympathies to the family and friends of Mohamed Ismail (“Issy”) Dinat, who passed on Tuesday, 8 December.
tgt: Kabinete e romela matshediso a yone le kutlwelobotlhoko kwa go ba lelapa le ditsala tsa Mohamed Ismail (“Issy”) Dinat, yo a ragileng kgamelo ka Labobedi, 8 Sedimonthole.

src: His selflessness and involvement in the Struggle contributed to our freedom.
tgt: Go se inaganele a le esi ga gagwe mmogo le mo go nneng le seabe ga gagwe mo kgaratlhong go nnile le seabe mo go iponeleng kgololesego ya rona.

src: AppointmentsAll appointments are subject to the verification of qualifications and the relevant clearance.
tgt: Go thapiwaGo thapiwa gotlhe go tla diragadiwa fa makwalothuto otlhe a netefaditswe mme go amogetswe tetlelelo e e matshwanedi.

src: Extension of the employment contract of Mr Thabane Wiseman Zulu as the Director-General (DG) at the Department of Energy.
tgt: Katoloso ya konteraka ya go thapiwa ya Rre Thabane Wiseman Zulu jaaka Mokaedikakaretso (DG) kwa Lefapheng la Eneji.

src: Dr Mmaphaka Ephraim Tau as Deputy DG (DDG): Forestry and Natural Resources Management at the Department of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries.
tgt: Ngaka Mmaphaka Ephraim Tau jaaka Motlatsamokaedikakaretso (DDG): Botsamaisi jwa Metswedi ya Tlhago le ya Bodirelatlhapi kwa Lefapheng la Temothuo, Jalo ya Dikgwa le Bodirelatlhapi.

src: Ms Kelebogile Sybil Sethibelo as DDG: Institutional Governance at the Department of Arts and Culture.
tgt: Mme Kelebogile Sybil Sethibelo jaaka DDG: Bobusi jwa Ditheo kwa Lefapheng la Botsweretshi le Setso.

src: Mr Omega Shelembe as DDG: State-Owned Enterprises Oversight and Information Communication Technology Enterprise Development at the Department of Telecommunications and Postal Services (DTPS).
tgt: Rre Omega Shelembe jaaka DDG: Tlhokomelo ya Dikgwebokgolo tsa Puso le Dikgwebokgolo tsa Tlhabololo ya Thekenoloji ya Ditlhaeletsano le Tshedimosetso kwa Lefapheng la Mafaratlhatlha a Ditlhaeletsano le Ditirelo tsa Poso (DTPS).

src: Mr Edward Xolisa Makaya as DDG: Africa at the Department of International Relations and Cooperation.
tgt: Rre Edward Xolisa Makaya jaaka DDG: Africa kwa Lefapheng la Dikamano le Tirisano ya Boditšhaba.

src: Ms Thulisile Glory Manzini as DDG: Administration at the DTPIn conclusion, Cabinet extends its gratitude to those South Africans who complied by submitting their tax returns resulting in a total of 5.94 million tax returns received for non-provisional taxpayers.
tgt: Mme Thulisile Glory Manzini jaaka DDG: Lephata la Tsamaiso kwa DTPS.

src: This is 11.52 per cent higher than in 2014, and the compliance for taxpayers filing on time exceeded 90 per cent for the third consecutive year.
tgt: Fa re digela, Kabinete e leboga maAforika Borwa ao a obametseng tsa lekgetho ka go tsenya dipusetso tsa bone tsa lekgetho e leng seo se dirileng gore go nne le palogotlhe ya dipusetso tsa lekgetho di le 5.94 milione tse di amogetsweng tsa baobamelalekgetho.

src: This high level of compliance enables government to deliver services that improve the quality of life of all its citizens.
tgt: Kobamelo e e jaaka eno ya maemo a a kwa godimo e thusa puso go abelana ka ditirelo tse di tokafatsang boleng jwa matshelo a baagi WEBTOKEN pakeng eno ya khunulogo, puso e tsenyatirisong matsholo a a farologaneng a a tlhokang gore maAforika Borwa otlhe mmogo le baeng ba yone go tshameka karolo ya bone mo go netefatseng gore ba keteka paka ya khunulogo mo tikologong e e babalesegileng e bile e sireletsegile.

src: During this festive period, government is implementing various campaigns which require all South Africans and visitors to play their part in ensuring that the festive period is enjoyed in a safe and secure environment.
tgt: Kabinete e ikuela mo go botlhe go dirisana mmogo le Tirelo ya Sepodisi sa Aforika Borwa.

src: Cabinet calls on all to work with the South African Police Service and to report any criminal activities in our homes and communities.
tgt: (SAPS) le go bega tiragalo efe kgotsa efe ya bosenyi mo malapeng le mo ditšhabeng tsa WEBTOKEN go kgoneng gore go amogelwe thologelo ya baeti ba ba kgabaganyang melelwane, mafapha otlhe a puso kwa meeding ya go tsena mo nageng go simolola ka la bo 10 Sedimonthole 2015 go fitlha ka la bo 14 Ferikgong 2016 go tla atolosiwa diura tsa one tsa tirelo.

src: These include Health, Agriculture, Police, Home Affairs and South African Revenue Service).
tgt: One a tla akaretsa Lefapha la Boitekanelo, Lefapha la Temothuo, SAPS, Lefapha la Merero ya Selega le Tirelo ya Lekgetho ya Aforika Borwa (SARS).

src: Details are available at www.
tgt: Dintlha ka botlalo di ka fitlhelwa mo www.

src: gov.
tgt: gov.

src: za.
tgt: za.

src: All road users are urged to adhere to the rules of the road, including adherence to speed limits ensure vehicles are roadworthy not drive under the influence and to wear safety belts.
tgt: Badirisi botlhe ba mebila go ikuelwa mo go bone go obamela melao ya tsela, go akaretsa kobamelo ya melao e e tobaneng le lebelo la mo mebileng ba netefatse fa dijanaga di siametse go ka tsena mo mebileng ba kganne ba sa itshiela ka madila mmogo le go apara mapanta a pabalesego.

src: Pedestrians are urged to ensure that when using the roads they do not endanger their well-being or that of motorists.
tgt: Batsamayakadinao go ikuelwa mo go bone go netefatsa gore fa ba tsamaya mo mebileng ga ba baye matshelo a bone kgotsa a bakganni ba dikoloi mo kotsing.

src: Law-enforcement agencies will be out in full force to deal with transgressors.
tgt: Badiri ba tsa molao ba tla tswa ka makatlanamane go samagana le dithuntsebe tse di tlolakakang mola.

src: Economy.
tgt: Ikonomi.

src: Cabinet met to deliberate on the state of the economy and budget related matters.
tgt: Kabinete e kopane go buisana ka maemo a ikonomi le merero e e amang tekanyetsokabo.

src: Cabinet noted a number of factors impacting on the economy of the country.
tgt: Kabinete e ne ya amogela dintlha tse dintsi tse di amang ikonomi ya naga.

src: The global outlook has deteriorated in recent months.
tgt: Maemo go ralala lefatshe a koafetse mo dikgweding tse di fetileng.

src: Slower global growth reflects, in particular, weaker performance and higher risks in several important developing countries, including China.
tgt: Kgolo e e bokoa ya lefatshe lotlhe e supa tiragatso e e bokoa le dikotsi tse di kwa godimo mo dinageng tse di botlhokwa tse di tlhabologang, go akaretsa China.

src: The welcomed recovery expected in the USA is likely to result in rising global interest rates.
tgt: Poelomannong e e amogelegang e e solofelwang kwa USA e ka baka tlhatlogo ya dieelo tsa morokotso go ralala lefatshe.

src: Depressed trade volumes and turbulence in global capital markets underscore the need for nations to build resilience and act cautiously in the period ahead.
tgt: Methamo e e ka fa tlase ga kgatelelo ya kgwebisano le maemo a a sa iketlang mo mebarakeng ya lefatshe ya matlole di gatelela tlhokego ya gore ditšhaba di tlhome tsepamo le go gata ka tlhoafalo mo dipakeng tse di latelang.

src: Cabinet further noted that there were some benefits from the low price of crude oil.
tgt: Kabinete e ne gape ya amogela gore go na le dipoelo dingwe tse di siameng ka ntlha ya tlhwatlhwa e e kwa tlase ya oli e e sa tlhotlhiwang.

src: As a major commodity exporter, South Africa is concerned about the continued weakness in commodity prices.
tgt: Jaaka moromelantle wa diphatlho o mogolo, Aforikaborwa e tlhobaediwa ke bokoa bo bo tswelelang ba ditlhwatlhwa tsa diphatlho.

src: Government continues to build on the country’s diverse economic structure, and export earnings continue to depend to a great extent on metals and semi processed raw materials.
tgt: Puso e tswelela go agelela mo maemong a ikonomi ya naga a mefutafuta, le dipoelo tsa thomelontle di tswelela go ikaega go le gontsi ka dimetale le dire tse di tlhotlhilweng go se kae.

src: The fall in commodity prices is unlikely to reverse speedily.
tgt: Go wa ga ditlhwatlhwa tsa diphatlho go ka se dirologe ka bonako.

src: This will have sustained consequences for the South African economy and many of our partners on the African continent.
tgt: Se se tla nna le ditlamorago tse di tla tswelelang mo ikonoming ya Aforika Borwa le tsa dinaga tse dingwe tse dintsi tse e leng balekane ba rona mo kontinenteng ya Aforika.

src: The depreciation of the Rand over the last few years offers much better prospects for export growth and, combined with a lower global oil price, has helped to relieve pressure on the current account.
tgt: Kwelotlase ya Ranta mo dingwageng di le mmalwa tse di fetileng e tlamela ka ditšhono tse di botoka tsa kgolo ya thomelontle mme, mmogo le tlhwatlhwa e e kwa tlase ya oli, e thusitse go fokotsa kgatelelo mo akhaontong ya matlole ya naga.

src: However, weaker growth in South Africa’s major trading partners has meant subdued demand for South African products abroad.
tgt: Le fa go le jalo, kgolo e e bokoa mo balekaneng ba Aforika Borwa ba kgwebisano e kaya topo e e fokotsegileng ya ditlhagiswa tsa Aforika Borwa kwa dinageng tse dingwe.

src: The global environment is regarded as particularly challenging for emerging markets, with lower commodity prices and tightening of monetary policy in the USA putting pressure on capital flows and growth expectations.
tgt: Maemo a lefatshe a tsewa a gwetlha mo mebarakeng e e alogang, ka ditlhwatlhwa tse di kwa tlase tsa diphatlho le go gagamadiwa ga pholisi ya ditšhelete kwa USA e leng se se beileng kgatelelo mo kelelong ya madi le ditsholofelo tsa kgolo.

src: This has translated into significant volatility in capital markets.
tgt: Se, se bakile ketsaetsego mo mebarakeng ya madi.

src: The South African Rand, which is amongst the most traded emerging market currencies, has been particularly hard-hit in recent WEBTOKEN this difficult global context, in which all economies face difficult challenges, Cabinet reaffirmed the need for government to intervene strategically and more decisively to restore the momentum of economic growth.
tgt: Ranta ya Aforika Borwa, e leng lengwe la madi a mebaraka e e alogang le go gwebisanwang thata ka lona, e utlwisitswe botlhoko, segolo mo dibekeng tse di sa tswang go WEBTOKEN maemong a a bokete a a lefatshe, a mo go ona diikonomi tsotlhe di lebaganeng le dikgwetlho tse dikgolo, Kabinete e gateletse tlhokego ya gore puso e tsereganye ka botlhale le ka go tsaya tshwetso go busetsa segalo sa kgolo ya ikonomi.

src: The National Development Plan provides for these interventions.
tgt: Leanotlhabololo la Bosetšhaba (NDP) le tlamela ka ditsereganyo tse.

src: Government will reach out to social partners, particularly business and organised labour, to build consensus on the collective actions required to stabilise the economy, build confidence, raise the level of investment and return South Africa to a path of inclusive economic growth.
tgt: Puso e tla golagana le balekane ba loago, segolo kgwebo le mekgatlo ya badiri, go bopa tumalano mo dikgatong tse di kopanetsweng tse di tlhokegang go tsepamisa ikonomi, go bopa tshepo, go tsholetsa maemo a peeletso le poelo mo Aforika Borwa go ya ntlheng ya kgolo ya ikonomi e e akaretsang.

src: Cabinet endorsed stronger measures to restore a sustainable fiscal path, taking account of the weakened outlook for the global economy and its domestic consequences.
tgt: Puo ya Maemo a Setšhaba (SoNA) ka 11 Tlhakole e tla tsaya tsia tiro e. Kabinete e tiisitse mekgwa e e maatla ya go busetsa tsela e e isegang ya matlole go lebilwe koafalo e e nnileng teng mo ikonoming ya lefatshe le ditlamorago tsa yona mo gae.

src: Finance Minister Pravin Gordhan will unveil the measures when he presents the national budget on 24 February Higher Education fundingCabinet approved amendments to national budget allocations that would shift resources to fund universities without breaching previously announced spending limits.
tgt: Tona ya Matlotlo, Pravin Gordhan, o tla ribolola ditsela tse fa a ala tekanyetsokabo ya bosetšhaba ka 24 Tlhakole Tlamelo ka matlole go Thuto e KgolwaneKabinete e amogetse diphetolo mo dikabong tsa tekanyetsokabo ya bosetšhaba tse di tla fetisang matlole go thusa diyunibesithi ntle le go fetisa ditekanyetso tse di begilweng tsa tirisong ya matlole.

src: President Jacob Zuma and Higher Education and Training Minister Blade Nzimande recently indicated that these allocations would cover the zero-fee increment agreed for the current academic year, clear accumulated debt owed by the National Student Financial Aid Scheme (NSFAS) students and prevent the accumulation of such debt over the medium term.
tgt: Moporesitente Jacob Zuma le Tona ya Thuto e Kgolwane le Katiso, Blade Nzimande, go sa le gale ba supile gore dikabo tse di tla dirisediwa gore dituelo di se tlhatlosiwe jaaka go dumelanwe mo ngwageng wa ga jaana wa dithuto, go phimola sekoloto sa baithuti sa Sekema sa Thuso ya Matlole sa Baithuti sa Bosetšhaba le go thibela kokotsego ya sekoloto se mo pakagareng.

src: These intervention measures are a response to a number of consultations which started in October 2015 and are still continuing.
tgt: Mekgwa e ya tsereganyo ke tsibogo ya ditherisano di le mmalwa tse di simolotseng ka Diphalane 2015 e bile di santse di tswelela.

src: The Minister of Higher Education and training with his management team has held a number of meetings with SASCO leadership, all Student Representative Councils, University South Africa Forum , South African Union of Students, the CEO’s of SETA’s , Higher Education Transformation Network and the Parliamentary committee responsible for higher education.
tgt: Tona ya Thuto e Kgolwane le Katiso le setlhopha sa gagwe sa bolaodi o tshwere dikopano di le mmalwa le boeteledipele ba SASCO, Makgotla a Dikemedi tsa Baithuti otlhe, Foramo ya Diyunibesithi tsa Aforika Borwa, Kopano ya Baithuti ba Aforika Borwa, boCEO ba diSETA, Mokgatlo wa Tlhabololo ya Thuto e Kgolwane le komiti ya Palamente e e nang le maikarabelo a thuto e kgolwane.

src: The President also met with the leadership of the students and has announced the setting up of the Commission to look into the issues raised in Higher Education.
tgt: Moporesitente o kopane gape le boeteledipele ba baithuti e bile o ba begetse ka go tlhongwa ga Khomišene e e tla lebang dintlha tse di tlhagisitsweng ka ga Thuto e Kgolwane.

src: These engagements are still continuing as we believe as government we do want to work towards finding a lasting solution.
tgt: Ditherisano tse di santse di tswelela pele gonne re dumela gore jaaka puso re batla go dira go bona tharabololo ya leruri.

src: The demands of the students are in line with the objectives of the programme of government in respect of education.
tgt: Ditopo tsa baithuti di nyalana le maitlhomo a thulaganyo ya puso tebang le thuto.

src: As an immediate measure, R.33 billion has been allocated to resolve the shortfall in operational funding for universities as a result of the agreement on a 0% fee increment for In the 2016/17 financial year, government has reprioritized R.543 billion of State funding to be allocated to NSFAS to provide loans to assist 71 753 identified students who qualified for NSFAS funding but were either partially or not funded at all over the past three academic years.
tgt: Mo maemong a ga jaana, dibilione tsa diranta tse 2.33 di abetswe go samagana le tlhaelo mo go tlameleng diyunibesithi ka matlole ka ntlha ya tumalano ya koketso ya dituelo ka 0% ka Mo ngwageng wa ditšhelete wa 2016/17, puso e abile sešwa dibilione tsa diranta di le 2.543 tsa matlole a Puso go abelwa NSFAS go tlamela ka dikadimo tsa go thusa baithuti ba ba supilweng ke NSFAS ba le 71 753 mme ba ne ba tlametswe ka seripa fela kgotsa ba sa tlamelwa gotlhelele ka matlole mo dingwageng di le tharo tse di fetileng tsa dithuto.

src: This means that these deserving students will not be prevented from continuing with their studies for owing universities outstanding fees.
tgt: Se se kaya gore baithuti ba ba tshwanelwang ba, ba ka se ganediwe go tsweletsa dithuto tsa bona ka ntlha ya fa ba na le dikoloto tse di saletseng morago tsa diyunibesithi.

src: A further R.039 billion will be allocated to NSFAS in the 2016/17 financial year to support unfunded or under-funded students still in the university system in 2016 to complete their qualifications.
tgt: Dibilione tse dingwe tsa diranta di le 2.039 di abetswe NSFAS mo ngwageng wa ditšhelete wa 2016/17 go tshegetsa baithuti ba ba senang matlole kgotsa ba matlole a a tlhaelang ba ba santseng ba le mo diyunibesithing ka 2016 go konosetsa dithuto tsa bona.

src: These funds are additional to the R10 billion that NSFAS will administer in the 2016 academic year.
tgt: Matlole a ke tlaleletso mo godimo ga dibilione tsa diranta di le 10 tse NSFAS e tla di rebolang mo ngwageng wa dithuto wa 2016.Puso e ineetse go tlamela ka thuto ya morago ga sekolo, go baithuti botlhe ba ba tshwanelwang, ya mahala go batlhoki le ba maemo a a kwa tlase a badiri, mo teng ga ditekanyetso tse di diregang tsa matlole.

src: Government is committed to providing post-school education for all academically deserving students that is free at the point of delivery for the poor and the working class, within fiscally sustainable limits.
tgt: Kabinete e ikuela go baithuti, badiri, batlhatlheledi le batsamaisi ba diyunibesithi go dirisana mmogo le puso go fitlhelela maikaelelo a. Dikgato tse di kgoreletsang dithuto kgotsa di tlholang maemo a a sa iketlang kgotsa go solofela dilo tse di ka se fitlhelelegeng, ga di na thuso epe.

src: Violence and intimidation are not acceptable.
tgt: Tirisodikgoka le matshosetsi ga di amogelege.

src: Cabinet calls on all South Africans to recognize that there are challenging circumstances in the period ahead.
tgt: Kabinete e ikuela go maAforika Borwa otlhe go lemoga gore go na le maemo a a gwetlhang mo pakeng e e tlang.

src: Global economic conditions have weakened.
tgt: Maemo a ikonomi ya lefatshe a koafetse.

src: The impact of lower commodity prices is already being felt in South Africa.
tgt: Seabe sa ditlhwatlhwa tse di kwa tlase tsa diphatlho se setse se utlwala mo Aforika Borwa.

src: Domestic constraints such as insufficient electricity supply are still with us.
tgt: Mathata a selegae jaaka tlamelo e e sa lekanang ya motlakase, a santse a le teng.

src: The severe drought is causing hardships in several provinces.
tgt: Komelelo e kgolo e baka mathata mo diporofenseng di le mmalwa.

src: Cabinet is confident that South Africans remain as a resilient nation that knows the value of working together in peace and harmony.
tgt: Kabinete e na le bonnete ba gore maAforika Borwa a tswelela go nna setšhaba se se maatla se se itseng boleng ba go dira mmogo ka kagiso le kutlwano.

src: The recent exposure of individuals with racist’s beliefs has strengthen our collective commitment to build a nonracial, nonsexist and prosperous society.
tgt: Go senoga ga sešweng ga batho ba ditumelo tsa go tlhaola ka mmala go maatlafaditse boineelo ba rona rotlhe ba go aga setšhaba se se sa tlhaoleng go ya ka mmala, ka bong mme e le setšhaba se se tswelelang.

src: AppointmentsCabinet approved the following appointments:.
tgt: Go thapiwaKabinete e amogetse go thapiwa ga ba ba latelang:.

src: Mr Shonisani Mathews Munzhedzi as Deputy Director-General (DDG): Biodiversity and Conservation in the Department of Environmental Affairs.
tgt: Rre Shonisani Mathews Munzhedzi jaaka Motlatsa Mokaedikakaretso (DDG): Mefutafuta ya Botshelo le Tshomarelo mo Lefapheng la Merero ya Tikologo.

src: Implementation of key government programmes.
tgt: Go tsenngwa tirisong ga manaane a botlhokwa a puso.

src: Cabinet welcomed President Jacob Zuma’s State of the Nation Address delivered on Thursday, 11 February.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse Puo ya Maemo a Setšhaba ya ga Moporesitente Jacob Zuma e e tlhagisitsweng ka Labone, 11 Tlhakole.

src: The speech set the strategic path for the implementation of government’s Programme of Action.
tgt: Puo e tlhomile mosupatsela wa togamaano wa tiragatso ya Lenaanetiro la Puso.

src: The President has called on government, labour and business to work together to find solutions for a sustainable economic growth.
tgt: Moporesitente o ikuetse mo pusong, mekgatlho ya badiri mmogo le mo kgwebong go dira mmogo go bona ditharabaololo tsa kgolo ya ikonomi e e nnelang leruri.

src: Cabinet supports the cost-cutting measures announced by the President, which will be elaborated by the Minister of Finance on 24 February.
tgt: Kabinete e tshegetsa dikgato tsa go fokotsa ditshenyegelo tse di itsesitsweng ke Moporesitente tse di tla tlhalosiwang ke Tona ya Ditšhelete ka la bo 24 Tlhakole.

src: The 2016/17 Budget Speech will further map out the allocation of resources to the various government programmes as emphasised by the President.
tgt: Puo ya Tekanyetsokabo ya 2016/17 e tla tlhagisa kabelo ya ditlamelo go ya kwa manaaneng a a farologaneng a puso go ya jaaka Moporesitente a gateletse.

src: Cabinet welcomed the successful Mining Indaba, which was held in Cape Town from 8 to 11 February.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse Indaba ya Meepo e e atlegileng e e neng e tshwaretswe kwa Motsekapa go tloga ka la bo 8 go fitlha ka la bo 11 Tlhakole.

src: Leading representatives from the mining sector and several governments from Africa shared their insights into how the sector can drive investments and capitalise on the opportunities available in Africa.
tgt: Baemedi ba ba eteletseng pele go tswa kwa lephateng la meepo le dipuso tse di farologaneng tsa Aforika ba arogane megopolo ya bona malebana le ka moo lephata le ka tsamaisang dipeeletso ka teng mmogo le go dirisa ditšhono tse di leng teng mo Aforika.

src: Cabinet appreciated the commitment made by the Japanese government to increase its investment in South Africa.
tgt: Kabinete e lebogetse maitlamo a a dirilweng ke puso ya Japane a go oketsa dipeeletso tsa yona mo Aforika Borwa.

src: Cabinet reaffirmed its commitment to a stable and flourishing mining sector.
tgt: Kabinete e boeleditse maitlamo a yona a lephata la meepo le le tsepameng e bile le dira ka katlego.

src: The Framework Agreement for a Sustainable Mining Industry supports the mining industry in this current difficult environment.
tgt: Tumelano ya Letlhomeso la Indaseteri ya Meepo e e nnelang Leruri e tshegetsa indaseteri ya meepo mo seemong sa ga jaana se se boima.

src: Government continues to provide a regulatory certainty and will ensure the finalisation of the Mineral and Petroleum Resources Development Bill, which is before Parliament.
tgt: Puso e tswelela go tlamela ka netefaletso ya taolo mme e tla netefatsa gore go konosediwa Molaotlhomo wa Tlhabololo ya Dimenerale le Ditlamelo tsa Peteroliamo, o o fa pele ga Palamente.

src: Cabinet approved the final National Gambling Policy, which addresses challenges hampering the effectiveness of the National Gambling Act, 2004 (Act 7 of 2004).
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse Pholisi ya Bosetšhaba ya makgaolakgang ya Itekolesego, e e samaganang le dikgwetlho tse di kgoreletsang go dira sentle ga Molao wa Bosetšhaba wa Itekolesego, wa 2004 (Molao wa bo 7 wa 2004).Pholisi e setse e fetile mo tsamaisong ya patlomaikutlo a setšhaba.

src: The policy proposes amendments to the regulatory structural framework of the gambling boards and strengthens the control mechanisms to minimize the abuse of gambling.
tgt: Pholisi e tshitshinya dipaakanyo mo letlhomesong la taolo ya dipopegotheo tsa diboto tsa itekolesego mme e maatlafatsa didirisiwa tsa taolo go fokotsa tiriso e e botlhaswa ya itekolesego.

src: It is applicable to casinos, bingo, limited payout machines and betting on horseracing.
tgt: E ama dikhasino, dibingo, metšhini e dituelo tsa yona di lekanyeditsweng mmogo le go betšha dipitsi.

src: The policy will replace the National Gambling Board with a National Gambling Regulator that will directly report to the Department of Trade and Industry (the dti).
tgt: Pholisi e tla emisetsa Boto ya Bosetšhaba ya Itekolesego ka Molaodi wa Bosetšhaba wa Itekolesego o o tla ikarabelang ka tlhamalalo kwa Lefapheng la Kgwebisano le Intaseteri.

src: Cabinet approved the submission of the Report on the Review of the Minimum Age of Criminal Capacity to Parliament, which is required in terms of the Child Justice Act, 2008 (Act 75 of 2008).
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse tlhagiso ya Pegelo ya Tshekatsheko ya Dingwagapotlana tsa go Golegwa Bosenyi kwa Palamenteng, e leng se se tlhokegang go ya ka Molao wa Bosiamisi wa Bana, wa 2008 (Molao wa bo 75 wa 2008).

src: The report recommends that the country adopts the international and regional obligations regarding the minimum age of criminal capacity of children who are in conflict with the law.
tgt: Pegelo e atlenegisa gore naga e amogela maitlamo a boditšhabatšhaba le a kgaolo malebana le dingwagapotlana tsa go golegelwa bosenyi tsa bana ba ba iphitlhelang ba na le kgotlhang le molao.

src: Cabinet approved the gazetting of Renewable Energy Development Zones (REDZ).
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse go tsenngwa mo kaseteng ga Dikgaolo tsa Tlhabololo ya Maatla a a Ntšhwafadiwang (REDZ).

src: These will streamline the regulatory process, identify geographical areas where wind and solar Photovoltaic technologies can be incentivised and where ‘deep’ grid expansion can be directed.
tgt: Seno se tla rulaganya thulaganyo ya taolo, sa supa mafelo a go ka maatlafadiwang dithekenoloji tsa motlakase wa phefo le wa letsatsidi ka bonwang le moo go ka atolosiwang tlamelo ya mafaratlhatlha a a boteng gona.

src: These REDZ will ensure a transition to a low carbon economy, accelerate infrastructure development, and contribute to a more coherent and predictable regulatory framework that reduces bureaucracy related to the cost of compliance.
tgt: Di-REDZ tseno di tla netefatsa kgabaganyo ya go ya kwa ikonoming e e tlhagisang khabone e e kwa tlase, di akofise tlhabololo ya mafaratlhatlha, le go tshwaela mo letlhomesong le le rulaganeng e bile le bonelwa pele la taolo le le fokotsang tsamaiso e e amanang le ditshenyegelo tsa go obamela.

src: Cabinet was briefed on the findings of the 2014 South African Science, Technology and Innovation Indicators Report of the National Advisory Council on Innovation.
tgt: Kabinete e boleletswe ka diphitlhelelo tsa Pegelo ya Aforika Borwa ya 2014 ya Disupi tsa Saense, Thekenoloji le Boitlhamedi mo Lekgotleng la Bosetšhaba la Bokgakolodi jwa Boitlhamedi.

src: The report provides the trends in the performance of the National System of Innovation (NSI).
tgt: Pegelo eno e tlamela ka mokgwa wa tiragatso wa Tsamaiso ya Bosetšhaba ya Boitlhamedi (NSI).

src: It assesses the performance and contribution of the NSI to key national priorities articulated in the National Development Plan (NDP).
tgt: E sekaseka tiragatso le tshwaelo ya NSI mo ditlapeleng tsa botlhokwa tsa bosetšhaba tse di tlhagisitsweng mo Leanong la Tlhabololo la Bosetšhaba (NPD).

src: Cabinet approved the use of retired and in-serving public servants as lecturers in the National School of Government (NSG).The NSG was launched in 2013, replacing the Public Administration Leadership and Management Academy (PALAMA), and is mandated to promote the progressive realisation of the values and principles governing public administration and enhance the quality, extend and impact of the development of human resource capacity in institutions.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse tiriso ya badiredisetšhaba ba ba rotseng tiro le ba ba dirang jaaka batlhatlheledi kwa Sekolokatisong sa Bosetšhaba sa Puso (NSG).NSG e tlhomilwe ka 2013, e tsena mo legatong la Setheo sa Tsamaiso le Boeteledipele jwa Botsamais jwa Thuto mo Pusong (PALAMA), mme thomo ya yona ke go tsweletsa phitlhelelo e e tswelelang ya boleng le dintlhatheo tse di laolang tsamaiso ya puso le go tokafatsa boleng, katoloso le ditlamorago tsa tlhabololo ya bokgoni jwa badiri mo ditheong.

src: This initiative will be piloted with the implementation of the Compulsory Induction Programme for public servants.
tgt: Maiteko ano a tla lekelediwa ka go tsenngwa tirisong ga Lenaane le le Pateletsang la Kitsisotiro la badiredisetšhaba.

src: This approach enables public servants to add value to the public service.
tgt: Mokgwa ono o kgontsha badiredisetšhaba go oketsa boleng mo tirelong setšhaba.

src: They will impart their experience, expertise, skills and knowledge to mentor and coach the public servants.
tgt: Ba tla dirisa maitemogelo a bona, bokgoni le kitso go tataisa le go rotloetsa badiredisetšhaba.

src: This initiative will further improve in an efficient and cost effective manner the quality of the services we give to the public.
tgt: Gape maiteko ano a tla tokafatsa boleng jwa ditirelo tse re di nayang setšhaba ka tsela e e bokgoni e bile e le tlhotlhwatlase.

src: Cabinet approved South Africa’s Final Phase 3 Country Report on the Implementation of the Organisation for Economic Cooperation and Development (OECD) (Anti-Bribery Convention).
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse Pegelo ya Naga ya Aforika Borwa ya Legato la Bofelo la bo 3 le le malebana le go Tsenngwa tirisong ga Mokgatlho wa Tirisanommogo ya Ikonomi le Tlhabololo (OECD) (Tumelano e e kgatlhanong le Pipamolomo).

src: The report is to be submitted to the OECD Working Group on Bribery.
tgt: Pegelo e tshwanetse go neelwa Setlhopha sa Tiro sa Pipamolomo sa OECD.

src: The report outlines the progress made by government in its interventions to curb foreign bribery by detecting, investigating and prosecuting it.
tgt: Pegelo e tlhalosa tswelelopele e e dirilweng ke naga ka ditsereganyo tsa yona tsa go fedisa pipamolomo ka go e supa, go batlisisa mmogo le go e sekisetsa.

src: The report further highlights the initiative undertaken to raise awareness of this crime.
tgt: Gape pegelo e sedimosa maiteko a a tserweng go lemosa ka bosenyi jono.

src: Cabinet approved that Department of Home Affairs (DHA) be reclassified under the Justice, Crime Prevention and Security Cluster.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse gore Lefapha la Merero ya Selegae (DHA) le aroganngwe gape ka fa tlase ga Setlhopha sa Bosiamisi, Thibelo ya Bosenyi le Pabalesego.

src: The mandate of the DHA is to maintain a secure, accurate register of the identity and status of all within the borders of our country, which is a critical enabler of all other functions of the state.
tgt: Thomo ya Lefapha la Merero ya Selegae ke go tshola le go babalela rejisetara ya boammaaruri ya boitshupo le seemo sa botlhe ba ba mo nageng ya rona, e leng sa botlhokwa se se kgontshang ditiro tse dingwe tsotlhe tsa mmuso.

src: It is also mandated to manage the immigration system, which impacts directly on national security, social cohesion and achievement of development goals.
tgt: Gape le romilwe go tsamaisa tsamaiso ya bofudugedi, e e amang ka tlhamalalo pabalesego ya bosetšhaba, tirisano ya loago mmogo le phitlhelelo ya diphitlhelelo tsa WEBTOKEN malobeng DHA e ne e arogantswe jaaka ditirelo tsa tshegetso ya tsamaiso ka kakaretso ka fa tlase ga Setlhopha sa Bolaodi le Tsamaiso.

src: Previously DHA was classified as a general administration support services under the Governance and Administration Cluster.
tgt: Molaotlhomo.1 Kabinete e amogetswe go tlhagisiwa ga Molaotlhomo wa Tshireletso, Tsweletso, Tlhabololo le Tsamaiso ya Kitso ya Tshimologo kwa Palamenteng.

src: Cabinet approved the submission of the Protection, Promotion, Development and Management of Indigenous Knowledge Bill to Parliament.
tgt: Molaotlhomo ono ke wa go sireletsa, go tsweletsa le go tsamaisa dithulaganyo tsa Kitso ya Tshimologo.

src: This Bill seeks to protect and promote the development and management of Indigenous Knowledge WEBTOKEN provides for the establishment and functions of the National Indigenous Knowledge systems office, management of the rights of indigenous knowledge holders, establishment and functions of the advisory panel on indigenous knowledge WEBTOKEN also allows access and conditions of access to the knowledge of indigenous and local communities, establishment of a national recordal system of indigenous knowledge systems, registration, accreditation and certification of indigenous practitioners, facilitation and co-ordination of indigenous knowledge based innovation.
tgt: O dira tlamelo ya go tlhomiwa le ditiro tsa kantoro ya Bosetšhaba ya dithulaganyo tsa Kitso ya Tshimologo, tsamaiso ya ditshwanelo tsa batshodi ba kitso ya tshimologo, go tlhamiwa le ditiro tsa phanele ya Bogakolodi ya dithulaganyo tsa kitso ya tshimologo.

src: The Bill will complement the Intellectual Property Laws Amendment Act, 2013 (Act 28 of 2013).Cabinet approved the publication of the Deeds Registries Amendment Bill of 2015 for public comments.
tgt: Gape o letlelela phitlhelesego le seemo sa phitlhelesego ya kitso ya merafe ya tshimologo le ya selegae, go tlhamiwa ga thulaganyo ya bosetšhaba ya go rekotiwa ga dithulaganyo tsa kitso ya tshimologo, go kwadisiwa le go tlhomamisiwa ga badiragatsi ba tshimologo, kgokaganyo ya boitlhamedi jo bo ikaegileng ka kitso ya tshimologo.

src: The Bill amends the Deeds Registries Act, 1937 (Act 47 of 1937).
tgt: Molaotlhomo o tla tshegetsa Molao o o Baakantsweng wa Melao ya Dithoto tsa Tlhaloganyo, wa 2-13 (Molao wa bo 28 wa 2013).Kabinete e amogetse go phasaladiwa ga Molaotlhomo o Baakantsweng wa Makwadisetso a Dikano, wa 2015 gore go tshwaelwe mo go ona.

src: The Bill aims to amend the Deeds Registries Act, 1937 (Act 47 of 1937) in order to migrate from paper to electronic methods deeds office.
tgt: Molaotlhomo o baakanya Molao wa Makwadisetso a Dikano, wa 1937 (Molao wa bo 47 wa 1937).

src: Cabinet approved the submission of the Plant Health (Phytosanitary) Bill of 2015 to Parliament.
tgt: Molaotlhomo o ikaeletse go baakanya Molao wa Makwadisetso a Dikano, wa 1937 (Molao wa bo 47 wa 1937) gore go fudugiwe go tswa kwa kantorong ya dikano ya dipampiri go ya kwa go ya mokgwa wa eleketoroniki.

src: The Bill aligns South Africa’s legislation with relevant obligations and standards to facilitate safe and fair international trade to secure the country’s domestic and international trade in plants and plant products.
tgt: O samagana le merero ya tshireletsego ka go tlamela ka kwadiso ya diphetiso jaaka badirisi ba ba mo molaong ba thulaganyo ya kwadiso ya dikano ya eleketoroniki.2 Kabinete e amogetse go itsesewe ga Molaotlhomo wa Boitekanelo jwa Dimela, wa 2015 kwa Palamenteng.

src: Once the Bill is passed, South Africa will be able to prevent the introduction of foreign quarantine pests and diseases that may spread harmful pests and diseases of plants in the country.
tgt: Molaotlhomo o lepalepanya melao ya Aforika Borwa le maitlamo a a maleba le dipeelo go gokaganya kgwebisano ya boditšhabatšhaba e e babalesegileng e bile e sa gobelele go netefatsa kgwebisano ya naga ya selegae le ya boditšhabatšhaba ya dimela le ditlhagiswa tsa dimela.

src: Cabinet approved the submission of the Courts of Law Amendment Bill of 2015 to Parliament.
tgt: Fa Molaotlhomo o setse o fetisitswe, Aforika Borwa o tla kgona go thibela go tlisiwa ga ditshenekegi le malwetsi a dinaga di sele a a tswaletsweng tse di ka anamisang ditshenekegi le malwetsi a a kotsi mo dimeleng tsa naga.3 Kabinete e amogetse go tlhagisiwa ga Molaotlhomo o o Baakantsweng wa Dikgotlatshekelo tsa Molao, wa 2015 kwa Palamenteng.

src: The Bill amends the Magistrates’ Courts Act, 1944 (Act 32 of 1944) and the Superior Courts Amendment Act, 2013 (Act 10 of 2013).The amendments seek to alleviate the plight of debtors who find themselves on the receiving end of abuses in the debt-collecting system in the magistrates’ courts and to accommodate the dti’s project to remove adverse consumer credit information.
tgt: Molaotlhomo o baakanya Molao wa Dikgotlatshekelo tsa Bomagiseterata, wa 1944 (Molao wa bo 32 was 1944) le Molao o o Baakantsweng wa Dikgotlatshekelo tse di Kwa Godimo, wa 2013 (Molao wa bo 10 wa 2013).Paakanyo e lebeletse go fokotsa mathata a bakoloti ba ba iphitlhelang ba sotlakakiwa ke thulaganyo ya go koleka dikoloto kwa dikgotlatshekelong tsa bomagiseterata le go amogela porojeke ya Lefapha la Kgwebisano le Madirelo ya go tlosa tshedimosetso e e maswe ya sekoloto ya badirisi.

src: The Bill seeks to amend sections of the Magistrates’ Courts Act, 1994 (Act 32 of 1994), to address abuses in the Emoluments Amendments Order (EAO).
tgt: Maikaelelo a Molaotlhomo ke go baakanya dikarolo tsa Molao wa Dikgotlatshekelo tsa Bomagiseterata, wa 1994 (Molao wa bo 32 wa 1994) (MCA), go samagana le tshotlakako e e mo Taelong e e Baakantsweng ya Tuelo (EAO).Molaotlhomo o ikaelela go samagana le go fedisa dikatlholo tse di rebolwang e se ka fa molaong, gantsi di dirwa ke ditlelereke tsa kgotlatshekelo kwa ntle ga bookamedi jwa bosiamisi, mme gantsi ka ntlha ya go tlhoka maitemogelo, gongwe go dirisana le ba ba kolotwang, babueledi gongwe ba ba kolekang sekoloto.

src: The Bill seeks to address and bring to an end judgments that are granted irregularly, mostly by clerks of courts without any judicial oversight, many times due to inexperience or collusion with the creditors, their attorneys or debt collectors.
tgt: Molaotlhomo o tla netefatsa gore bakoloti ba newa katlholo e e obamelang taelo ya tuelo gongwe Taelo ya Go Tsewa ga Tuelo e e obamelang melao ya tuelo.

src: The first voter registration weekend for the 2016 Local Government Elections will take place from 5 to 6 March 2016.
tgt: Ditiragalo tse di tlang.1 Mafelo a beke a ntlha a go ikwadisetsa ditlhopho a Ditlhopho tsa Pusoselegae tsa 2016 e tla nna go tloga ka la bo 5 go fitlha la bo 6 Mopitlwe 2016.

src: Cabinet calls on all South Africans to take advantage of and honour this hard-won democracy by going out to exercise their democratic right to register and vote in the forthcoming elections.
tgt: Kabinete e ikuela mo maAforikaborweng otlhe go dirisa tšhono eo le go tlotla temokerasi e e bonweng ka bothata ka go ya go dirisa ditshwanelo tsa bona tsa go kwadisa le go tlhopha mo ditlhophong tse di tlang.2 Moporesitente o tla tsaya Leeto la Semmuso go ya kwa Rephaboliking ya Islamo ya Iran go tloga ka la bo 28 go fitlha la bo 29 Tlhakole 2016.Leeto le tla maatlafatsa dipuisano tsa rona tse di tswelelang pele tsa sepolotiki le ikonomi le Iran le go susumetsa dikamano tsa Dinaga tsa Borwa jwa Mogarafatshe.

src: President Zuma will undertake a State Visit to the Islamic Republic of Iran from 28 to 29 February 2016.The visit will strengthen our ongoing political and economic engagements with Iran and boost South-South WEBTOKEN the Commander-in-Chief of the South African National Defence Force (SANDF), President Zuma will officiate at the fifth segment of the Armed Forces Day celebrations in Port Elizabeth, Eastern Cape, on 21 February 2016.
tgt: Jaaka Molaodimogolo wa Sesole sa Tshireletso ya Naga ya Aforika Borwa (SANDF), Moporesitente Zuma o tla bo a tsamaisa kwa karolong ya botlhano ya meletlo ya Letsatsi la Matsholo a a Tlhometseng kwa Port Elizabeth, Kapabotlhaba, ka la bo 21 Tlhakole 2016.

src: This annual celebration demonstrates the support and gratitude to the men and women of the SANDPresident Zuma will address the opening of the National House of Traditional Leaders in Parliament, Cape Town on 26 February 2016.
tgt: Moletlo ono wa ngwaga le ngwaga o supa tshegetso le ditebogo go banna le basadi ba SANDF.3 Moporesitente Zuma o tla bua kwa pulong ya Ntlo ya Bosetšhaba ya Dikgosi/Ntlo ya Bosetšhaba ya Baeteledipele ba Setso kwa Palamenteng, Motsekapa ka la bo 26 Tlhakole 2016.

src: The relationship between government and traditional leaders is critical as they work towards improving the lives of people.
tgt: Botsalano magareng ga puso le baeteledipele ba setso bo botlhokwa jaaka mmogo ba direla go tokafatsa matshelo a batho.4 Ka Lamatlhatso, la bo 20 Thakole 2016, Motlatsamoporesitente Cyril Ramaphosa o tla etelela pele kemedi ya Ditona kwa Dipontshong tsa Moporesitente tsa Tlhabololo ya Bašwa kwa Grace Bible Church kwa Pimville, Soweto.

src: The expo is supported by the departments of Home Affairs, Labour, Social Development and Defence.
tgt: Dipontsho tseno di tshegediwa ke mafapha a Merero ya Selegae, Badiri, Tlhabololo ya Loago le Phemelo.

src: Cabinet calls on young people in the area to attend the expo, which will provide information on how they can further their studies, start their own business or benefit from government’s support initiatives.
tgt: Kabinete e ikuela mo bašweng ba lefelo leo go tsenela dipontsho, tse di tla tlamelang ka tshedimosetso ya gore ba ka tsweletsa dithuto tsa bona jang, ba itshimololela dikgwebo jang gongwe go ungwelwa mo maitekong a puso a tshegetso.5 Kabinete e amogetse go amogelwa ga Seminara ya Kgaolo ya Aforika ka ga Tshireletso ya Batho go ya ka Boitlhophelo jwa Bona jwa Bong, Boitshupo le Itlhagiso ya Bong, ke Khomišene ya Ditshwanelo tsa Botho ya Aforika Borwa, go tloga ka la bo 3 go fitlha la bo 5 Mopitlwe 2016.Seminara e tla gokaganya puisano gore go tlhaloganngwe botoka modi le go tlhagelela ga dikgwetlho tseno gore go bonwe ditharabololo tse di dirang mmogo le boitlhophelo jo bo gona mo Mebusong go samagana le dikgatako tseno.
