tgt: Fa e sale e tlhomiwa, go tlhamilwe ditiro di feta 4 500 mo maphateng a a farologaneng.

src: Two of the nine tugboats being built by the Southern African Shipyards for Transnet National Ports Authority (TNPA) in the Port of Durban are destined for the Port of Port Elizabeth.
tgt: Mekoro e e gogang e le mebedi mo go e e robongwe e e agiwang ke Southern African Shipyards ba e agela Bothati Jwa Bosetšhaba jwa Maemelakepe jwa Transnet (TNPA) kwa Boemelakepeng jwa Durban di lebile kwa Boemelakepeng jwa Port Elizabeth.

src: President Zuma launched the first tugboat in Port Elizabeth, named the Mvezo, after the birthplace of former President Nelson Mandela.
tgt: Moporesitente Zuma o tlhomile mokoro wa ntlha o o gogang kwa Port Elizabeth, o o teilweng leina la Mvezo, o teelelwa lefelo le Moporesitente Nelson Mandela a belegetsweng kwa go lona.

src: The TNPA has allocated over R7 billion to improve our ports.
tgt: TNPA e abile madi a feta R7 bilione go tokafatsa maemelakepe a rona.

src: The President viewed the refurbished and reconstructed slipway and lead-in jetties within the Port of Port Elizabeth that will be able to accommodate 12 more vessels as compared to the current two.
tgt: Moporesitente o ne a lebelela mafelo a dikepe di emelang mo go ona a a ntšhwafaditsweng mo Boemelakepeng jwa Port Elizabeth a a tla kgonang go amogela dikepe tse dingwe di le 12 fa a bapisiwa le a ga jaana a a amogelang di le pedi.

src: Cabinet thanks all taxpayers who have partnered with government in the 2015/16 financial year to take our revenue collection to R1 trillion for the first time.
tgt: Kabinete e leboga baduelalekgetho botlhe ba ba tshwaraganeng le puso mo ngwageng wa ditšhelete wa 2015/16 go tsholetsa kokoanyo ya rona ya lotseno go ya go R1 trilione la ntlha.

src: This is a clear demonstration of the strength of our thriving economy even under difficult WEBTOKEN is through the tax contributions of compliant South Africans and the effective collection by the South African Revenue Service that government is better able to provide much-needed services that contribute to improving the lives of South Africans.
tgt: Seno ke sesupo se se tlhamaletseng se se ka ga maatla a ikonomi ya rona e e tsweletseng pele le fa go le thata WEBTOKEN fela ka tuelo ya lekgetho ya maAforika Borwa a a obamelang melao mmogo le kokoanya e e matlhagatlhaga ya letseno ka Tirelo ya Lekgetho ya Aforika Borwa (SARS) moo puso e kgonang go tlamela ka botlalo ditirelo tse di tlhokegang tse di nang le seabe mo tokafatsong ya matshelo a maAforika Borwa.

src: Cabinet welcomes President Zuma’s announcement of 3 August 2016 as the date for the 2016 Local Government Elections.
tgt: Kabinete e amogela kitsiso ya ga Moporesitente Zuma ya gore la bo 3 Phatwe 2016 ke letlha la Ditlhopho tsa Pusoselegae tsa 2016.

src: Government is pleased that the two registration weekends on 5 – 6 March and 9 – 10 April saw large numbers of potential voters visiting the voting stations, especially first-time voters and the youth.
tgt: Puso e kgotsofaditswe ke gore mafelo a beke a mabedi a ikwadiso a la bo 5-6 Mopitlwe le la bo 9-10 Moranang a ne a na le palo e e kwa godimo ya ba ba ka tlhophang ba ba neng ba etetse diteišene tsa ditlhopho, bogolo segolo ba ba tla bong ba tlhopha la ntlha mmogo le bašwa.

src: Cabinet thanks all those who responded to the call to register and check their details on the voters’ roll.
tgt: Kabinete e leboga botlhe ba ba tsibogetseng boikuelo jwa go ikwadisa le go tlhola dintlha tsa bona mo lenaneng la batlhopi.

src: It is through our collective participation that our democracy moves from strength to strength.
tgt: Ke fela ka seabe sa rona mmogo re ka bonang temokerasi ya rona e gola.

src: Cabinet urges all citizens who have not yet registered or checked their details to visit offices of the Independent Electoral Commission in their local municipalities and update their details on the voters’ roll (provide addresses) and register to vote during the 3 August polls.
tgt: Kabinete e ikuela mo baaging botlhe ba ba iseng ba ikwadise gongwe go tlhola dintlha tsa bona go etela dikantoro tsa Khomišene e e Ikemetseng ya Ditlhopho kwa makgotlatoropong a bona le go ntšhwafatsa dintlha tsa bona mo lenaneng la batlhophi (ba tlamele ka diaterese) le go ikwadisetsa go tlhopha ka ditlhopho tsa la bo 3 Phatwe.

src: Voters can also SMS their ID number to 3281.0 or call the contact centre on 0800 11 8000 to verify their status.
tgt: Gape batlhophi ba ka romela dinomoroitshupo tsa bona ka SMS mo go 3281.0 gongwe go letsetsa tikwatikwe ya kgolagano kwa 0800 11 8000 go tlhomamisa seemo sa bona.

src: Registration secures your name on the voters’ roll so that you can be able to vote.
tgt: Ikwadiso e netefatsa gore leina la gago le teng mo lenaneng la batlhophi gore o kgone go tlhopha.

src: Cabinet calls on citizens to exercise our hard won democratic right to vote in the 2016 Local Government Elections on 3 August 2016.
tgt: Kabinete e ikuela mo baaging botlhe go diragatsa tshwanelo ya bona ya temokerasi e e lwetsweng ka thata ya go tlhopha mo Ditlhophong tsa Dipusoselegae tsa 2016 ka la bo 3 Phatwe 2016.

src: Cabinet welcomes the official launch of the eChannel Pilot Project of the Department of Home Affairs (DHA) by President Zuma.
tgt: Kabinete e amogela go tlhomiwa semmuso ga Porojeke ya Tekeletso ya eChannel ya Lefapha la Merero ya Selegae (DHA) ke Moporesitente Zuma.

src: This new innovative system allows citizens to apply for their Smart ID cards online and avoid long queues.
tgt: Thulaganyo eno e ntšhwa ya boitlhamedi e letla baagi go dira dikopo tsa dikarata tsa boitshupo mo inthaneteng go tila mela e meleele.

src: This collaboration with four major banks – ABSA, FNB, Nedbank and Standard Bank– to introduce an online application platform for Smart ID cards and passports will enable customers to visit DHA kiosks to submit their fingerprints and pictures after having made appointments and payments online.
tgt: Tirisanommogo eno le dibanka tse dikgolo di le nne - Dibanka tsa ABSA, FNB, Nedbank le Standard - go tsenyatirisog serala sa go dira dikopo ka inthanete tsa dikarata tsa boitshupo le makwalo a mosepele go kgontsha badirisi go etela dikioseke tsa Lefapha la Merero ya Selegae go isa fela dikgatiso tsa menwana le ditshwantsho morago ga go dira peelano le tuelo mo inthaneteng.

src: eChannel is part of the department’s overall modernisation strategy to move services from paper to digital, a process which will include the cleaning of the population register.
tgt: eChannel ke karolo ya togamaano ya tlhabololo ka kakaretso ya lefapha go tlosa ditirelo kwa mokgweng wa pampiri go ya go wa dijitale, e leng tsamaiso e e tla akaretsang go phepafatsa rejisetara ya baagi.

src: Cabinet welcomes the success of the recently held Imbizo Focus Week under the theme ‘Together we move South Africa forward’, which saw government officials interacting with communities throughout the country.
tgt: Kabinete e amogela katlego ya Beke ya Imbizo e e neng e tshwerwe fa gautshwane ka moono wa 'Mmogo re tswetsa pele Aforika Borwa', e mo go yona batlhankedi ba puso ba neng ba kopana le baagi go ralala naga.

src: Cabinet commends those South Africans who participated in over 36 programmes across the country, which ensured that government responded to identified community needs.
tgt: Kabinete e akgola maAforika Borwa a a nnileng le seabe mo manaaneng a feta 36 go ralala naga, a a netefaditseng gore puso e tsibogela ditlhokego tsa baagi tse di supilweng.

src: The Imbizo Focus Week has empowered communities with information on government programmes.
tgt: Beke ya Imbizo e maatlafaditse baagi ka tshedimosetso e e ka ga manaane a puso.

src: The Department of Human Settlements hosted a very successful United Nations (UN) conference dealing with informal settlements, emphasising the phenomenal rate of urbanisation and the growth of slums.
tgt: Lefapha la Manno a Batho le ne le amogetse khonferese e e atlegileng tota ya Ditšhabakopano (UN) e e dirang ka mafelo a baipei, e gatelela seelo se se kwa godimo sa phudugelo mo metsesetoropong mmogo le go gola ga mafelo a baipei.

src: Now one billion people in the world live in slums.
tgt: Ga jaana batho ba le bilione mo lefatsheng ba nna mo mafelong a baipei.

src: South Africa has since 1994 built millions of houses as part of ensuring a better life for all.
tgt: Fa e sale ka 1994, Aforika Borwa e agile matlo a le dimilione e le karolo ya go netefatsa gore go nna le botshelo jo bo botoka go botlhe.

src: BillsCabinet approved the following draft Bills:.
tgt: MelaotlhomoKabinete e amogetse Melaotlhomo e e latelang:.

src: Critical Infrastructure Protection Bill of 2016 to be published in the Government Gazette for public comment.
tgt: Molaotlhomo wa Tshireletso ya Dikago tsa Botlhokwa wa 2016 o o tla phasaladiwang mo Kaseteng ya Puso gore baagi ba tshwaele mo go ona.

src: The Bill repeals the National Key Points Act, 1980 (Act 102 of 1980), and seeks to align the process of identifying and declaring critical infrastructures in a transparent and accountable manner.
tgt: Molaotlhomo o phimola Molao wa Dintlha tsa Botlhokwa tsa Bosetšhaba, wa 1980 (Molao wa bo 102 wa 1980), mme o ikaelela go lepalepanya thulaganyo ya go supa le go goeletsa dikago tsa botlhokwa ka tsela e e seng bofitlha mme e le maikarabelo.

src: It will also further ensure that all critical infrastructures for the national security of the country are identified and adequately protected.
tgt: Gape o tla netefatsa gore dikago tsotlhe tsa botlhokwa tsa tshireletsego ya setšhaba mo nageng di a supiwa mme di sirelediwa ka tsela e e maleba.

src: The Bill provides for the setting up of an institutional framework to monitor and administer the protection of the critical infrastructures.
tgt: Molaotlhomo o dira tlamelo ya gore go tlhomiwe letlhomeso la setheo go tlhokomela le go tsamaisa tshireletso ya dikago tsotlhe tsa botlhokwa.

src: It further defines the functions of the body that will advise the Minister of Police in the declaration of critical infrastructures.
tgt: Gape o tlhalosa tiro ya bothati jo bo tla gakololang Tona ya Sepodisi ka kgoeletso ya dikago tsa botlhokwa.

src: The Communal Property Associations Amendment Bill of 2016 to be published for public comment.
tgt: Molaotlhomo o o Baakantsweng wa Mekgatlho ya Dithoto tse di Tlhakanetsweng wa 2016 o o tla phasaladiwang gore baagi ba tshwaele mo go ona.

src: The Bill amends the current Communal Property Associations Act, 1996 (Act 28 of 1996).The Bill will strengthen the democratic governance process of the existing Communal Property Associations or existing Trust entities that oversee communal land.
tgt: Molaotlhomo ono o baakanya Molao wa ga jaanong wa Mekgatlho ya Dithoto tse di Tlhakanetsweng, wa 1996 (Molao wa bo 28 wa 1996).Molaotlhomo o tla maatlafatsa thulaganyo ya bolaodi jwa temokerasi jwa Mekgatlho e e leng teng ga jaana ya Dithoto tse di Tlhakanetsweng gongwe ditheo tsa Dikgwama tse di okameng mafatshe a a tlhakanetsweng ke baagi.

src: The amended Bill provides for the setting up of the Registrar in the Department of Rural Development and Land Reform, and defines the functions of this office.
tgt: Molaotlhomo ono o o baakantsweng o dira tlamelo ya gore go tlhomiwe Mokwadisi mo Lefapheng la Tlhabololo ya Metseselegae le Ntšhwafatso ya Naga, mme o tlhalosa tiro ya kantoro eno.

src: Once this Bill is passed into law, it will strengthen the regulation of governance institutions and enhance State support to WEBTOKEN will enable communities to acquire, hold and manage properties through effective statutorily established administration entities supported by government.
tgt: Fa Molaotlhomo o setse o fetisitswe jaaka molao, o tla maatlafatsa taolo ya ditheo tsa bolaodi le go tokafatsa tshegetso ya Mmuso mo go tsona.

src: The introduction of the International Arbitration Bill of 2016 to Parliament.
tgt: Go itsisewe ga Molaotlhomo wa Boditšhabatšhaba wa Tsereganyo wa 2016 kwa Palamenteng.

src: The international arbitration process is an essential tool for doing business across the borders of the country.
tgt: Thulaganyo ya tsereganyo ya boditšhabatšhaba ke sediriswa sa botlhokwa sa go gweba go ralala melelwane ya naga.

src: It will improve access to justice services for companies doing business outside the country and foreign companies in South Africa.
tgt: E tla tokafatsa phitlhelesego ya ditirelo tsa bosiamisi mo ditlamong tse di gwebang kwa ntle ga naga le ditlamo tsa kwa ntle tse di mo Aforika Borwa.

src: The Bill repeals the Recognition and Enforcement of Foreign Arbitral Awards Act, 1977 (Act 40 of 1977) and also amends the current Protection of Business Act, 1978 (Act 99 of 1978).
tgt: Molaotlhomo o phimola Molao wa Temogo le Tiragatso ya Dikabo tsa Tsereganyo ya Dinaga di sele, wa 1977 (Molao wa bo 4 wa 1977) mme gape o baakanya Molao wa ga jaana wa Tshireletso ya Kgwebo, wa 1978 (Molao wa bo 99 wa 1978).

src: The proposed Bill aligns with the Model Law on International Commercial Arbitration, which has been adopted by the UN Commission on International Trade Law.
tgt: Molaotlhomo o o tshitshinngwang o lepalepana le Sekao sa Molao wa Tsereganyo ya Kgwebo ya Boditšhabatšhaba, se se amogetsweng ke Khomišene ya UN ya Molao wa Kgwebisano ya Boditšhabatšhaba.

src: The publication of the draft National Research Foundation Amendment Bill of 2016 in the Government Gazette for public comment.
tgt: Go phasaladiwa ga Molaotlhomo o o Baakantsweng wa Setheo sa bosetšhaba sa Dipatlisiso wa 2016 mo Kaseteng ya Puso gore batho ba tshwaele mo go ona.

src: The Bill amends the National Research Foundation Act, 1998 (Act 23 of 1998).The Bill will improve South Africa’s competitiveness in research development and innovation through effective, adequate and coordinated management of public engagement with science, and improved research infrastructure provision and access.
tgt: Molaotlhomo o baakanya Molao wa Setheo sa Bosetšhaba sa Dipatlisiso, wa 1998 (Molao wa bo 23 wa 1998).Molaotlhomo o tla tokafatsa bokgoni jwa Aforika Borwa jwa go gaisana mo tlhabololong ya dipatlisiso le boitlhamedi ka tsamaiso ya kgolagano le setšhaba ka tsela e e bokgoni, e e lekaneng mme e gokagane ya saense, mmogo le tlamelo le phitlhelesego e e tokafetseng ya ditlamelo tsa dipatlisiso.

src: It will also improve the responsiveness and effectiveness of research development and innovation provision, to improve the quality of life of South Africans through better alignment with government priorities.
tgt: Gape o tla tokafatsa tsibogo le bokgoni jwa tlhabololo ya dipatlisiso le tlamelo ya boitlhamedi, go tokafatsa boleng jwa botshelo jwa maAforika Borwa ka go lepalepanya ditlapele tsa puso botoka.

src: The draft White Paper was first published for public comment in March 2015.
tgt: Lekwalotlhomo la mabudusatsela le phasaladitswe la ntlha gore baagi ba tshwaele mo go lona ka Mopitlwe 2015.

src: The paper provides for a police service that is biased towards active citizenry and responds to the existing policing environment.
tgt: Lekwalo le dira tlamelo ya tirelo ya sepodisi e e ikamanyang le boagi jo bo tlhaga mme e tsibogela tikologo ya ga jaana ya sepodisi.

src: It also provides for a South African Police Service and metro police that is accountable and professional.
tgt: Gape le dira tlamelo ya Tirelo ya Sepodisi sa Aforika Borwa le sepodisi sa metro se se maikarabelo e bile se le porofešenale.

src: The White Paper also calls for the establishment of a National Police Board which, amongst other tasks, will be responsible for setting up the objective criteria for the recruitment, selection and appointment of new recruits in the police services.
tgt: Gape Lekwalotlhomo la mabudusatsela le ikuela gore go tlhamiwe Boto ya Bosetšhaba ya Sepodisi e, gareng ga tse dingwe, e tla rwalang maikarabelo a go tlhoma ditlhokego tsa go ngoka badiri, go tlhopha le go thapa bangokiwa ba bantšhwa mo tirelong ya sepodisi.

src: Cabinet adopted the White Paper on Safety and Security.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse Lekwalotlhomo la mabudusatsela la Tshireletsego le Pabalesego.

src: The White Paper, which has already been out for public consultation in February 2015, focuses on an integrated and developmental approach to safety beyond policing.
tgt: Lekwalotlhomo la Mabudusatsela le le setseng le ntsheditswe go batla maikutlo a batho ka Tlhakole 2015, le totile mokgwa o o lotaneng wa tlhabololo wa pabalesego e e sa feleleng fela mo sepodising.

src: It seeks to guide on preventative safety measures for communities.
tgt: Le ikaelela go kaela mo dikgatong tse di tla thusang baagi ka thibelo mo mererong ya tshireletsego.

src: The White Paper identifies all the relevant departments and community-based organisations that contribute to the safety of communities.
tgt: Lekwalotlhomo la Mabudusatsela le supa mafapha otlhe a a maleba mmogo le mekgatlho ya baagi e e tshwaelang mo pabalesegong ya baagi.

src: Cabinet approved the draft Policy on the Customary Practice of Initiation in South Africa and approved for the Department of Traditional Affairs to commence drafting national legislation on initiation.
tgt: Kabinete e rebotse Pholisitlhomo ya Tiragatso ya Setso ya Thupiso mo Aforika Borwa mme e rebotse gore Lefapha la Merero ya setso le simolole go kwala molao wa bosetšhaba wa thupiso.

src: The policy has already gone through an extensive public consultation process with relevant stakeholders.
tgt: Pholisi e setse e fetile mo thulaganyong ya patlomaikutlo a baamegi ba ba maleba.

src: The policy provides guidelines that ensure the protection of the traditional custom of the annual initiation of young boys without compromising their safety.
tgt: Pholisi e tlamela ka kaedi e e netefatsang tshireletso ya meetlo ya setso ya thupiso ya basimane ya ngwaga le ngwaga kwa ntle ga go ba baya mo kotsing.

src: This forms part of the steps that government is taking to reinforce appropriate and acceptable customs.
tgt: Seno ke karolo ya dikgato tse puso e di tsayang go maatlafatsa meetlo e e maleba e bile e amogelesega.

src: It restores an acceptable level of accountability to those that run initiation schools and parents that send their children to these schools.
tgt: E busetsa seelo se se amogelesegang sa maikarabelo go botlhe ba ba tsamaisang dikolo tsa thupiso le batsadi ba ba romelang bana kwa dikolong tseno.

src: Cabinet approved the recommendations made by the Committee of Inquiry on the feasibility of trading in rhino horns as one of the options to preserve the country’s rhino population.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse dikatlegeniso tse di dirilweng ke Komiti ya Dipatlisiso malebana le kgonagalo ya go gweba ka manaka a ditshukudu jaaka boitlhophelo jwa go ka somarela ditshukudu tsa naga.

src: The recommendations were endorsed by the Interdepartmental Technical Advisory Committee and the Inter-Ministerial Committee appointed to investigate the possibility of legalising commercial international trade in rhino horn.
tgt: Dikatlenegiso di tshegeditswe ke Komiti ya Setegeniki ya Bogakolodi ya Mafapha le Komiti ya Ditona e e thapetsweng go batlisisa kgonagalo ya go dira gore go nne le kgwebisano ya semolao ya boditšhabatšhaba ya manaka a tshukudu.

src: The recommendations endorse South Africa’s integrated strategic management approach to resolving the poaching of rhino and illegal trade in rhino.
tgt: Dikatlenegiso di tshegetsa mokgwa wa tsamaiso ya togamaano ya Aforika Borwa wa go rarabolola mathata a bogodu jwa ditshukudu mmogo le kgwebisano e e seng mo molaong ka ditshukudu.

src: The committee recommends that the current mode of keeping the country’s stock levels be kept as opposed to the trading in rhino horns.
tgt: Komiti e atlenegisa gore mokgwa wa ga jaana wa go tshola seelo sa naga o tswelediwe go na le gore go gwebisanwe ka manaka a ditshukudu.

src: The country’s strategic approach entails security community empowerment biological management responsive legislative provisions that are effectively implemented and enforced and demand management.
tgt: Togamaano ya naga e akaretsa tshireletso maatlafatso ya baagi tsamaiso ya diphologolo ditlamelo tsa molao tse di diragadiwang le go dirisiwa sentle le tsamaiso ya tlhokego.

src: Cabinet approved the following 2016 commemorative coin designs:a) The National Geographic Coin Series – Big Cats Initiative: ‘The Cheetah’.b) The Sterling-silver crown and tickey coin series ‘South African inventions – ‘Dolosse’.The coin designs, together with their proclamations, will be printed in the Government Gazette, and will then be manufactured and sold through the normal channels.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse dithadiso tse di latelang tsa madi a segopotso tsa 2016:a) Motseletsele wa ledi la National Geographic Coin - Maiteko a Dikatse tse Dikgolo: 'Lengau'b) Motseletsele wa korone ya selefera le ledi la tiki 'boitlhamedi jwa Aforika Borwa - ‘Dolosse’.Dithadiso tsa madi, mmogo le dikgoeletso tsa tsona, di tla gatisiwa mo Kaseteng ya Puso, mme di tla tlhagisiwa le go rekisiwa ka ditsela tsa setlwaedi.

src: Upcoming events.
tgt: Ditiragalo tse di tlang.

src: President Zuma will between the 18 and 22 April 2016 undertake working visits to member states of the Southern Africa Custom Union (SACU) which include Namibia, Botswana, Lesotho and Swaziland.
tgt: Magareng ga la bo 18 le la bo 22 Moranang 2016, Moporesitente Zuma o tla tsaya maeto a tiro kwa mebusong e e leng ditokololo tsa Mokgatlhotshwaraganelo wa Ditso tsa Borwa jwa Aforika (SACU) e e akaretsang wa Namibia, Botswana, Lesotho le wa Swaziland.

src: The visits will enhance the important role that SACU plays in promoting regional integration and economic development of all its members.
tgt: Maeto a tla tokafatsa seabe sa botlhokwa se SACU e nang naso go tsweletsa kgolagano ya kgaolo le tlhabololo ya ikonomi ya ditokololo tsotlhe tsa yona.

src: The President will undertake a State Visit to the Islamic Republic of Iran on 23 and 24 April 2016 to strengthen political and economic engagements between the two countries.
tgt: Moporesitente o tla tsaya Leeto la Semmuso go ya kwa Rephaboliking ya Islamo ya Iran ka la bo 23 le la bo 24 Moranang 2016 go maatlafatsa dipuisano tsa sepolotiki le tsa ikonomi magareng ga dinaga ka bobedi.

src: The President will lead the National Freedom Day celebrations on 27 April 2016 in Limpopo, Giyani Stadium under the theme: “Together building better communities – Local Government is everyone’s business”.Cabinet calls on all South Africans and sectors to demonstrate their patriotism by participating in the various events commemorating Freedom Month.
tgt: Moporesitente o tla etelela pele meletlo ya Bosetšhaba ya Letsatsi la Kgololesego ka la bo 27 Moranang 2016 kwa Limpopo, kwa Lebaleng la Metshameko la Giyani ka moono wa: "Mmogo re aga baagi ba ba botoka - Pusoselegae e ama mongwe le mongwe".Kabinete e ikuela mo maAforika Borweng otlhe le maphata otlhe go bontsha boikanyego jwa bona ka go nna le seabe mo ditiragalong tse di farologaneng tsa segopotso sa Kgwedi ya Kgololesego.

src: During the upcoming weeks, Parliament will be holding departmental Budget Votes.
tgt: Mo dibekeng tse di tlang, Palamente e tla tshwara Ditekanyetsokabo tsa mafapha.

src: The respective departmental Executives will unpack their operational plans for the 2016/17 financial year.
tgt: Bakhuduthamaga ba ba farologaneng ba mafapha ba tla ala maano a bona a tiro a ngwaga wa ditšhelete wa 2016/17.

src: Members of the public will be informed about service-delivery programmes of government.
tgt: Baagi ba tla itsisewe ka manaane a tlamelo ya ditirelo a puso.

src: Cabinet’s position on key issues in the environment.
tgt: Maemo a Kabinete mo Mererong e e Botlhokwa ya ga jaana.

src: Cabinet welcomed the response and subsequent apology by President Zuma to the Constitutional Court judgment relating to compliance with remedial actions set out in a report of the Public Protector.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse tsibogo le kopo ya boitshwarelo ya ga Moporesitente Zuma malebana le katlholo ya Kgotlatshekelo ya Molaotheo malebana le go obamela dikgato tsa paakanyo tse di tlhagelelang mo pegelong ya Mosireletsi wa Setšhaba.

src: Cabinet is studying the judgment to establish if there are any other actions to be undertaken to strengthen the role of the Public Service.
tgt: Kabinete e buisa katlholo go bona gore a go na le dikgato dingwe gape tse di tshwanetseng go tsewa go maatlafatsa seabe sa Tirelo ya Setšhaba.

src: The Constitutional Court judgment reinforces and asserts South Africa’s constitutional democracy.
tgt: Katlholo ya Kgotlatshekelo ya Molaotheo e tlhomamisa temokerasi ya Aforika Borwa ya molaotheo.

src: Cabinet noted the actions by the four banks that gave notice to close the bank account of a company.
tgt: Kabinete e lemogile dikgato tse di tserweng ke dibanka di le nne tse di ntshitseng kitsiso ya go tswala akhaonto ya banka ya setlamo.

src: Whilst Cabinet appreciate the terms and conditions of the banks, the acts may deter future potential investors who may want to do business in South Africa.
tgt: Le fa Kabinete e amogela melawana le dipeelo tsa dibanka, dikgato tseo di ka tshosa babeeletsi ba isago ba ba ka batlang go dira kgwebo mo Aforika Borwa.

src: Cabinet has endorsed that the Ministers of Finance, Labour and Mineral Resources should open a constructive engagement with the banks to find a lasting solution to this matter.
tgt: Kabinete e tlhomamisitse gore Ditona tsa Ditšhelete, Bodiri le Ditlamelo tsa Diminerale di tshwanetse go bula dipuisano tse di agang le dibanka go bona tharabololo ya leruri ya morero ono.

src: Cabinet congratulated the Minister of Health, Dr Aaron Motsoaledi, who received the USAID-TB international award in recognition of his leadership in the global fight against tuberculosis (TB) as well as championing South Africa's and regional initiatives in the screening, treatment and prevention of TB TB/HIV co-infection and multi-drug resistant TCabinet welcomes the nomination of South Africa as the 2016 recipient of the Distinguished Diplomatic Service Award by the World Affairs Council in Washington, DAs the first African country to receive this award, it recognises the country’s outstanding commitment to global education, international affairs and global communications to advance our national interests.
tgt: Kabinete e akgotse Tona ya Boitekanelo, Ngaka Aaron Motsoaledi, yo o amogetseng sekgele sa boditšhabatšhaba sa USAID-TB ka ntlha ya boeteledipele jwa gagwe mo ntweng ya lefatshe kgatlhanong le bolwetsi jwa lehuba (TB) gammogo le go etelela pele maiteko a Aforika Borwa le a kgaoloa go tlhatlhoba, go alafa le go thibela TB tshwaetso ya TB/HIV mmogo le TB e e dipelang melemo.

src: Cabinet commends the Minister of International Relations and Cooperation, Ms Maite Nkoana-Mashabane, for her contribution to South Africa’s international engagements, which are driven by the vision of a “united African continent that is peaceful, democratic, non-racial, non-sexist and prosperous, and which contributes to a just and equitable world.”.
tgt: Kabinete e amogela go supiwa ga Aforika Borwa jaaka moamogedi wa 2016 wa Sekgele sa Tirelo e e Kgethegileng ya Sedipolomate (Distinguisned Diplomatic Service Award) ke Lekgotla la Merero ya Lefatshe kwa Washington DJaaka naga ya ntlha ya Aforika go amogela sekgele seno, se lemoga maitlamo a naga a thuto ya lefatshe, merero ya boditšhabatšhaba mmogo le tlhaeletsano ya lefatshe go tsweletsa dikgatlhego tsa setšhaba.

src: Cabinet welcomes the appointment by President Zuma of Advocate Jan Lekhoa Mothibi, as the Head of the Special Investigating Unit, and wishes him all the best in his new responsibilities of combating corruption and maladministration.
tgt: Kabinete e akgola Tona ya Dikamano tsa Boditšhabatšhaba le Tirisanommogo, Mme Maite Nkoana-Mashabane, ka ntlha ya tshwaelo ya gagwe mo dipuisanong tsa Aforika Borwa tsa boditšhabatšhaba, tse di tsamaisiwang ke ponelopele ya "kontinente ya Aforika e e kopaneng mme e na le kagiso, temokerasi, e sa tlhaole go ya ka bosemorafe, e sa tlhaole go ya ka bong mme e humile, le e e tshwaelang mo lefatsheng le le nang le tshiamo le tekatekano.".

src: Cabinet conveys its heartfelt condolences to the Makwetu family and the Pan Africanist Congress on the passing of Mr Clarence Makwetu.
tgt: Kabinete e amogela go thapiwa ke Moporesitente Zuma ga Moatefokate Jan Lekhoa Mothibi jaaka Tlhogo ya Yuniti ya Dipatlisiso tse di Kgethegileng, mme e rata go mo eletsa masego mo maikarabelong a gagwe a mantšhwa a go lwantsha bobodu le tsamaiso e e sokameng.

src: Mr Makwetu will be remembered for his immense contribution and personal sacrifices to the liberation movement and the establishment of the new democratic South Africa.
tgt: Kabinete e romela matshediso a a tswang kwa botennye jwa dipelo kwa lelapeng la ga Makwetu le Pan Africanist Congress ka go tlhokafala ga Rre Clarence Makwetu.

src: The President declared a Special Provincial Official Funeral for the liberation struggle stalwart.
tgt: Rre Makwetu o tla gakologelwa ka ntlha ya tshwaelo ya gagwe e e boitshegang le go intsha setlhabelo mo mokgatlhong o o neng o lwela kgololesego mmogo le go tlhamiwa ga Aforika Borwa e ntšhwa ya temokerasi.

src: Cabinet conveys its heartfelt condolences to the Naidoo family on the passing of Mr Kumaran Naidoo.
tgt: Kabinete e romela matshediso a a tswang kwa botennye jwa dipelo kwa lelapeng la ga Naidoo ka go tlhokafala ga Rre Kumarana Naidoo.

src: Mr Naidoo was the Acting Director-General of the Department of Economic Development.
tgt: Rre Naidoo e ne e le Mokaedikakaretso wa Namaotshwere wa Lefapha la Tlhabololo ya Ikonomi.

src: He previously served as the Chief Financial Officer of the Department of Trade and Industry.
tgt: O kile a dira jaaka Motlhankedimogolo wa Ditšhelete wa Lefapha la Kgwebisano le Indaseteri.

src: Mr Naidoo has contributed immensely in financial management within the Public Service.
tgt: Rre Naidoo o tshwaetse go utlwala mo tsamaisong ya ditšhelete mo Tirelong ya Setšhaba.

src: Cabinet expressed its appreciation on the contribution made by Mr William Smith, who served as Cabinet Secretariat.
tgt: Kabinete e tlhagisitse malebo ka tshwaelo e e dirilweng ke Rre William Smith, yo o dirileng jaaka Mokwaledi wa Kabinete.

src: Mr Smith retired at the end of March after serving the Public Service for 27 years.
tgt: Rre Smith o rotse tiro ka bogodi kwa bokhutlong jwa Mopitlwe morago ga go direla Tirelo Setšhaba dingwaga di le Kabinete e mo eletsa molemo mo pakeng ya gagwe ya phenšene.

src: The Cabinet was briefed about the Report of the Commission of Inquiry into Allegations of Fraud, Corruption, Impropriety or Irregularity in the Strategic Defence Procurement Package (Arms Procurement Commission) which was released by the President this morning.
tgt: Kabinete e lotlegetswe ka ga Pegelo ya Khomišene ya Dipatlisiso malebana le Magatwe a Tsietso, Bobodu, Tsamaiso e e sa siamang mo Thulaganyong ya Theko ya tsa Phemelo (Khomišene ya Theko ya Dibetsa) e e golotsweng ke Moporesitente mosong ono.

src: The Report has found no evidence of wrongdoing, bribery, fraud or corruption in the arms procurement process, As Government we welcome the findings of the Commission.
tgt: Pegelo e fitlhetse go sena bosupi jwa molato, pipamolomo, tsietso gongwe bobodu mo thulaganyong ya theko ya dibetsa.

src: We join President Zuma in thanking Justice Willie Seriti and Judge Thekiso Musi, all the witnesses, including former President Thabo Mbeki, evidence leaders, legal teams, staff and those who contributed to making the work of the Commission a success.
tgt: Re tlhatswitswe maina jaaka re sa bolo go bua mo dingwageng tse dintsintsi gore ga gona phoso epe le gore theko e dirilwe ka WEBTOKEN solofela gore diphitlhelelo di tla tswalela morero ono o o sa bolong go WEBTOKEN golagana le Moporesitente Zuma go leboga Moatlhodi Willie Seriti le Moatlhodi Thekiso Musi, dipaki tsotlhe, go akarediwa le Moporesitente wa maloba Thabo Mbeki, batsamaisi ba bosupi, ditlhopha tsa molao, badiri le botlhe ba ba tshwaetseng go atlegisa tiro ya Khomišene.

src: AppointmentsAll appointments are subject to the verification of qualifications and the relevant clearance.
tgt: Go thapiwaGo thapiwa gotlhe go tla diragadiwa fa makwalothuto otlhe a netefaditswe mme go amogetswe tetlelelo e e matshwanedi:.

src: Mr Siyabonga Gama as Group Executive and Mr Garry Pita as Group Chief Financial Officer of Transnet.
tgt: Rre Siyabonga Gama jaaka Mokhuduthamaga wa Setlhopha le Rre Garry Pita jaaka Motlhankedimogolo wa Ditšhelete wa Transnet.

src: Mr Lufuno Leslie Nevhutalu as member and Chairperson of the Construction Industry Development Board.
tgt: Rre Lufuno Leslie Nevhutalu jaaka tokololo le Modulasetilo wa Boto ya Tlhabololo ya Indaseteri ya Dikonteraka.

src: Mr Andile Nongogo as the Chief Executive Officer of the Services Sector Education Training Authority.
tgt: Rre Andile Nongogo jaaka Mokhuduthamaga wa Bothati jwa Katiso ya Thuto ya Lephata la Ditirelo.

src: Implementation of Key Government Programmes.
tgt: Go tsenngwa tirisong ga Manaane a a Botlhokwa a Puso.

src: Cabinet welcomes President Jacob Zuma’s State Visit of to the Islamic Republic of Iran, which escalates economic and trade relations between both countries, through the signing of several agreements and commitments.
tgt: Kabinete e amogela Leeto la Semmuso la ga Moporesitente Jacob Zuma go ya kwa Rephaboliking ya Islamo ya Iran, le le akofisang botsalano jwa ikonomi le kgwebisano magareng ga dinaga ka bobedi, ka go saeniwa ga ditumelano le maitlamo a le mmalwa.

src: President Jacob Zuma and President Hasan Rouhani strengthened cooperation in the fields of trade, education and skills development science and technology energy, including petrochemical gas exploration and refining capacity agriculture mining and mineral beneficiation infrastructure development and transport finance, banking and insurance and tourism.
tgt: Moporesitente Jacob Zuma le Moporesitente Hasan Rouhani ba maatlafaditse tirisanommogo mo maphateng a kgwebisano, thuto le tlhabololo ya bokgoni saense le thekenoloji maatla, go akarediwa go phuruphudiwa ga gase ya petorokhemikale mmogo le bokgoni jwa go e fetola temothuo meepo mmogo le go fetolwa ga diminerale tlhabololo ya mafaratlhatlha le dipalangwa ditšhelete, dibanka le inšorense mmogo le bojanala.

src: All of which contributes to the implementation of the National Development Plan.
tgt: Mme tsotlhe tse di tshwaela mo go diragadiweng ga Leano la Tlhabololo la Bosetšhaba (NDP).Mo go tsa boditšhabatšhaba, baeteledipele ka bobedi ba dumelane ka go maatlafatsa boikuelo jwa tlhabololo ya Ditšhabakopano (UN), bogolo segolo Lekgotla la Tshireletso la UN, mo dikgatlhegong tsa dinaga tse di tlhabologang.

src: On the international front, the two leaders agreed to intensify the call for the reform of the United Nations especially the UN Security Council, in the interests of the developing world.
tgt: Dipoelo tseno di maatlafaditse Leeto la Tiro la Moporesitente kwa United Arab Emirates (UAE) koo mebuso ka bobedi e neng ya ntšhwafatsa maitlamo a yona malebana le tsolotanyo le kgodiso ya botsalano jwa sebedi, bogolo segolo mo maphateng a kgwebisano, dipeeletso le ikonomi go nna botsalano jwa togamaano jo bo akaretsang.

src: These outcomes reinforced the President’s Working Visit to the United Arab Emirates (UAE) where both states renewed their commitment towards the consolidation and elevation of bilateral relations, particularly in the trade, investment and economic fields into a comprehensive strategic partnership.
tgt: Seno se ageletse mo Leetong la Semmuso la ga Moporesitente Jacob Zuma ka Ngwanaitsele 2011, fa go ne ga tlhamiwang Khomišene e e Tlhakanetsweng ya SA-UAE e e akofisitseng lebelo la kgwebisano magareng ga dinaga ka bobedi go tloga go R13 bilione ka 2011 go ya go R27 bilione ka 2015.Aforika Borwa le UAE ba dumelane go atolosa tirisanommogo go dirisa ditšhono tsa Ikonomi ya Mawatle, go tsweletsa go romelwa ntle ga ditlhagiswa tsa temothuo tsa Aforika Borwa, ditlhagiswa tse di dirilweng mme bogolo segolo theko le tirisanommogo mo go tsa phemelo.

src: This built on President Jacob Zuma’s State Visit in November 2011 which saw the establishment of the SA-UAE Joint Commission that accelerated total trade momentum between the two countries from R13 billion in 2011 to R27 billion in 2015.South Africa and the UAE also agreed to expand cooperation to take advantage of opportunities in the Ocean Economy, to promote the export of South African agricultural products, manufactured products and particularly defence procurement and partnerships.
tgt: Gape leeto le tsweleditse bokgoni jwa Aforika Borwa jwa go aga mafaratlhatlha go totilwe ditšhono tsa ditlamo tsa Aforika Borwa kwa EXPO 2020 kwa Dubai, gammogo le tirisanommogo mo mererong ya kagiso, tshireletso mmogo le tsepamo.

src: The visit also promoted South African infrastructure building capacity targeting opportunities for South African companies at EXPO 2020 in Dubai, as well as cooperation in the field of peace, security and stability.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse dikgato tse di tsepameng tse di beilweng ke Tona ya Metshameko le Boitapoloso Fikile Mbalula go aga sešwa sebopego se se kgaoganeng e bile se tlhaola thata sa metshameko le boitapoloso ka Tumelano ya Diphetogo.

src: Cabinet welcomed the firm measures that have been put in place by the Minister of Sport and Recreation Fikile Mbalula to reconstruct the fragmented and deeply discriminatory sport and recreation landscape through its Transformation Charter.
tgt: Seno se tla akofisa diphetogo tse di lebisang kwa tsamaisong e e kopaneng ya metshameko e e ikaegileng ka dintlhatheo tsa temokerasi, tekatenako, go direla dilo mo pepeneneng, kemedi ya baagi ba ba farologaneng, phitlhelesego, mmogo le seabe se se oketsegileng go lepalepana le dikeletso tsa NDKabinete e amogela ditekanyetsokabo tse di tlhagisiwang ke mafapha a a farologaneng ka dipegelo tse di tseneletseng tse di tlhagisang tswelelopele e e dirilweng malebana le go tokafatsa matshelo a maAforika Borwa.

src: This demonstrates implementation of the Medium Term Strategic Framework which takes us closer to the realisation of Vision 2030 of the National Development Plan.
tgt: Seno se bontsha tiragatso ya Letlhomeso la Togamaano ya Pakagare (MTSF) le le re atametsang mo go fitlheleleng Ponelopele 2030 ya NDP.

src: Cabinet calls on South Africans to follow the budget votes on various media platforms to better understand Government’s Programme of Action.
tgt: Kabinete e ikuela mo maAforika Borweng otlhe go latedisisa ditekanyetsokabo mo bobegakgannyeng jo bo farologaneng gore ba tlhaloganye Leanotiro la Puso botoka.

src: Cabinet calls for continued commitment to secure meaningful workplace transformation in view of the findings from the 16th Commission for Employment Equity Annual Report for all designated employers which was launched under the theme “Transformation does make business sense”.
tgt: Kabinete e ikuela gore go nne le maitlamo a a tswelelang go netefatsa gore go nna le diphetogo tse di mosola mo tirong go lebeletswe diphitlhelelo tsa Pegelo ya Ngwaga le Ngwaga ya bo 16 ya Khomišene ya Tekatekano mo Tirong ya bathapi botlhe ba ba neng ba supilwe, e e tlhomilweng ka moono wa "Diphetogo di mosola mo kgwebong".

src: The Report helps government to understand the status of employment equity in the country and its progress in workplace transformation for the year 2015.
tgt: Pegelo e thusa puso go tlhaloganya seemo sa tekatekano mo tirong mo nageng mmogo le tswelelopele malebana le diphetogo mo tirong mo ngwageng wa 2015.

src: Cabinet congratulated the Department of Human Settlements on the delivery of 4, 3 million houses and housing opportunities since the dawn of democracy.
tgt: Kabinete e akgola Lefapha la Manno a Batho malebana le go abiwa ga Dintlo di le milione mmogo le ditšhono tsa dintlo fa e sa le temokerasi e le gona.

src: These opportunities include 2, 806 235 fully subsidized houses (BNG houses), 121 784 social/rental housing, 6329 Financial Linked Individual Subsidy Programme and 986 608 serviced sites.
tgt: Ditšhono tseno di akaretsa dintlo di le 2 806 235 tse di etleediwang ka botlalo (dintlo tsa BNG), dintlo tsa loago/tse di hiriwang di le 121 784, di le 6 329 tsa Lenaane la Ketleetso ya Motho ka nosi le le Golaganeng le Ditšhelete le ditsha tse di nang le ditirelo di le 986 608.Phitlhelelo eno ya hisetori e tlametse batho ba feta dimilione di le 20 ka dintlo mme go keteka phitlhelelo eno, lefapha le tlhomile letsholo la bosetšhaba go bontsha katlego ya naga.

src: This historic milestone has provided a roof for more than 20 million people and to celebrate this achievement the department has launched a national campaign to profile the country’s success.
tgt: Go tlhomiwa bosetšhaba go dirilwe kwa COSMO City, e leng nngwe ya diporojeke tsa ditlapele mo nageng e gape e ketekang dingwaga di le lesome e ntse e le teng.

src: The national launch took place in COSMO City, one of the integrated priority projects around the country which is also celebrating ten years of its existence.
tgt: Kabinete e lebogetse maAforika Borwa otlhe ka ntlha ya ditshwaelo tsa ona, boineelo le go dira ka natla go netefatsa gore maAforika Borwa a a tlhokang a busediwa seriti ka manno.

src: Cabinet thanked all South Africans for their contributions, dedication and hard work in ensuring that the dignity of South Africans in need is restored through human settlements.
tgt: Kabinete e akgola Mokwaledikakaretso wa Ditšhabakopano ka go bitsa Moletlo wa Maemo a a kwa Godimo wa go Saena Tumelano ya Paris, e e amogetsweng ke Ditokolo di le 176 ka Sedimonthole 2015.

src: Cabinet commends the United Nations Secretary-General for convening the High-Level Signing Ceremony of the Paris Agreement, which was adopted by 176 Parties in December 2015.
tgt: Go saeniwa ga Tumelano ya Paris go tshwaile kgato ya ntlha ya go diragadiwa ga yona go go tla kaelang maiteko a boditšhabatšhaba a go lekanyetsa tlhagiso ya digase tsa greenhouse mmogo le go fitlhelela dikgwetlho tsotlhe tsa phetogo ya tlelaemete.

src: The signing of the Paris Agreement marked the first step in its implementation which will guide international efforts to limit greenhouse gas emissions and to meet all the associated challenges posed by climate change.
tgt: Kabinete e letetse go konosediwa ga dithulaganyo tsa selegae tsa go amogelwa ke botlhe, go kgontsha gore go diragadiwe Tumelano ya Paris ka nako gore ka 2020 e bo e diragadiwa ka botlalo.

src: Cabinet looks forward to the conclusion of the respective domestic ratification procedures, by all, to enable timely entry into force for full implementation of the Paris Agreement by 2020.
tgt: Gape Kabinete e lemoga gore Lefapha la Merero ya Tikologo le dirisana mmogo le Lefapha la Bojanala go diragatsa dilaboratori tsa tlamelo tse di bidiwang "Biodiversity Lab: Go godisa tshwaelo ya ikonomi ya ditlamelo tsa bayoloji tsa Aforika Borwa" go tloga ka la bo 10 Moranang go fitlha ka la bo 13 Motsheganong 2016.Maikaelelo ke go lemoga bokgoni jwa ikonomi jwa ditshedi le dimela tse di farologaneng jo bo tlhalositseng mo Togamaanotlhomo ya Ikonomi ya Bosetšhaba ya Ditshedi le Dimela tse di farologaneng e e amogetsweng ke Kabinete ka Phukwi 2015 gore batho ba nne le seabe mo go yona.

src: Cabinet also notes that the Department of Environmental Affairs has partnered with the Department of Tourism in convening delivery labs titled “Biodiversity Lab: Growing the economic contribution of South Africa’s biological resources” from 10 April to 13 May 2016.The aim is to realise the economic potential of South Africa’s rich biological diversity which is articulated in the draft National Biodiversity Economy Strategy that was approved by Cabinet in July 2015 for public participation.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse Leanotiro la Pholisi ya Diindaseteri (IPAP) la 2016/17 - 2018/19, e leng pilara ya botlhokwa ya Leano la Moporesitente la Dintlha di le Robongwe mme le tshwaela mo go diragadiweng ga NDP.

src: This is the eighth annual iteration of successive government industrialisation plans which builds on the achievements, policy platforms and programmes of previous iterations.
tgt: Seno ke poeletso ya borobedi ya maano a madirelo a puso a a latelanang a a agelelang mo diphitlhelelong, dipholising mmogo le mo manaane a dipoeletso tse dingwe tse di fetileng.

src: IPAP 2016/17 seeks to achieve a higher impact industrial policy in difficult economic circumstances.
tgt: Maitlhomo a IPAP 2016/17 ke go fitlhelela ditlamorago tse di kwa godimo tsa pholisi ya madirelo mo maemong a a boima a ikonomi.

src: These include the on-going effects of the global economic recession including the steel crisis and commodity slump as well as the severe drought and other significant domestic constraints.
tgt: Seno se akaretsa ditlamorago tse di tswelelang pele tsa kwelotlase ya ikonomi lefatshe ka bophara go akarediwa le mathata a tshipi mmogo le kwelotlase ya diminerale gammogo le komelelo e e tseneletseng mmogo le dikgoreletsi tse dingwe tsa selegae.

src: Achievements from the previous year include the saving of approximately 67 000 jobs and the creation of an estimated 7 000 new decent jobs in the Clothing and Textile Leather and Footwear sector.
tgt: Diphitlhelelo tsa ngwaga o o fetileng di akaretsa go bolokiwa ga ditiro di ka fopholediwa go 67 000 le go tlhamiwa ga ditiro tse di nang le seriti di ka nna 7 000 mo lephateng la Diaparo le Matlalo le Ditlhako.

src: The Agro-processing sub-sector is one of the largest domestic manufacturing sectors by employment, providing an estimated 216 090 jobs in 2015 compared to 208 822 in 2014.
tgt: Lephatapotlana la phetolo ya ditlhagiswa tsa temothuo ke lengwe la maphata a madirelo a selegae a magolo ka go thapa, mme le tlametse ka ditiro tse di fopholediwang go 216 090 ka 2015 fa go bapisiwa le 208 822 ka 2014.

src: Over R600 million worth of investment was attracted in 2015/16, laying the basis for strengthening enterprise development with a focus on rural communities.
tgt: Go ngokilwe dipeeletso tsa boleng jo bo fetang R600 milione ka 2015/16 mme seo ya nna motheo wa go maatlafatsa tlhabololo ya dikgwebo go totilwe baagi ba metsemagae.

src: Cabinet approved the Final Integrated Urban Development Framework and 2016/19 Implementation Plan.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse Letlhomeso la Makgaolakgang la Tlhabololo e e Kopaneng ya Metsesetoropo le Leano la Tiragatso la 2016/19.

src: The overall outcome of the Integrated Urban Development Framework is spatial transformation.
tgt: Ditlamorago tsa kakaretso tsa Letlhomeso la Tlhabololo e e Kopaneng ya Metsesetoropo ke phetogo ya go abiwa ga dibaka.

src: This marks a new deal for South African cities and towns, which will steer urban growth towards a sustainable growth model of compact, connected and coordinated cities and towns, which are safer, resource efficient and good places to work and live in.
tgt: Seno ke tumelano e ntšhwa ya ditoropokgolo le ditoropo tsa Aforika Borwa, e e tla lebisang kgolo ya metsesetoropo kwa sekaong sa kgolo ya leruri ya ditoropokgolo le metsesetoropo e e kitlaneng, e gokagane, e babalesegile, e dirisa ditlamelo sentle mme e le mafelo a a siameng a bonno le a tiro.

src: This responds to the National Development Plan directive to develop an urban development policy that will ensure proper planning, infrastructure investments and management to support growth and unlock the economic potential of our cities and towns.
tgt: Seno se tsibogela kaelo ya NDP ya go tlhama pholisi ya tlhabololo ya metsesetoropo e e tla netefatsang thulaganyo e e siameng, dipeeletso tsa mafaratlhatlha le botsamaisi go tshegetsa kgolo le go bulela bokgoni jwa ikonomi jwa ditoropokgolo le ditoropo tsa rona.

src: Cabinet approved publication of the Draft National Career Development Services Policy – Building an effective and Integrated Career Development Services System for South Africa, in the Government Gazette for public comment.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse go phasaladiwa ga Pholisitlhomo ya Tirelo ya Bosetšhaba ya Tlhabololo ya Tiro - Go agela Aforika Borwa Thulaganyo e e bokgoni le e e Gokaganeng ya Tirelo ya Tlhabololo ya Tiro, mo Kaseteng ya Puso gore batho ba tshwaele.

src: The draft Policy once implemented will provide a coordinated approach to quality career development services for all citizens.
tgt: Fa Pholisitlhomo e diragadiwa, e tla dira tlamelo ya mokgwa o o gokaganeng wa ditirelo tsa tlhabololo ya tiro tsa boleng go baagi botlhe.

src: This will enable them to make informed career choices to obtain employment, contribute to society and build the South African WEBTOKEN Development Services plays a key role in helping labour markets work and education systems meet their goals.
tgt: Seno se tla ba kgontsha go dira boitlhophelo jwa tiro ka kitso go kgona go fitlhelela go thapiwa, go tshwaela mo loagong mmogo le go aga ikonomi ya Aforika Borwa.

src: This contributes towards the achievement of the National Development Plan recommendations of promoting economic growth and employment, matching of employed workers to jobs and increasing skills development and the number of university graduates.
tgt: Tirelo ya Tlhabololo ya Tiro e na le seabe sa botlhokwa go thusa gore mebaraka ya ditiro e dire mme ditsamaiso tsa thuto di fitlhelele diphitlhelelo tsa tsona.

src: Cabinet was briefed on implementation of the National Evaluation System and approved the Annual report 2014/15 and the fifth National Evaluation Plan for 2016/17 to 2018/19, as part of the drive to improve service delivery,The National Evaluation System emanates from the National Evaluation Policy Framework which ensures that credible and objective evidence from evaluations is incorporated in processes of planning, budgeting, organisational improvement, policy review, as well as on-going programme and project management so as to improve performance.
tgt: Seno se tshwaela mo go fitlheleleng dikatlenegiso tsa NDP tsa go tsweletsa kgolo ya ikonomi le go thapa, go lepalepanya badiri le ditiro le go oketsa tlhabololo ya bokgoni mmogo le palo ya dialogane tsa diyunibesithi.

src: Forty-seven (47) evaluations have been completed or are underway, covering R75 billion of government expenditure.
tgt: Go konoseditswe gongwe go tsweletswe ka ditshekatsheko di le 47, tse di akaretsang ditshenyegelo tsa puso tsa R75 bilione.

src: Fifteen (15) evaluation reports were approved and 12 tabled at Cabinet to date.
tgt: Go amogetswe dipegelo tsa tshekatsheko di le 15 mme go fitlha ga jaana, di le 12 di tlhagisitswe fa pele ga Kabinete.

src: Fourteen (14) improvement plans are being implemented and progress on these reflects substantial changes, to widen impact.
tgt: Go diragadiwa maano a tokafatso a le 14 mme tswelelopele ya ona e bontsha diphetogo tse di bonalang.

src: Cabinet was briefed on the evaluation findings and approved recommendations with a view to increase impact from the implementation of the Expanded Public Works Programme Social Sector (EPWP-SS).This Programme plays an important social protection role for unemployed able bodied adults, by drawing them into productive work and receiving a monthly stipend of an average amount of R1 517.
tgt: Kabinete e itsisitswe ka diphitlhelelo tsa tshekatsheko mme ya amogela dikatlenegiso e lebile go oketsa ditlamorago go tswa kwa tiragatsong ya Lephata la Loago la Lenaanekatoloso la Ditiro tsa Setšhaba (EPWP-SS).Lenaane leno le na le seabe sa botlhoka sa tshireletso ya loago mo bagolong ba ba itekanetseng mme ba sa dire, ka go ba gogela mo tirong e e tlhagisang mme ba amogela tlhatswadiatla ya kgwedi le kgwedi ya palogare ya R1 Bontsi jwa manaane a lephata la loago bo tlamela baagi ba ba mo matshosetsing le ba ba humanegileng ka ditirelo tse di kgethegileng.

src: The EPWP-SS grew rapidly between phase one and phase two, from 5 to 22 programmes which resulted in the sector achieving 175 769 work opportunities in phase one and 866 246 work opportunities in phase two, well above the 750 000 target.
tgt: EPWP-SS e godile ka bonako magareng ga legato la ntlha le legato la bobedi, go tloga go manaane a le 5 go ya go a le 22 a a bakileng gore lephata le fitlhelele ditšhono tsa tiro di le 175 769 mo legatong la ntlha le ditšhono tsa tiro di le 866 246 mo legatong la bobedi, e leng go feta 750 000 e e neng e beilwe.

src: The recommendations focus on improving implementation to reduce inefficiencies in decision-making, implementation (payments of stipends) and provision of training, as well as coordination.
tgt: Dikatlenegiso di totile go tokafatsa tiragatso go fokotsa tlhaelo ya go tsaya ditshwetso, tiragatso (tuelo ya tlhatswadiatla) mmogo le tlamelo ka katiso, gammogo le kgokaganyo.

src: Cabinet was briefed on the findings and endorsed the recommendations of the design and implementation evaluation of the Urban Settlement Development Grant and its Improvement Plan.
tgt: Kabinete e itsisitswe ka diphitlhelelo mme ya tlhomamisa dikatlenegiso tsa sethalo le tiragatso ya tshekatsheko ya Kabelo ya Tlhabololo ya Manno a Metsesetoropo mmogo le Leano la teng la Tokafatso.

src: The findings support retaining the Urban Settlement Development Grant as a supplementary grant that funds a wider notion of sustainable and equitable human settlements for the benefit of poor and moderate income households.
tgt: Diphitlhelelo di tshegetsa go tswelela ka Kabelo ya Tlhabololo ya Manno a Metsesetoropo jaaka kabelo ya tshegetso ya manno a batho a leruri le a a nang le tekatekano a a tswelang mosola magae a a humanegileng le a letseno le le sa reng sepe.

src: This is instrumental in achieving the targets from the Medium Term Strategic Framework provision of 1 495 million housing opportunities in quality living environments by 2019.
tgt: Seno se botlhokwa mo go fitlheleleng diphitlhelelo tsa MTSF go tlamela ka ditšhono di le 1 495 milione tsa dintlo mo tikologong ya boleng ka 2019.

src: Cabinet approved the report on the Implementation and Impact Evaluation of the Technology and Human Resources for Industry Programme, the management response to the report and the improvement plan submitted by the Department of Trade and Industry.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse pegelo ya Tiragatso le Tshekatsheko ya Ditlamorago tsa Ditlamelo tsa Thekenoloji le Badiri tsa Manaane a Indaseteri, tsibogo ya botsamaisi mmogo le leano la tokafatso le le tlhagisitsweng ke Lefapha la Kgwebisano le Indaseteri.

src: This Programme was introduced by the Department of Trade and Industry in 1992 to strengthen skills development in science, engineering and technology.
tgt: Lenaane leno le itsisitswe ke Lefapha la Kgwebisano le Indaseteri ka 1992 go maatlafatsa tlhabololo ya bokgoni mo saenseng, boenjiniri le thekenoloji.

src: It contributes to job creation by producing a flow of highly skilled researchers and technology managers for industry and by improving the competitiveness of the participating business organisations.
tgt: Le tshwaela mo go tlhameng ditiro ka go tlhagisa kelelo ya babatlisisi ba ba nang le bokgoni jo bo kwa godimo le batsamaisi ba thekenoloji mo indasetering le go tokafatsa bokgoni jwa kgaisano jwa dikgwebo tse di nang le seabe.

src: The Programme is a valid, important and efficient element of innovation support that offers considerable value for money both in terms of technology development and developing human resources and industry-related skills.
tgt: Lenaane ke karolo ya boammaaruri, ya botlhokwa le e e bokgoni ya tshegetso ya boitlhamedi e e tlamelang ka boleng jo bo bonalang jwa madi go lebeletswe tlhabololo ya thekenoloji mmogo le tlhabololo ya badiri le bokgoni jo bo maleba jwa indaseteri.

src: It also compares favourably to some international programmes.
tgt: Gape le gaisana sentle le Manaane mangwe a boditšhabatšhaba.

src: Cabinet was briefed on the findings of the Report by the Ministerial Task Team probe into the allegations of the ‘educator posts for sale’ involving individuals, teacher unions and officials of certain Provincial Education Departments.
tgt: Kabinete e itsisitswe ka diphitlhelelo tsa Pegelo ya Setlhophatiro sa Ditona se se neng se batlisisa magatwe a 'diphatlhatiro tsa borutabana tse di rekisiwang' a a amang mekgatlho ya barutabana le batlhankedi ba Mafapha a Diporofense a Thuto.

src: Cabinet endorsed recommendations to deal systematically and pointedly with the WEBTOKEN its final Report the Ministerial Task Team provides a critique of the role played by all stakeholders in the process of the selection and recruitment of WEBTOKEN also notes the significant problems in the current system of appointments to posts in the basic education sector and provides recommendations to assist the Department of Basic Education and the basic education sector in general to address the identified challenges.
tgt: Kabinete e tlhomamisitse dikatlenegiso tsa go samagana le diphitlhelelo ka tsela e e WEBTOKEN Pegelong ya sona ya makgaolakgang, Setlhophatiro sa Ditona se sekasekile seabe sa baamegi botlhe mo tsamaisong ya go tlhopha le go ngoka WEBTOKEN lemogile gape mathata a a bonalang mo tsamaisong ya ga jaana ya go thapa mo diphatlhatirong mo lephateng la thuto ya motheo se tlamela ka dikatlenegiso tsa go thusa Lefapha la Thuto ya Motheo le lephata la thuto ya motheo ka kakaretso go samagana le dikgwetlho tse di supilweng.

src: Bills.
tgt: Molaotlhomo.

src: Cabinet approved submission of the National Forest Amendment Bill to Parliament.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse go tlhagisiwa ga Molaotlhomoo o Baakantsweng wa Bosetšhaba wa Dikgwa kwa palamenteng.

src: The Bill amends the National Forests Act, 1998 (Act No.
tgt: Molaotlhomo o baakanya Molao wa Bosetšhaba wa Dikgwa wa 1998 (Molao wa bo 84 wa 1998).Tiragatso ya dipaakanyo e tla tokafatsa tsamaiso ya leruri ya dikgwa mme gape e rotloetse seabe sa ditlhopha tse di mo matshosetsing, tse di ikaegileng ka jalo ya dikgwa go itshedisa, mo Lekgotleng la Bogakolodi la Bosetšhaba la Dikgwa.

src: Upcoming events.
tgt: Ditiragalo tse di tlang.

src: President Jacob Zuma will attend the inauguration and swearing-in ceremony of Ugandan President Yoweri Museveni in Kampala on 12 May 2016.
tgt: Moporesitente Jacob Zuma o tla tsenela moletlo wa go tlhongwa le go ikanisiwa ga Moporesitente wa Uganda Yoweri Museveni kwa Kampala ka la bo 12 Motsheganong 2016.

src: The outgoing visit will further strengthen bilateral relations between South Africa and Uganda.
tgt: Leeto le tla maatlafatsa gape dikamano tsa sebedi magareng ga Aforika Borwa le Uganda.

src: President Jacob Zuma will officiate a National Day of Prayer to be held at ABSA Stadium in Durban on 29 April 2016.
tgt: Moporesitente Jacom Zuma o tla tsamaisa Letsatsi la Bosetšhaba la Thapelo le le tla tshwarelwang kwa Setediamo sa ABSA kwa Durban ka la bo 29 Moranang 2016.

src: Religious leaders and leaders of civil society formations will join government in praying for the further consolidation of democracy, national unity, social cohesion as well as successful and peaceful 2016 Local Government Elections.
tgt: Baeteledipele ba sedumedi le baeteledipele ba mekgatlho ya baagi ba tla tshwaragana le puso go rapelela go golagana go ya pele ga temokerasi, kopano ya setšhaba, kopano ya loago gammogo le Ditlhopho tsa Pusoselegae tsa 2016 tse di atlegileng e bile di rena kagiso.

src: Cabinet was briefed on plans by the Department of Arts and Culture to host Africa Month in May 2016 under the theme: “Building a Better Africa and a Better World” as part of the continent’s celebration of the establishment of the Organisation of Africa Unity, now the African Union and the work it has done.
tgt: Kabinete e itsisitswe ka maano a Lefapha la Botsweretshi le Setso go tshwara Kgwedi ya Aforika ka Motsheganong 2016 ka moono wa: "Re aga Aforika yo o Botoka le Lefatshe le le Botoka" jaaka karolo ya meletlo ya kontinente go keteka go tlhamiwa ga Mokgatlho wa Kitlano ya Aforika, o jaanong o bidiwang Kitlano ya Aforika le tiro e o e dirileng.

src: President Jacob Zuma will launch Africa Month on the National Day of Prayer on 29 April WEBTOKEN 2016 Africa Month will focus on women and youth development initiatives, while we commemorate the 60th year of the Women’s March and the 40th year of the Youth Uprisings in Soweto.
tgt: Moporesitente Jacob Zuma o tla tlhoma Kgwedi ya Aforika ka Letsatsi la Bosetšhaba la Thapelo ka la bo 20 Moranang WEBTOKEN 2016, Kgwedi ya Aforika e tla tota maiteko a tlhabololo ya basadi le bašwa, fa re ntse re gopola ngwaga wa bo60 wa Mogwanto wa Basadi le ngwaga wa bo40 wa Dikhuduego tsa Bašwa tsa kwa Soweto.

src: South Africans are urged to participate in the multi-disciplinary programme that involves a wide range of activities including visual arts, theatre, music, lectures and colloquia as well as the 10th anniversary of the African World Heritage Fund.
tgt: MaAforika Borwa a rotloediwa go nna le seabe mo lenaaneng la maphata mantsi le le akaretsang ditiragalo tse di farologaneng tse di akaretsang botsweretshipono, teatere, mmino, ditlhatlhelelo le dipuisano gammogo le segopotso sa bo10 sa Letlole la Aforika la Ngwaoboswa ya Lefatshe.

src: Africa Month serves as a platform to reconnect and recommit ourselves to Pan Africanism and African Renaissance in bringing the people of the continent closer.
tgt: Kgwedi ya Aforika ke serala sa gore re golagane gape le go itlama gape ka Kopano ya maAforika le Tsosoloso ya Aforika go kopanya batho ba kontinente.

src: On 20 May 2016 government will lead the national celebration of the centenary of the University of Fort Hare at the Alice campus in the Eastern Cape.
tgt: Ka la bo 20 Motsheganong 2016, puso e tla etelela pele keteko ya bosetšhaba ya ngwagakgolo wa Yunibesithi ya Fort Hare kwa khamphaseng ya Alice kwa Kapabotlhaba.

src: In preparation for the main celebration, President Jacob Zuma has established an Inter-Ministerial Committee (IMC) to plan and coordinate the historic centenary celebration.
tgt: Go baakanyetsa keteko e kgolo, Moporesitente Jacob Zuma o tlhamile Komiti ya Ditona (IMC) go rulaganya le go gokaganya keteko eno ya hisetori ya ngwagakgolo.

src: This historic learning institution served as a beacon during our struggle for freedom and is also known as the “crucible of African leadership” with it being the alma mater of anti-apartheid struggle figures such as the great ZK Matthews, Nelson Mandela, Robert Sobukwe, Oliver Tambo and Govan Mbeki.
tgt: Setheo seno sa thuto sa hisetori se dirile jaaka mosupatsela ka nako ya kgaratlho ya rona ya kgololesego mme gape se itsege jaaka "motswedi wa boeteledipele jwa Aforika" jaaka e le setheo se se tlhagisitseng balwelakgololesego ba tshwana le bagaka ZK Matthews, Nelson Mandela, Robert Sobukwe, Oliver Tambo le Govan Mbeki.

src: It is the only Southern African university to have produced five heads of state: Nelson Mandela of South Africa, Yusuf Lule of Uganda, Robert Mugabe of Zimbabwe, Ntsu Mokhehle of Lesotho and Sir Seretse Khama of WEBTOKEN part of the University of Fort Hare’s centenary celebrations Cabinet calls on the Alumni and members of the public to share their Fort Hare memories for the Tell Your Story campaign using the hashtag #MyFortHare.
tgt: Ke yona fela yunibesithi ya Borwa jwa Aforika e e tlhagisitseng ditlhogo tsa mebuso di le tlhano: Nelson Mandela wa Aforika Borwa, Yusuf Yule wa Uganda, Robert Mugabe wa Zimbabwe, Ntsu Mokhehle wa Lesotho le Sir Seretse Khama wa Botswana.

src: Deputy President Cyril Ramaphosa will lead the South Africa delegation to the 26th World Economic Forum (WEF) Africa in Rwanda between 11 and 13 May 2016.
tgt: Jaaka karolo ya meletlo ya ngwagakgolo wa Yunibesithi ya Fort Hare, Kabinete e ikuela mo go botlhe ba ba ithutileng koo mmogo le baagi go amogana tseo ba di gakologelwang ka Fort Hare mo letsholong la Anela Kgang ya Gago ba dirisa #MyFortHare.

src: The forum is hosted under the theme: “Connecting Africa’s Resources through Digital Transformation”.Government through its Nine-Point Plan is advancing the country’s own digital transformation.
tgt: Motlatsamoporesitente Cyril Ramaphosa o tla etelela pele kemedi ya Aforika Borwa kwa Foramong ya Lefatshe ya Ikonomi (WEF) ya bo26 ya Aforika kwa Rwanda magareng ga la bo 11 le la bo 13 Motsheganong 2016.

src: It is rolling out the first phase of its broadband initiative that will connect more than 5 000 government facilities in eight district municipalities over a three-year period.
tgt: E atolosa legato la ntlha la maiteko a broadband e e tla golaganyang ditheo di feta 5 000 tsa puso mo makgotlatoropong a dikgaolo a le robedi mo pakeng ya dingwaga tse tharo.

src: Funding to the tune of R740 million has been allocated in support of the rollout.
tgt: Go rebotswe matlole a bokana ka R740 milione go tshegetsa katoloso eno.

src: INDABA 2016 at the Inkosi Albert Luthuli Convention Centre in Durban from 7 to 9 May 2016, is a Pan-African platform that will promote our tourism products to international buyers.
tgt: INDABA 2016 kwa Inkosi Albert Luthuli Convention Centre kwa Durban go tloga la bo 7 go fitlha la bo 9 Motsheganong 2016, ke serala sa Kopano ya maAforika se se tla tsweletsang ditlhagiswa tsa bojanala mo bareking ba boditšhabatšhaba.

src: Tourism, as one of the six pillars of economic growth of the National Development Plan, contributed R357 billion to our GDP in 2014 and supported 9 per cent of total employment in South Africa.
tgt: Bojanala jaaka nngwe ya dipilara tse thataro tsa kgolo ya ikonomi mo Leanong la Bosetšhaba la Tlhabololo, bo tshwaetse R357 bilione mo GDP ya rona ka 2014 mme bo tshegeditse diperesente di le 9 tsa ditiro tsotlhe mo Aforika Borwa.

src: The World Travel and Tourism Council estimates that tourism will contribute R560 billion to our GDP by 2025 and will support over two million jobs.
tgt: Lekgotla la Lefatshe la Maeto le Bojanala le fopholetsa gore bojanala bo tla tshwaela R560 bilione mo GDP ya rona ka 2025 mme bo tla tshegetsa ditiro di feta dimilione di le pedi.

src: Growing the Tourisms impact in the Oceans Economy is a critical pillar of the Nine-Point Plan, informed by the untapped potential of our oceans, which can contribute to economic growth.
tgt: Go godisa ditlamorago tsa Bojanala mo Ikonoming ya Mawatle ke ntlha ya botlhokwa mo Leanong la Dintlha tse Robongwe, mme seno se ikaegile ka bokgoni jo bo iseng bo dirisiwe jwa mawatle a rona, a a ka tshwaelang mo kgolong ya ikonomi.

src: The oceans economy and tourism provide tremendous opportunities for economic growth and job creation.
tgt: Ikonomi ya mawatle le bojanala di tlamela ka ditšhono tse di boitshegang tsa kgolo ya ikonomi le go tlhamiwa ga ditiro.

src: In commemoration of Workers’ Day on 1 May 2016, Cabinet reiterates the country’s commitment to protect worker rights through our progressive labour legislation.
tgt: Mo segopotsong sa Letsatsi la Badiri ka la bo 1 Motsheganong 2016, Kabinete e boeletsa maitlamo a naga go sireletsa ditshwanelo tsa badiri ka melao ya rona e e nang le tswelelopele.

src: Since 1994 government has through legislation such as the Labour Relations Act, the Basic Conditions of Employment Act, Employment Equity Act and Occupational Health and Safety advanced workers’ rights.
tgt: Fa e sa le ka 1994, puso e ntse e tsweletsa ditshwanelo tsa badiri ka melao e tshwana le Molao wa Dikamano tsa Bodiri, Molao wa Dipeelo tsa Motheo tsa go Thapa, Molao wa Tekatekano ya go Thapa mmogo le wa Boitekanelo le Pabalesego mo Tirong.

src: Cabinet urges Grade 12 learners to start downloading application forms or apply online to institutions of higher learning as part of the Apply Now/ Khetha Career Guidance Campaign.
tgt: Kabinete e ikuela mo barutwaneng ba Mophato wa 12 go simolola go laisolola diforomo tsa go dira kopo gongwe go dira dikopo mo inthaneteng kwa ditheong tsa thuto e kgolwane jaaka karolo ya Letsholo la Dira kopa jaanong/ Kheta Career Guidance.

src: The Campaign undertaken annually by the Department of Higher Education and Training, will run nationally until September 2016 and assists learners in making informed choices when applying to institutions of higher learning.
tgt: Letsholo leno la ngwaga le ngwaga la Lefapha la Thuto e Kgolwane le Katiso, le tla tswelela bosetšhaba go fitlha ka Lwetse 2016 mme le thusa barutwana go dira boitlhophelo ka kitso fa ba dira dikopo tsa kwa ditheong tsa thuto e kgolwane.

src: Learners are encouraged to contact the Career Development Services Centre through SMS or a “please call me” on 072 204 5056 or 086 999 0123, email EMAILTOKEN, on Facebook at WEBTOKEN or on Twitter at WEBTOKEN Cabinet’s position on key issues in the environment.
tgt: Barutwana ba rotloediwa go ikgolaganya le Tikwatikwe ya Ditirelo tsa Tlhabololo ya Ditiro (Career Development Services Centre) ka SMS gongwe “please call me” mo 072 204 5056 gongwe 086 999 0123, emeile EMAILTOKEN, mo Facebook kwa WEBTOKEN gongwe mo Twitter kwa WEBTOKEN Maemo a Kabinete mo Mererong e e Botlhokwa ya ga jaana.

src: Cabinet encourages relevant stakeholders to comment on the draft reviewed Broad-Based Black Economic Empowerment Charter for the South African Mining and Minerals Industry, 2016 which was published in the Government Gazette.
tgt: Kabinete e rotloetsa baamegi botlhe ba ba maleba go tshwaela mo lekwalotlhomong le le sekasekilweng la Tumelano ya Maatlafatso ya Ikonomi ya Bantsho e e Atolositsweng ya Indaseteri ya Aforika Borwa ya Meepo le Diminerale 2016 le le phasaladitsweng mo Kaseteng ya Puso.

src: The draft reviewed Mining Charter further integrates government’s transformation policies and legislation to enhance the ease of doing business, create regulatory clarity, predictability and certainty.
tgt: Lekwalotlhomo le le sekasekilweng la Tumelano ya Meepo gape le gokaganya dipholisi le melao ya puso ya diphetogo go tokafatsa tsela ya go dira kgwebo, go tlhalosa dintlha tsa taolo, diponelopele mmogo le tsepamo.

src: It is also aligned to the provisions of the Broad-Based Black Economic Empowerment Act, 2003 (Act No.
tgt: Gape le lepalepane le ditlamelo tsa Molao wa Maatlafatso ya Ikonomi ya Bantsho e e Atolositsweng, 2003 (Molao wa bo53 wa 2003) le Melawana ya Tiragatso e e Siameng (Code of Good Practice (Melawana ya DTI).

src: Cabinet notes that approval of the proposed acquisition of SAB Miller by AB InBev is under consideration by the competition authorities.
tgt: Kabinete e lemoga gore go amogelwa ga go tsewa go go tshitshintsweng ga SAB Miller ke AB InBev go sa ntse go sekwasekwa ke bothati jwa dikgaisano.

src: Cabinet welcomes the agreed approach by the Minister of Economic Development and AB InBev to the competition authorities on a range of public interest issues.
tgt: Kabinete e amogela tsamaiso e e dumelanweng ke Tona ya Tlhabololo ya Ikonomi le AB InBev le bothati jwa dikgaisano mo dintlheng tse di farologaneng tsa dikgatlhego tsa setšhaba.

src: The commitment by the company serves as a guide, on public interest issues, to other companies in merger and acquisitions in similar circumstances.
tgt: Maitlamo a setlamo a tla dira jaaka kaedi ya ditlamo tse dingwe tse di mo seemong sa go kopana le go tsaya tse dingwe mo mererong ya dikgatlhego tsa setšhaba.

src: This includes an agreed commitment by the company to spend R1 billion over the next five years to promote small-scale farming and local supplier development, new enterprises, energy and water efficiency technologies and youth development.
tgt: Seno se akaretsa maitlamo a setlamo se dumelaneng ka ona go dirisa R1 bilione mo dingwageng tse di tlang di le tlhano go tsweletsa bolemirui jo bo potlana le tlhabololo ya batlamedi ba selegae, dikgwebo tse dintšhwa, dithekenoloji tse di somarelang maatla le metsi mmogo le tlhabololo ya bašwa.

src: The commitment on jobs including an undertaking to avoid involuntarily retrenchment of workers as a result of the merger and to maintain employment levels at the company for the next five years, are part of a ground-breaking agreement between the company and government to support industrialisation, small business development and job creation.
tgt: Maitlamo a ditiro, go akarediwa maitlamo a go tila go fokotsa badiri ka ntlha ya go kopana ga ditlamo le go tshola badiri mo seemong sa ga jana mo setlamong mo dingwageng tse tlhano tse di latelang, ke karolo ya tumelano magareng ga setlamo le puso go tshegetsa go tlhabololwa ga indaseteri, dikgwebopotlana mmogo le go tlhamiwa ga ditiro.

src: In a separate development, Cabinet notes the coming into effect of provisions of the Competition Amendment Act that makes it a criminal offence for directors and management to collude in the fixing of prices, tenders or markets.
tgt: Mo ntlheng e nngwe e e kwa thoko, Kabinete e lemoga go diragadiwa ga ditlamelo tsa Molao o o Baakantsweng wa Dikgaisano tse di reng ke tlolomolao ya bosenyi gore bakaedi le botsamaisi ba dumelane go tsepamisa ditlhotlhwa, dithendara gongwe mebaraka.

src: These provisions are part of the measures to step up the fight against cartels that damage the economy and impose high prices on consumers.
tgt: Ditlamelo tseno ke karolo ya dikgato tsa go maatlafatsa ntwa kgatlhanong le digongwana tse di senyang ikonomi mme di bolaisa badirisi ditlhotlhwa tse di kwa WEBTOKEN ikuela mo dikgwebong tsa Aforika Borwa go gaisana go ikaegilwe ka ditlhotlhwa tse di kwa tlase, boitlhamedi, boleng jo bo tokafetseng jwa dithoto gongwe ditirelo tse di gaisang go badirisi go na le go dira seo ka go dumelana.

src: We call on businesses in South Africa to compete based on lower prices, more innovation, improved quality of goods offered or superior service to customers rather than on collusion.
tgt: Kabinete e lemogile ka moo lephata la dibanka le laolwang ka gona mo Aforika Borwa - le lefatshe ka bophara, le tlhokego ya gore Aforika Borwa a obamele seemo sa boditšhabatšhaba go tshwana le Basel III le melawana e e kgatlhanong le madi a a bonwang ka bonweenwee (Anti-money laundering regulations) ya Setheo sa Tiro sa Dikgato sa Ditšhelete (Financial Action Task Force (FATF)), tse di kileng tsa amogelwa ke Kabinete, mme di tshegediwa ke molao o o amogetsweng ke Puso.

src: Cabinet noted how highly regulated the banking sector is in South Africa - and globally, and the need for South Africa to comply with international standards like Basel III and Anti-money laundering regulations of the Financial Action Task Force (FATF), which have been previously approved by Cabinet, and supported by underlying legislation approved by Government.
tgt: Thulaganyo ya Twin Peaks e tla laola maitsholo a mebaraka mo lephateng la dibanka le ditšhelete.".

src: The Twin Peaks system will also regulate market conduct in the banking and broader financial sector.".
tgt: Kabinete e amogela ditlamorago tsa Kopano ya Dikgakologo ya Letlole la Boditšhabatšhaba la Ditšhelete le Ditlhopha tsa Dibanka tsa Lefatshe ya 2016 e e neng e tshwerwe ka moono wa "Dikgwetlho tsa Lefatshe, Ditharabololo tsa Lefatshe".

src: A three-pronged approach to ignite growth at a global level was proposed, encouraging countries to use all policy levers to spur growth, i. e. monetary, fiscal and structural reforms.
tgt: Go tshitshintswe tsela e e dintlha tse tharo go tlhosetsa kgolo mo legatong la lefatshe, go rotloetsa dinaga go dirisa dipholisi go tsweletsa kgolo, go tewa diphetogo mo go tsa ditšhelete le dipopegotheo.

src: Countries with monetary and fiscal space were encouraged to do more to boost demand however, implementation of structural reforms was critical for all.
tgt: Dinaga tse di nang le sebaka sa ditšhelete di rotloeditswe go dira go le gontsi go oketsa tlhokego fela, tiragatso ya diphetogo tsa dipopegotheo e nnile botlhokwa go botlhe.

src: For many this includes investment in infrastructure, innovation and improving the regulatory environment, amongst others.
tgt: Go bontsi, seno se akaretsa dipeeletso mo mafaratlhatlheng, boitlhamedi le go tokafatsa tikologo ya taolo, gareng ga tse dingwe.

src: Cabinet reminds all those eligible voters who have not yet registered and verified their details that they can still do so by visiting their local Independent Electoral Commission (IEC) Office.
tgt: Kabinete e gakolola botlhe ba ba nang le tshiamelo ya go nna batlhophi ba ba iseng ba ikwadise le go tlhomamisa dintlha tsa bona gore ba sa ntse ba ka dira jalo ka go etela Kantoro ya selegae ya Khomišene e e Ikemetseng ya Ditlhopho (IEC).

src: This is needed to secure your name on the voters’ roll which will enable eligible voters to exercise their democratic right on 3 August 2016.Cabinet urges eligible voters to ensure that they meet the requirement of providing their address to their local Independent Electoral Commission (IEC) office.
tgt: Seno se a tlhokega go netefatsa gore leina la gago le teng mo lenaneng la batlhophi le le tla kgontshang batlhophi ba ba nang le tshiamelo go diragatsa tshwanelo ya bona ya temokerasi ka la bo 3 Phatwe 2016.Kabinete e ikuela mo batlhophing botlhe ba ba nang le tshiamelo go netefatsa gore ba fitlhelela ditlhokego tsa go tlamela ka diaterese tsa bona kwa kantorong ya selegae ya Khomišene e e Ikemetseng ya Ditlhopho (IEC).

src: Election queries can be directed to the IEC contact centre on 0800 11 8000, which is open Monday to Friday, from 7am to 9pm.
tgt: Dipotsiso tsa ditlhopho di ka romelwa kwa tikwatikweng ya dikgolagano ya IEC kwa 0800 11 8000 e e bulwang Mantaga go fitlha Labotlhano, go tloka ka 7 mo mosong go fitlha 9 bosigo.

src: Cabinet congratulates Transnet, National Prosecuting Authority, SABC and the Departments of Higher Education and Training, International Relations and Cooperation, and Justice and Constitutional Development for being ranked “Most Attractive Employers” in South Africa by employer branding company, UNIVERSUCabinet commends Minister of Science and Technology, Naledi Pandor, who received an Order of Merit from the Federal Republic of Germany for her contribution to the development of science globally.
tgt: Kabinete e akgola Transet, Bothati jwa Bosetšhaba jwa Botšhotšhisi, SABC le Mafapha a Thuto e Kgolwane le Katiso, Dikamano le Tirisano tsa Boditšhabatšhaba le Bosiamisi le Tlhabololo ya Molaotheo jaaka di supilwe ele "Bathapi ba ba Ngokelang go Gaisa" mo Aforika Borwa ke setlamo sa matshwaokgwebo a bathapi, UNIVERSUKabinete e akgola Tona ya Saense le Thekenoloji, Naledi Pandor, yo o amogetseng Order of Merit go tswa kwa Rephaboliking ya Bofederale ya Jeremane ka ntlha ya tshwaelo ya gagwe mo tlhabololong ya saense mo lefatsheng.

src: The merit has been awarded to people from around the world for their achievements in political, social or intellectual spheres.
tgt: Sekgele se abetswe batho go tswa lefatsheng ka bophara ka ntlha ya diphitlhelelo tsa bona mo maphateng a sepolotiki, loago le botlhale.

src: Cabinet congratulates the Environmental Affairs Director-General Nosipho Ngcaba for receiving the 2015/16 Lifetime Achievement Eco-Logic Award from environment publication, The Enviropaedia.
tgt: Kabinete e akgola Mokaedikakaretso wa Merero ya Tikologo, Nosipho Ngcaba ka ntlha ya go amogela Sekgele sa 2015/16 Lifetime Achievement Eco-Logic go tswa kwa phasalatsong ya tsa tikologo, The Enviropaedia.

src: Cabinet applauds artist Kemang Wa Lehulere for becoming "Artist of the Year" for 2017 which is supported by Deutsche Bank.
tgt: Kabinete e akgola motsweretshi Kemang Wa Lehulere ka go nna "Motsweretshi wa Ngwaga" wa 2017 ka ketleetso ya Deutsche Bank.

src: Wa Lehulere, who explores the relevance of the artistic gesture in post-Apartheid South Africa, will present his first institutional solo exhibition in Germany at the Deutsche Bank KunstHalle in Berlin next year.
tgt: Wa Lehulere, yo o lebelelang bomaleba jwa botsweretshi mo go Aforika Borwa wa morago ga Tlhaolele, o tla tlhagisa pontsho ya gagwe ya ntlha ya motho a le mongwe kwa Jeremane kwa Deutsche Bank KunstHalle kwa Berlin mo ngwageng o o tlang.
