src: Cabinet approved the introduction to Parliament the ratification of the Amendment to the Montreal Protocol on Substances that Deplete the Ozone Layer to include hydrofluorocarbons (HFCs).
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse go tsenngwa tirisong kwa Palamenteng ga dipaakanyo tsa Diphetogo mo go Porotokholeng ya Montreal ka ga Diritibatsi tse di Fetsang Llaga ya Osoune tse di akaretsang hydrofluorocarbons (di-HFC).

src: The amendment seeks to phase down HFCs (the Kigali Agreement), which are some of the greenhouse gasses contributing to the depletion of the ozone layer.
tgt: Diphetogo tseno maitlhomo a tsona ke go fedisa di-HFC (Tumelano ya Kigali), e leng e e ka ga tse dingwe tsa dintlwana tsa tshomarelotlhago tseo ga jaanong le tsona di nang le seabe mo go fetseng Llaga ya Osoune.

src: South Africa is already a signatory to the Montreal Protocol.
tgt: Aforika Borwa jaanong e setse e le yona mosaeni wa Porotokholeng ya Montreal.

src: Cabinet also approved the introduction into Parliament the ratification of the Minamata Convention on Mercury.
tgt: Kabinete gape e amogetse go tsenngwatirisong kwa Palamenteng ga Dipaakanyo tsa Kopanokgothakgothe ya Minamata e e ka ga Mekhuri.

src: It provides opportunities for the protection of vulnerable groups, especially those staying in areas where there is mining activity, against the adverse consequences of mercury on the environment and human health.
tgt: E neelana ka ditšhono tsa go babalela batho ba ba leng mo tlalelong, bogolosegolo bao ba nnang kwa mafelong ao go nang le meepo mo go yona, ka go nna kgatlhanong le tiroso ya mekhuri mo tikologong le mo boitekanelong ja baatho.

src: Cabinet was briefed on the Report of the Commission of Inquiry into Higher Education and Training in the Republic of South Africa.
tgt: Kabinete e begetswe ka Pegelo ya Khomišene ya Dipatlisiso ka ga Thuto le Katiso tse di Kgolwane mo Rephaboliking ya Aforika Borwa.

src: The Presidential Fiscal Committee will sit soon to interrogate financial implications.
tgt: Komiti ya Matlole ya Moporesitente e tla kopana mo nakong e e sa fediseng pelo go atlhaatlha ditlamorago tsa matlole.

src: The Department of Higher Education and Training will have to review relevant policies and legislation, where necessary.
tgt: Lefapha la Thuto le Katiso tse di Kgolwane le tla tshwanelwa ke go sekaseka dipholisi le melao e e matshwanedi, fa go tlhokagala.

src: President Zuma will release the report to the public soon and the President’s spokesperson, Dr Bongani Ngqulunga, will make an announcement regarding this matter.
tgt: Moporesitente Zuma o tla rebolela setšhaba pegelo eo mo nakong e e sa fediseng pelo mme se sebueledi sa Kantoro ya Moporesitente, Ngaka Bongani Ngqulunga, o tla dira tsiboso mabapi le ntlha eno.

src: Cabinet approved the National Minimum Wage Bill effecting the minimum wage to the lowest paid workers in the South African Labour Market.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse Molaotlhomo wa Mogolo o o kwa Tlase wa Bosetšhaba o o dirang gore go nne le mogolo o o kwa tlase o o amogelesegang go ka duelwa modiredi yo a amogelang letseno le le kwa tlase mo Marakeng wa Badiri wa Aforika Borwa.

src: The Bill calls for every worker to be paid a wage that is no less than the national minimum wage.
tgt: Molaotlhomo o no o laela gore modiredi yo mongwe le yo mongwe yo a sa goleng mogolo o montsi a seke a duelelwa madi a a ka fa tlase ga o o tlhalositsweng ka fa moogolong o o kwa tlase wa bosetšhaba.

src: Once this Bill takes effect employers will be expected to pay their workers no less than the national minimum, which is to be adjusted annually.
tgt: Gang fa Molaotlhomo ono o sena go simololwa go diragadiwa, go tla solofelwa gore bathapi ba se duelele badiredi ba bona madi a a ka fa tlase ga ao a beilweng a naga, e leng ao a tla namelelang ngwaga yo mongwe le yo mongwe.

src: Cabinet also approved the submission to Parliament of the Basic Conditions of Employment Amendment Bill of 2017.
tgt: Kabinete gape e amogetse go tlisiwa kwa Palamenteng ga Diphetogo tsa Molaotlhomo wa Maemo a Motheo a Mafelotiro, 1997 (Molao wa bo 75 wa 1997) go netefatsa gore o tshegetsa Molaotlhomo wa Mogolo o o kwa Tlase wa Bosetšhaba.

src: This amends the Basic Conditions of Employment Act, 1997 (Act 75 of 1997) to ensure it provides for the Minimum Wage Bill.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse go tlisiwa kwa Palamenteng ga Diphetogo tsa Molaotlhomo wa Dikamano tsa Merero ya Badiri wa 2017.

src: The Bill is a culmination of consultation with all the relevant stakeholders.
tgt: Molaotlhomo ono ke dipoelo tsa go buisana le bannaleseabe botlhe ba ba maleba.

src: It addresses, amongst others, picketing procedures, the protracted strikes and arbitration advisory structures.
tgt: Gareng ga tse dingwe o samagana le dikgato tse di tshwanetsweng go latelwa go dira ditshupetso, megwanto gogang lobaka lo lo leele mmogo le ditheo tsa dikeletso tsa botsereganyi.

src: Cabinet approved the submission to Parliament of the Local Government: Municipal Structures Amendment Bill of 2017.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse go tlisiwa kwa Palamenteng ga Pusoselegae: Diphetogo tsa Molaotlhomo wa Ditheo tsa Masepala wa 2017.

src: This amends the Local Government: Municipal Structures Act, 1998 (Act 117 of 1998).The Bill seeks to strengthen intergovernmental and democratic governance arrangements.
tgt: Ona o fetola Pusoselegae: Molao wa Ditheo tsa Masepala, (Molao wa bo 117 wa 1998).Molaotlhomo ono o ikaelela go matlafatsa dithulaganyo tsa tsamaiso ya ka fa gare ga puso le tsa puso ya temokerasi.

src: It also seeks to address issues around the administration and management of municipal elections, and to promote the effective and efficient implementation of the Act, as well as to strengthen oversight and governance in municipalities.
tgt: Gape maitlhomo a ona ke go rarabolola merero e e ka ga tsamaiso ya puso le bolaodi jwa ditlhopho tsa masepala, mmogo le go rotloetsa mosola le tolamo ya go tsenya molao tirisong, mmogo le go matlafatsa botlhokomedi jwa tsamaiso mo pusong le mo dimasepaleng.

src: Cabinet approved for the submission to Parliament of the Electronic Deeds Registration Systems Bill of 2017.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse go tlisiwa kwa Palamenteng ga Molaotlhomo wa Thulaganyo ya Ikwadisetso ya Makwalobopaki jwa Madulo a Ileketeroniki wa 2017.

src: The Bill has already gone through public WEBTOKEN allows for the development of an electronic deeds registration system (e-DRS), for the processing of deeds, to effect the registration of large volumes of deeds as necessitated by Governments’ land reform initiatives.
tgt: O letla gore go tlhomiwe thulaganyo ya ikwadisetso ya makwalobopaki jwa madulo a ileketeroniki (e-DRS), gore go diriwe makwalobopaki jwa madulo, go kgontsha gore go kgonwe go kwadisa makwalobopaki jwa madulo a mantsi jaaka go tlhokagala go ya ka matsholo a pusetso ya dinaga.

src: As part of promoting the use of ICTs to build an inclusive economy, Cabinet approved the iKamva National e-Skills Institute Bill of 2017 (iNeSI Bill) to be gazetted for public consultation and comment.
tgt: Jaaka karolo ya go rotloetsa tiriso ya di-ICT ya go tlhoma ikonomi e e akaretsang botlhe, Kabinete e amogetse Molaotlhomo wa Setheo sa Naga sa Bokgoni jwa tsa Ileketeroniki wa iKamvao wa 2017 (Molaotlhomo wa iNeSI) gore o phasaladiwe mo Kaseteng ya Puso gore baagi ba dire ditshwaelo ka one.

src: The iNeSI Bill provides for the establishment of iNeSI as a public entity with its own enabling legislation, to address the e-skills shortage that hinders investment, socio-economic development and capacity development in the country.
tgt: Molaotlhomo wa iNeSI o letlelela gore go tlhomiwe iNeSI jaaka setheo sa puso ka melao ya sona, go samagana le tlhaelo ya bokgoni jwa tsa ileketeroniki e e kgoreletsang dipeeletso, tlhabololo ya ikonomi ya loago mmogo le tlhabololo ya bokgoni mo nageng.

src: This will establish ICT production hubs in each province, which will then assist iNeSI to develop and design relevant programs and training material, promote and undertake innovative research, and provide research capacity to postgraduate students.
tgt: Seno se tla tlhoma mafelotlhagiso a didirisiwa tsa ICT mo porofenseng e nngwe le e nngwe, a a tla thusanang le iNeSI go tlhoma le go betla manaane le didirisiwa tsa katiso tse di maleba, go rotloetsa le go samagana le dipatlisiso tsa boitlhamedi, mmogo le go tlamela ka bokgoni jwa dipatlisiso mo baithuting ba dithuto tsa morago ga go konosetsa dithuto tsa ntlha tse dikgolwane.

src: Cabinet approved the publication of the Postal Services Amendment Bill in the Government Gazette for public comment.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse gore go phasaladiwe mo Kaseteng ya Puso Molaotlhomo wa Diphetolo tsa Ditireloposo gore baagi ba dire ditshwaelo ka one.

src: 124 of 1998.The Bill provides for the restructuring of the postal sector in general to contribute to the provisions of universal access to innovative e-services while continuing to provide quality and secure traditional postal services.
tgt: Seno se tla fetola Diphetolo tsa Molao wa Ditireloposo wa bo 124 wa 1998.Molaotlhomo ono o letlelela gore lekala la poso lotlhe le ka rutlomololwa mme la rulaganngwa sešwa gore go nne le seabe mo phitlhelelong ya botlhe mo ditirelong tsa eleketeroniki tsa boithamedi fa mo letlhakoreng le lengwe le tswelela go tlamela ka ditireloposo tse di tlwaelegileng tse di boleng e bile di babalesegile.

src: This contributes to equality and human dignity through access to information and affordable postal services, which facilitate social development and improve the quality of life for individuals and communities.
tgt: Seno se a thusa mo go nneng le boleng le seriti ka go fitlhelela tshedimosetso le ditireloposo tse di duelesegang, e leng se se samaganeng le tsa tlhabololo ya loago le go tokafatsa boleng jwa botshelo jwa motho ka nosi le jwa baagi.

src: Upcoming eventsCabinet also acknowledged some of the upcoming events in the government calendar.
tgt: Ditiragalo tse di TlangKabinete gape e amogetse tse dingwe tsa ditiragalo tse di tlang tse di leng mo Khalentarenng.

src: President Zuma is scheduled to visit the Steve Biko Academic Hospital in Tshwane on Friday, 3 November 2017 to monitor the delivery of healthcare services as part of the Presidential Siyahlola Monitoring Programme.
tgt: Moporesitente Zuma o tla etela Sepetlele sa Baithuti sa Steve Biko kwa Tshwane ka la Botlhano, ka la bo 3 Ngwanaitseele Steve Biko go tlhokomela ka fao kabotirelo ya boitekanelo e diragadiwang ka yona, jaaka e le karolo ya Lenaale la Ditlhatlhobo tsa Moporesitente la Siyahlola.

src: The hospital is one of the best performing public hospitals in the country and is named after Steve Bantu Biko, the late liberation struggle hero and former medical student at the then University of Natal (now called University of KwaZulu-Natal).President Zuma’s visit is part of the ongoing government monitoring programme that aims to address challenges facing public hospitals and to improve the healthcare system in the country, which is one of government’s key priorities.
tgt: Sepetlele seno ke se sengwe sa dipetlele tse di dirang bontle mo nageng e bile se reetswe ka Steve Bantu Biko, mogale wa molwelakgaratlho wa mo malobeng e bile e ne e le moithuti mo dithutong tsa bongaka kwa Yunibesiting mo malobeng ya Natal (eo jaanong e bediwang University of KwaZulu-Natal).Leeto leno la Moporesitente Zuma ke karolo ya lenaane le le tsweletseng la puso la tshekatsheko le maitlhomo e leng go samagana le dikgwetlho tse di tobaneng le dipetlele tsa puso le go tlhabolola thulaganyo ya tlhokomelo ya boitekanelo mo nageng, e leng e nngwe ya ditlapele tsa puso tse di botlhokwa thata.

src: National Disability Rights Awareness Month.
tgt: Kgwedi ya Bosetšhaba ya Ditemoso tsa Ditshwanelo tsa Batho ba ba nang le Bogole.

src: Cabinet calls on all South Africans to support National Disability Rights Awareness Month between 3 November and 3 December 2017, which also coincides with the International Day of Persons with Disabilities.
tgt: Kabinete e ikuela mo go maAforika Borwa otlhe go tshegetsa Kgwedi ya Temoso ya Naga ka Ditshwanelo tsa Batho ba ba Tshelang ka Bogolofadi magareng ga la bo 3 Ngwanaitseele le la bo 3 Sedimonthole 2017, eo gape e ketekiwang ka nako e le nngwe le Letsatsa la Boditšhabatšhaba la Batho ba ba Tshelang ka Bogolofadi.

src: South Africans are encouraged to raise awareness and protect the rights of people with disabilities, while recognising the gains that have been made to address challenges faced by people with disabilities.
tgt: MaAforika Borwa a rotloediwa go dira ditemoso le go sireletsa batho ba ba tshelang ka bogolofadi, fa mo letlhakoreng le lengwe go bontshwa tseo di fitlheletsweng go samagana le dikgwetlho tseo batho ba ba tshelang ka bogolofadi ba neng ba tobana le tsona.

src: National Local Economic Development Conference.
tgt: Khonferense ya Naga ya Tlhabololo ya Ikonomi ya Selegae.

src: The Department of Cooperative Governance and Traditional Affairs and Department of Small Business Development will convene the first National Local Economic Development Conference on 9 and 10 November 2017 in Gauteng.
tgt: Lefapha la Pusotshwaraganelo le Merero ya Setso (CoGTA) mmogo le Lefapha la Tlhabololo ya Dikgwebopotlana a tla tshwara kopano ya ntlha ya Khonferense ya Naga ya Tlhabololo ya Ikonomi ya Selegae ka la bo 9 le la bo 10 Ngwanaitseele 2017 kwa Gauteng.

src: The conference is a strategic platform for dialogue between public and private sector on topical and critical issues relating to stimulating local economies by creating an enabling environment to achieve inclusive economic development.
tgt: Khonferense eno ke serala sa togamaano ya dipuisano magareng ga lekala la puso le la poraefete ka ga merero e e kwa setlhoeng le e e botlhokwa thata e e amanang le go thuthusa diikonomi tsa loago ka go tlhola tikologo e e kgontshang seo gore go fitlhelelwe tlhabololo ya ikonomi e e akaretsang botlhe.

src: Messages.
tgt: Melaetsa.

src: Cabinet welcomes the announcement of over one billion US dollar to be invested over several months in the South African Economy in technology, education and agribusiness.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse tsiboso ya gore didolara tsa Amerika di feta bilione di tla beelediwa mo tsamaong ya dikgwedi di le mmalwa mo ikonoming ya Aforika Borwa ya thekenolojing, thuto le kgwebisano ya temothuo.

src: This was announced by Ambassador Harold Doley, Jr, the Governor of the African Development Bank.
tgt: Seno se rebotswe ke moAmbasatara Harold Doley, Jr, yo e leng Mmusisi wa Bankatlhabololo ya Aforika.

src: Cabinet congratulates Dr Nono Simelela on her appointment as World Health Organisation (WHO) Assistant Director-General.
tgt: Kabinete e akgotsa Ngaka Nono Simelela ka go thapiwa ga gagwe jaaka Mothusi wa Mokaedikakaretso wa Mokgatlhong wa Boitekanelo jwa Lefatshe (WHO).

src: Dr Simelela will head the WHO Family, Women, Children and Adolescents Division from 13 November 2017.
tgt: Ngaka Simelela o tla etelela pele Kgaolo ya Merero ya ba Lelapa, Basadi, Bana le ba Bosima mo setheong sa WHO go simolola ka la bo 13 Ngwanaitseele 2017.

src: She is the first African woman to become a gynaecologist in South Africa.
tgt: Ke mosadi wa ntlha wa moAforika yo a nnileng ngaka ya tsa sesadi mo Aforika Borwa.

src: Cabinet welcomes the announcement by World Rugby that has recommended South Africa as the preferred country to host the 2023 Rugby World Cup tournament.
tgt: Kabinete a amogetse tsiboso ya Mokgatlho wa Lefatshe wa Rakabii ya go tshitshinya gore metshameko ya dikgaisano tsa Sejana sa Lefatshe tsa Rakabi ka 2023 e tshwarelwe kwa Aforika Borwa.

src: Cabinet also commends the work of the Minister of Sport and Recreation, Mr Thulas Nxesi, Deputy President Ramaphosa and the South African Rugby Union bid team.
tgt: Kabinete gape e akgotse tiro e e dirilweng ke Tona ya Lefapha la Metshameko le Boitapoloso, Rre Thulas Nxesi, Motlatsamoporesitente Ramaphosa mmogo le setlhopha sa go tsenela dikgaisano sa Mokgatlhotshwaraganelo wa Rakabii ya Aforika Borwa.

src: World Rugby will announce the final decision on 15 November 2017.
tgt: Mokgatlho wa Lefatshe wa Rakabii o tla rebola tshweetso ya yona ya bofelo ka seno ka la bo 15 Ngwanaitseele 2017.

src: Cabinet congratulates all participants and winners of the 15th Annual Public Sector Innovation Awards.
tgt: Kabinete e akgola bao ba tsereng karolo mmogo le bafenyi botlhe ba Dikabo tsa bo 15 tsa Boitshimololedi tsa Lekala la Puso.

src: These awards recognise successful and effective service-delivery initiatives that have been achieved through the application of innovative approaches, methodologies and tools.
tgt: Dikabo tseno di akgola matsholo a a mosola a a atlegileng a kabotirelo ao a diragaditsweng ka go tsaya dikgato tsa boitshimololedi, tsa mekgwatiro le tsa go dirisa didirisiwa.

src: Cabinet congratulates SuperSport United FC for reaching the finals of the CAF Confederation Cup after beating Tunisian side Club Africa 3-1 and 4-2 on aggregate.
tgt: Kabinete e akgola setlhopha sa SuperSport United FC gore se bo se fitlheletse kwa makgaolakganyeng a Sejana sa CAF morago ga go šašara Tunisian side Club 3-1 le 4-2 ka go kopanya dino tsotlhe.

src: The team generally known as Matsatsantsa will meet TP Mazembe in the second-tier continental club competition final next month.
tgt: Setlhopha seno se se itsegeng thata ka gore ke Matsatsantsa se tla thulana le TP Mazembe mo karolong ya bobedi ya dikgaisano tsa metshameko ya kontinente ya bofelo mo kgweding e e tlang.

src: Cabinet expressed its condolences to the family and friends of Ian McLeod, whose passing was a loss to South African football.
tgt: Kabinete e rometse matshediso a yona kwa go ba lelapa le ditsala tsa ga Ian McLeod, yo go latlhegelwa ke botshelo jwa gagwe e nnileng tatlhegelo e kgolo mo kgweleng ya dinao mo nageng ya Aforika Borwa.

src: He became the first South African to referee at a FIFA World Cup tournament, when he officiated in the 1998 global showpiece in France.
tgt: E nnile moletsaphala wa moAforika Borwa wa ntlha go ka dira kwa kgaisanong ya metshameko ya Sejana sa Lefatshe sa FIFA, fa a ne a laola motshameko wa lefatshe wa 1998 kwa Fora.

src: AppointmentsAll appointments are subject to the verification of qualifications and the relevant clearance.
tgt: Go thapiwaGo thapiwa gotlhe go tla diragadiwa fa makwalothuto otlhe a netefaditswe mme go amogetswe tetlelelo e e matshwanedi.

src: Directors to the Board of the Export Credit Insurance Corporation of South Africa SOC Limited:a. Ms Lerato Herriette Mothae andb.
tgt: Bakaedi ba Boto ya Koporasi ya Aforika Borwa ya Inšorense ya Dikoloto tsa Diromelwantle ya SOC Limited.

src: Full-time members to the National Consumer Tribunal:a. Ms Hazel Viloshni Devraj andb.
tgt: Ditokololo tsa leruri tsa Bothati jwa Naga jwa Bareki:a. Mme Hazel Viloshni Devraj leb.

src: Adv John Rinton Simpson.
tgt: Moatefokate John Rinton Simpson.

src: Reappointment of two part-time members of the Competition Tribunal:a. ProfImraan Valodia andb.
tgt: Go thapiwa sešwa ga ditokololo di le pedi tsa nakwana tsa Bothati jwa Dikgaisano:a. Moporofesara Imraan Valodia leb.

src: Mr Anton Roskan.
tgt: Rre Anton Roskan.

src: Board of the Human Sciences Research Council:a. ProfMvuyo Tom – (Chairperson)b. ProfLindiwe Zunguc.
tgt: Boto ya Lekgotla la Dipatlisiso tsa Saense le Batho:a. Moporofesara Mvuyo Tom – (Monnasetulo)b. Moporofesara Lindiwe Zunguc.

src: ProfHaroon Bhoratf.
tgt: Moporofesara Haroon Bhoratf.

src: ProfShireen Hassimg.
tgt: Moporofesara Shireen Hassimg.

src: Cabinet met on Wednesday, 15 November 2017 at Tuynhuys, Cape Town.
tgt: Kabinete e ne e tshwere kopano ya yona ka Laboraro, la bo 15 Ngwanaitseele 2017, kwa Tuynhuys, Motsekapa.

src: Cabinet welcomes Ford Motor Company’s R3-billion investment into the Silverton Plant, Pretoria, Gauteng.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse peeletso ya R3 bilione e e dirilweng ke Setlamo sa Ford Motor mo Polanteng ya kwa Silverton, Pretoria, Gauteng.

src: This investment will result in the creation of direct and indirect jobs due to the expected increased production of its Ford Ranger model.
tgt: Peeletso eno e tla tlhola ditiro tse di maleba le tse di seng maleba go lebilwe tlhagiso e e tla oketsegang ya sejanaga sa yona sa mobetlo wa Ford Ranger.

src: Such investments affirm the work that we continue to do as government in growing the economy and addressing the challenges of unemployment.
tgt: Dipeeletso tsa mothale o di bontsha tiro eo re tsweletseng go samagana nayo jaaka puso mo go godiseng ikonomi le go samagana le dikgwetlho tsa botlhokatiro.

src: Through government’s R.8 billion incentive scheme in Automotive Production and Development Programme, R.5 billion private investments have been unlocked.
tgt: Ka sekema sa puso mo Lenaaneng la Tlhagiso le Tlhabololo ya Dijanaga sa bokanaka R.8 bilione,go buletswe dipeeletso tsa ditlamo tsa poraefete tsa bokanaka R.5 bilione.

src: These include the announcement by Toyota to manufacture their new Toyota Hilux and Fortuner models as part of R.1billion investment.
tgt: Tseno di akaretsa ditsiboso tse di dirilweng ke Toyota tsa maikaelelo a yona a go tlhagisa dijanaga tsa yona tsa mebetlo ya Toyota Hilux le Fortuner.

src: 2017 Tax Season.
tgt: Paka ya Lekgetho ya 2017.

src: Cabinet extends its gratitude to all taxpayers who have already submitted their tax returns for the 2016/17 tax year.
tgt: Kabinete e leboga baduelalekgetho botlhe bao ba setseng ba dirile dipusetso tsa lekgetho tsa ngwaga wa lekgetho wa 2016/17.

src: The revenue generated from income tax ensures government has the capacity to provide much-needed services and social support to millions of less fortunate South Africans.
tgt: Madikokoanyo ao a kokoangwang go tswa mo lekgethong la megolo a kgontsha puso go nna le bokgoni jwa go tlamela ka ditirelo tse di tlhokagalang thata mmogo le go tshegetsa maAforika Borwa a a dikobo dikhutshwane.

src: Cabinet reminds taxpayers that the deadline for submission is Friday 24 November 2017 and encourages them to submit their tax returns.
tgt: Kabinete e gopotsa baduelalekgetho gore letlha la bofelo la go dira dipusetso tsa lekgetho ke Labotlhano la bo 24 Ngwanaitseele 2017 mme e ba rotloetsa go di tlisa go sa le gale.

src: Inaugural National Local Economic Development (LED) Conference.
tgt: Kamogelo ya Khonferense ya Naga ya Tlhabololo ya Ikonomi ya Selegae (LED).

src: Cabinet is pleased with the outcomes of the recently held National LED Conference.
tgt: Kabinete e itumedisitswe ke dipoelo tsa Khonferense ya Bosetšhaba ya LED e e neng e tshwerwe mo malobeng.

src: It was held under the leadership of the Minister of Cooperative Governance and Traditional Affairs, Mr Des van Rooyen and the Minister of Small Business Development, Ms Lindiwe Zulu.
tgt: E ne e tshwerwe go latela boeteledipele jwa Tona ya Lefapha la Pusotshwaraganelo le Merero ya Setso (COGTA), Rre Des van Rooyen mmogo le Tona ya Lefapha la Tlhabololo ya Dikgwebopotlana, Mme Lindiwe Zulu.

src: It presented an opportunity to craft a new South African Local Economic Development agenda guided by the National Development Plan (NDP) priorities.
tgt: E abelane ka tšhono ya go tlhagisa mogopolo o montšhwa wa LED ya Aforika Borwa o o supetswang tsela ke ditlapele tsa Leano la Tlhabololo la Bosetšhaba (NDP).

src: Its outcomes included the launch of the first Economic Development Council of South Africa (EDCSA), which aims to professionalise the economic development sector.
tgt: Dipoelo tsa yona di akaretsa le go thankgololwa ga Lekgotla la Aforika Borwa le le Mabapi le Tlhabololo ya Ikonomi (EDCSA), leo maitlhomo a lona e leng go dira lekala la tlhabololo ya ikonomi gore e nne la seporofešenale.

src: As a professional body, the EDCSA will manage and monitor the professional conduct of the many practitioners who participate in the different development initiatives.
tgt: Jaaka mokgatlho wa seporofešenale, EDCSA e tla laola le go lekola maitshwaro a seporofešenale a badiredi ba le bantsi bao ba tsayang karolo mo matsholong a a farologaneng a a ka ga tlhabololo.

src: Cabinet noted also the historic launch of the Global Entrepreneurship Week (GEW) at 22 on Sloane, a new start-up campus, on the 10th of November 2017, in which the Minister of Small Business Development, Ms Lindiwe Zulu, hosted World entrepreneurship luminary, Sir Richard Branson.
tgt: Kabinete gape e etse tlhoko thankgololo ya hisetori ya Beke ya Lefatshe ya Baitshimololedikgwebo (GEW) kwa 22 e e kwa Sloane, eo e leng khamphase e ntšhwa ya boitshimololedi, ka la bo 10 Ngwanaitseele 2017, mo Tona Zulu a neng a amogetse moitseanape wa lefatshe wa boitshimololedikgwebo, Rre Richard Branson.

src: The campus is the first one opened by the Global Entrepreneurship Network – offering direct and virtual support services to entrepreneurs throughout Africa as well as access to an international network of mentors, investors and entrepreneurial support organisations.
tgt: Khamphase eno ke yone ya ntlha go bulwa ke GEE tlamela ka ditirelo tsa tshegetso tse di molemo mo go baitshimololedikgwebo go ralala le Aforika mmogo le phitlhelelo ya lethathama la batlhatlheledi ba boditšhabatšhaba, babeeletsi mmogo le mekgatlho ya tshegetso ya boitshimololedikgwebo.

src: During Global Entrepreneurship Week, roughly 10 million participants take part in 35,000 events, activities and competitions in more than 165 countries around the world.
tgt: Mo nakong ya GEW, batsayakarolo ba ka nna 10 milione ba tsaya karolo mo meketeng, ditiragalong le dikgaisanong di ka nna 35 000 mo dinageng di feta 165 go ralala le lefatshe.

src: Heher Commission Report.1 Cabinet noted the release on Monday, 13 November 2017 of the Report of the Commission of Inquiry into the Feasibility of making High Education and Training Fee-free in South Africa.
tgt: Kabinete e nopotse go rebolwa ka Mosupologo, la bo 13 Ngwanaitseele 2017 ga Pegelo ya Khomišene e e mabapi le Dipatlisiso tse di mabapi le Kgonagalo ya go Dira gore Thuto le Katiso tse Dikgolwane di se duelelwe mo nageng ya Aforika Borwa.

src: Cabinet calls on all South Africans to study the report and its implications for the country while the recommendations are being considered by government.2 The President will make a pronouncement on the report in due course after processing by the Inter-Ministerial Committee on Higher Education Funding and the Presidential Fiscal Committee.
tgt: Kabinete e ikuela mo go maAforika Borwa otlhe go buisa pegelo eno mmogo le ditlamorago tsa yona mo nageng fa puso yona e santse e tsweletse go sekasekana le ditshtshinyo tsa yona.

src: Government remains determined to resolve the barriers to access higher education, and looks forward to concluding a sustainable solution for higher education funding.
tgt: Moporesitente o tla neelana ka tsiboso mabapi le pegelo eno mo tsamaong ya nako go latela gore e sekasekiwe ke Komiti ya Ditona tsa ka fa Nageng ya Tlamelo ka Matlole a Thuto e Kgolwane mmogo le Komiti ya tsa Matlole ya Moporesitente.

src: The current dam levels in the country remain a concern as there is more evaporation than rainfall.
tgt: Maemo a metsi a ga jaanong kwa matamong a a tlhobaetsa ka ntlha ya fa go sena pula mme metsi a a mowafala.

src: The fact that South Africa has not received sufficient rainfall to recharge our water sources to adequate levels means that the country is not yet out of the drought situation.
tgt: Ka ntlha ya fa Aforika Borwa e ntse e sa nelwe ke pula go le kalo go ka oketsa metsi a a leng mo metsweding ya rona ya metsi go raya gore naga e santse e le mo maemong a kakafalo.

src: Forecasts predict that the country will only receive its major rainfall from the beginning of January 2018.
tgt: Ponelopele ya maemo a bosa e tlhalosa gore naga e tla nelwa ke dipula tse dintsi mo tshimologong ya Ferikgong 2018.

src: Cabinet wishes to assure the public that national, provincial and local government are cooperating and working together to ensure South Africa does not run out of water.
tgt: Kabinete e batla go netefaletsa baagi gore puso ya naga, ya porofense le ya selegae e dirisana mmogo go netefatsa gore Aforika Borwa ga e kgale metsi.

src: Cabinet encourages everyone to play their part in saving and using water wisely and sparingly.
tgt: Kabinete e rotloetsa batho botlhe go nna le karolo mo go somareleng le mo go a diriseng ka go se a senye metsi.

src: Zimbabwe.1 Cabinet supports the intervention by President Jacob Zuma, in his capacity as Chair of SADC in response to the Zimbabwean situation.
tgt: Kabinete e tshegetsa kgato ya tsereganyo e e tserweng ke Moporesitente Jacob Zuma, mo maemong a gagwe jaaka Monnasetulo wa Dinaga tsa Mokgatlho wa Tlhabololo ya Borwa jwa Aforika (SADC) mo go tsibogeleng seemo sa kwa Zimbabwe.

src: He has sent Special Envoys, Minister of Defence and Military Veterans Ms Nosiviwe Mapisa-Nqakula and State Security Minister, Adv Bongani Bongo.
tgt: O rometse Baromiwa ba Sesole ba ba Itlhophileng, Tona ya Sesole sa Tshireletso ya Naga le Bagale ba Sesole, Mme Nosiviwe Mapisa-Nqakula mmogo le Tona ya Pabalesego ya Puso ya Naga, Moatefokate Bongani Bongo.

src: They are to meet with President Robert Mugabe and the Zimbabwean Defence Force.
tgt: Ba tla kopana le Moporesitente Robert Mugabe mmogo le Sesole sa Tshireletso ya Naga ya Zimbabwe.

src: Thereafter proceed to brief President João Lourenço as the Chairperson of the SADC Organ on Politics, Defence and Security.
tgt: Ka jalo, ba tla tsibosa Moporesitente wa Angola João Lourenço mo maemong a gagwe jaaka Monnasetulo wa SADC mo Lekaleng la Sepolotiki, Sesole le Pabalesego.

src: Further updates on this matter will be communicated by the Presidency.
tgt: Kantoro ya Moporesitente e tla abelana ka tshedimosetso e nngwe mo ntlheng eno fa nako e ntse e tsamaya.

src: Square Kilometre Array (SKA).
tgt: Arei ya Sekwere kilometara (SKA).

src: Cabinet welcomes the economic and social development achievements derived from the focused investment in social development in the region of the SKA South Africa.
tgt: Kabinete e amogela diphitlhelelo tsa ikonomi le loago tse di tswang mo peeletsong e go tsepamisiwtsweng mogopolo mo go yona mo tlhabololong ya loago mo kgaolong ya SKA ya Aforika Borwa.

src: Communities neighbouring the SKA area continue to benefit through better education and training projects, investment in small businesses and increased job opportunities.
tgt: Metse e e gaufi le lefelo la SKA e tswelela go unngwelwa go tswa mo diporojekeng tsa thuto le katiso, peeletso mo dikgwebopotlaneng le koketsego ya ditšhono tsa ditiro.

src: The Department of Science and Technology, under the leadership of the Minister of Science and Technology, Ms Naledi Pandor, will hold a public-participation programme to celebrate achievements with the communities around Carnarvon, Northern Cape from 16 to 19 November 2017.Cabinet decisions.
tgt: Lefapha la Saense le Thekenoloji, ka fa tlase ga boeteledipele jwa Tona ya lona, Mme Naledi Pandor, le tla tshwara lenaane la go tsaya karolo ga setšhaba go keteka diphitlhelelo le baagi ba tikologo ya Carnarvon, Kapa Bokone go simolola ka la bo 16 go fitlha ka la bo 19 Ngwanaitseele 2017.Ditshwetso tsa Kabinete.

src: Second performance quarterly progress reports for 2017/1.
tgt: Pegelo ya kgweditharo ya bobedi ya tiragatso ya tiro 2017/1.

src: Cabinet was apprised on the second performance quarterly progress reports for 2017/18 (July to September 2017) by all the five clusters.
tgt: Kabinete e akgotswe ka dipegelo tsa kgweditharo ya bobedi ya tiragatso ya tiro tsa 2017/18 (Phukwi go fitlha go Lwetse 2017) tsa makala otlhe a le matlhano.

src: This forms part of Cabinet’s broad monitoring and evaluation of the Programme of Action derived from the Medium Term Strategic Framework (MTSF) 2014 to 2019.
tgt: Seno ke karolo ya Lenaanetiro le legolo la Kabinete le le ka ga tekolo le tshekatsheko go tswa mo Letlhomeso la Togamaano ya Pakagare (MTSF) la 2014 go fitlha go 2019.

src: The Department of Planning, Monitoring and Evaluation and the Ministerial Cluster Committees will conduct media briefings to unpack the progress of these reports.
tgt: Lefapha la Tiromaano,Tekolo le Tshekatsheko ya Tiro mmogo le Komiti ya Ditona tsa Makala ba tla tshwara ditsiboso tsa bobegakgang go ka tlharolola kgatelopele e e dirilweng go ya ka dipegelo tseno.

src: The GCIS will coordinate the media briefings and publish the schedule on WEBTOKEN in due course.
tgt: Mo tsamaong ya nako GCIS e tla rulaganya ditsiboso tseno tsa bobegakgang le go phasalatsa lenaneothulaganyo la tsone mo go WEBTOKEDitsibosopeonakong ka ga letsholo la go tsenya diaterese le go neelana ka diaterese.

src: Update on address harvesting initiative and assignment of addresses.
tgt: Kabinete e tsopoletswe ka ga pegelo ya kgatelopele mo go tsenyeng tirisong Katlholo ya Kgotlatshekelo ya Molaotheo ya go tsenya diaterese mo lenaaneng la batlhophi.

src: Cabinet was briefed on the progress report on the implementation of the Constitutional Court Judgement to assign addresses to the voters roll.
tgt: Kabinete e leboga kobamelo ka botlalo ya pegelo ya kgatelopele ya dikgwedi di le thataro e e rometsweng kwa Kgotlatshekelo ya Molaotheo.

src: Cabinet appreciated the full compliance with the six monthly progress reports submitted to the Constitutional Court.
tgt: Go fitlha ga jaanong khomišene ya Ditlhopho e e Ikemetseng (IEC), ka go dirisana mmogo le ditheo tse dingwe tsa puso, e fitlheletse katlego e e kanaka 75% mo go bokeletseng diaterese tsa batho bao ba batlang go ka tsenela ditlhopho.

src: To date the Independent Electoral Commission (IEC), working with other state agencies has attained almost 75% success in collecting the addresses of potential voters.
tgt: Kabinete gape e ne ya nopolelwa ka ga lenaane le le rulagantsweng ke ba Ditireloposo tsa Aforika Borwa (SAPO) go ka thusa bao ba senang diaterese mo metseng ya bona.

src: Cabinet was also briefed on the planned programme by the SAPO to assist those who do not have physical addresses.
tgt: Kabinete e itumeletse kgatelopele e e setseng e dirilwe go fitlha ga jaana mmogo le tirisanommogo magareng ga SAPO, IEC le ditheo tse dingwe tsa puso mo tirong eno ya porojekeng ya diaterese.

src: Cabinet further calls on those who have not updated their addresses to do so during the next voter registration week in March 2018.Upcoming events.
tgt: Kabinete gape e ikuela mo go bao ba iseng ba tsenyedinakong diaterese tsa bona gore ba dire jalo mo bekeng e e latelang ya ikwadisetso ditlhopho ka Mopitlwe 2018.Ditiragalo tse di Tlang.

src: Fourth session of the South Africa-Botswana Binational Commission (BNC).
tgt: Kopano ya bone ya Khomišene ya Dinagapedi (BNC) ya Aforika Borwa-Botswana.

src: President Jacob Zuma will undertake a working visit to participate in and co-chair the Fourth Session of the South Africa-Botswana BNC to be held in Gaborone, Botswana on Friday, 17 November 2017.
tgt: Moporesitente Zuma o tla tsaya leeto la tirelo go tsaya karolo le go nna monnasetulommogo mo Kopanong ya Bone ya BNC ya Aforika Borwa-Botswana e e tla tshwarelwang kwa Gaborone, Botswana ka Labotlhano, 17 Ngwanaitseele 2017.

src: South Africa and Botswana meet annually at the level of the Heads of State within the framework of the BNC to review bilateral cooperation and discuss issues of common interest.
tgt: Naga ya Aforika Borwa le ya Botswana di kopana ngwaga o mongwe le o mongwe mo maemong a go nna Ditlhogo tsa Dinaga mo letlhomesong la BNC go leba sešwa botsalano jwa bonagapedi mmogo le go buisanela merero e e amang dinaga ka bobedi.

src: The two countries enjoy cordial relations which are informed by cultural ties and geographical proximity.
tgt: Dinaga ka bobedi di na le botsalano jo bo tseneletseng jo bo tlhodilweng ke kamano ya ditso tsa tsone le go nna baagisani ba ba gaufi.

src: They cooperate on a number of issues including, transport, trade and investment, health, environmental issues etc.
tgt: Di dirisana mo mererong e le mentsi e e akaretsang dipalangwa, kgwebisano le dipeeletso, boitekanelo, merero ya tikologo mmogo le merero e mengwe gape e mentsintsi.

src: South Africa is one of Botswana’s major trading partners, with several South African companies operating in that country.
tgt: Aforika Borwa ke mogwebisani yo mongwe wa bagwebisani ba bagolo ba Botswana, ka ditlamo di le mmalwa tsa yone tse ga jaanong di direlang kwa nageng eo.

src: Angolan State President visit.
tgt: Leeto la Semmuso la Moporesitente wa Puso ya Angola.

src: President Zuma will host his Excellency, the President of the Republic of Angola, João Lourenço, for a historic State Visit to South Africa from 23 November 2017.
tgt: Moporesitente Zuma o tla amogela Motlotlegi, Moporesitente wa Rephaboliki ya Angola, João Lourenço, mo Leeto la Semmuso le le tla dirang hisetori mo nageng ya Aforika Borwa go simolola ka la bo 23 Ngwanaitseele 2017.

src: This will be his first state visit to our country after his inauguration.
tgt: Leno e tla nna Leeto la gagwe la Semmuso la ntlha mo nageng ya rona fa e sale a ikanisediwa go rwala puso mo magetleng a gagwe.

src: The two countries have historical and fraternal ties dating back from the days of the liberation struggle when Angola housed and supported South African liberation cadres in various camps in that country.
tgt: Dinaga ka bobedi di na le botsalano jwa bogolotala le jwa tirisanommogo fa e sale mo nakong ya fa go ne go kgaratlhelwa kgololesego fa Angola e ne e amogetse le go tshegetsa balwelakgololesego ba Aforika Borwa ba ba neng ba le kwa dikampeng tse di farologaneng kwa nageng eo.

src: Trade and economic cooperation between the two countries has grown substantially, to the extent that South Africa is Angola’s number one trading partner on the continent.
tgt: Kgwebisano le tirisanommogo mo ikonoming magareng ga dinaga ka bobedi e oketsegile go utlwagala, mo ebileng Aforika Borwa e leng mogwebisani yo a di gogang kwa pele wa Angola mo kontinenteng.

src: Many South African companies are conducting business in Angola in a variety of sectors including construction, mining, housing, retail, food and beverages, hotels and leisure, banking and medical services.
tgt: Ditlamo di le dintsi tsa Aforika Borwa di dira dikgwebo kwa Angola mo makaleng a a farologaneng a a akaretsang setlamo sa dikago, sa meepo, sa dintlo, sa direkisiwa, sa dijo le dino, sa dihotele le botlhabakgobe, sa ditirelo tsa dibaka le tsa WEBTOKEN leetong la gagwe, Moporesitente Lourenço gape o tla ema ka lefoko phuthego ka Labotlhano, 24 Ngwanaitseele 2017 kwa OR Tambo Building mo Pretoria.

src: 16 Days of Activism.
tgt: Matsatsi a le 16 a Bolweladitshwanelo.

src: Cabinet joins all South Africans who are taking a stand against women and child abuse.
tgt: Kabinete e ikamanya le maAforika Borwa a a tsayang dikgato kgatlhanong le pogiso ya basadi le bana.

src: The 16 Days of Activism for No Violence against Women and Children campaign is taking place between 25 November and 10 December 2017.
tgt: Letsholo la Matsatsi a le 16 a Bolweladitshwanelo Kgatlhanong le Tiririsodikgoka mo Basading le mo Baneng le tla simolola ka la bo 25 Ngwanaitseele go fitlha ka la bo 10 Sedimonthole 2017.

src: This is the 19th year of the campaign in South Africa and it will continue under the theme: “Count Me In: Together Moving a Non-Violent South Africa Forward”.
tgt: Ono ke ngwaga wa bo 19 wa letsholo leno mo nageng ya Aforika Borwa mme go tla tswelelwa ka lona ka moono yo o reng: “Mpale: Mmogo re Tsweletsa Pele Aforika Borwa yo o Senang Tirisodikgoka”.

src: President Zuma will launch the 16 Days of Activism campaign in the Eastern Cape on Saturday, 25 November 2017.
tgt: Moporesitente Zuma o tla thankgolola letsholo la Matsatsi a le 16 a Bolweladitshwanelo mo Kapa Botlhaba ka Lamatlhatso, la bo 25 Ngwanaitseele 2017.

src: It will focus on the continued roll-out of National Dialogues, which encourage people to talk about the scourge of gender-based violence.
tgt: Le tla tsepamisa mogopolo mo tsweletsong e e sa kgaotseng ya Dipusano tsa Bosetšhaba, e e rotloetsang batho go buisana ka leuba la tirisodikgoka e e totileng batho ba bong jo bo rileng (GBV).

src: This will be preceded by International Men’s Day on Sunday, 19 November 2017, which calls on men to play their part in building a safer and more socially cohesive society.
tgt: Seno se tla latelwa ke Letsatsi la Boditšhabatšhaba la Banna ka Latshipi, la bo 19 Ngwanaitseele 2017, leo le ikuelang mo banneng go tshameka karolo ya bona mo go ageng setšhaba se se bolokesegileng e bile se tshwaragane go ka nna seoposengwe.

src: The Department of Justice and Constitutional Development will undertake the second community radio campaign under its Let’s Talk Justice series, which brings government services to people by providing listeners with an opportunity to engage with officials on topical issues.
tgt: Lefapha la Bosiamisi le Tlhabololo ya Molaotheo le tla tsaya letsholo la bobedi la diyalemowa tsa baagi ka setlhogo sa yona sa Tla re Bueng ka Bosiamisi, leo le tlisang ditirelo tsa puso kwa baaging ka go neela bareetsi tšhono ya go buisana badiredipuso ka dintlha tse di kwa setlhoeng.

src: The launch of a Sexual Offences Court during the campaign will also ensure better access to the justice system.
tgt: Go thankgolowla ga Kgotlatshekelo ya Dikgetse tsa Tlolomolao ya Thobalano mo nakong ya letsholo leno go tla netefatsa gape gore go nna bonolo go fitlhelela thulaganyo ya bosiamisi.

src: Cabinet is confident that by working together we can end the cycle of abuse.
tgt: Kabinete e na le tshepo e e tletseng gore ka go dirisana mmogo re ka fedisa dipogisego.

src: Through our collective efforts we can act to prevent abuse while ensuring a safer society for women and children.
tgt: Ka go dirisana mmogo re ka tsaya dikgato go thibela dipogisego fa mo letlhakoreng le lengwe re netefatsa gore re nna le setšhaba se se babalesegileng mo basading le mo baneng.

src: All people in South Africa are urged to wear a white ribbon as a symbolic pledge towards eliminating this scourge from our society.
tgt: Go ikuelwa mo baagi botlhe mo Aforika Borwa go apara lente le le tshweu go bontsha boikuelo jwa maikemisetso a go fedisa leuba leno mo setšhabeng sa rona.

src: Build up to World AIDS Day.
tgt: Itukisetso ya Letsatsi la Lefatshe ka ga AIDKabinete e ipiletsa mo go botlhe mo setšhabeng go tsaya karolo mo Labotlhanong wa Lente le le Khibidu go goteletsa kwa pele Letsatsi la Lefatshe ka ga AIDS ka la bo 1 Sedimonthole go fitlha kwa bokhutlhong jwa kgwedi eo.

src: Cabinet calls on all in society to participate in Red Ribbon Friday activations ahead of World AIDS Day on 1 December and up until the end of that month.
tgt: Go apara lente le le khibidu ke sesupo sa tshwaraganelo le maikemisetso a go lwantsha HIV le AIDLetsatsi la Lefatshe ka ga AIDS ke tšhono ya baagi botlhe go tshwaragana mo go lwantsheng HIV, ba bontshe tshegetso ya bao ba tshelang ka HIV le go gopola bao ba hulereng ka ntlha ya yona.

src: Wearing a red ribbon is a symbol of solidarity and commitment to the fight against HIV and AIDWorld AIDS Day is an opportunity for every community to unite in the fight against HIV, show support for people living with HIV and remember those who have passed on.
tgt: Mokete wa monongwaga o tla tshwarwa ka moono: “Ke Tshwanelo ya Me go Itse Seemo sa Me, Go Thibela Ketegelo ke Maikarabelo a Me”, o o golaganeng le moono wa lefatshe ka bophara o o reng: “Ke Tshwanelo ya Me go Iponela Ditirelo tsa Boitekanelo”.

src: This bolsters implementation of South Africa’s National Strategic Plan for HIV, Tuberculosis and Sexually-Transmitted Illnesses 2017 - 2022 (NSP), which is a key pillar in South Africa’s progress towards achieving universal healthcare as reflected in the NDP, which promotes a healthier, stronger and more equitable nation.
tgt: Tsenngotirisong eno e e bonatla ya Leano la Togamaano ya Bosetšhaba (NSP) ka HIV, Lehuba le Malwetse a Phetelano ka Thobalano la 2017 - 2022 la Aforika Borwa, leo le leng botlhokwa mo kgatelong pele ya Aforika Borwa mo go fitlheleleng tlhokomelo ya boitekanelo ya batho botlhe jaaka go tlhalositswe mo go NDP, eo e rotloetsang gore go nne le baagi ba ba tshelang ka boitekanelo, ba ba nang le matla e bile ba lekalekana.

src: National Imbizo Focus Week.
tgt: Beke ya Mtsholo a Naga a Imbizo.

src: Cabinet calls on communities to join participation in the upcoming 7th National Imbizo Focus Week, expected to be held from 27 November to 3 December 2017.
tgt: Kabinete e ikuela mo baaging go tsaya karolo mo Bekeng ya bo 7 ya Mtsholo a Naga a Imbizo a a tlang, a a solofelwang go simolola ka la bo 27 Ngwanaitseele go fitlha ka la bo 3 Sedimonthole 2017.

src: Under the leadership of the GCIS, this platform promotes interactive engagements between members of the Executive and communities.
tgt: Ka boeteledipele jwa GCIS, serala seno se rotloetsa dikgolagano tsa dipuisano magareng ga ditokololo tsa khuduthamaga le baagi.

src: It is taking place within the context of the centennial of Oliver Reginald Tambo, who advocated for gender equality.
tgt: E diragala ka nako ya mekete ya ngwagakgolo wa Oliver Reginald Tambo, yo a neng a lwela tekatekano ya batho ba bong jo bo sa tshwaneng.

src: The activities are aimed to support the 16 Days of Activism campaign.
tgt: Ditiragalo tseno maitlhomo a tsona ke go tshegetsa Letsholo la Matsatsi a le 16 a Bolweladitshwanelo.

src: Events will be placed on the national calendar and shared on the government website (WEBTOKEN).Bills.
tgt: Matsatsi ano a tla tsenngwa mo khalentareng ya naga le go abelanwa mo webesaeteng ya puso (WEBTOKEN).Melaotlhomo.

src: Cabinet approved the publication of a notice in terms of section 74(5) of the Constitution of the Republic of South Africa of 1996.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse go phasaladiwa ga tsiboso go ya ka karolo ya bo 74(5) ya Molaotheo wa Rephaboliki ya Aforika Borwa wa 1996.

src: The aim is to initiate a national and provincial consultation process for purposes of effecting changes to provincial boundaries in respect of the Matatiele Local Municipality in the Eastern Cape and certain areas of Ba Ga Mothibi in North West.
tgt: Maitlhomo ke go simolola thulaganyo mo maemong a bosetšhaba le a porofense go senka maikutlo gore go diriwe diphetogo mo melelwaneng ya porofense tebang le Masepala wa Selegae wa Matatiele kwa Kapa Botlhaba mmogo le kwa mafelong a mangwe a Ba Ga Mothibi kwa Bokone Bophirima.

src: The intended redetermination of the provincial boundaries emanates from the communities of the areas in question who wish to be relocated to neighboring provinces.
tgt: Maikemisetso a go lebelelwa sešwa melelwane ya porofense a tlhagelela ka ntlha ya fa baagi ba dikarolo tsa dinaga tse di umakilweng ba batla go wela kwa diporofenseng tsa baagisani.

src: Messages.
tgt: Melaetsa.

src: Cabinet congratulates France as the preferred host of the 2023 Rugby World Cup and thanks government’s delegation, headed by Deputy President Cyril Ramaphosa, Sport and Recreation Minister Thulas Nxesi and the South African Rugby Union, for the work done in promoting South Africa’s bid to host the event.
tgt: Kabinete e akgotse Fora go bo e le naga e e atlenegisitsweng go ka tshwarela kwa go yona Sejana sa Lefatshe tsa Rakabi sa 2023 mme e leboga boemedi jwa puso, jo bo neng bo eteletswe pele ke Motlatsamoporesitente Cyril Ramaphosa, Tona ya Metshameko le Boitapoloso Thulas Nxesi mmogo le Mokgatlhotshwaraganelo wa Aforika Borwa wa Rakabi, ka tiro e e dirilweng mo go tsholetseng maiteko a Aforika Borwa a go ka tshwarela meletlo eo kwano.

src: Cabinet congratulates Minister Pandor, who was awarded the Outstanding Educator Award.
tgt: Kabinete e akgotse Tona Pandor, yo a abetsweng Kabo ya Morutabaithuti yo o Diphatsa.

src: The award was presented to Minister Pandor by the Chancellor of the University of South Africa, former President Thabo Mbeki.
tgt: Kabo eno e neetswe Tona Pandor, ke Molaodi wa Yunibesiti ya Aforika Borwa, Moporesitente wa mo malobeng rre Thabo Mbeki.

src: The Outstanding Educator Award, one of four categories, acknowledges the contribution of any outstanding educator who has excelled in or advanced teaching, learning, skills development and/or research in their area of expertise.
tgt: Kabo ya Morutabaithuti yo o Diphatsa, e leng e nngwe ya dikabo di le nne, e leboga seabe sa barutabaithuti ba ba diphatsa ba ba dirileng bontle mo thutong le mo go godiseng thuto, go ithuta, tlhabololo ya bokgoni le/dipatlisiso mo dikarolong tse ba di itseng jaaka ba ikitse.

src: Cabinet convened for its last 2017 meeting at the Union Buildings in Pretoria.
tgt: Kapinete e tshwere kopano ya yona ya bofelo ya ngwaga wa 2017 kwa Union Buildings mo Pretoria.

src: Cabinet DecisionsCabinet approved the National Tourism Sector Strategy (NTSS) 2016-2026 for implementation.
tgt: Kabinete e atlenegisitse Togamaano ya Bosetšhaba ya Lekala la Bojanala (NTSS) 2016-2026 gore e ka tsenngwatirisong.

src: The NTSS is anchored on five strategic pillars, namely marketing, facilitation of ease of access for tourists, enhance visitor experience, destination management and broad-based benefits.
tgt: NTSS e tlhalosiwa ka dipilara tsa togamaano di le tlhano e leng ya phasalatso, tolamiso ya go nolofatsa phitlhelelo ya bojanala, go oketsa boitumelo jwa bajanala, taolo ya lefelo le go iwang kwa go lona mmogo le go anamisa dipoelo tse kgolo.

src: The full document is available on the Department of Tourism’s website: www.
tgt: Tokomane e e feletseng e teng mo webesaeteng ya Lefapha la Bojanala ya: www.

src: tourism.
tgt: tourism.

src: gov.
tgt: gov.

src: za.
tgt: za.

src: Cabinet approved the framework for the establishment of a National Broadband Network Company.
tgt: Kabinete e atlenegisitse letlhomeso la go tlhoma Setlamo sa Naga sa Neteweke ya Porotebente.

src: It will be formed out of the merger of Sentech and Broadband Infraco.
tgt: Se tla tlhamiwa ka go kopanya Sentech le Broadband Infraco.

src: This will facilitate the roll-out of the interdependent elements in a coordinated manner and create a national broadband champion.
tgt: Seno se tla laola go tsenngwatirisong ga mananeo ano a a tshegetsaneng ka tsela e e rulagantsweng le go tlhoma mofenyi wa naga wa porotebente.

src: Cabinet approved the First Annual Progress Report on Implementation of the White Paper on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities (WPRPD).
tgt: Kabinete e atlenegisitse Pegelo ya Ntlha ya Dikgatelopele ya Ngwaga le Ngwaga e e ka ga go tsenngwatirisong Lokwalotemoso lwa Lefapha la Puso ka ga Ditshwanelo tsa Batho ba ba Nang le Bogolofadi (WPRPD).

src: The report covers the period from 1 January to 31 December 2016.The report gives a high-level assessment of the extent to which government departments have started embedding the policy directives of WPRPD into their respective planning, budgeting, and service delivery and reporting systems.
tgt: Pegelo eno e akaretsa paka e e simolotseng ka la bo 1 Ferikgong go fitlha ka la bo 31 Sedimonthole 2016.Pegelo eno e tlhagisa tekolo ya maemo a a kwa godimo mo ebileng mafapha a puso a setseng a simolotse go tsenyeletsa ditaelo tsa pholisi eno ya WPRPD mo maanong a bona, mo ditekanyetsokabong le mo dithulaganyong tsa le tsa kaboditirelo le tsa go dira dpegelo.

src: Cabinet approved the publication of the Strategic Disability Policy Framework for the Post-School Education and Training System for public comment.
tgt: Kabinete e atlenegisitse phasalatso ya Pholisi ya Letlhomeso la Togamaano ya Bogolofadi go samagana le Thulaganyo ya Thuto le Katiso ya Morago ga go Konosetsa Dithuto tsa Sekolo (PSET) gore baagi ba dire ditshwaelo.

src: Cabinet was briefed on the outcomes of the Review of the Taxi Recapitalization Programme conducted from November 2015 until September 2016.
tgt: Kabinete e nopoletswe ka dipoelo tsa Tshekatsheko ya Lenaane la Tlhabololo ya Dithekesi le le diragaditsweng go simolola ka Ngwanaitseele 2015 go fitlha ka Lwetse 2016.

src: The programme is part of the broader Public Transport Strategy, which aims to provide an integrated safety and efficient transport system in South Africa.
tgt: Lenaane leno ke karolo ya togamaano e kgolo ya Togamaano ya Dipalangwa tsa Baagi, eo maitlhomo a yona e leng go tlhagisa thulaganyo ya dipalangwa e e dirang sentle e bile e babalesegile e e kopanetsweng mo Aforika Borwa.

src: Cabinet approved that more consultation and work must be done with relevant departments before the National Department of Transport can embark on the revised approach.
tgt: Kabinete e atlenegisitse gore go diriwe dipuisano le tiro e e tseneletseng le mafapha a a maleba pele Lefapha la Naga la Dipalangwa le ka samagana le kgato e e ntšhwafaditsweng.

src: Cabinet approved the public release of the 8th edition of the Development Indicators (2016).
tgt: Kabinete e atlenegisitse go phasaladiwa mo baaging ga kgatiso ya bo robedi ya Ditshupetso tsa Kgatelopele (tsa 2016).

src: The Development Indicator Report focuses on South Africa’s development since democracy and monitors implementation of the National Development Plan Vision 2030.Cabinet approved measures to strengthen the management of discipline of public servants in relation to officials conducting business with organs of state.
tgt: Pegelo ya Ditshupetso tsa Kgatelopele e tsepamisitse mogopolo mo tlhabololong ya Aforika Borwa fa e sale go nna le temokerasi mme e ela tlhoko go tsenngwatirisong ga Leano la Tlhabololo la Bosetšhaba (NDP): Ponelopele ya Kabinete e atlenegisitse dikgato tse di tla matlafatsang taolo ya dikgato tsa kgalemo ya badiredipuso mabapi le badiredipuso ba ba gwebisanang le ditheo tsa puso.

src: It gives effect to the Public Service Regulations 2016, which prohibits public servants from conducting business with the State.
tgt: E tswa mo Melawaneng ya Ditirelo tsa Puso ya 2016, e e thibelang badiredipuso go gwebisana le Puso.

src: From 1 March, National Treasury, supported by the Department of Public Service and Administration (DPSA), will monitor all new registrations on the online Central Supplier Database against the Persal System.
tgt: Go simolola ka la bo 1 Mopitlwe, Lefapha la Matlotlo a Naga, le tshegeditswe ke Lefapha la Bodiredipuso le Tsamaiso (DPSA), ba tla lekola boikwadiso jotlhe jo bo diragadiwang mo Sefalanakgobokgobotshedimosong sa Baabiditirelo (CSD) gore baikwadisi bao ga ba tlhagelele gape mo thulaganyong ya Persal.

src: Cabinet approved the New Performance Management and Development System for Heads of Department, which accurately reflects the link between individual and organisational performance.
tgt: Kabinete e atlenegisitse gore Thulaganyo e Ntšhwa ya Tlhabololo ya Bolaodi jwa Tiragatsotiro ya Ditlhogo tsa Lefapha, e e bontshang ka tolamo kgolagano magareng ga tiragatsotiro ya batho le ya mokgatlho o ba o direlang.

src: It comes into effect on 1 April 2018.Cabinet approved the introduction and implementation of the Public Service Graduate Recruitment Scheme Framework.
tgt: E tla simolola go tsenngwatirisong ka la bo 1 Moranang Kabinete e atlenegisitse go tsenngwatirisong ga Letlhomeso la Sekema sa go Thapiwa ga Dialogane mo Ditirelong tsa Puso.

src: This forms part of the development programme within the Public Service to attract talented graduates into the Public Service.
tgt: Seno ke karolo ya lenaane la tlhabololo mo Ditirelong tsa Puso go ka ngokela dialogane tse di nang le bokgoni go ka direla puso.

src: The framework includes earmarking a percentage of each department’s vacant posts for the recruitment of graduates in scarce occupations.
tgt: Letlhomeso leno le akaretsa go nopola phesente e e rileng ya diphatlhatiro tsa lefapha le lengwe le le lengwe gore e tswalelwe ke dialogane mo ditirong tseo go nang le tlhaelo ya batho ba ba dirang mefuta eo ya tiro.

src: The Minister of Public Service and Administration will also align this framework to the Youth Employment Service Programme.
tgt: Tona ya DPSA o tla lepalepanya gape letlhomeso leno le Lenaane la Tirelo ya go Thapiwa ga Bašwa.

src: Cabinet approved for the publication of the following Notices in the Government Gazette relating to the Rationalisation of Courts Jurisdiction, which aims to increase access to justice for previously marginalised and under-serviced rural villages.
tgt: Kabinete e atlenegisitse gore go phasaladiwe Dikitsiso tse di latelang mo Kaseteng ya Puso tse di amanang le Dikamano tsa Melao ya Dikgotlatshekelo, tseo maitlhomo a tsone e leng go tokafatsa phitlhelesego ya bosiamisi mo go bao mo malobeng ba neng ba kgapetswe kwa thoko le mo metseng e e kwa metseselegaeng eo e sa direlweng ka botlalo.

src: The rationalisation is in magisterial districts in the Free State and Northern Cape, and the removal of certain Magisterial Districts from the Gauteng Division of the High Court and placing them under the jurisdiction of the North West Division of High Court.
tgt: Go tla potlakisiwa dikgaolo tsa magiseterata kwa Foreistata le kwa Kapa Bokone, le go ntshiwa ga Dikgaolo tse dingwe tsa Magiseterata mo Kgaolong ya Gauteng go tswa ka fa diphukeng tsa Kgotlatshekelokgolo go di tsenya ka fa tlase ga diphuka tsa bosiamisi jwa Kgaolo ya Kgotlatshekelokgolo ya Bokone Bophirima.

src: Cabinet approved the Regulations on Mediation Rules in terms of the Protection of Investment Act, 2015 (Act 22 of 2015).
tgt: Kabinete e atlenegisitse Melawanataolo e e ka ga Melao ya Tsereganyo go ya ka Molao wa Tshireletsego ya Dipeeletso, 2015 (Molao wa bo 22 wa 2015).

src: The regulations provide for an investor that has a dispute in respect of action taken by government that affects an investment, to request the Department of Trade and Industry (the dti) to intervene with possible mediation mechanism.
tgt: Melawana eno e thusa mobeeletsi yo a nang le ngongora ka kgato e e tserweng ke puso mme e ama peeletso, go kopa Lefapha la Kgwebisano le Intaseteri (dti) go ka tsereganya ka mekgwa eo maitlhomo e leng go tsereganya.

src: Cabinet approved the convening and hosting of the following conferences:National Community Development Workers Programme Consultative Conference 2018 by the DPSInternational Association of Prosecutors 23rd Annual Conference, to be hosted by the National Prosecuting Authority in Durban during September 2018.2021 World Science Forum in South Africa.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse gore go ka tsenelwa le go tshwarwa dikhonferense tse di latelang:Khonferense ya 2018 ya Dipatlisiso ka ga Lenaane la Naga la Tlhabololo ya Baagi le Badiri ka DPSA.

src: The Department of Science and Technology will engage with the World Science Forum Steering Committee for possible hosting.2017 African Union (AU) High-Level Dialogue, hosted by the DPSA from 6 to 8 December 2017.
tgt: Khonferense e e Tshwarwang Ngwaga le Ngwaga ya bo 23 ya Mokgatlho wa Boditšhabatšhaba wa Basekisi, e e tla tshwarwang ke Bothati jwa Bosekisi jwa Bosetšhaba (NPA) kwa Durban mo pakeng ya Lwetse 2018.Foramo ya Lefatshe ya Saense mo Aforika Borwa ka 2021.

src: Cabinet approved for the designs and commemorative collectors’ and circulation coin series to be issued in 2018.The coin designs, with their proclamations, will be printed in the Government Gazette: 2018 2oz, 22-carat gold Krugerrand2018 24-carat gold Natura coin series (Rise of the dinosaurs – Archosauria)2018 24-carat gold R1 coin series (Reptiles of South Africa – the parrot beaked padloper)2018 bi-metal R5 circulation coin (Nelson Mandela Centenary)2018 24-carat gold and sterling-silver Protea coin series (Life of Legend – Nelson Mandela)2018 sterling-silver R2 Crown and 2 ½ Tickey series (South African inventions – Computed Tomography) and2018 sterling-silver colour finished coin series (Birds and Flowers of the Waterberg Biosphere Reserve).Issues in the EnvironmentGDP Growth ResultsCabinet is pleased with South Africa’s economy growth which grew by an annualised 2% in the third quarter of 2017, from an upwardly revised 2.8% in the second quarter.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse go betliwa ga madi a tshipi a go bontsha tlotlo a a ka bokelediwang le a a tla dirisediwang go reka gore a rebolwe ka 2018.Mebetlo ya madi ano a tshipi, le seo a se buang, di tla gatisiwa mo Kaseteng ya Puso:Madi a 2018 a di onse di le 2, ka dikharate di le 22 tsa gauta a ranta ya KrugerMadi a 2018 a lethathama la madi a tshipi a Natura ka dikharate di le 24 tsa gauta (Go Tsoga ga dikgolomodumo – Archosauria)Madi a 2018 a lethathama la madi a tshipi a R1 ka dikharate di le 24 tsa gauta (Digagabi tsa naga ya Aforika Borwa – khudu)Madi a 2018 a a bopilweng ka motswako wa ditshipi di le pedi a R5 a a tla dirisediwang go reka (Ngwagakgolo wa Nelson Mandela)Madi a 2018 a lethathama la madi a tshipi a Protea a dikharate di le 24 tsa gauta le selefera o o opafaditsweng a (Botshelo jwa Mogaka – Nelson Mandela)Madi a 2018 a lethathama la madi a tshipi a R2 wa Korone le 2 ½ waTiki a selefera o o opafaditswenga (Ditlhagisiwa tsa Boitlhamedi tsa Aforika Borwa tsa Didirisiwa tsa khomphiuthara tsa go dirisa maphotho a pono go bona foo go sa bonagaleng) mmogo leMadi a 2018 a lethathama la madi a tshipi a a kgabisitsweng a selefera o o opafaditsweng(Polokelo ya tsa Tlhago ya Dinonyane le Malomo a Waterberg).

src: The stronger-than-expected performance was mainly due to continued strong growth in the agriculture sector, which contributed percentage points to overall growth on the back of per cent quarter-on-quarter growth.
tgt: Dipoelo tsa Seelosotlhe sa Ditlhagisiwa tsa Naga mo Ngwageng (GDP)Kabinete e itumedisitswe ke kgolo ya ikonomi ya Aforika Borwa e e godileng ka 2% mo ngwageng mo kotareng ya boraro mo ngwageng wa 2017, go tswa mo palong e e fetotsweng e e neng e le kwa godimo ya 2.8% mo kotareng ya bobedi.

src: Strong performance in agriculture, which has seen three consecutive quarters of robust growth, was due to higher production of field crops (such as maize) in summer rainfall areas and horticultural products.
tgt: Tiragatsotiro e e thata go feta e e neng e solofetswe eno e ne e ikaegile bogolosegolo ka kgolo e e neng e ntse e tsweletse go gola mo lekaleng la temothuo, leo le tlametseng ka seabe sa karolo ya diphesente ya go fitlha mo kgolokakaretsong ya mo morago ga 44.2% mo kotareng e nngwe le e nngwe.

src: Mining and manufacturing also contributed to the growth recorded, with mining and quarrying increasing by 6.6% and contributing percentage points to growth.
tgt: Tiragatsotiro e e matlafetseng eno mo temothuong, e e tlhagisitseng dikotara di le tharo tse di latelaneng tsa kgolo, e dirilwe ke kotulo e e kwa godimo ya dijalo (tse di jaaka mmidi) mo mafelong a a tshologelwang ke dipula mo selemong le mo ditlhagisweng tse di somarelwang.

src: The electricity sector was the biggest laggard, down by 5.5%.
tgt: Makala a meepo le a tlhagisodikuno le one a latlhetse tlhwarelegonnyane mo kgolong e e nopotsweng, ka meepo le lenkwari di oketsegile ka 6.6% le go nna le seabe sa karolo ya diphesente ya mo kgolong.

src: Growth in household consumption of 2.6% was mainly due to spending on durable goods, which accounted for percentage points of the 2.6% increase.
tgt: Lekala la motlakase ke lone le le nnileng bodipa go gaisa, ka go wela tlase ka 5.5%.

src: Outbreak of ListeriosisCabinet appeals to all people to take the necessary precaution – such as washing their hands before preparing food and avoiding raw or uncooked foods – to curb the spread of Listeriosis, whilst investigations continue to establish the source of the bacteria.

src: The awards recognised outstanding teaching and leadership in several categories, including the Nelson Mandela Lifetime Achievement Award and Profssor Kader Asmal Award.
tgt: The awards recognised outstanding teaching and leadership in several categories, including the Nelson Mandela Lifetime Achievement Award and Professor Kader Asmal Award.

tgt: Cabinet conveys its condolences to Deputy Minister Obed Bapela on the loss of his wife Constance Bapela, who served the country as a councillor at the time of her passing.

tgt: Cabinet joins President Ramaphosa in conveying condolences to the family, friends and associates of the political economist and author, Prof Johannes “Sampie” Terreblanche, who passed on at the age of Cabinet congratulates Minister Naledi Pandor on her recognition by Leiden University in the Netherlands as an Oort Honorary Visiting Professor of Astronomy and Development.

src: This is in recognition of the Minister’s extraordinary accomplishment in harnessing science, particularly astronomy, as a tool for global development and societal benefit.
tgt: This is in recognition of the Minister’s extraordinary accomplishment in harnessing science, particularly astronomy, as a tool for global development and societal benefit.

src: Cabinet met on Wednesday, 14 March 2018, at Tuynhuys, Cape TownIssues in the environment.
tgt: Kabinete e tshwaretse kopano kwa Tuynhuis, Motse Kapa ka Laboraro, 14 Mopitlwe 2018Merero ya ga jaanong.

src: Economic growth.
tgt: Kgolo ya Ikonomi.

src: Cabinet welcomes the 1.3% growth in the economy in 2017.
tgt: Kabinete e amogela kgolo ya ikonomi ka 1.3% ka 2017.

src: This is an increase from 0.3% in 2016.
tgt: Eno ke koketsego go tswa go 0.3% ka 2016.

src: The performance of the economy under difficult conditions bodes well for the country’s future economic prospects.
tgt: Tiragatso ya ikonomi ka fa tlase ga maemo a a boima e bonelapele ikonomi ya isago e e solofetsang ya naga.

src: The growth figures signal that the economy is on an upward trajectory, with National Treasury expecting the economy to expand by 1.5% this year and accelerate to 2.1% in 2020.
tgt: Dipalopalo tsa kgolo di bontsha gore ikonomi e a tlhatlhoga, le Matlotlo a Bosetšhaba a solofetse ikonomi go gola ka 1.5% monongwaga le go oketsega go ya go 2.1% ka 2020.

src: Cabinet calls on all sectors of society to build on the positive momentum of 2017, and work with government to translate its plans into concrete action to sustain economic growth and create jobs.
tgt: Kabinete e ikuela go maphata otlhe a setšhaba go agelela mo tswelopele e ntle ya 2017, le go dira mmogo le puso go fetolela maano a yona go nna tiragatso ya mmatota go tsweledisa kgolo ya ikonomi le go tlhola ditiro.

src: Land reform Cabinet welcomes the adopted motion to amend the Constitution of the Republic of South Africa of 1996 so as to allow for the expropriation of land without compensation.
tgt: Ntšhwafatso ya Mafatshe Kabinete e amogela tshitshinyo ya go fetola Molaotheo wa Aforika Borwa wa 1996 gore o tle o letle go tsewa ga lefatshe ntle le tuelo.

src: Government has since 1994 worked hard to reverse the legacy of land dispossession under colonialism and apartheid.
tgt: E sale ka 1994 puso e dirile ka natla go busetsa morago letlotlo la go amogiwa lefatshe ka fa tlase ga bokolianale le tlhaolele.

src: Working within the law, government has done much to ensure the continued productivity of the land, while speeding up the process of redress for those affected by land dispossessions.
tgt: Re dira go ya ka molao, puso e dirile go le gontsi go netefatsa gore lefatshe le tsweledisa tlhagiso, fa ka fa letlhakoreng le lengwe le itlhaganedisa tsamaiso ya go duela bao ba amilweng ke go amogiwa lefatshe.

src: The matter has been referred to the Constitutional Review Committee, which must report back to Parliament by 30 August 2018.
tgt: Ntlha eno e fetiseditswe kwa Komiting ya Tebosešwa ya Molaotheo, eo e tshwanetseng go begela Palamente ka 30 Phatwe 2018.

src: The recommendations to the National Assembly will be informed by a series of public hearings followed by committee meetings.
tgt: Dikatlenegiso go Kokoano Bosetšhaba di tla laelwa ke metseletsele ya ditheetso tsa setšhaba di salwa morago ke dikopano tsa komiti.

src: Cabinet calls on all stakeholders to make their input during this process of engagement, which will guide the solutions to take our country forward.
tgt: Kabinete e ikuela go baamegi botlhe go dira ditshwaelo mo tsamaisong eno ya dipuisano, eo e tla kaelang ditshweetso tse di isang naga ya rona kwa pele.

src: As a caring and people-centred government, all stakeholders will be engaged during this process.
tgt: Jaaka puso e e kgathalelang le go ikaega ka batho, baamegi botlhe ba tla nna le seabe ka nako ya tsamaiso eno.

src: Cabinet further urges communities to desist from illegal land invasions.
tgt: Kabinete e tswelela go kopa baagi go emisa go itseela lefatshe e se ka molao.

src: We are a law-abiding and peace-loving country with adequate mechanisms of dealing with issues, including the land issue.
tgt: Re naga e e obamelang molao le go nna le kagiso ka mekgwa e e lekaneng ya go mekamekana le merero, go tsenyeletsa le morero wa lefatshe.

src: South Africa remains open for business, and investments in agriculture and farming are welcomed.
tgt: Aforika Borwa e tswelela go amogela kgwebo, mme dipeeletso go temothuo le temo di amogelesegile.

src: It is in South Africa's interests to have commercial farmers and this process can ensure we have even greater numbers of successful commercial farmers.
tgt: Ke mo dikgatlhegong tsa Aforika Borwa go nna le bagwebi ba balemi mme tsamaiso eno e ka netefatsa gore re nna le dipalo tse di kwa godimo tsa bagwebi ba balemi ba ba atlegileng.

src: Nofingxana community’s Double Drift Wildlife Economy Project.
tgt: Porojeke ya Ikonomi ya Diphologo tse di Tlhaga ya Double Drift ya baagi ba Nofingxana.

src: Cabinet welcomes the launch of the Nofingxana community’s Double Drift Wildlife Economy Project, at Double Drift Nature Reserve in the Eastern Cape by the Minister of Environmental Affairs, Dr Edna Molewa.
tgt: Kabinete e amogela go tlhomiwa ga Porojeke ya Ikonomi ya Diphologolo tse di Tlhaga ya Double Drift ya Baagi ba Nofingxana, kwa Serapeng sa Diphologolo sa Double Drift kwa Kapa Botlhaba ke Tona ya Merero ya Tikologo, Ng Edna Molewa.

src: This included the handing over of the title deed to the Likhaya Lethu Communal Property Association (CPA) on behalf of the Minister of Rural Development and Land Reform, Ms Maite Nkoana-Mashabane.
tgt: Seno se tsenyeletsa go newa ga makwalokano a bonno go Mokgatlo wa Thototlhakanelwa wa Likhaya Lethu (CPA) mo boemong jwa Tona ya Tlhabololo ya Magae le Ntšhwafatso ya Mafatshe, Moh Maite Nkoana-Mashabane.

src: The Double Drift community was dispossessed of the residential and grazing rights by the 1913 Land Act.
tgt: Baagi ba Double Drift ba ne ba tseelwa ditshwanelo tsa bona tsa boagi le phulo ke Molao wa Lefatshe wa 1913.

src: In 1994, this community lodged a land claim that was settled in 2012, resulting in Likhaya Lethu CPA being established.
tgt: Ka 1994, baagi bano ba ne ba tsenya topo ya lefatshe eo e neng ya duelwa ka 2012, eo e neng ya tsala go tlhomiwa ga Likhaya Lethu CPLikhaya Lethu CPA e na le maloko a le 1 500 a baagi ba Double Drift mme e amogetse R6 milione go tswa kwa Lefapheng la Merero ya Tikologo go tlhama kgwebo ya ikonomi ya diphologolo tsa naga mo polaseng ya Naudeshoek (1 400 diheketara).

src: The transaction was processed through the Department of Rural Development and Land Reform.
tgt: Tuelo e ne ya tsamaiswa ka Lefapha la Tlhabololo ya Magae le Ntšhwafatso ya Lefatshe.

src: VBS Mutual Bank.
tgt: Banka ya VBS Mutual Kabinete e utlwile kitsiso ya Banka ya Resefe ya Aforika Borwa malebana le Banka ya VBS Mutual.

src: Cabinet has noted the South African Reserve Bank announcement with regard to the VBS Mutual Bank.
tgt: Go thapiwa ga botlhokomedi go tla thusa Banka ya VBS Mutal go busetsa dikgwetlho tsa yona tsa go bona madi le go direla dikgatlhego tsa setšhaba le babeeletsi ba VBKabinete e nna e ntse e itlamile go katoloso le phetolo ya lephata la ditšhelete kwa ntle ga go tsenya dikgatlhego tsa babeeletsi mo kotsing.

src: Cabinet welcomes the ‘CEOs Know’ campaign by Brand South Africa, in collaboration with Business Leadership South Africa, to promote South Africa as an investment destination.
tgt: Kabinete e amogela letsholo la Brand South Africa ya ‘CEOs Know’ , e dirisana le Business Leadership South Africa, go tsweletsa Aforika Borwa jaaka lefelo la peeletso.

src: This builds on our world-class infrastructure through InvestSA One-Stop Shop, research and development capabilities, innovation and an established manufacturing base to support investors.
tgt: Seno se agelela mo mafaratlhatlheng a rona a maemo a a kwa godimo ka Lefelo la ditirelodintsi la InvestSA, bokgoni jwa patlisiso le tlhabologo, botlhami le lefelo le le setseng le le gona la go tlhama go tshegetsa babeeletsi.

src: New growth areas have also been opened in the oceans economy, renewable energy, the green economy and shale-gas exploration.
tgt: Mafelo a mantšhwa a kgolo le ona a butswe mo ikonoming ya lewatle, eneji e ntšhwafaditsweng, ikonomi ya tlhago le go epiwa ga gase ya shale.

src: The campaign features CEOs from multinational corporations based in South Africa sharing their insights on continued investment in South Africa.
tgt: Letsholo le na le di CEO go tswa kwa dikhamphaning tsa dinaga tsa boditšhabatšhaba tse di leng mo Aforika Borwa ba arolelana maitemogelo a bona a go tswelela go beeletsa mo Aforika Borwa.

src: Cabinet encourages all South Africans in the spirit of “Thuma Mina” (Send Me) sweeping across our nation to play their part by sharing their positive stories to build our country’s reputation and grow its investment appeal.
tgt: Kabinete e rotloetsa maAforika Borwa otlhe go nna mo moweng wa “Thuma Mina” (Roma Nna) oo o rotloetsang setšhaba sa rona go tshameka karolo ya bona ka go arolelana dikgang tse di namatsang go aga serodumo sa naga ya rona le go godisa selebego sa yona sa peeletso.

src: Independent Power Producers (IPPs) Procurement Programme.
tgt: Lenaneo la Tshenkelo la Batlhagisi ba ba Ikemetseng ba Motlakase (IPPs).

src: Cabinet has noted the High Court case filed by two non-governmental organisations regarding government’s decision to sign the power purchase agreements with 27 IPPs.
tgt: Kabinete e itse ka ga kgetse e e tlhatlhetsweng ke mekgatlo e mebedi eo e seng ya puso kwa Kgotlatshekelo Kgolo mabapi le tshwetso ya puso ya go saena ditumelano tsa theko ya motlakase le di 27 IPPs.

src: The matter will be concluded by the High Court on 27 March 2018.
tgt: Kgotla Kgolo e tla tsaya tshwetso ka ga morero ono ka di 27 Mopitlwe 2018.

src: In the spirit of constitutionalism and the rule of law, the signing has been postponed.
tgt: Mo moweng wa puso ya molaotheo le taolo ya molao, go sainiwa go ne ga sutisediwa kwa pele.

src: Cabinet affirms the commitment to resolve the matters around these programmes.
tgt: Kabinete e gatelela maitlamo a go rarabolola merero e e dikologileng mananeo ano.

src: The Renewable Energy Independent Power Producer Procurement Programme will ensure that consumers in our country have access to cost-efficient and clean energy, and will bring much-needed investment in South Africa.
tgt: Lenaneo la Tshenkelo la Motlakase o Ntšhwafaditsweng la Batlhagisi ba ba Ikemetseng ba Motlakase le tla netefatsa gore badirisi mo nageng ya rona ba neelwa motlakase o o phepha o le tlhotlhwa tlase, le go tlisa peeletso eo e tlhokegang thata mo Aforika Borwa.

src: These projects will provide 61 600 full-time jobs, 95% of which are for South African citizens, specifically targeting the youth.
tgt: Diporojeke tseno di tla tlisa ditiro tsa leruri di le 61 600, 95% ya tsone e le tsa baagi ba Aforika Borwa, segolobogolo go lebeletswe thata bašwa.

src: Cabinet reaffirms its commitment to a solid public-private partnership as we pursue our energy transition objectives of the future and a better life for all.
tgt: Kabinete e gatelela maitlamo a yona go kgwebisano e e tseneletseng ya puso le dikhamphani tsa poraefete jaaka re latela maikaelelo a rona a phetolo ya motlakase wa isago le botshelo jo bo botoka go botlhe.

src: This is needed to bring much-needed policy and regulatory certainty, and maintain South Africa’s position as an energy investment destination of choice.
tgt: Seno se a tlhokega go tlisa pholisi eo e tlhokegang thata le netefaletso ya taolo, go tshola maemo a Aforika Borwa jaaka lefelo la boitlhophelo la peeletso go motlakase.

src: Listeriosis.
tgt: Lesetereosisi.

src: Cabinet extends its heartfelt condolences to the friends and family of those who lost their lives after contracting Listeriosis, and wishes those who are recuperating a speedy recovery.
tgt: Kabinete e romela matshidiso go ditsala le balosika ba bao ba latlhegetsweng ke matshelo a bona morago ga go tshwaetswa ke bolwetse jwa Lesetereosisi, le go eleletsa bao ba tokafetseng pholo ya ka bonako.

src: More than 180 people died and 940 cases were reported in South Africa.
tgt: Go tlhokafetse batho ba feta 180 mme go setse go begilwe dikgetse di le 940 mo Aforika Borwa.

src: Cabinet is encouraged by the intensive efforts by the Department of Health, the National Institute for Communicable Diseases (NICD) and the World Health Organisation to stop the listeria bacteria from spreading.
tgt: Kabinete e rotloeditswe ke matsapa a a tseneletseng a Lefapha la Boitekanelo, Setheo sa Bosetšhaba sa Megare e e Tshelanang (NICD) le Mokgatlo wa Lefatshe wa Boitekanelo go thibela mogare wa leseteria go anama.

src: To further strengthen these efforts, the Minister of Health, Dr Aaron Motsoaledi, will meet with the South African Nursing Council on Thursday, 15 March 2018.
tgt: Go tswelela go matlafatsa maiteko ano, Tona ya Boitekanelo, Ng Aaron Motsoaledi, o tla kopana le Khansele ya Baoki ya Aforika Borwa ka Labone, 15 Mopitlwe 2018.

src: Cabinet acknowledges that the positive progress made in identifying and isolating the source of the deadly Listeriosis outbreak.
tgt: Kabinete e lemoga tswelopele e e namatsang e e dirilweng mo go supeng le go tlhaola motswedi wa leroborobo la bolwetsi jo bo kotsi jwa Lisetereosisi.

src: The subsequent recall of food products from three Enterprise and Rainbow meat processing plants – where the bacteria was found – was a defining moment to stop the outbreak.
tgt: Go busediwa morago ga dikuno tsa dijo go tswa kwa ditheong di le tharo tsa tirelo tsa Enterprise le Rainbow – kwa mogare o bonweng teng – e ne e le motsotso o o botlhokwa wa go thibela leroborobo.

src: The food-borne disease was first identified in June 2017.
tgt: Mogare o o tlhagelelang go tswa mo dijong o ne wa supiwa lwantlha ka Seetebosigo 2017.

src: Listeriosis is a serious and preventable illness that can be treated successfully with antibiotics.
tgt: Liseteriosisi ke bolwetse jo bo kotsi mme bo ka thibelwa le go ka alafiwa ka katlego ka di anthibiotiki.

src: Those most at risk are pregnant women, very young infants, elderly persons and people with a weakened immune system.
tgt: Bao ba leng thata mo kotsing ke baimana, masea a a sa tswang go tsalwa, bagodi le batho ba ba nang le masole a mmele a a bokoa.

src: People who show symptoms of fever, muscle aches, nausea or diarrhoea should visit their medical practitioner or local clinic immediately.
tgt: Batho ba ba nang le matshwao a letshoromo, ditlhabi mo mesifeng, letlhatsa le letshollo ba tshwanetse go ya go bona ka bonako ngaka ya bona kgotsa kliniki ya selegae.

src: Cabinet is optimistic that South Africa will defeat the current outbreak and urges all people to observe the five food safety rules during this time:Wash hands with soap and water before handling food, and after using a bathroomCook food thoroughly and do not eat half-cooked food as the Listeria bacteria will die when food is well cookedDo not handle raw and cooked food togetherKeep food at appropriate temperatures andMake sure that all milk products are pasteurised or at least parboiled and wash non-cooked food with clean running water before ingestion or at least with pre-boiled water.
