tgt: Aforika Borwa ke yona e e di gogang kwa pele ka fa kontinenteng ya Aforika fa go tla mo nameng ya diphologolo tsa naga.

src: The strategy seeks to ensure the creation of 202 666 sustainable jobs in the game meat industry by 2030.
tgt: Leano leno le ikaeletse go tlhola ditiro di ka nna 202 666 tse di tla nnelang ruri mo lephateng la intaseteri ya nama ya diphologolo tsa naga mo ngwageng wa 2030.

src: The strategy will be published on the Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment’s website: WEBTOKETourism Sector Master Plan Cabinet has approved the alignment of the Tourism Sector Recovery Plan to a new Tourism Master Plan.
tgt: Leano leno le tla phasaladiwa mo webesaeteng ya Lefapheng la Merero ya Dikgwa, Botshwaro jwa Ditlhapi le ya Tikologo mo go: WEBTOKELeanokonokono la Kgwebo ya Bojanala Kabinete e neseditse pula dikgato tsa go bapisa Leano la go Tsosolosa Lekala la Bojanala le Leanokonokono la Kgwebo ya Bojanala.

src: An important component of the Master Plan is to mitigate the impacts of the COVID-19 pandemic on the tourism sector.
tgt: Karolo e e botlhokwa ya leanokonokono leno ke go samagana le ditlamorago tsa leroborobo la COVID-19 mo lephateng la bojanala.

src: It further provides a road map for full recovery of tourism in the country.
tgt: Le thusa gape le gore naga e itharabologelwe ka botlalo mo lephateng la bojanala.

src: Whereas the Tourism Sector Recovery Plan was developed to facilitate the recovery of the sector, preserve jobs and protect livelihoods, the Master Plan will take this work to another level and facilitate new opportunities in the sector.
tgt: Fela jaaka maitlhomo a Leano la go Tsosolosa Lekala la Bojanala le ne le logetswe go thusa go tsosolosa lekala leno, go somarela ditiro le ditsela tse batho ba iphedisang ka tsona, Leanokonokono leno le logetswe go tsweletsa pele tiro ya leano leno ka go dira gore go nne le ditšhono tse dintšhwa mo lekaleng leno.

src: The plan proposes seven intervention strategies to ensure the tourism sector returns to its glory days, and that it becomes the centre of job creation and entrepreneurship.
tgt: Leano leno le tshitshinya dikgato di le supa go thusa go busetsa lekala la bojanala mo maemong a le neng le le mo go ona mo motsing yoo botshelo bo neng bo itobetsa, mme le dira gore lekala leno le nne botlhokwa mo go tlholeng ditiro le mo go itshimololeleng dikgwebo.

src: The tourism industry is a vital contributor to the economy and had supported 725 000 jobs before the COVID-19 pandemic.
tgt: Intaseteri ya bojanala e na le seabe se se botlhokwa thata mo ikonoming, mme pele ga leroborobo la COVID-19 e ne e eme nokeng ditiro di le 725 000.

src: South African Broadcasting Corporation (SABC) Bill of 2023.
tgt: Molaotlhomo wa Lekgotlakgaso la Aforika Borwa (SABC) wa Ngwaga wa 2023.

src: Cabinet approved the submission of the SABC Bill of 2023 to Parliament.
tgt: Kabinete e neseditse pula dikgato tsa go isa kwa Palamenteng Molaotlhomo wa SABC wa 2023.

src: Once passed into law, the Bill will result in the repeal of the current Broadcasting Act, 1999 (Act 4 of 1999).
tgt: Fa molaotlhomo ono o sena go fetisiwa go ka nna molao wa semmuso, o tla tsena mo legatong la molao wa ga jaana o o bidiwang Molao wa Kgaso wa ngwaga wa 1999 (Molao wa bo 4 wa 1999).

src: The amendments will strengthen the efficiency of the operations of the public broadcaster.
tgt: Dikarolo tse di kwalolotsweng sešwa di tla dira gore ditiro tsa setheo sa kgaso di nne tse di manontlhotlho.

src: The Bill further proposes reforms in the SABC’s funding model and the TV-licensing system.
tgt: Molaotlhomo ono o dira gape le ditshitshinyo mo mererong e e ka ga tlamelo ya SABC ka matlole mmogo le mo go ya dithulaganyo tsa dilaensense tsa thelebišene.

src: Draft Water Services Amendment Bill Cabinet approved the publication of the Water Services Amendment Bill for public comments.
tgt: Sekwalwa se Iseng se Butswe sa Molaotlhomo yo o Kwalolotsweng Sešwa wa Ditirelo tsa Metsi Kabinete e amogetse gore go phasaladiwe Sekwalwa se Iseng se Butswe sa Molaotlhomo yo o Kwalolotsweng Sešwa wa Ditirelo tsa Metsi gore baagi ba ntshe se se mo mafatlheng a bona ka ga ona.

src: The key aims of the Bill are to strengthen accountability for water services providers and to introduce transparency.
tgt: Maitlhomomagolo a Molaotlhomo ono ke go gagamatsa dikgato tsa go nna le maikarabelo ga batlamedi ba ditirelo tsa metsi mmogo le go dira gore mo lephateng leno go se nne mahunelo.

src: The amendments to the Water Services Act, 1997 (Act 108 of 1997) will ensure that water-service providers deliver high-quality water as part of their licensing conditions.
tgt: Dikarolo tse di kwalolotsweng sešwa mo Molaong wa Ditirelo tsa Metsi wa ngwaga wa 1997 (Molao wa bo 108 wa 1997) di tla dira bonnete jwa gore batlamedi ba ditirelo tsa metsi ba abelane ka metsi a maemo a ona a leng boleng jo bo kwa godimo jaaka seno e tla nna karolo ya ditlhokwa tse di beewang mo tumelanong ya go ba neela dilaesense.

src: The amendments will also address weaknesses that have been identified in the water services sector.
tgt: Dikarolo tse di kwalolotsweng sešwa tseno di tla thusa gape le go tswalela makoa a a nopotsweng mo lekaleng la ditirelo tsa metsi.

src: The Bill sets minimum standards for the functioning of water services providers, which must be enforced by Water Services authorities.
tgt: Molaotlhomo ono o tlhoma maemo a batlamedi ba ditirelo tsa metsi ba tshwanetsweng go itepatepanya nao, mme tiro ya go netefatsa gore go itepatepanngwa nao e rwele ke magetla a Setheo sa Ditirelo tsa Metsi.

src: Cabinet approved the publication of the draft National Water Amendment Bill for public comments.
tgt: Sekwalwa se Iseng se Butswe sa Molaotlhomo o o Kwalolotsweng Sešwa wa Metsi a Naga Kabinete e amogetse gore go phasaladiwe Sekwalwa se Iseng se Butswe sa Molaotlhomo o o Kwalolotsweng Sešwa wa Metsi a Naga gore baagi ba ntshe se se mo mafatlheng a bona ka ga ona.

src: The Bill amends the National Water Act, 1998 (Act 36 of 1998).
tgt: Molaotlhomo ono o kwalola sešwa Molao wa Metsi a Naga wa ngwaga wa 1998 (Molao wa bo 36 wa 1998).

src: These amendments will improve regulations and will ensure that the country’s water resources are well managed, protected and conserved.
tgt: Dikarolo tse di kwalolotsweng sešwa di tla thusa go tokafatsa melawanataolo ya metsi mmogo le go dira bonnete jwa gore metsi a naga a tlhokomelwa ka tshwanelo, a sirelediwa mmogo le go somarelwa.

src: The Bill also makes proposals to eliminate the imbalances of the past relating to water allocation, and provides for effective and quicker internal dispute resolution mechanisms.
tgt: Molaotlhomo ono o dira ditshitshinyo tsa gore go fedisiwe go tlhoka tekatekano go go tlhodilweng ke ditiragalo tsa mo nakong e e fetileng tse di ka ga kabelo ya metsi, mme o tshitshinya gore go nne le dikgato tse di matlhagatlhaga tsa go rarabolola ka bonako dikgogakgogano tse di nnang teng magareng ga ditheo tse di dirisanang mmogo.

src: Appointments All appointments are subject to the verification of qualifications and relevant clearance.
tgt: Go Thapiwa Pele batho botlhe ba thapiwa go tla tlhatlhobiwa makwalo a bona a dithuto le ditlankana dingwe tse di tlhokagalang.

src: Mr Kuberndran Moodley as General Manager: Manufacturing and Engineering at the Government Printing Works.
tgt: Rre Kuberndran Moodley o thapilwe go nna Motsamaisimogolo: mo Lekaleng la Tlhagisodikuno le Boenjenere mo Setheong sa Puso sa Bogatisi.

src: Mr Sihle Ngubane as General Manager: Operations Management at the Government Printing Works.
tgt: Rre Sihle Ngubane o thapilwe go nna Motsamaisimogolo: mo Lekaleng la Tsamaiso ya Tiro mo Setheong sa Puso sa Bogatisi.

src: Ms Mmolaeng Mooki as General Manager: Corporate Services at the Government Printing Works.
tgt: Mme Mmolaeng Mooki o thapilwe go nna Motsamaisimogolo: mo Lekaleng la Ditirelo tsa Taolo ya Tsamaiso ya Setheo mo Setheong sa Puso sa Bogatisi.

src: Appointment of non-executive directors to the Board of the South African Special Risk Insurance Association.
tgt: Go thapiwa ga Bakaedi bao e Seng ba Khuduthamaga ba Boto ya Mokgatlho wa Ditlamo tsa Diinšorense tsa Matshosetsi a a Itlhophileng tsa Aforika Borwa.

src: Ms Deshnie Subbiah and.
tgt: Mme Deshnie Subbiah le.

src: Appointment of non-executive directors to the Board of the Development Bank of Southern Africa.
tgt: Go thapiwa ga Bakaedi bao e Seng ba Khuduthamaga ba Boto ya Bankatlhabololo ya Dinaga tsa Borwa jwa Aforika.

src: Mr Bongani Nqwabana (reappointment).
tgt: Rre Bongani Nqwabana (o thapilwe sešwa).

src: Mr Petrus Matji (reappointment).
tgt: Rre Petrus Matji (o thapilwe sešwa).

src: Ms Pinkie Nqeto (reappointment).
tgt: Mme Pinkie Nqeto (o thapilwe sešwa).

src: Mr Jonathan Muthige.
tgt: Rre Jonathan Muthige.

src: Ms Chantal Naidoo.
tgt: Mme Chantal Naidoo.

src: Mr Barry Hore.
tgt: Rre Barry Hore.

src: Mr Joel Netshitenzhe ProfEdgar Pieterse and.
tgt: Rre Joel Netshitenzhe Moporofesara Edgar Pieterse le.

src: Upcoming Events.
tgt: Ditiragalo tse di Tlang.

src: Transport Month This year’s Transport Month will be commemorated under the theme: “Siyakha - Building better infrastructure to grow South Africa”.
tgt: Kgwedi ya Dipalangwa Monongwaga Kgwedi ya go Keteka Dipalangwa e tla ketekiwa ka molaetsamogolo yo o reng: “Re a Aga - Re aga mafaratlhatlha a a botoka thata gore Aforika Borwa e kgone go gola”.

src: Transport Month 2023 will focus on major investments in transport infrastructure, and a call to action to protect transport infrastructure from theft and vandalism.
tgt: Kgwedi ya Dipalangwa ya ngwaga wa 2023 e tla tsepamisa mogopolo mo dipeeletsong tse dikgolo mo lephateng la mafaratlhatlha a dipalangwa, mmogo le mo go direng boikuelo jwa gore mafaratlhatlha a dipalangwa a tlhokomelwe gore a se utswiwe le go phutlhamisiwa.

src: World Teachers’ Day South Africa will join the rest of the world in commemorating World Teachers’ Day on Thursday, 5 October 2023, under the theme: “The teachers we need for the education we want: The global imperative to reverse the teacher shortage”.
tgt: Letsatsi la go Keteka Tiro ya Barutabana Naga ya Aforika Borwa e tla keteka mmogo le lefatshe ka bophara Letsatsi la go Keteka Tiro ya Barutabana ka Labone wa la bo 05 Diphalane 2023 ka molaetsamogolo yo o reng: “Barutabana ba re ba tlhokang go tlisa thuto e re e batlang: dikgato tse di botlhokwa tsa lefatshe ka bophara tsa go dira gore barutabana ba se tlhaele”.Maitlhomo a letsatsi leno ke go lemosa setšhaba, go dira gore se tlhaloganye le go lemoga botlhokwa jo barutabana ba nang le bona mo thutong le mo go tliseng tlhabologo lefatshe ka bophara.

src: The day aims to raise awareness, understanding and appreciation for the vital contribution that teachers make to education and development across the globe.
tgt: Letsatsi leno le utlawnetswe mmogo ke Mokgatlho wa Lefatshe wa Badiri mmogo le Mokgatlho wa Dinagakopano o o ka ga Merero ya Thuto, Saense le Ditso go keteka tiro e e botlhokwa e barutabana ba rona ba e dirang.

src: Messages.
tgt: Melaetsa.

src: CongratulationsCabinet extended its congratulations and well-wishes to: General Bheki Cele, the Minister of Police, who received the Great Wall Commemorative Medal from the People’s Republic of China for the South African Police Service’s contribution to the broader law-enforcement cooperation between the two countries.
tgt: Melaetsa ya go AkgolaKabinete e romela melaetsa ya yona ya go akgola le go eletsa masego kwa go: Rre Bheki Cele, Tona ya Mapodisi, yo a abetsweng Metale wa Tlotlo wa Great Wall go tswa kwa nageng ya China mabapi le go nneng le seabe ga gagwe mo Tirelong ya Sepodisi sa Aforika Borwa (SAPS) mo go dirisaneng le ditheong ka bontsi tsa molao tse di dirisanang le dinaga ka bobedi.

src: Ms Angie Motshekga, the Minister of Basic Education, on being selected by the Secretary-General of the UN, Mr Antonio Guterres, to serve on a Global High-Level Panel to advise him on how countries can transform their education systems.
tgt: Mme Angie Motshekga, Tona ya Thuto ya Motheo, jaaka a tlhophilwe ke Mokwaledikakaretso wa UN Rre Antonio Guterres, gore a nne yo mongwe wa baeletsi ba gagwe ba bagolo mo Setlhopheng sa Merero e e kwa Godimo mo Lefatsheng ba ba mo eletsang ka fao dinaga di ka fetolang ka gone dithulaganyo tsa tsona tsa thuto.

src: The selection of Minister Motshekga into the high-level panel reflects her level of expertise in the field of education and is an expression of confidence on South Africa’s education trajectory.
tgt: Go tlhophiwa ga Tona Motshekga mo Setlhopheng sa Merero e e kwa Godimo mo Lefatsheng go supa kitso e e tseneletseng e a nang le yona mo thutong e bile seno ke sesopu sa go bontsha tshepo mo dikgatong tsa thuto tse Aforika Borwa e di WEBTOKEN setlhopheng seno go na le baemedi go tswa kwa Mokgatlhong wa Lefatshe wa Badiri, Setlhopha sa Barutabana sa Mokgatlho wa Dinagakopano o o ka ga Merero ya Thuto, Saense le Ditso, Mokgatlho wa Lefatshe wa Badiri mmogo le Ditona di le tharo tsa Thuto.

src: The panel was co-chaired by two former Presidents.
tgt: Setlhopha seno se tla etelelwa pele ke Baporesitente ba mo malobeng ba le babedi.

src: Cape Town Film Studios, local actors and stunt performers, for their work on the Netflix series, One Piece, that rocketed to number one worldwide on the online streaming platform.
tgt: Disetudio tsa kwa Motse Kapa tsa Metshameko ya Difilimi, batshameko ba ka fa nageng mmogo le bao ba diragatsang ditiro tse di masisi mo legatong la batshameki, jaaka ba dirile bontle mo Metshamekong ya ditshwatsho tsa Netflix, mo setshwantsho sa One Piece, se tlhatlogetseng kwa maemong a ntlha a a kwa godimo a setshwantsho se se bogelwang ga jaana ke batho ba bantsi mo diraleng tse di gasang ditshwantsho tse di bogelwang.

src: Van Ryn's Distillery, for being awarded the World's Best Brandy trophy for its 12-year-old potstill brandy at the 2023 International Spirits Challenge in London.
tgt: Setlamo sa go titiela dinotagi sa Van Ryn's, jaaka kwa moletlong wa ngwaga wa 2023 wa dikgaisana tsa dinotagi o o neng o tshwaretswe kwa London, se abetswe terofi ya maemo a a kwa godimo ka ntlha ya bojalwa jwa bona jo bo bogale jwa porenti e e titieletsweng sebaka sa dingwaga di le 12 ka fa nkgong.

src: Condolences Cabinet expressed condolences to the family and friends of: Mr Aziz Goolam Hoosein Pahad (82), the former anti-apartheid activist who was the first South African democratic government Deputy Minister of Foreign Affairs from 1994 to 2008.Lieutenant Commander Gillian Elizabeth Hector, Master Warrant Officer William Masela Mathipa, and Warrant Officer Class One Mmokwapa Lucas Mojela, who died in the line of duty while aboard the submarine, SAS Manthatisi, off Kommetjie in the Western Cape.
tgt: Melaetsa ya Matshediso Kabinete e romela matshediso a yona kwa ba lelapa le ditsala tsa: Rre Aziz Goolam Hoosein Pahad (82), yo e neng e le molwelakgololesego kgatlhanong le puso ya tlhaolele yo gape e nnileng ene Motlatsatona wa ntlha mo pusong ya temokerasi ya Aforika Borwa go ka tsorama maemo ano mo Lefapheng la Merero ya Tirisanommogo le Dinaga tsa Boditšhaba go simolola ka ngwaga wa 1994 go fitlha ka 2008.Lieutenant Commander Gillian Elizabeth Hector, Master Warrant Officer William Masela Mathipa, mmogo le Warrant Officer Class One Mmokwapa Lucas Mojela, ba ba tlhokafetseng ba le mo letsholong la tiro fa ba ne ba le ka fa teng ga sekepe se se thumelang ka fa gare ga mpa ya lewatle se se bediwang, SAS Manthatisi, kwa ntle ga lefelo la Kommetjie kwa lewatleng la porofense ya Kapa Bophirima.

src: the 22 mineworkers from the Venetia Diamond Mine in Limpopo, who died in a road accident in Musina (Vhembe District).Ms Zoleka Mandela (43), author and activist, and the granddaughter of anti-apartheid heroes Nelson Mandela and Winnie Madikizela-Mandela.
tgt: Badiredi ba moepo ba le 22 ba ba neng ba direla Moepo wa Venetia Diamond, ba ba tlhokafetseng mo kotsing ya sejanaga se ba neng ba se nametse kwa Musina (kwa Tikologong ya Vhembe).Mme Zoleka Mandela (43), yo e neng e le mokwadi, molwelakgaratlho wa balwetse ba kankere e bile gape e le setlogolo sa ga balwelakgaratlho ba ba neng ba le kgatlhanong le puso ya tlhaolele e bong Nelson Mandela le Winnie Madikizela-Mandela.

src: Issues in the environment 2023 Rugby World Cup Champions Cabinet congratulated the Springboks on their 2023 Rugby World Cup victory that made South Africa the only country to win the Rugby World Cup four (4) times and second to win the title back-to-back.
tgt: Merero ya ga Jaanong Bagale ba Sejana sa Lefatshe sa Metshameko ya Rakabi ya Ngwaga wa 2023 Kabinete e akgotse setlhopha sa di-Springbok jaaka se fentse Sejana sa Lefatshe sa Metshameko ya Rakabi ya Ngwaga wa 2023 mme phenyo eno e dirile gore Aforika Borwa e nne yona naga e le esi mo lefatsheng go ka fenya makgetlo a le mane Sejana sa Lefatshe sa Metshameko ya Rakabi mme e bile gape setlhopha seno se fentse sejana seno ka tlhomagano makgetlo a le mabedi.

src: In the history of rugby in South Africa, this Springboks team is the most diverse in terms of the demographics representation of South Africa.
tgt: Fa e sale go nna le rakabi mo nageng ya Aforika Borwa setlhopha seno sa di-Springbok ke sona sa ntlha se se emetsweng ke batshameki ba merafe e e farologaneng ya naga ya Aforika Borwa.

src: The composition of such a diverse team was not an act of coincidence, but a deliberate effort by the management and coaching staff of the Springboks to select an inclusive team.
tgt: Gore setlhopha seno se rulaganngwe ka mokgwa o se leng ka ona ga se ka ntlha ya lesego, ke ka ntlha ya ditshweetso tse di totobetseng tse balaodi le bakatisi ba di tsereng ba butse matlho mo ba neng ba batla gore di-Springbok di emelwe ke setlhopha sa merafe e e farologaneng.

src: That bold decision by then coach Rassie Erasmus and his team continues to demonstrate to South Africans and the rest of the world, that everyone with skill, if given a chance and support, can become great – an affirmation that we are Stronger Together.
tgt: Tshweetso e e nonofileng e e tserweng ke mokatisi wa mo malobeng Rassie Erasmus mmogo le setlhopha se se neng se mo eme nokeng e tswelela go iponagatsa mo go maAforika Borwa le mo lefatsheng ka bophara gore motho yo mongwe le yo mongwe yo a nang le bokgoni, fa a ka neelwa tšhono le go enngwa nokeng, a ka kgona go ntsha ga tshwene – mme seno ke bontlha bongwe jo bo totobatsang boammaruri jwa gore Re le Ngatananngwe ga go se se ka re Tsenang fa Gare.

src: Most importantly, the resilience and determination of the Springboks in the field of play is an embodiment of a true essence of being South African, that which makes this great nation rise against all odds and adversities to emerge victorious.
tgt: Se se botlhokwa go gaisa ke ka fao batshameki ba di-Springbok ba neng ba kakatletse ka teng mo lebaleng fa ba ne ba tshameka e leng sesupo sa go nna moAforika Borwa tota, e leng sona se se dirang gore naga eno ya baganka e atlege le go finyelela le fa e tobane le dikgwetlho tsa dinta di fuduga.

src: Some of the best players of this Springboks team have had to overcome personal adversities on their path to greatness.
tgt: Ba bangwe ba batshameki ba ba dirileng bontle mo setlhopheng seno sa di-Springbok ba ne ba itshokela dikgwetlho mo matshelong a bona gore ba kgone go atlega.

src: Cabinet expressed its congratulations to Siyamtanda “Siya” Kolisi, the Springboks double World Cup-winning captain for leading the team to the Greatest of All Time (GOAT) status and the celebrations must go-on.
tgt: Kabinete e akgotse Siyamtanda “Siya” Kolisi, mokapotene wa setlhopha sa di-Springbok sa go fenya gabedi ka tatelano Sejana sa Lefatshe jaaka a eteletse kwa pele setlhopha seno gore se kgone go fenya maemo a a iseng a tle a bonwe mme ka ntlha ya seno re tshwanetse go se kgaotse go keteka tiro e ntle eno.

src: AGOA Forum Cabinet had welcomed the confirmation by both the United States administration and congress on the intention to extend AGOA, which brings certainty to the investment community in the AGOA-eligible countries.
tgt: Kopano ya AGOA Kabinete e neseditse pula mafoko a puso ya Amerika mmogo le a palamente ya yona a go totobatsa gore ba ikemiseditse go oketsa nako ya go nna mo tirisong ga Molao wa Kgato ya go Oketsa Ditšhono tsa go Godisa Ikonomi ya Aforika (AGOA), mme seno se tla digela matswalo a bao ba batlang go ka beeletsa mo dinageng tse di nang le matshwanedi a go unngwelwa ke AGOKabinete e neseditse pula gape le go neelwa tetla ya go tshwara Kopano ya AGOA ya 2023 kwa Johannesburg go tloga ka la bo 2 go fitlha ka la bo 4 Ngwanaitseele 2023 mme e tla tsenelwa ke bannaleseabe go tswa kwa dinageng di le 32 tsa Aforika mo maphateng a puso, kgwebo, mme lekgetlho la ntlha fa e sale go tla bo go na le mekgatlho ya baagi le mekgatlho ya badiri mmogo le batlhankedi ba puso ya naga ya Amerika.

src: Cabinet had also welcomed the hosting of the 2023 AGOA Forum in Johannesburg from the 2nd – 4th November 2023 with participants from 32 Africa countries from government, Business, civil society and organised labour for the first time and representatives of the United States government.
tgt: Kabinete ga e a bolo go ema ka lefoko le le reng AGOA e naya Amerika tšhono ya go ka ema ka dintsetsenkwano go thusa ikonomi ya Aforika mme ka jalo go matshwanedi gore e okelediwe nako gore e nne mo tirisong sebaka se se utlwagalang, mme e atlaatlhiwe gore e kgone go nna le seabe se se utlwagalang mmogo le go ngokela.

src: Cabinet has always asserted that AGOA provides an opportunity for the United States of America to strengthen its economic relationship with Africa and thus it must be extended for a meaningful period, enhanced to make it impactful and attractive.
tgt: Kopano ya Ditona tsa Bojanala mo Dinageng tsa BRICS Kabinete e neseditse pula dikgato tsa go garela ka katlego Kopano ya Ngwaga wa 2023 ya Ditona tsa Bojanala mo Dinageng tsa BRICS e e neng e tshwaretswe kwa Motsekapa, mme kopano eno e lopile dinaga tse e leng leloko go oketsa tirisanommogo ya tsona ka go rotloetsa go jelana nala ga batho ba dinaga tsa BRICS, go aga mebila gore go etelana le go golagana ga dinaga tse e leng leloko e nne selo se se botlhofo.

src: This will further strengthen South Africa’s tourism sector which is already showing signs of recovery.
tgt: Seno se tla gagamatsa lephata la bojanala la naga ya Aforika Borwa jaaka le setse le ntse le itharabologelwa.

src: For the first 8 months of 2023, the country saw million arrivals which represented a 63.4% increase from the same period in 2022.
tgt: Mo dikgweding di le robedi tsa ntlha tsa ngwaga wa 2023, re bone ka fa nageng go goroga bajanala ba le dimilione di le tlhano le halofo mme palo eno e lekana le koketsego ya bokana ka diphesente di le 63.4% go tloga mo go tsa yona paka eno mo ngwageng wa 2022.

src: Voter Registration The IEC has announced the 18th and 19th of November 2023 as a first voter registration weekend for the 2024 General Elections.
tgt: Go Ikwadisetsa go Tlhopha Khomišene e e Ikemetseng ya Ditlhopho (IEC) e tsibositse gore ka la bo 18 le la bo 19 Ngwanaitseele 2023 e tla bo e le matsatsi a bokhutlho jwa beke jwa ntlha a go ikwadisetsa go tlhopha mo Ditlhophong tsa ngwaga wa 2024.

src: Cabinet is calling on all eligible voters to register to vote for the 2024 General Elections at your nearest voting stations.
tgt: Kabinete e ikuela mo bathong botlhe ba ba nang le matshwanedi a go tlhopha go ikwadisetsa go tlhopha mo Ditlhophong tsa ngwaga wa 2024 ka go leba kwa mafelong a ditlhopho a mo metseng ya bona.

src: Online voter registration has been opened since February 2023 and citizens are urged to use the facility to register or update their details.
tgt: Serala sa go ikwadisetsa ditlhopho ka inthanete ga se a bolo go bula ka Tlhakole 2023 mme baagi go ikuelwa mo go bona go sola mosola serala seno ka go ikwadisa mo go sona kgotsa ka go tsenya dintlha tsa bona mo dinakong.

src: South Africans who have applied for their IDs are encouraged to visit their local Home Affairs office to collect them.
tgt: MaAforika Borwa a a dirileng dikopo tsa makwaloitshupo go ikuelwa mo go bona go leba kwa dikantorong tsa Merero ya Selegae go di lata.

src: There are more than 500 000 smart ID cards still to be collected atHome Affairs offices across the country.
tgt: Go santse go na le makwaloitshupo a feta a le 500 000 a a santseng a tlhoka beng ba ona go tla go a tsaya kwa dikantorong ya Merero ya Selegae go ralala le naga ka bophara.

src: Electricity The Minister in the Presidency responsible for Electricity has provided a comprehensive briefing on electricity situation in the country.
tgt: Motlakase Tona mo Kantorong ya Moporesitente e e rweleng maikarabelo mo kantorong ya Tona ya Merero ya Motlakase o buile go tlala molomo ka maemo a motlakase ka fa nageng.

src: Cabinet applauded efforts by the Gauteng Provincial Government working with Eskom to restore electricity to areas in Gauteng that have been hit by black-outs due to the theft or damage to transformers.
tgt: Kabinete e akgotse Puso ya Porofense ya Gauteng jaaka e dirisana le setlamo sa Eskom gore ba busetse motlakase kwa mafelong a a kgaoletsweng motlakase a kwa Gauteng ka ntlha ya go utswiwa kgotsa go senyega ga diteransefomara tsa motlakase.

src: Last night, six new electrical transformers were switched in Kagiso, in the West Rand area after communities were left without power for more than 3 years.
tgt: Maabane bosigo go letswe go tshumilwe diteransefomara tsa motlakase tse dintšhwa di le thataro kwa Kagiso, mo kgaolong ya West Rand morago ga gore baagi ba foo ba fetse dingwaga di le tharo ba se na motlakase.

src: Cabinet calls on these communities to protect the critical infrastructure from theft, vandalism and damage that is caused by illegal connections.
tgt: Kabinete e ikuela mo baaging bano go tlhokomela mafaratlhatlha ano a a botlhokwa gore a se utswiwe ke magodu, ba se a senye bona ka bo bona ka ntlha ya fa ba batla go itsenyetsa motlakase go se mo molaong.

src: Food Poisoning Cabinet is concerned by the spate of food poisoning of children from eating expired and contaminated foodstuff from spaza shops and street vendors.
tgt: Dijo tse di nang le botlhole Kabinete e tshwenyegile thata ka dintsho tse di ganang go fela tsa bana ba ba nnye ba ba fetsang ke dijo tse di feletsweng ke nako le tse di kgotlhelegileng tse ba di rekang kwa mabentleleng a di-spaza le mo bathong ba ba rekisang mo mebileng.

src: Cabinet is encouraged by the law enforcement efforts to enforce food safety compliance.
tgt: Kabinete e tiisitswe maatla ke dikgato tse ditheo tsa molao di di tsereng mo go direng gore go obamelwe melao e e buang ka tlhokomelo ya dijo.

src: International Migration Workshop with Mayors and Traditional leaders Cabinet was briefed about the international migration workshop hosted by the Department of Home Affairs with the participation of the DSBD, COGTA, Human Settlements and traditional leaders and mayors from metro and district municipalities that focused on curbing effects of illegal immigration, including the operations of spaza shops.
tgt: Kopano ya go Tlhatlhelela Dimeyara le Magosi ka Phudugelo ya Baditšhaba Kabinete e tsibositswe ka Kopano ya go Tlhatlhelela Dimeyara le Magosi ka Phudugelo ya Baditšhaba e e neng e tshwerwe ke Lefapha la Merero ya Selegae mo Lefapha la Thuso ya Dikgwebopotlana (DSBD), la Pusotshwaraganelo le Merero ya Setso (CoGTA), le la Bonno jwa Batho ba nnileng le seabe mmogo le magosi le dimeyara tsa diteropokgolo le tsa dikgaolo ba atlhaatlhileng kgang ya gore ba ka fokotsa jang ditiragalo tsa batho ba ba tlang ka fa nageng go se mo molaong, mmogo le ona mabenkele a di-spaza.

src: Key outcomes include the introduction of omnibus by-laws to address challenges relating to the enforcement of business by-laws by municipalities and traditional authorities.
tgt: Dintlha tse di botlhokwa tse di tswileng foo ke go tsenya tirisong matsholo a sekaseka mabenkele go bona gore a obamela melao ya dimasepala le ya magosi.

src: There will be immediate joint inspections of businesses, in particular spaza shops by the departments of labour, health, small business development and the Home Affairs immigration inspectorate teams, to enforce compliance with applicable laws An audit of spaza shops in villages and townships, and mechanisms to register them by both traditional leaders and municipalities will be undertaken.
tgt: Go tla simololwa ka gangwe matsholo a go phuruphutsa dikgwebo, segolobogolo dikgwebo tsa di-spaza mme tiro eno e tla diriwa ke ba lefapha la merero ya ditiro, la boitekanelo, la thuso ya dikgwebopotlana mmogo le la merero ya selegae leo le tla bong le emetswe ke batlhankedi ba go phuruphutsa ditokomane tsa go tsena ka fa nageng, mme seno se tla dira bonnete jwa gore go ikobelwa melao ya naga e e leng teng.

src: There are also efforts to support traditional authorities to keep a record of foreign nationals in their communities.
tgt: Go tla tsewa dikgato tsa go sekaseka mabentlele a di-spaza a a butsweng kwa metseselegaeng le kwa makeišeneng, mme go tla nna le ditsela tse di tsenngwang tirisong tsa go kwadisa dikgwebo tseno mo dikantorong tsa magosi kgotsa tsa dimasepala.

src: Business licencing legislation is being amended to support all those who wish to trade in the informal sector.
tgt: Go na gape le dikgato tsa go ema nokeng ditshwetso tsa gore magosi a nne le rekoto ya gore batho ba ba nnang foo ba tswa kwa dinageng tsa kwa ntle ke bo mang.

src: Integrated Crime Fighting Cabinet commends the SAPS for dealing a massive blow to international drug syndicates following the discovery of cocaine valued at R80 million which were seized on 20 October 2023 at a warehouse at the Dube Trade Port within the King Shaka International Airport.
tgt: Go samaganwe le go kwalola sešwa molao wa go rebola dilaesense tsa dikgwebo gore o kgone go ema nokeng batho botlhe ba ba batlang go simolola dikgwebo tse di sa kwadisiwang.

src: Two days prior the seizure, another R70 million worth of cocaine was also seized from a container at the Durban Harbour.
tgt: Letsholo le le Tshwaraganetsweng la go Lwantshana le Bosenyi Kabinete e akgotse Tirelo ya Mapodisi a Aforika Borwa (SAPS) ka tsela eo e phuagantseng ditiragalo tsa digongwana tsa bogodu tsa go gweba ka diritibatse ka ntlha ya go utolola le go thopa diritibatsi tse di ka balelwang go R80 milione ka la bo 20 Diphalane 2023 kwa lefelong la go tlhokomela dithoto la Dube Trade Port kwa Boemelafofaneng jwa Difofane tsa Boditšhabatšhaba jwa King Shaka.

src: Cabinet applauds the SAPS for their work in disrupting and dismantling transnational organised crime that poses a significant threat to our communities and the nation.
tgt: Kabinete e akgotse SAPS ka tiro e ba e dirileng mo go latlhiseng motlhala bosenyi jo bo tsamaisanang le magodu a dinaga tsa boditšhaba jaaka seno se wisetsa baagi ba rona le naga ya rona ka digegi.

src: Operation Safer Festive Season is already yielding results with police arresting over 140 suspects, including an alleged illegal mining kingpin, and seizing unlicensed firearms.
tgt: Letsholo la Tshireletsego mo Pakeng ya Matsatsi a Dikeresemose le setse le re tswela mosola mo re boneng mapodisi a golega babelaelwa ba feta ba le 140, go tsenyeletsa le mmelaelwa yo a latofadiwang ka gore ke ene komang ka nna wa ditiragalo tsa bogodu jwa dirašwa, mmogo le go thopa ditlhobolo tse di seng mo molaong.

src: Presidential Oversight Visit Cabinet welcomed the Presidential Oversight Visit to the Emfuleni Municipality, which followed-up on engagements with the community during the District Development Model visit of 2022.
tgt: Leeto la Moporesitente la go Lekola Maemo Kabinete e neseditse pula Leeto la Moporesitente la go Lekola Maemo kwa Masepaleng wa Emfuleni, mme mo leetong leno Moporesitente o ne a ikgata motlhala morago ga gore a tsee leeto la ntlha la Leano la Tiragatso ya Kabo ya Ditirelo le le Ikaegileng ka Ditikologo mo ngwageng wa 2022.

src: The 2022 visit to Emfuleni identified issues of poor infrastructure maintenance by the municipality Through the intervention of the Department of Water and Sanitation, there has been notable progress in addressing water and sanitation infrastructure challenges that had resulted in the collapse of the Vaal Waste Water system.
tgt: Mo leetong la ngwaga wa 2022 kwa Emfuleni go nopotswe dikgwetlho tse di tsamaisanang le masepala jaaka o sa tlhokomele mafaratlhatlha.

src: Work has been undertaken to improve water supply, the proper functioning of the waste water infrastructure and thus eliminating the problem of the sewer effluent that run running on the streets and people’s yards.
tgt: Ka ntlha ya go thusiwa ke Lefapha la Metsi le Kgeleloleswe, jaanong go na le ponelopele ya gore go lebilwe kae mo go rarabololeng matsapa a metsi le kgeleloleswe a a dirileng gore Bodutelo jwa go Tlhatswa Metsi a a Leswe jwa Vaal bo phutlhame.

src: Noted progress during the visit include improvements in critical bulk pipelines and water pump stations, resurfacing and resealing of roads, and a massive rollout of streetlights to improve lighting and safety.
tgt: Go setse go simolotswe ka tiro ya go baakanya tlamelo ya metsi, go dira gore bodutelo jwa go tlhatswa metsi a a letswe bo dire ka tshwanelo le go fedisa matsapa a kgelelolese gore re se nne le mantle a a gasaganeng mo mebileng le mo malapeng a batho.

src: Roadmap for the Freight Logistics System in South Africa The Department of Transport has commenced consultations on the Roadmap for the Freight Logistics System in South Africa, as part of measures to address the challenges facing the freight and logistics sector and the strengthening of South Africa’s economic recovery efforts.
tgt: Seo go bonagetseng e kete go na le kgatelopele mo teng ke dipeipi tse dikgolo tsa metsi mmogo le diteišene tsa dipompo tsa metsi, go tsosoloswa le go tshelwa ga dikontiri, mmogo le matsholo a magolo a go tsenya mabone mo mebileng gore go nne le lesedi le gore go nne le pabalesego.

src: Infrastructure Development and Maintenance Cabinet welcomed the progress being made with infrastructure development and maintenance with the completion of 36 rural bridges under the Welisizwe Rural Bridges, and the construction underway on 20 projects in human settlements, roads, and water.
tgt: Leano la Tsamaiso ya Dithoto la Ditlamo tsa Naga ya Aforika Borwa Lefapha la Dipalangwa le setse le boloditse letsholo la go batla maikutlo a Ditlamo tsa Naga ya Aforika Borwa tsa Tsamaiso ya Dithoto, jaaka seno e le karolo ya dikgato tse di tsewang go rarabolola dikgwetlho tse di tobaneng le lephata la tsamaiso ya dithoto mmogo le go matlafatsa maiteko a go busetsa sekeng maemo a ikonomi ya Aforika Borwa sekeng.

src: Relaunch of South African Airways (SAA) international routes Cabinet welcomed the relaunch of SAA international routes with the re-introduction of its intercontinental flight to São Paulo, Brazil, which also marked the return of the long-haul service out of Cape Town and Johannesburg.
tgt: Kago le Tlhokomelo ya Mafaratlhatlha Kabinete e neseditse pula kgatelopele e e diriwang mabapi le go agiwa le go tlhokomelwa ga mafaratlhatlha mo go setseng go konoseditswe diporojeke tsa go agiwa ga maborogo a le 36 kwa metseselegaeng ka letsholo la Mborogo a Metseselegae la Welisizwe, mmogo le matsholo a go samaganweng nao a diporojeke di le 20 tsa go aga dintlo, ditsela le mafaratlhatlha a metsi.

src: The return of SAA in the international routes will contribute directly in driving growth in international travel to the country, and growth of the tourism sector after the ravages of the Covid-19 pandemic.
tgt: Go Bulwa Sešwa ga Mebila ya go Leba kwa Dinageng tsa Boditšhabatšhaba ka Difofane tsa Naga ya Aforika Borwa Kabinete e neseditse pula dikgato tsa go bulwa Sešwa ga Mebila ya SAA go Leba kwa Dinageng tsa Boditšhabatšhaba mmogo le go busediwa tirong gape ga difofane tsa yona tsa mebila ya ka fa kontinenteng go leba kwa São Paulo, Brazil, mme seno se tshwaile gape le go busediwa tirong ga ditirelo tsa maeto a matelele a go tloga kwa Motse Kapa go leba kwa Johannesburg.

src: South Africa launches the largest drone in Africa Cabinet congratulated the Defence and aerospace company Milkor on their successful launch of the Milkor 380 unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV), which places South Africa among the countries that continue to make strides in drone technology.
tgt: Go busediwa tirong ga maeto a go leba kwa dinageng tsa boditšhabatšhaba ga SAA go tla nna le seabe mo go godiseng kgolo mo maetong a boditšhabatšhaba a go leba ka fa nageng, mmogo le go godisa lephata la bojanala go latela gore le phuaganngwe ke leroborobo la COVID-19.

src: The Milkor 380 is the largest drone built in Africa and it will be used by the defence industry for combat, border control, conservation efforts including to combat poaching.
tgt: Aforika Borwa e Thankgolola Terouno e Kgolo go Gaisa tsa Dinaga tse Dingwe tsa Aforika Kabinete e akgotse Sesole sa yona mmogo le setlamo sa go aga difofane sa Milkor jaaka ba atlegile mo go thankgololeng sefofane se se okomelang maemo se le kwa godimo (UAV) se se bediwang Milkor 380, mme seno se raya gore naga ya Aforika Borwa ke e nngwe ya dinaga tse di ntshang ga tshwene fa go tla mo go thekenolojing ya difofane tsa diterouno.

src: Matric and Year-end schools examinations Cabinet welcomed the smooth start to the 2023 National Senior Certificate (matric) exams, which commenced on 30 October 2023.
tgt: Milkor 380 ke terouno e kgolo e e iseng e tle e agiwe ka fa kontinenteng ya Aforika mme e tla dirisiwa ke sesole mo dintweng, mo go diseng melelwane, mo go tlhokomeleng tlhago mmogo le mo go lwantshaneng le polao ya diphologolo tsa naga.

src: Parents and guardians are encouraged to continue to support learners during this critical period.
tgt: Batsadi le bagodisi ba bana ba rotloediwa go tswelela go ema barutwana nokeng mo pakeng e e botlhokwa eno.

src: Cabinet also sends its well wishes to all the learners who will be sitting for their year-end exams.
tgt: Kabinete e eletsa gape masego le barutwana ba bangwe botlhe ba ba tla bong ba kwala ditlhatlhobo tsa bona tsa bokhutlho jwa ngwaga.

src: Cabinet decisions The Situation in Palestine Cabinet is disappointed by the refusal of the Israeli government to respect international law and its continued undermining of the United Nations resolutions for the implementation of a ceasefire with impunity.
tgt: Ditshwetso tsa Kabinete Seemo sa kwa Palestina Kabinete e swabile nko go feta molomo ke maitsholo a puso ya Iseraele a go gana go ikobela melao ya lefatshe jaaka e tswelela go bontsha lenyatso le le feletseng mo ditshweetsong tse di tserweng ke Dinagakopano tsa go fedisa ntwa e e runtseng koo.

src: The humanitarian corridors for the people of Palestine remain closed with dire consequences for children, women and innocent civilians.
tgt: Ditirelo tsa go thusa baagi ba Palestina ba ba leng mo tlalelong di santse di tswaleletswe ke puso ya Iseraele, mme seno ga se jese diwelang mo baneng, basading le mo baaging ba ba senang molato.

src: The genocidal airstrikes by the government of Israel on the people of Palestine, continue with rising death toll that include women and children.
tgt: Polao ya Mapalestina e kete ke ditshenekegi ba bolawa ka difofane ke puso ya Iseraele e santse e tswelela mo dipalo tsa batho ba ba bolawang di tlhatlogang e bile di tsenyeletsang basadi le bana.

src: In the last two days, the world have sat helplessly and watched as intensifying airstrikes on Gaza and the West Bank have destroyed schools, health facilities, ambulances and civilian infrastructure and supposedly safe roads travelling to the South of Gaza.
tgt: Mo matsatsing a le mabedi fela a a fetileng lefatshe le ne le itshwere ditlhogo le lebeletse difofane di tlhasela metse ya kwa Gaza le kwa West Bank mo go phampholotsweng dikolo, maokelo, dijanaga tsa balwetse le mafaratlhatlha a baagi mmogo le ditsela e leng dilo tse di neng di tshwanetse go bo di sa kgomiwe e bile di babalesegile ka ntlha ya fa e le dilo tse di sa tshwanelang go tlhaselwa kwa kgaolong ya Borwa jwa Gaza.

src: For these, the Cabinet has decided to recall all South African diplomats from Tel Aviv for consultation.
tgt: Ka ntlha ya tiragalo eno, Kabinete e tsere tshweetso ya go laela diambasatara tsotlhe tsa naga ya Aforika Borwa go phuthaphutha sengwe le sengwe sa puso eno kwa Tel Aviv go boela gae gore ba tle go itlhalosa sentle gore matsapa di a tsaya kae.

src: Cabinet has also noted with disquiet the continuing disparaging remarks of the Israeli’s ambassador to South Africa, Mr. Eliav Belotsercovsky, against South Africans, the leadership of South Africa both in and outside government including civil society who are speaking against the holocaust being committed by the Israeli government against the Palestinians.
tgt: Kabinete e nopotse gape le dipuo tse di swabisang nko tse di tswang mo molomong wa moabasatara wa naga ya Iseraele tse di ka ga naga ya Aforika Borwa, e bong Rre Eliav Belotsercovsky, yo a buang kgattlhanong le Aforika Borwa, le boeteledipele jwa Aforika Borwa fa a bua a le mo maemong a gagwe a puso le fa a bua a sa emela maemo a gagwe a puso yo a ganetsang gore se se diriwang ke puso ya Iseraele mo baaging ba Palestina ga se tshwane le seo Puso ya Jeremane e kileng ya se dira baagi ba Majuta.

src: The disparaging remarks of Ambassador Belotsercovsky are contrasted by the statements of two former Israeli ambassadors to South Africa (Illan Baruch and Dr. Alon Liel) who have been consistent in describing the actions of their government against Palestinians as Apartheid.
tgt: Dipuopuo tsa ga Moabasatara Belotsercovsky ga di tsamaisane ka gope le tseo di tswang mo melomong ya diambasatara di le pedi tsa mo nakong e e fetileng tsa Iseraele tse di neng di emetse naga ya tsona ka fa nageng ya Aforika Borwa (mme bona ke Illan Baruch mmogo le Ngaka Alon Liel) mme bona ba ne ba totobetse ka le le reng seo puso ya bona e se dirang mo go Mapalestina ga se farologane ka gope le seo puso ya tlhaolele e neng e se dira.

src: The disparaging remarks against those speaking up against the atrocities and the country’s leaders make ambassador Belotsercovsky position more and more untenable.
tgt: Dipuopuo tsa moambasatara yono tse di emang kgatlhanong le bao ba ntshang maikutlo a bona ka seo se sa itumediseng seo se diriwang ke baeteledipele ba naga eo se dira gore go se tlhole go nna le pelotelele ya go itshokela moambasatara Belotsercovsky.

src: As such Cabinet has directed the Department of International Relations and Cooperation to convey the South African government displeasure with the ambassador formally through diplomatic channels.
tgt: Mme ka ntlha ya seno, Kabinete e laetse Lefapha la Dikamano le Tirisano le Dinaga tsa Boditšhaba go begela moamasatara yono semmuso ka fao puso ya Aforika Borwa e swabisiwang ke dipuopuo tsa gagwe mme e dire jalo ka go latela dikgato tsa semmuso tsa setipolomate.

src: Medium Term Budget Policy Statement Cabinet welcomed the 2023 Medium Term Budget Policy Statement (MTBPS), which provided a frank assessment of the current economic climate and demonstrated government’s firm hold on our nation’s finances amid tough revenue constraints.
tgt: Puo ya Pholisi ya Tekanyetsokabo ya Kgweditharo (MTBPS) Kabinete e neseditse pula MTBPS ya ngwaga wa 2023, e e neng e baya mo pepeneneng maemo a ikonomi a re leng mo go ona mme e bontshitse le ka fao puso e kakatletseng ka gone mo mererong ya matlole a naga le fa go ntse go le boima mo go direng letseno.

src: The decisions in the MTBPS improve our fiscal framework stimulate economic growth while balancing our social commitments that support the vulnerable in our nation.
tgt: Ditshwetso tse di tserweng mo go MTBPS di tla tokafatsa matlole a rona, tsa godisa ikonomi mmogo le go re thusa gore re diragatse ditsholofetso tsa rona mo go tlhokomeleng baagi ba ba tlhokang ditlogo ka fa nageng.

src: The Economic Reconstruction and Recovery Plan has contributed to many green shoots in our economy.
tgt: Leano la Itharabologelo le Kagosešwa ya Ikonomi le thusitse dikarolo di le dintsi mo ikonoming ya rona.

src: High Speed Rail Development Cabinet approved the High Speed Rail Development Framework and the financial implications for implementation will be discussed between the Ministers of Transport and Finance Cabinet approved the prioritisation of the Johannesburg to Durban corridor for a detailed feasibility study, and the Johannesburg-Polokwane to Musina, and the Johannesburg to Mbombela will be put to the market.
tgt: Go Agiwa ga Diterene tse di Tsamayang ka Lebelo Kabinete e neseditse pula Leano la go Tsamaisa Tiro ya Go Agiwa ga Diterene tse di Tsamayang ka Lebelo mme Tona ya Matlole mmogo le ya Dipalangwa ba tla atlhaatlha kgang ya gore go tla tlhokagala matlole a le kanakang.

src: The draft Policy aims to provide a framework to guide the granting of residency and citizenship to foreign nationals, as well as the protection of refugees and asylum seekers in South Africa, cognisant of the Republic’s national security interests and in compliance with international agreements and protocols on migration that South Africa is party to.
tgt: Kabinete e neseditse pula dikgato tsa go simolola ka diporo tsa go tloga kwa Johannesburg go leba kwa Durban gore go diriwe dipatlisiso tse di tseneletseng tsa gore go ka tlhokagala eng, mmogo le tsa go tloga kwa Johannesburg go leba kwa Polokwane le go fetela kwa Musina, mmogo le tsa Johannesburg go leba kwa Mbombela.

src: The 6th Annual Progress Report on the implementation of the White Paper on the Rights of People with Disabilities Cabinet has approved for publication in the government gazette the 6th Annual Progress Report on the implementation of the White Paper on the Rights of People with Disabilities.
tgt: Sekwalwa se Iseng se Butswe sa Masupatsela se se Buang ka go Bona Ditshwanelo tsa go Nna Moagi, Mofaladi le Tlhokomelo ya Batho ba ba Tshabetseng ka fa Nageng Kabinete e neseditse pula dikgato tsa go phasalatsa Sekwalwa se Iseng se Butswe sa Masupatsela se se Buang ka go Bona Ditshwanelo tsa go Nna Moagi, Mofaladi le Tlhokomelo ya Batho ba ba Tshabetseng ka fa Nageng gore baagi ba dire ditshwaelo ka ga sona.

src: The publication of the progress report will coincide with the international commemoration of the Disability Rights Awareness Month from 3 November to 3 December.
tgt: Sekwalwa se Iseng se Butswe seno maitlhomo a sona ke go tla ka ditsela tse dintšhwa tsa go neela baagi ba dinaga tsa kwa ntle ditshwanelo tsa go nna baagi ba naga eno, mmogo le tsa go tlhokomela bafaladi le batho ba ba tshabetseng ka fa nageng ya Aforika Borwa, mme seno ga se ree gore go tla itlhokomoloswa melao ya pabalesego ya naga mmogo le go tswelela go ikobela ditumelano tsa dinaga tsa boditšhabatšhaba mmogo le melao e e tshwanetsweng go latelwa e e ka ga baagi ba ba tshabelang kwa dinageng tse dingwe eo naga ya Aforika Borwa e leng karolo ya dinaga tse di di saenetseng.

src: The progress report also signals an increase of the minimum employment equity target from 2% to 3% for persons with disabilities as from the 2024/2025 financial year, towards a minimum 7% employment equity target for persons with disabilities by 2030.
tgt: Pegelo ya Borataro ya Dikgatelopele tsa Ngwaga le Ngwaga ka ga go Tsenywa Tirisong Sekwalwa sa Masupatsela se se Buang ka Ditshwanelo tse Batho ba ba Nang le bogolofadi ba Nang le Tsona Kabinete e neseditse pula dikgato tsa go gatisa mo Lekwalong la Semmuso le le Gatisang Melao ya Puso Pegelo ya Borataro ya Dikgatelopele tsa Ngwaga le Ngwaga ka ga go Tsenywa Tirisong Sekwalwa sa Masupatsela se se Buang ka Ditshwanelo tse Batho ba ba Nang le bogolofadi ba Nang le Tsona Go phasaladiwa ga pegelo ya dikgatelopele eno go tla diragadiwa ka nako e le nngwe le ya go ketekiwa ga Kgwedi ya Bosetšhaba ya Temososetšhaba ka ga Ditshwanelo tsa Batho ba ba nang le Bogolofadi e e simololang ka la bo 03 Ngwanaitseele le go garela ka la bo 03 Sedimonthole.

src: Bills Draft African Renaissance and International Cooperation Fund (ARF) Bill Cabinet approved the submission of the ARF Amendment Bill to Parliament.
tgt: Melaotlhomo Sekwalwa se Iseng se Butswe sa Molaotlhomo yo o Kwalolotsweng Sešwa wa Letlole la Tirisano le Dinaga tsa Boditšhabatšhaba go Tsosolosa Aforika (ARF) Kabinete e neseditse pula dikgato tsa go isa kwa Palamentent Sekwalwa se Iseng se Butswe sa Molaotlhomo yo o Kwalolotsweng Sešwa wa ARMaitlhomo a Molaotlhomo ono ke go kwalola sešwa Molao wa ARF wa ngwaga wa 2000 (Molao wa bo 51 wa 2000) mmogo le go dira gore go tlhomiwe Setheo sa Aforika Borwa sa Badirisanimmogo go Tlisa Tlhabologo, mme sona se tla ema nokeng dikgato tsa naga ya Aforika Borwa tsa go go tlisa tlhabologo le go tlisa tirisanommogo magareng ga dinaga tse di dirisanang le Aforika Borwa ka go tlotlomatsa temokerasi, tsamaiso e e lolameng ya ditheo tsa puso, go thibela le go rarabolola dintwa, go thusana le ikonomi le baagi mmogo le go bopa setšhaba se e leng seoposengwe.

src: Appointments
tgt: Bao ba Thapilweng

src: All appointments are subject to the verification of qualifications and relevant clearance.
tgt: Pele batho botlhe ba thapiwa go tla tlhatlhobiwa makwalo a bona a dithuto le ditlankana dingwe tse di tlhokagalang.

src: Appointment of Mr Ebrahim Rasool as Chairperson of the Development Bank of Southern Africa.
tgt: Go thapiwa ga Rre Ebrahim Rasool go nna Monnasetulo wa Bankatlhabololo ya Dinaga tsa Borwa jwa Aforika.

src: Appointment of Ms Margaret Mosibudi Phiri as a member to the National Nuclear Regulator Board
tgt: Go thapiwa ga Mme Margaret Mosibudi Phiri go nna tokololo ya Setheo sa Taolo ya Motlakase wa Naga.

src: Upcoming Events Anti-Corruption Dialogue The Anti-Corruption Dialogue will be held on 8 and 9 November 2023 at Birchwood Hotel in Ekurhuleni to mobilise society in the fight against corruption in line with the country’s National Anti-Corruption Strategy Cabinet, in November 2020, approved the National Anti-Corruption Strategy (NACS 2020-2030).
tgt: Ditiragalo tse di Tlang Dipuisano ka ga go Lwantshana le Bonweenwee Dipuisano ka ga go Lwantshana le Bonweenwee di tla tshwarwa ka la bo 08 le la bo 09 Ngwanaitseele 2023 kwa Birchwood Hotel kwa Ekurhuleni mo go tla ngokelwang setšhaba gore se ipope ngatana se eme kgatlhanong le bonweenwee go ya ka Leano la Naga la go Ema Kgatlhanong le Bonweenwee (NACS 2020-2030).

src: This is a country strategy that is aimed at creating a corruption-free society while also encouraging citizens to have zero-tolerance for corruption and abide by the rule of law.
tgt: Leno ke leano la naga le maitlhomo a lona e leng go dira gore ka fa nageng go se tlhole go nna le bonweenwee e bile le rotloetsa baagi gore ba se tlhole ba itshokela bonweenwee mme ba ikobele melao.

src: 16 Days of Activism Campaign for No Violence Against Women and Children 2023 This year marks the 25th anniversary of South Africa’s participation in the 16 Days of Activism for No Violence against Women and Children Campaign which will be observed under the theme: “Accelerating actions to end Gender-Based Violence and Femicide (GBVF): Leaving no one behind”.
tgt: Letsholo la Ngwaga wa 2023 la Matsatsing a le 16 la go Ema Kgatlhanong le Tirisodikgoka mo Basading le mo Baneng Monongwaga ke Mokete wa bo 25 wa go keteka tseokarolo ya naga ya Aforika Borwa mo Letsholong la Matsatsing a le 16 la go Ema Kgatlhanong le Tirisodikgoka mo Basading le mo Baneng mme lona le tla ka ketekiwa ka molaetsamogolo yo o reng: “Go Oketsa Lebelo la go Tsaya Dikgato tsa go Fedisa Tirisodikgoka le Polao ya Basadi le Bana: Ga go Ope yo go Itlhokomoloswang Ene”.

src: This global campaign runs from 25 November, the International Day for the Elimination of Violence against Women to 10 December, International Human Rights Day.
tgt: Letsholo leno le tla simolola ka la bo 25 Ngwanaitseele, fa go tla bo go ketekiwa Letsatsi la Boditšhabatšhaba le Phediso ya Tirisodikgoka mo Basading mme le tla garelwa ka la bo 10 Sedimonthole, fa go tla bo go ketekiwa Letsatsi la Boditšhabatšhaba la Ditshwanelo tsa Batho.

src: It aims to combat violence against women whilst upholding human rights.
tgt: Maitlhomo a letsholo leno ke go lwantshana le tirisodikgoka mo basading fa ka fa letlhakoreng le lengwe le tsholetsa ditshwanelo tse batho ba nang le tsona.

src: 3 14th Policy Dialogue Forum South Africa will co-host the 14th Policy Dialogue Forum in collaboration with the UNESCO International Teacher Task Force for Education (TTF) in January 2024 under the theme “Addressing teacher shortages and making the profession more attractive”.
tgt: Kopano ya bo 14 ya go Buisana ka Pholisi Naga ya Aforika Borwa e tla tshwara Kopano ya bo 14 ya go Buisana ka Pholisi mmogo le Setlhopha sa Tiro sa Baromiwa ba Merero ya Barutabana Lefatshe ka Bophara (TTF) ba Mokgatlho wa Dinagakopano mo Mererong ya Thuto, Saense le Setso (UNESCO) ka Ferikgong 2024 ka molaetsamogolo yo o reng, “Go samagana le kgwetlho ya go tlhaela ga barutabana mmogo le go dira gore tiro eno e nne e e ngokelang”.

src: The forum will bring together government officials, NGOs, teachers and education experts to discuss critical issues pertaining to the conditions of service for teachers, issues of teacher autonomy and accountability as well as how to make teaching an attractive profession.
tgt: Foramo eno e tla tsenelwa ke batlhankedi ba puso, Mekgatlho e e sa Direng Letseno (di-NGO), barutabana mmogo le baitseanape mo mererong ya thuto mme ba tla bo ba tshwaraganetse kgetse ya tsie e e ka ga maemo mo ditirong tsa bona, go ikemela ka bobona jaaka barutabana mmogo le go rweswa maikarabelo mmogo le ka ga seo se ka diriwang go dira gore batho ba nne le lerato la go fisegela go ka nna barutabana.

src: Messages Congratulations
tgt: Melaetsa Melaetsa ya go Akgola

src: Cabinet extended its congratulations and well wishes to: The Proteas for securing a place in the semi-finals of the the ICC World Cup 2023 in India.
tgt: Setlhopha sa di-Protea jaaka se kgonne go phunyeletsa kwa makgaolakgannyeng kwa Metshamekong ya Sejana sa Lefatshe ya Kerikete e e tshamekelwang kwa nageng ya India.

src: Despite the setback in their match against India yesterday, the country remains firmly behind the team and is confident they will continue to build and make us proud.
tgt: Le fa se reteletswe ke go ka fopha setlhopha sa India maabane, setšhaba sa rona se tswelela go ba ema nokeng e bile se na le tshepo e e tletseng ya gore ba tla tswelela go dira bontle mo metshamekong ya bona le go re dira motlotlo.

src: Moto GP racing star Brad Binder who is now the outright premier class podium record holder for South Africa after his top three finish at the Thailand Grand Prix.
tgt: Moganka wa Metshameko ya Mabelo a Dijanaga ya Moto GP e bong Brad Binder yo ga jaanong e leng moganka wa maemo a a kwa godimo ka go se sute mo maemong a gagwe yo a emetseng naga ya Aforika Borwa morago ga gore a dire bontle kwa metshamekong ya Thailand Grand Prix.

src: South Africa’s first pro-wheelchair bodybuilder Macethandile Kulati for defending his title at the 2023 International Federation of Body Builders and Fitness World Championship in Slovenia.
tgt: Rra dikgoka wa moAforika Borwa wa ntlha wa metshameko ya batho ba ba tsamayang ka ditiloteti, e bong Macethandile Kulati, jaaka a santse a tshwere maemo a gagwe mo metshamekong ya ngwaga wa 2023 ya Dikgaisano tsa Boditšhabatšhaba tsa Batshameki ba Lefatshe ka Bophara ba Metshameko ya go Kuka Ditshipi le go Ikwetlisa e e neng e tshwaretswe kwa Slovenia.

src: South African Chartered Accountants for earning the top position in the Edelman global professional trust survey.
tgt: Batlhankedi ba Ditiro tsa Chartered Accountants jaaka ba fitlheletse maemo a a kwa godimo mo dipatlisisong tsa botshepegi mo tirong eno lefatshe ka bophara tsa Edelman.

src: Dr Claude Mashego for winning the inaugural Miss World South Africa and she will now represent South Africa at the Miss World in New Delhi, India in December this year.
tgt: Ngaka Claude Mashego jaaka a fentse dikgaisano tsa Aforika Borwa tsa Bommabontle ba Lefatshe mme o tla emela naga ya Aforika Borwa kwa dikgaisanong tsa Bommabontle ba Lefatshe tse di tla tshwarelwang kwa New Delhi, kwa India ka Sedimonthole monongwaga.

src: Advocate Kholeka Gcaleka following her appointment as the new Public Protector for a term of seven years with effect from 1 November 2023.
tgt: Moatefokate Kholeka Gcaleka jaaka a thapilwe go nna motlhankedi yo montšhwa yo a tla okamang maemo a Mosireletsi wa Setšhaba sebaka sa dingwaga di le supa go simolola ka la bo 01 Ngwanaitseele 2023.

src: Economic Recovery and Growth Quarterly Labour Force Survey (QLFS) Cabinet welcomes the 2023, 3rd quarter, QLFS results as released by Statistics South Africa that indicated employment figures have surpassed the pre-COVID-19 employment levels.
tgt: Merero ya ga Jaanong Tsosoloso le Kgolo ya Ikonomi Dipatlisiso tsa Kgweditharo tsa Dipalopalo tsa Badiri (QLFS) Kabinete e amogetse Pegelo ya kotara ya boraro ya ngwaga wa 2023 ya QLFS e e gololotsweng ke ba Setheo sa Dipatlisiso tsa Dipalopalo sa Aforika Borwa (StatsSA) e e bontshang gore dipalopalo tsa batho ba ba nang le ditiro di setse jaanong di tlhatlogile go feta le tseo di neng di le teng mo matsatsing a pele ga COVID-19.

src: Cabinet is pleased that all provinces but one have contributed to the 399 000 increase to the number of employed people to a total of 16,7 million people in employment in the 3rd quarter, compared to 16,3 million in the 2nd quarter of 2023.
tgt: Kabinete e itumedisiwa ke gore diporofense tsotlhe, ntle le e le esi fela, di dirile gore palo ya batho ba ba nang le ditiro e oketsege ka bokanaka 399 000 mo jaanong batho botlhe ba ba nang le ditiro ba leng kanaka dimilione di le 16,7 mo kotareng ya boraro, fa di bapisiwa le dimilione di le 16,3 mo kotareng ya bobedi mo ngwageng wa 2023.

src: The strong contributions to additional jobs of KwaZulu-Natal (up by 152 000), Limpopo (up by 70 000), North West (up by 61 000) and Mpumalanga, indicate the gradual but steady realisation of the goal of the Economic Reconstruction and Recovery Plan of rebuilding better, stronger and inclusively.
tgt: Go tlholegeng ga ditiro tseno tse di ka fitlhang go 152 000 kwa porofenseng ya KwaZulu-Natal, tse di ka fitlhang go 70 000 kwa porofenseng ya Limpopo, mmogo le tse di ka fitlhang go 61 000 kwa porofenseng ya Bokone Bophirima mmogo le ya Mpumalanga, go bontsha sentle gore maemo a ikonomi a a itharabologelwa ka iketlo mo go ageng sešwa ikonomi e e botoka, e e thatafetseng le e e direlang botlhe a ntse a itharabologelwa ka ntlha ya Leano la Itharabologelo le Kagosešwa ya Ikonomi.

src: Cabinet appreciates the continued and consistent contribution of the following sectors and industries: The formal sector employment increased by 287 000 whereas informal sector increased by 29 000 jobs Finance (this includes business services) up by 237 000 jobs Community and social services up by 119 000 jobs and agriculture by 61 000 jobs.
tgt: Mo lephateng la dikgwebo tse di kwadisitsweng semmuso dipalo tsa ditiro tse di tlhodilweng di oketsegile ka di le 287 000 fa mo lephateng le le sa kwadisiwang semmuso teng di oketsegile ka di le 29 000.

src: Cabinet also noted the negative impact the electricity and logistics constraints continued to have on the manufacturing, mining, transport and utilities.
tgt: Mo lephateng la tlamelo ya matlole (fano go buiwa gape le ka ditirelo tsa dikgwebo) teng go tlhatlogile ka diphatlhatiro di ka fitlhata go di le 237 000.

src: Cabinet is confident that noticeable progress will soon be visible in eradicating both load-shedding, and constraints within the freight and logistics industry.
tgt: Mo lephateng la baagi le thuso ya setšhaba teng go tlhatlogile ka diphatlhatiro di ka fitlhata go di le 119 000 fa mo lephateng la temothuo teng di tlhatlogile ka di le 61 000.

src: Cabinet is also pleased that despite remaining challenges, youth unemployment is gradually declining (a decrease of 1.9% from the previous quarter), and a 237 000 increase in the number of employed youth, rising to a total of six (6) million youth in employment.
tgt: Kabinete e nopotse gape le seabe se se sa jeseng diwelang seo dikgwetlho tsa motlakase le tsa dijanaga tse di rwalang dithoto di tswelelang go nna le tsona mo maphateng a tlhagisodikuno, meepo, dipalangwa le tse dingwe tse di botlhokwa.

src: Investments In the same trajectory of a recovering and growing economy, Cabinet welcomed the additional R5-billion investment by the Ford Motor Company for its new plug-in hybrid electric Ford Ranger that is earmarked for export to Europe, New Zealand and Australia.
tgt: Kabinete e na le tshepo e e tletseng ya gore kgatelopele e tla iponagatsa mo nakong e e sa fediseng pelo mo go fediseng ditiragalo tsa motlakase o o tshabetseng ruri mmogo le matsapa a a leng teng mo intasetering ya dijanaga tse di rwalang dithoto.

src: Cabinet further welcomed the investment by Procter & Gamble (P&G) in its new state-of-the-art production line of the Pampers Premium Care in Ekurhuleni, Gauteng.
tgt: Dipeeletso Mo ona maiteko ano a go tsosolosa le go godisa ikonomi, Kabinete e amogetse matlole a mangwe gape a a kana ka dibilione di le tlhano tsa diranta a a beeleditsweng ke Setlamo sa Dijanaga sa Ford jaaka se batla go tlisa sejanaga sa bona se sentšhwa sa motlakase se se tsamayang ka dibeteri sa Ford Ranger se go solofelwang gore se tla rekisediwa dinaga tsa Yuropa, New Zealand le Australia.

src: Both The Ford Motor Company and P&G project launches are testament of the valuable contribution of President Cyril Ramaphosa’s investment drive through the South Africa Investment Conference, and a reaffirmation of South Africa as an investment destination of choice.
tgt: Kabinete e amogetse gape le dipeeletso tse di dirilweng ke setlamo sa Procter & Gamble (P&G) mo femeng ya bona ya maemo a a kwa godimo ya Pampers Premium Care kwa Ekurhuleni, Gauteng.

src: South Africa’s red meat access to the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia Cabinet welcomed the signing of the red meat agreement with the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, during the Saudi-African Investment Summit.
tgt: Dipeeletso tsa ditlamo tseno ka bobedi e leng tsa Setlamo sa Dijanaga sa Ford mmogo le tsa porojeke ya P&G a bontsha botlhokwa jwa seabe seo Moporesitente Cyril Ramaphosa a nnileng le sona mo a tsereng matsapa a go batlana le babeeletsi kwa Khonferenseng ya Dipeeletso ya Naga ya Aforika Borwa mmogo le go totobaletsa babeeletsi gore naga ya Aforika Borwa ke lefelo le le siametseng dipeeletso tsa bona.

src: This agreement marks a critical step in ensuring that South African red meat products gain access to an important market, and further strengthens the contribution of the agricultural sector in both economic growth and job creation.
tgt: Go Rekisiwa ga Nama ya Kgomo kwa Nageng ya Bogosi ya Saudi Arabia Kabinete e amogetse dikgato tsa go saenela ditumelano tsa go rekisiwa ga nama ya kgomo kwa nageng ya Bogosi ya Saudi Arabia, fa go ne go tshwerwe Samiti ya Dipeeletso ya Dinaga tsa Saudi le tsa Aforika.

src: Cabinet congratulated Ministers Thoko Didiza and Ebrahim Patel for the work done to ensure the opening of this market for South African red meat products.
tgt: Kgato eno e botlhokwa thata mo go direng bonnete jwa gore ditlhagisiwa tsa nama ya kgomo tsa naga ya Aforika Borwa di letlelelwa go rekisediwa maraka o o botlhokwa ono, mmogo le mo go direng gore lephata la temothuo le kgone go godisa ikonomi le go tlhola ditiro.

src: Deliberate distortions of the Agri-Black Economic Empowerment (BEE) requirements for agricultural exports Cabinet condemned deliberate distortions by some sections of the media of the Agri-BEE requirements for agricultural exports to stoke racial tensions, and reminded the media that its freedom equally comes with responsibility.
tgt: Kabinete e akgotse Tona Thoko Didiza mmogo le Tona Ebrahim Patel ka tiro e ba e dirileng mo go direng bonnete jwa gore naga ya Aforika Borwa e bulelwe dikgoro tsa go rekisetsa maraka ono nama ya kgomo.

src: Cabinet expressed its appreciation to the agricultural industry, in particular the SA Wine and Agricultural Chamber of Business, commonly known as Agbiz, for rejecting attempts to plunge the country and the sector into racial tensions by publicly clarifying the distortions as soon as they were published.
tgt: Maaka a ka Bomo a a ka ga Ditlhokwa tsa go Ikobela Dikgato tsa Matlafatso ya Bathobantsho mo Mererong ya Ikonomi (BEE) mo go Rekisetseng Dinaga tsa kwa Ntle Ditlhagisiwa tsa Lephata la Temothuo.

src: Tourism Cabinet noted the partnership established between the Department of Tourism and Google as a game changer that will assist in promoting South Africa as a prime tourist destination.
tgt: Kabinete e kgalema ka mafoko a a bogale maaka a ka bomo a a dirilweng ke ditheo tsa bobegakgang a a ka ga ditlhokwa tsa go ikobela Dikgato tsa Matlafatso ya Bathobantsho mo Mererong ya Ikonomi mo go rekisetseng dinaga tsa kwa ntle ditlhagisiwa tsa lephata la temothuo mme maitlhomo a maaka ano ke fela go gotetsa ditlhobogano tsa semorafe mme e gakolola ditheo tsa bobegakgang gore kgololesego ya ditheo tseno ga e tsamaye e le esi, e tsamaya le maikarabelo.

src: The partnership aims, amongst others, to facilitate the use of digital tools to enhance tourism experiences and sustainability, including the commitment that Google Maps will use technology to avoid crime hotspots.
tgt: Kabinete e leboga intaseteri ya temothuo, segolobogolo ba SA Wine and Agricultural Chamber of Business, bao ba itsegeng thata ka gore ke ba Agbiz, jaaka ba eme kgatlhanong le seno ka maitlhomo a go se letlelele naga gore e gogagogane ka semorafe jaaka ba tsere dikgato ka bonako go supa fa seno e le maaka ka gang fela morago ga gore maaka ano a phasaladiwe.

src: Fight against crime and corruption Integrated Crime Fighting Cabinet welcomed the deployment of 3 300 members of the South African National Defence Force (SANDF), from 28 October 2023 until 28 April 2024, to support the South African Police Service (SAPS) and other law-enforcement agencies to deal with illegal mining in the country.
tgt: Lefoko la lona mo ntlheng eno le bontsha sentle gore le eme ka lefoko le le leng fela jaaka setlhopha sa naga sa di-Springbok, le eme ka le le reng Re na le Maatla Fa Fela Re le Ngatananngwe.

src: This deployment affirms government’s commitment to put an end to illegal mining and create conditions for inclusive growth and transformation of the economy.
tgt: Kabinete e nopotse tirisanommogo e e tlhomilweng magareng ga Lefapha la Bojanala mmogo le Setlamo sa Google jaaka selo se se tla fetolang dilo jaaka seno se tla dira gore naga ya Aforika Borwa e beewe kwa maemong a a kwa godimo jaaka lefelo le le gaisang le go ka jelwang nala kwa go lona.

src: The Ministers of the Justice, Crime Prevention and Security Cluster have provided progress with work underway to fight against crime, and the Minister of Police last week provided an update on the quarterly crime statistics.
tgt: Tirisanommogo eno magareng ga tse dingwe tse dintsi e tla dira gore tiriso ya dididirisiwa tsa thekenoloji e kgone go godisa bojanala le go somarela tlhago, mmogo le mo go diragatseng maikano a Google Maps a go dira gore thekenoloji e thuse bajanala gore ba se latlhwe ke leoto ba iphitlhele ba wetse mo ditseleng tse di itsegeng ka ditiragalo tse di tletseng botlhokotsebe.

src: These Bills cover areas such as public procurement, administrative reform, conduct of public servants, reform of intelligence services, money laundering and electoral reform.
tgt: Kgato eno e totobatsa maikano a puso a go fedisa gotlhelele ditiragalo tsa meepo tse di seng mo molaong le go dira gore maemo e nne a a edileng a a unngwelang botlhe mmogo le a a kgontshang ikonomi go fetoga.

src: The Asset Forfeiture Unit has been granted freezing orders worth R14 billion for state capture related cases and has recouped R.4 billion of the ill-gotten gains.
tgt: Ditona tsa Setlhopha sa Bosiamisi, Thibelobosenyi le Tshireletsego ba fane ka tshedimosetso e e mabapi le kgatelopele e e dirilweng mo go lwantshaneng le bosenyi, e bile gape mo bekeng e e fetileng Tona ya Mapodisi o abelane ka tshedimosetso ya go re baya mo dinakong ka Dipalopalo tsa Dikgetse tsa Bosenyi tsa Kotara e nngwe le e nngwe.

src: Fight against gender-based violence and femicide Cabinet condemned in the strongest terms the stabbing of a female Cape Peninsula University of Technology student, by her husband.
tgt: Kabinete e itumeletse Dipuisano tsa Naga tse di tshwerweng ka katlego tsa Lekgotlha la Naga la Dikeletso mo Mererong ya go Ema Kgatlhanong le Bonweenwee tse mo go tsona go neng go atlhaatlhiwa kgatelopele e e setseng e dirilwe mo go tsenyeng tirisong Leano la Naga la go Ema Kgatlhanong le Bonweenwee mmogo le ditshitshinyo tse di dirilweng mo pegelong ya Khomišene ya Diphuruphutso Mabapi le go Goga Puso ka Nko.

src: Cabinet calls on society to work together with government to eliminate gender-based violence whilst law-enforcement agencies continue to bring perpetrators of such callous acts to justice.
tgt: Kgatelopele e e dirilweng e tsenyeletsa go diragadiwa ga ditshitshinyo di le robedi mo go di le 16 tse di ka ga go kwalola sešwa melao gore e kgone go samagana le ditshitshinyo tse di rileng tse di dirilweng ke Khomišene ya Diphuruphutso Mabapi le go Goga Puso ka Nko mme melao eno ga jaana e atlhaatlhwa ke palamente.

src: Death of children due to malnutrition Cabinet noted with concern the reported deaths of children due to malnutrition as reported by the South African Human Rights Commission.
tgt: Melaotlhomo eno ke e e buang ka maphata a a jaaka a dithendara tsa puso, tsamaiso ya phetolo ya batsholateu, maitsholo a badiredipuso ba tshwanetseng go nna nao, phetolo ya ditheo tsa tirelo ya twantsho ya bosenyi, ditiragalo tsa go timetsa motlhala wa tšhelete ya bogodu mmogo le go fetola tsamaiso ya ditlhopho.

src: Cabinet wishes to remind members of the community about government support programmes such as the Child Support Grant which is aimed at assisting families to meet the basic needs of children.
tgt: Yuniti ya Thopo ya Dithoto dikopo tsa yona tsa go rebolelwa taelo ya kgotlatshekelo ya go tswalela tiriso ya dithoto tsa batho ba go belaelwang ba amegang mo mofetshong wa bosenyi di amogetswe ke kgotlatshekelo mme dithoto tse di ka balelwang go dibilione tsa diranta di le 14 mo melatong e e tsamaelang le ya go goga puso ka nko mme e bile gape e kgonne go dira gore madi a le kanaka dibilione tsa diranta di le a a neng a tserwe go se mo molaong a busediwe.

src: This is in addition to the comprehensive Social Assistance Programme through which government provides healthy meals to vulnerable households through the National School Nutrition Programme and Community Nutrition and development centres.
tgt: Mo godimo ga tseno tsotlhe, Kantoro ya Mokaedi wa Dipatlisiso e setse e tlhatlhetse kwa kgotlatshekelo dikgetse di le 34 tse di tsamaisanang le ditiragalo tsa go goga puso ka nko, mme mo go tsona go na le balatofadiwa ba le 205.

src: At the centre of Gauteng’s water challenges is water losses caused by old municipal infrastructure and deficiencies in water leakage monitoring and efficient repairs.
tgt: Go Agiwa ga Mafaratlhatlha Motlakase Tona ya Merero ya Motlakase mo Kantorong ya Moporesitente o buile go tlala molomo ka maemo a motlakase ka fa nageng mmogo le ka kgatelopele e e dirilweng mo go direng gore re se tlhaele motlakase.. Go se Felelwe ke Metsi.

src: SA Connect Phase Two Cabinet received and considered an update report on the implementation of the SA Connect Phase 2 Project.
tgt: Kabinete e itumedisitswe ke dipegelo tse di reng dikgogakgogano tse di ntseng di le teng magareng ga tse di dirileng gore go nne le tshalelomorago mo go tsenyeng tirisong porojeke ya Letamo la Mzimvubu di rarabolotswe mme tlhatlhobo ya lefelo e simolotse ka Ngwanaitseele, mme dipuisano magareng ga magosi mabapi le ka ga ka fao baagi ba tla amegang di tsweletse.

src: SA Connect is a flagship programme of government that seeks to bridge the digital divide by connecting households and government institutions and provide Wi-Fi access to communities across the country.
tgt: Kabinete e nopoletswe gore go tsweletswe ka tiro ya go godisiwa ga dipota tsa Letamo la Clanwilliam gore le kgone go ka boloka metsi a a kanaka dimitara tsa dikhubiki di le dimilione di le 344 go fepa metsi kwa baaging ba Masepala wa Tikologo wa West Coast, ba Masepaleng wa Selegae wa Cederberg mmogo le ba Masepaleng wa Selegae wa Matzikama.

src: On progress with Phase 2 of the project, Cabinet was pleased that 1 000 households were connected with broadband and that 1 000 community Wi-Fi hotspots are planned to be installed by December 2023.
tgt: Kabinete e tsopoletswe gore go agiwa ga Letamo la Tzaneen go simolotswe gape ka Seetebosigo 2023, mme go lebeletswe gore tiro eno e tla garela ka Moranang 2025.

src: In addition, the project has rolled out infrastructure for Internet connectivity that allows households to access the Internet at cheaper rates.
tgt: Kabinete e tsopoletswe gore setlhopha se se golaganeng sa batlhankedi ba mebasepala ya diteropokgolo e le meraro e bong wa Ekurhuleni, Joburg le wa Tshwane mmogo le ba Setlamo sa Rand Water ba tswelela go kopana letsatsi le lengwe le le lengwe go atlhaatlhaa mabaka a a dirang gore go nne le dikgwetlho tsa metsi.

src: It is estimated that the project will also contribute to economic participation through the provision of 4 505 semi-skilled and 169 skilled employment opportunities, and will support over 75 small to medium-sized companies.
tgt: Mabapi le kgatelopele e e setseng e dirilwe mo Kgatong ya Bobedi ya porojeke eno, Kabinete e itumedisitswe ke gore go setse go gokeletswe malapa a le 1 000 mo porotebenteng mme go logwa maano a go tsenyetsa baagi mafelo a di Wi-Fi a feta a le 1 000 mo Sedimontholeng wa 2023.

src: In addition, high demand spectrum will be provided to more than 18 000 schools, 943 libraries, 5 731 health facilities and 8 241 tribal authorities over the next months through the social obligations to telecommunications companies.
tgt: Mo godimo ga seno, porojeke eno e thankgolotse mafaratlhatlha a inthanete gore malapa a golaganngwe le go dira gore inthanete e se ba turele.

src: It is anticipated that the project will deliver connectivity to more than five million households and 32 000 community Wi-Fi hotspots across the country over the next 36 months.
tgt: Ka R249 ka kgwedi lelapa le le ikwadiseditseng go tsenyetswa inthanete le tla kgona go reka datha e e sa feleng kgwedi yotlhe, mme datha ya R5 ka letsatsi e ka kgona go ba rekela datha e e kanaka ghiki o le mong.

src: As of 23 July 2023, all 123 analogue transmitters above 694 Megahertz were switched off in the remaining four provinces namely the Eastern Cape, KwaZulu-Natal, Western Cape and Gauteng.
tgt: Go lebeletswe gape le gore porojeke eno e tla re tswela mosola mo ikonoming jaaka e tla tlholela batho ba ba nang le bokgoni jo bonnye ba le 4 505 ditiro mmogo le go tlholela ba le 169 ba ba nang le bokgoni ditiro, mme e bile gape e tla ema nokeng dikgwebopotlana le tse dikgolonyana di le Mo godimo ga seno, dikolo di le 18 000, dilaeborari di le 943, maokelo a le 5 731 mmogo le dikgotla di le 8 241 mo dikgweding tse di tlang mafelo ano a tla tlamelwa ka marang a kgaso a a dirisiwang ka bontsi mme seno se tla diriwa go ya ka maikano a go thusa baagi a a dirilweng ke ditlamo tsa mafaratlhatlha a ditlhaeletsano.

src: Municipal Cleaning and Greening Programme Cabinet encourages South Africans to join the programme to keep our country clean and free from litter by participating in the municipal cleaning and greening initiatives taking place across the country.
tgt: Lenaaneng la Phetolelokgaso go ya go ya Dijithale Kabinete e nopotse kgatelopele e naga eno e tsweletseng go e dira mo go tsweng mo kgasong ya analoko go tseneng mo go ya dijithale.

src: The programme which has already created more than 37 000 work opportunities is aimed at clearing the 7 251 illegal dumping hotspots in communities across the country.
tgt: Fa e sale ka la bo 23 Phukwi 2023, dikgaso tsotlhe tse di gasang ka marang a kgaso a analoko mo marang a teng a sa feteng di-mekahetse di le 694 di ne tsa timiwa mo diporofenseng tseo di neng di saletse kwa morago mme tsona ke porofense ya Kapa Botlhaba,KwaZulu-Natal, Kapa Bophirima mmogo le Gauteng.

src: This involves the daily cleaning of streets, clearing illegal dumping sites, cleaning coastal areas and the revitalisation of parks.
tgt: Seno se tla lokolola sekgala se se tlhokagalang sa porotebente ya megala ya seatla le go kgontsha didirisiwa tse dingwe tsa thekenoloji ya ditlhaeletsano le tshedimosetso go ka nna le sekgala.

src: Capacity of the State Improved National and Provincial Audit Outcomes (2022/23 financial year) Cabinet was briefed by the Auditor-General of South Africa (AGSA) non the outcomes of the 2022/23 financial year national and provincial audits.
tgt: Kabinete e nopoletswe gore Tona ya Ditlhaeletsano le Mafaratlhatlha a Thekenoloji o ne a dira boikano jwa gore e tla re ka Sedimonthole 2024 ga garelwa kgato ya bofelelo ya go tima dikgaso tsotlhe tsa analoko, mme mo ntlheng eno go na le tema e e diriwang e bile letlha leno le santse le eme fela jalo.

src: The AGSA pointed out to encouraging trend of continuous improved performance which indicates overall improvement in accountability, transparency, adequacy and effectiveness of controls.
tgt: Letsholo la Dimasepala la go Phepafatsa le go Jala Kabinete e ikuela mo go maAforika Borwa go nna le seabe mo letsholong la go dira gore naga e phepafadiwe le go nna e le phepa ka go tsenya letsogo mo letsholong la go phepafatsa le go jala le le tla diragadiwang naga ka bophara.

src: Although challenges still remain, the outcomes of the 2022/23 national and provincial governments audits dispel claims that State capacity is in total collapse, with independent and objective assessment by institutions such as the AGSA indicating a very strong and continuous improvement trajectory.
tgt: Kabinete e ne ya tsiboswa ke Setheo sa Kantoro ya Moruni yo Mogolo wa Aforika Borwa (AGSA) ka dipholo tsa ngwaga wa matlole wa 2022/23 tsa ditheo tsa puso ya naga le ditheo tsa mebuso ya diporofense.

src: International Relations – State Visit to Qatar Last week, President Cyril Ramaphosa concluded a State Visit to Qatar at the invitation of His Highness Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani, Amir of the State of Qatar.
tgt: AGSA e nopotse dikgato tse di tiisang mmoko tse di bontshang tokafalo e e ntseng e nna gone mo go bontshang gore mo ditheong tsotlhe go simolola go nna le thwalo ya maikarabelo, botshepegi, botswapelo le dikgato tsa taolo tse di tswileng diatla.

src: It is because of these continued atrocities that are being committed with impunity by the Israeli Government with the support and protection of powerful countries, that on 17 November 2023, South Africa – together with the Comoros, Djibouti, Bolivia and Bangladesh – jointly referred the situation in Palestine and Israel to the International Criminal Court (ICC).
tgt: Le fa go santse go na le dikgwetlho tse dintsi, dipholo tsa boruni tsa ngwaga wa 2022/23 ka ditheo tsa puso ya naga le mebuso ya diporofense di ganetsana le dipuopuo tsa gore puso e gosomela ka mogoso, mme ditheo tse di sa tseyeng letlhakore tse ditlhatlhobo tsa tsona di senang diphitlhela tse di jaaka AGSA di bontsha tokafalo e e boitshegang e e tswelelang go nna teng.

src: Our ambassador in the Hague delivered the referral in person, which asked the ICC to investigate the commission of war crimes, crimes against humanity and genocide with a view to holding those most responsible accountable.
